Hindi me hum "tez baarish", "tez chai", "tez bukhaar" — sabke liye ek "tez" bol dete hain. English me har noun ka apna adjective hai. Yahi jodiyan sabse zyada pakdi jaati hain.

Figure 37.3. Expensive price bahut aam galti hai — price khud mehngi nahi hoti, high hoti hai. Cheez expensive hoti hai: an expensive phone .
  • There was heavy traffic because of the heavy rain. Traffic aur baarish dono "heavy" — "zyada" ke liye.
  • She has a high fever, so she's in deep sleep now. Bukhaar "high", neend "deep".
  • I need a cup of strong tea and some fresh air. Kadak chai = strong tea. Taazi hawa = fresh air.

'Tez' ke chhah roop

heavy rain / traffic · strong tea / coffee / wind · high fever / price / temperature · deep sleep. Hindi ka ek "tez" English me noun dekh kar badalta hai. "big rain", "big fever", "expensive price" — teeno se bacho.

docs.title: 37.5 Verb + preposition — depend on, listen to
docs.text:
Kuch verb apne saath ek khaas preposition laate hain — aur galat preposition se matlab badal bhi sakta hai. Inhe ek shabd ki tarah yaad karo: depend-on, listen-to.

Jodi Example Suno depend on It depends on the weather. listen to Listen to me carefully. wait for I'm waiting for the bus. agree with (insaan) I agree with you. agree to (prastaav) They agreed to our plan. apologise for I apologise for the delay. look forward to + -ing I look forward to meeting you. believe in She believes in hard work.

Jinke saath kuch nahi lagta

Kuch verbs ke baad koi preposition nahi: discuss the plan, enter the room, reach Delhi, marry someone, answer the question. "discuss about", "reach at", "answer to the question" — teeno galat. Aur "look forward to" ke baad -ing: "looking forward to meeting you", "to meet you" nahi.

docs.title: 37.6 Bolne wale verbs — say, tell, speak, talk
docs.text:
Charon ka matlab "bolna/kehna" hai, par jodi alag-alag. Yahin "say a lie" aur "tell me sorry" jaisi galtiyan janam leti hain. Sabse pehle say aur tell ka dhaancha samjho.

Figure 37.4. Tell ke baad seedha insaan aata hai (told me ). Say ke baad insaan chahiye to to lagao (said hello to me ).
  • Always tell the truth, even when it's hard. Sach "tell" hota hai — aur jhooth bhi: tell a lie.
  • He said sorry and told us what happened. say sorry · tell + us + baat.
  • Do you speak Tamil? Let's talk about it later. Bhasha "speak" hoti hai; kisi vishay par "talk about".

say vs tell

tell + insaan (tell me, tell her) — aur hamesha tell the truth / a lie / a story / a joke. say + baat (say hello, say sorry, say thank you) — insaan chahiye to say … to me. Bhasha speak hoti hai, vishay par talk about.

docs.title: 37.7 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Ye jodiyan India me itni aam hain ki sahi lagne lagti hain. Par client call, interview ya IELTS me yahi chhoti jodiyan aapki English ko "translated" bana deti hain.

Collocation ki aam galtiyan

  • Galat: I did a big mistake.
  • Sahi: I made a big mistake.

  • Kyun: Galti hamesha make hoti hai. "Do" kaam ke liye hai.

  • Galat: My son has big fever.

  • Sahi: My son has a high fever.

  • Kyun: Bukhaar ka number hota hai, isliye wo high hota hai. Aur "a" mat bhoolo: a high fever.

  • Galat: Don't say a lie.

  • Sahi: Don't tell a lie.

  • Kyun: Jhooth aur sach dono tell hote hain: tell a lie, tell the truth.

  • Galat: I gave my exam yesterday.

  • Sahi: I took my exam yesterday. / I sat my exam yesterday.

  • Kyun: Student exam take karta hai. "Give an exam" bahar teacher ka kaam lagta hai.

  • Galat: Please close the light.

  • Sahi: Please switch off the light. / Please turn off the light.
  • Kyun: "Light band karo" ka anuvaad. Light, fan, TV switch on / switch off hote hain; darwaaza close hota hai.

Ye bhi dhyaan do — aur ek achhi khabar

eat medicine → take medicine · do a party → have / throw a party · strong rain → heavy rain. Achhi khabar: take a decision bilkul sahi hai (British aur Indian English), aur make a decision bhi — dono me se koi bhi bolo.

docs.title: 37.8 Collocation kaise seekhein — shabd ka jaal banao
docs.text:
Collocation ka koi formula nahi, isliye tareeka hi sab kuch hai. Har naye zaroori noun ke chaaron taraf uske saathi likho — kaunse verb, kaunse adjective, kaunsa preposition. Ek jaal, ek page.

Figure 37.5. We need to reach a final decision on the budget. — jaal ke teen hisse ek hi vaakya me.

Roz ki teen aadatein

1. Padhte waqt shabd nahi, jodi underline karo — "heavy traffic", "made a decision". 2. Notebook me har noun ka chhota jaal banao, upar jaisa. 3. Shak ho to jodi ko quotes me search karo — "big fever" vs "high fever" — jo zyada mile, wahi natural.

docs.title: 37.9 Practice — Collocations
docs.text:
Exercise 1

I need to ___ a phone call to the bank.

  • make
  • do
  • give
  • say
Jawaab

make

Phone call 'make' hoti hai — kuch naya paida karna. 'Give me a call' bhi chalta hai, par call karne wala 'makes a call'.

Exercise 2

We had very ___ rain last night.

  • heavy
  • strong
  • big
  • high
Jawaab

heavy

Baarish 'heavy' hoti hai. 'Strong' hawa ke liye (strong wind), 'big rain' bilkul nahi.

Exercise 3

My son has a ___ fever. I'm taking him to the doctor.

  • high
  • big
  • heavy
  • strong
Jawaab

high

Bukhaar ka number hota hai — isliye 'high fever', jaise high temperature, high price.

Exercise 4

Can you do me a ___? Please pick up my parcel.

Hint: Ehsaan — 'do' ki pakki jodi.

Jawaab

favour / favor

'Do someone a favour' = kisi par ehsaan karna. Favour 'do' hota hai, 'make' nahi.

Exercise 5

It depends ___ the weather.

Hint: depend ke saath kaunsa preposition?

Jawaab

on

Hamesha 'depend on' — 'depend upon' bhi sahi hai par purana lagta hai. 'depend of' galat.

Exercise 6

Is vaakya me galat verb par tap karo.

I did a big mistake in the exam.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: did.

Sahi roop: I made a big mistake in the exam.

Galti hamesha 'make' hoti hai — make a mistake.

Exercise 7

Ek shabd galat jodi bana raha hai — dhoondo.

Never say a lie to your parents.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: say.

Sahi roop: Never tell a lie to your parents.

Jhooth aur sach 'tell' hote hain — tell a lie, tell the truth.

Exercise 8

Verb ko uski pakki jodi se milao.

A B make a photo do a speech take a mistake give your homework Jawaab

make — a mistake; do — your homework; take — a photo; give — a speech

make = paida karna, do = kaam, take a photo, give a speech — inhe jodi me hi yaad karo.

Exercise 9

Adjective ko sahi noun se milao.

A B heavy temperature strong sleep high traffic deep coffee Jawaab

heavy — traffic; strong — coffee; high — temperature; deep — sleep

Hindi ka 'tez/zyada' English me noun dekh kar badalta hai — heavy traffic, strong coffee, high temperature, deep sleep.

Exercise 10

Sahi kram me lagao — email ki aakhri line.

Shabd: forward / you / I / to / meeting / looking / am

Jawaab

I am looking forward to meeting you

'look forward to' ke baad -ing: meeting. 'to meet you' yahan galat hai.

Exercise 11

Ye vaakya bolo — do pakki jodiyan ek saath.

Jawaab

Bolo: I made a mistake, but I told the truth

make a mistake + tell the truth. 'made a' ko jodkar bolo — 'mei-da'.

Aage kya karein

Is hafte ek "jodi diary" rakho. Roz jo bhi English padho ya suno, usme se teen jodiyan likho. Mahine ke ant tak nabbe jodiyan — aur unme se aadhi aapki zubaan par hongi.

docs.title: Chapter 42: Milte-julte shabd
docs.text:
Milte-julte shabd — jo roz dhokha dete hain

Kuch shabd judwa bhaiyon jaise hain — dikhte ek jaise, sunai ek jaise, par kaam bilkul alag. loose aur lose, then aur than, your aur you're — ye galtiyan padhe-likhe logon ki emails me bhi roz dikhti hain. Spell-check bhi nahi pakadta, kyonki dono shabd sahi hain — bas galat jagah par. Is chapter me solah jode hain, samajhdaari se guchhon me baante hue, aur har guchhe ke saath ek yaad rakhne ki trick.

docs.title: 42.1 Teen tarah ke jode — pehle pehchaano
docs.text:
Har confusion ki jad alag hoti hai, isliye ilaaj bhi alag. Pehle ye pehchaano ki jodi kis tarah ki hai — aadha kaam wahin ho jaata hai.

Figure 42.1. Pehla guchha likhte waqt pakadta hai, doosra padhte waqt, aur teesra bolte waqt — kyonki Hindi me ek hi shabd dono kaam karta hai.

Kaise padhein

Ek baar me ek guchha. Har jode ki trick zor se bolo, phir apna ek vaakya banao. Trick yaad rahi to jodi kabhi nahi ulajhegi.

docs.title: 42.2 Apostrophe wale — its/it's, your/you're, their/there/they're
docs.text:
Ye sabse aam likhit galti hai — WhatsApp se lekar office email tak. Bolte waqt koi fark nahi padta, kyonki aawaaz ek hai. Par likhte waqt ek chhota sa apostrophe poora matlab badal deta hai.

Figure 42.2. Apostrophe ek patch hai jo gayab akshar ki jagah lagta hai. Patch hai to khol ke padho. Shabd Matlab Example it's / its it is / uska (cheez ka) It's raining. · The phone lost its charge. you're / your you are / aapka You're late. · Is this your seat? they're they are They're coming at six. their unka Their car is new. there wahan / "hai" (there is) Put it over there. · There is a problem.

Khol ke padho

Apostrophe = gayab akshar. "it's" ko "it is", "you're" ko "you are", "they're" ko "they are" bana ke padho — vaakya sahi baithe to apostrophe, na baithe to bina apostrophe wala (its / your / their). "Your welcome" → "You are welcome"? Haan! To "You're welcome".

docs.title: 42.3 Ek aawaaz, do spelling — stationary/stationery, principal/principle
docs.text:
Ye do jode bilkul ek jaise bole jaate hain — sirf ek akshar ka fark hai. Isliye inke liye aawaaz nahi, tasveer wali trick kaam karti hai.

Figure 42.3. Ek akshar, ek tasveer. A = khadi car, E = lifafa, PAL = insaan, LE = rule.
  • The bus was stationary, so I bought some stationery from the shop nearby. Bus ruki hui thi, to maine paas ki dukaan se pen-copy le li.
  • Our principal never breaks her principles. Hamari principal madam apne usool kabhi nahi todti.
  • The principal reason was cost. "principal" adjective bhi hai = sabse mukhya. Isme bhi -al.

Ek akshar, ek tasveer

stationAry = At rest (ruka hua) · stationEry = Envelope (pen-kaagaz). principAL = insaan / mukhya ("your PAL") · principLE = usool (ruLE).

docs.title: 42.4 Noun ya verb — affect/effect, advice/advise
docs.text:
In do jodon me ek shabd kaam (verb) hai aur doosra cheez (noun). Vaakya me dekho ki wahan verb chahiye ya noun — jawaab khud mil jaayega.

Figure 42.4. Pehle Action (affect), phir End result (effect) — alphabet me bhi A pehle aata hai, E baad me. Shabd Kya hai Example Suno affect verb — asar daalna Stress can affect your sleep. effect noun — asar, nateeja The medicine had a quick effect. advice noun — salaah (s ki aawaaz) Can I give you some advice? advise verb — salaah dena (z ki aawaaz) I advise you to wait.

A = Action, -ice = cheez

Affect = Action (verb), Effect = End result (noun). Advice ice jaisi ek cheez hai (noun, "s" ki aawaaz); advise ek kaam hai (verb, "z" ki aawaaz). Aur advice ginti nahi hoti: "some advice", "a piece of advice" — "an advice" ya "advices" nahi.

docs.title: 42.5 Ek akshar ka farq — lose/loose, quite/quiet, then/than, accept/except
docs.text:
In jodon me ek akshar idhar-udhar hota hai, aur padhte waqt aankh use chhod deti hai. Har jodi ki ek chhoti trick hai — trick ko shabd ke saath jodo, matlab apne aap aa jaayega.

Figure 42.5. Samay ki line par then , taraazu par than . Jodi Matlab Trick lose / loose khona, haarna / dheela lose ne ek "o" kho diya. loose me "oo" — dheela, jagah zyada. quite / quiet kaafi / shaant quite = ek syllable (kwait). qui-et = do syllable (kwai-yet) — shaanti me dheere bolo. then / than phir / se (tulna) thEn = timE, thAn = compArison. accept / except sweekar karna / ke alawa accept = apnaana. except = exit — bahar rakhna.
  • These jeans are too loose. I must have lost weight! loose = "loos" (s ki aawaaz), lose = "looz" (z ki aawaaz). Bolne me bhi farq hai.
  • The library is quite big, and it's always quiet. Kaafi bada, aur hamesha shaant.
  • I accept all the changes except the last one. Saare badlaav manzoor, aakhri wale ko chhod kar.

Chaar tricks

lose ne ek "o" kho diya (khona) · loose = dheela · quiet = do syllable, shaant · quite = kaafi · thEn = timE · thAn = compArison · except = exit (bahar), accept = apnaana.

docs.title: 42.6 Disha wale jode — borrow/lend, bring/take, say/tell
docs.text:
Hindi me "lena-dena" aur "laana-le jaana" alag shabd hain — phir bhi English me ye ulajh jaate hain, kyonki hum "udhaar" ya "le aao" jaise ek shabd se sochte hain. Yahan sawaal hai: cheez kis taraf ja rahi hai?

Figure 42.6. Ek hi kitaab, do nazariye: dene wala lend karta hai, lene wala borrow . Aur aap jahan ho, wahi tay karta hai bring ya take.
  • Could you lend me your pen? / Could I borrow your pen? Dono sahi — par "Can you borrow me…" kabhi nahi. Saamne wala dega = lend.
  • Please bring your ID card tomorrow, and take the old one home. Yahan (office) laao = bring. Ghar le jao = take.
  • She told me the news and said it was a secret. tell + insaan (told me), say + baat (said it was…). "She said me" galat.

Cheez kis taraf ja rahi hai?

lend = dena, borrow = lena (lend to, borrow from). bring = bolne wale ki taraf, take = usse door. tell ke baad insaan (tell me), say ke baad baat (say something).

docs.title: 42.7 Ginti aur rakhna — fewer/less, lie/lay
docs.text:
Ye do jode sabse "advanced" lagte hain, par niyam seedha hai. fewer/less me sawaal hai: gin sakte ho? Aur lie/lay me: koi cheez rakhi ja rahi hai, ya aap khud let rahe ho?

Figure 42.7. Gol-gol log gine ja sakte hain → fewer. Paani beh jaata hai, gina nahi jaata → less. Verb Matlab Aaj Kal (past) Kar chuka lie letna lie · lying lay lain lay (kuch) rakhna, bichhaana lay · laying laid laid lie jhooth bolna lie · lying lied lied
  • I'm tired. I'm going to lie down for a bit. Khud letna = lie. Iske baad koi cheez nahi aati.
  • Please lay the files on my desk. Kuch rakhna = lay + cheez (the files).
  • There were fewer cars today, so it took less time. Cars gin sakte ho → fewer. Time nahi → less.

Gin sakte ho? Kuch rakh rahe ho?

fewer + jo gin sakte ho (fewer people), less + jo nahi gin sakte (less water). lay ke baad hamesha koi cheez (lay the table); lie ke baad nahi (lie down). Sabse bada jaal: lie ka past "lay" hai — "Yesterday I lay in bed all day."

docs.title: 42.8 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Ye saari galtiyan asli emails, WhatsApp messages aur class ki copies se li gayi hain. Inme se ek bhi aapki aadat me hai, to aaj hi use pakdo.

Milte-julte shabdon ki aam galtiyan

  • Galat: Can you borrow me your charger?
  • Sahi: Can you lend me your charger? / Can I borrow your charger?

  • Kyun: Dene wala lend karta hai, lene wala borrow. "Borrow me" kabhi nahi.

  • Galat: I don't want to loose this chance.

  • Sahi: I don't want to lose this chance.

  • Kyun: Khona = lose (ek o). Loose = dheela — "loose shirt".

  • Galat: The new rule will effect everyone.

  • Sahi: The new rule will affect everyone.

  • Kyun: "will ___ everyone" me verb chahiye → Affect = Action.

  • Galat: My brother is taller then me.

  • Sahi: My brother is taller than me.

  • Kyun: Tulna (taller) ke baad than. "then" sirf samay ke liye.

  • Galat: Your welcome!

  • Sahi: You're welcome!
  • Kyun: Khol ke padho: "You are welcome" — fit hai, to you're.

docs.title: 42.9 Practice — Milte-julte shabd
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Shabd ko uske kaam se jodo.

A B affect verb — salaah dena effect noun — salaah advise verb — asar daalna advice noun — asar, nateeja Jawaab

affect — verb — asar daalna; effect — noun — asar, nateeja; advise — verb — salaah dena; advice — noun — salaah

A = Action (affect, verb), E = End result (effect, noun). Advice ek cheez hai (noun), advise ek kaam (verb).

Exercise 2

Ek akshar ka farq — sahi matlab se jodo.

A B stationery pradhan, sabse mukhya stationary usool principal pen, paper, file principle ruka hua Jawaab

stationery — pen, paper, file; stationary — ruka hua; principal — pradhan, sabse mukhya; principle — usool

E = Envelope (stationery), A = At rest (stationary). The principal is your PAL; principLE = ruLE.

Exercise 3

Is vaakya me galat shabd par tap karo.

Can you borrow me your charger for an hour?

Jawaab

Galat shabd: borrow.

Sahi roop: Can you lend me your charger for an hour?

Saamne wala dega, to wo 'lend' karega. Aap lete ho to 'Can I borrow…?'

Exercise 4

Spelling ka dhokha dhoondo.

I don't want to loose my job.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: loose.

Sahi roop: I don't want to lose my job.

Khona = lose (ek o). Loose = dheela.

Exercise 5

Apostrophe galat jagah hai — us shabd par tap karo.

The dog wagged it's tail happily.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: it's.

Sahi roop: The dog wagged its tail happily.

Khol ke padho: 'wagged it is tail'? Fit nahi — to bina apostrophe: its = uska.

Exercise 6

I think ___ going to be late. The traffic is terrible.

  • they're
  • their
  • there
  • them
Jawaab

they're

Khol ke dekho: 'I think they are going to be late' — fit hai, to they're.

Exercise 7

Everyone came to the party ___ Rahul. He was ill.

  • except
  • accept
  • expect
  • excuse
Jawaab

except

except = ke alawa (ex = exit, bahar rakhna). accept = sweekar karna.

Exercise 8

Please ___ the baby gently on the bed.

  • lay
  • lie
  • lied
  • lain
Jawaab

lay

Kisi cheez ya insaan ko rakhna = lay + object (lay the baby). Khud letna = lie.

Exercise 9

There are ___ people here than yesterday.

Hint: People gine ja sakte hain.

Jawaab

fewer

Gin sakte ho → fewer. 'less people' bahut aam galti hai; less sirf uncountable ke liye (less water).

Exercise 10

Please be ___. The baby is sleeping.

Hint: Shaant — do syllable wala shabd.

Jawaab

quiet

quiet (kwai-yet) = shaant. quite (kwait) = kaafi.

Exercise 11

Sahi kram me lagao.

Shabd: our / rain / heavy / will / affect / The / plans

Jawaab

The heavy rain will affect our plans

'will ___ our plans' me verb chahiye — affect (A = Action).

Exercise 12

Ye polite request bolo.

Jawaab

Bolo: Could I borrow your pen, please

Aap le rahe ho → borrow. 'borrow' me zor pehle hisse par: BOR-row.

Aage kya karein

Apni pichhli das emails ya messages kholo aur sirf teen cheezein dhoondo: your/you're, its/it's, then/than. Jo galti mile, use is chapter ki trick ke saath ek baar dobara likho.

docs.title: Chapter 23: If wale vaakya
docs.text:
If wale vaakya — shart aur nateeja

Conditional vaakya ka matlab hai: agar ye, to wo. Hindi me hum roz bolte hain — "agar baarish hogi to match nahi hoga". English me chaar tarah ke "if" vaakya hote hain, aur unme farq sirf ek cheez ka hai: baat kitni sambhav hai. Pakki baat, ho sakne waali baat, mushkil baat, aur wo baat jo ab kabhi nahi ho sakti. Chaar tarah ki sambhaavna, chaar formula. Aur ek sunehra rule jo sab se zyada toota jaata hai: "if" ke baad "will" kabhi nahi.

Ek line me

A conditional sentence has two parts: the if-clause (shart) and the main clause (nateeja). Kram badla ja sakta hai. Agar "if" wala hissa pehle aaye to beech me comma lagta hai; baad me aaye to comma nahi.

  • If it rains, we will stay home. If pehle aaya — comma laga.
  • We will stay home if it rains. If baad me aaya — comma nahi. Matlab bilkul wahi hai.

docs.title: 23.1 Chaar shaakhayein — sambhaavna ke saath
docs.text:
Neeche wali tasveer har tarah ke "if" vaakya ko uski sambhaavna ke saath dikhaati hai. Patti (bar) jitni bhari hui hai, utni hi baat ho sakne wali hai.

Figure 23.1. Dhyaan do ek khoobsurat baat: jaise-jaise sambhaavna ghatti hai, verb ek-ek kadam peeche ki tense me chala jaata hai. English me door ki baat purani tense me kehte hain.

docs.title: 23.2 Zero conditional — jo hamesha hota hai
docs.text:
Yahan "if" ka matlab lagbhag "when" hota hai. Niyam, vigyaan, machine, aadat — in sab ke liye ye roop hai. Dono taraf present simple.

  • If you heat water to 100 °C, it boils. Hamesha hota hai — koi shaq nahi.
  • If the light turns red, the traffic stops. Niyam hai. Yahan "when" bhi chalega.

docs.title: 23.3 First conditional — asli sambhaavna
docs.text:
Aane wale waqt ki asli baat. Ho sakta hai, ho bhi sakta hai nahi. Ye sabse zyada bola jaane wala roop hai — plan, vaada, dhamki, chetawni, sab isme aate hain.

Kaam Example Plan If the train is on time, we will reach by eight. Vaada If you help me today, I will help you tomorrow. Chetawni If you touch that wire, you will get a shock. Shart / sauda If you finish the work, you can go early.

Sunehra rule — 'if' ke baad 'will' nahi

  • Galat: If it will rain, we will cancel the match.
  • Sahi: If it rains, we will cancel the match.
  • Kyun: "will" ek vaakya me ek hi baar, aur wo nateeje wale hisse me. Shart wala hissa present simple me rehta hai, chahe baat kal ki ho.

Yahi rule when, after, before, until, as soon as, unless ke saath bhi chalta hai.

will ki jagah doosre shabd bhi chalte hain

First conditional me nateeje wale hisse me can, may, should, must aur hukm bhi aa sakta hai: If you are tired, you should rest. If he calls, tell him I am busy.

docs.title: 23.4 Second conditional — kalpana aur salaah
docs.text:
Jab baat ab ki haalat me mushkil ya kaalpanik hai. Dekho kaise verb past me jaata hai, par baat past ki nahi hai — baat abhi ki hai. Isliye isko "unreal present" bhi kehte hain.

  • If I won a lottery, I would buy a house for my parents. Lottery jeetne ka chance kam hai — isliye past roop, par baat aaj ki hai.
  • If I were you, I would speak to the manager. Salaah dene ka sabse shisht aur natural tareeka.

'If I were' — yahan 'was' nahi

Second conditional me "be" ka roop were hota hai — har subject ke saath. If I were rich… · If he were here… · If she were in charge… "If I was you" bol-chaal me sun lete hain, par sahi aur sunne me achha roop "If I were you" hi hai — aur ye poori duniya me salaah dene ka standard vaakya hai.

docs.title: 23.5 Third conditional — jo ho hi nahi saka
docs.text:
Guzra hua waqt, jo badal nahi sakta. Isme pachhtaawa, ilzaam, ya "kaash aisa hota" wali baat hoti hai. Dono taraf ek-ek kadam aur peeche: had + V3 aur would have + V3.

  • If I had left earlier, I would not have missed the train. Main jaldi nahi nikla, aur train chhoot gayi. Ab kuch nahi ho sakta.
  • If she had told me, I could have helped her. "would" ki jagah could / might bhi chalta hai — sambhaavna ka rang badal jaata hai.

docs.title: 23.6 Mixed conditional — do waqt ek vaakya me
docs.text:
Kabhi shart past ki hoti hai aur nateeja aaj ka, ya ulta. Tab dono taraf ke roop mila diye jaate hain. Ye advanced hai, par bahut kaam ka — kyunki zindagi me baatein aise hi hoti hain.

Kism Formula Example Matlab Past shart → aaj ka nateeja If + had + V3 , would + V1 If I had studied engineering, I would be an engineer today. Padha nahi tha, isliye aaj engineer nahi hoon. Aaj ki haalat → past ka nateeja If + past simple , would have + V3 If I were braver, I would have told him the truth. Main himmat wala nahi hoon, isliye us waqt sach nahi bola.

docs.title: 23.7 "if" ke doosre roop
docs.text:
Shabd Matlab Example unless agar nahi (= if not) You will fail unless you work hard. as long as jab tak You can stay as long as you keep quiet. provided that is shart par ki I will sign it provided that you read it first. in case kahin aisa na ho ki Take an umbrella in case it rains. even if chahe Even if you apologise, he will not forgive you. otherwise warna Hurry up, otherwise we will be late.

'unless' me 'not' dobara nahi

  • Galat: Unless you do not hurry, you will miss the bus.
  • Sahi: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
  • Kyun: "Unless" ke andar hi "not" chhipa hua hai (= if you do not hurry). Dobara "not" lagane se matlab ulta ho jaata hai.

docs.title: 23.8 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Conditional ki top galtiyan

  • Galat: If I will go to Delhi, I will meet you.
  • Sahi: If I go to Delhi, I will meet you.

  • Kyun: Shart wale hisse me will nahi — present simple. Ek vaakya me will ek hi baar.

  • Galat: If he would come, I would be happy.

  • Sahi: If he came, I would be happy.

  • Kyun: Second conditional me "if" wale hisse me past simple aata hai, would nahi. Would sirf nateeje me.

  • Galat: If I was you, I would not accept that offer.

  • Sahi: If I were you, I would not accept that offer.

  • Kyun: Kaalpanik baat me "were" aata hai, har subject ke saath. Ye salaah dene ka standard vaakya hai.

  • Galat: If she would have told me, I would have helped.

  • Sahi: If she had told me, I would have helped.

  • Kyun: Third conditional me shart "had + V3" hoti hai. "would have" sirf nateeje wale hisse me.

  • Galat: If you would study hard, you will pass.

  • Sahi: If you study hard, you will pass.

  • Kyun: Do modal mila dene se vaakya uljh jaata hai. Ek sadhe formula par tiko.

  • Galat: I will tell you if he will come.

  • Sahi: I will tell you if he comes.
  • Kyun: Chahe "if" baad me aaye, rule wahi — if ke baad present.

Chaar formula, ek line me

Zero: if + present, present First: if + present, will + V1 Second: if + past, would + V1 Third: if + had + V3, would have + V3 Dekho — "if" wale hisse me kabhi will/would nahi aata. Yahi ek baat 90% galtiyan bacha leti hai.

docs.title: 23.9 Practice — Conditionals
docs.text:
Exercise 1

If it ___ tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.

  • will rain
  • rains
  • would rain
  • rained

Hint: If ke baad kaunsa roop aata hai?

Jawaab

rains

First conditional hai — if wale hisse me present simple (rains) aur nateeje me will. 'If it will rain' sabse aam galti hai.

Exercise 2

If I ___ a bird, I would fly to the mountains.

  • am
  • was
  • were
  • will be

Hint: Kaalpanik baat hai — be ka kaunsa roop?

Jawaab

were

Second conditional me 'be' ka roop hamesha 'were' hota hai — chahe subject I, he ya she ho. 'If I were a bird' sahi hai.

Exercise 3

If you had called me, I ___ at the station.

  • will come
  • would come
  • would have come
  • came

Hint: Third conditional ka nateeja kaisa hota hai?

Jawaab

would have come

Third conditional — guzri baat. Shart 'had called' hai, isliye nateeja 'would have come'. Ab ye ho nahi sakta, sirf pachhtaawa hai.

Exercise 4

Kaunsa vaakya zero conditional hai?

  • If I get time, I will call you.
  • If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.
  • If I were rich, I would travel.
  • If he had tried, he would have won.

Hint: Kaunsi baat hamesha sach hai?

Jawaab

If you mix blue and yellow, you get green.

Zero conditional me dono taraf present simple hota hai aur baat hamesha sach hoti hai — rang milane ka nateeja kabhi nahi badalta.

Exercise 5

If I ___ (have) more time, I would learn the guitar.

Hint: Second conditional — abhi time nahi hai.

Jawaab

had

Second conditional me if ke baad past simple aata hai. 'Had' likhne ka matlab past ki baat nahi — matlab 'abhi time nahi hai'.

Exercise 6

You will not pass ___ you work hard.

Hint: 'agar nahi' ka ek hi shabd.

Jawaab

unless

'Unless' ka matlab hai 'if not'. Iske andar hi 'not' chhipa hai, isliye dobara 'not' nahi lagana.

Exercise 7

If water ___ (freeze), it becomes ice.

Hint: Hamesha sach — zero conditional.

Jawaab

freezes

Zero conditional me dono taraf present simple. 'Water' singular hai, isliye 'freezes' — -s lagega.

Exercise 8

Is vaakya me ek galti hai — galat shabd par tap karo.

If I will get the job, I shall shift to Pune.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: will.

Sahi roop: If I get the job, I shall shift to Pune.

If wale hisse me will/shall kabhi nahi aata. Wahan present simple rehta hai — 'If I get'.

Exercise 9

Galat shabd dhoondo.

If I was the captain, I would change the batting order.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: was.

Sahi roop: If I were the captain, I would change the batting order.

Kaalpanik baat (main captain nahi hoon) me 'were' aata hai, 'was' nahi.

Exercise 10

Ek shabd galat hai — pakdo.

If she would have asked me, I might have helped her.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: would.

Sahi roop: If she had asked me, I might have helped her.

Third conditional me shart 'had + V3' hoti hai. 'If she would have' galat hai — wahan 'If she had' aata hai. Would/might have sirf nateeje wale hisse me.

Exercise 11

Sahi kram me second conditional banao.

Shabd: I / job / take / were / you / that / I / If / would

Jawaab

If I were you I would take that job

Salaah dene ka standard roop — 'If I were you, I would…'. Yaad rakho: if wale hisse me 'were', nateeje me 'would + V1'.

Exercise 12

Conditional ki kism ko uske matlab se jodo.

A B If you heat ice, it melts abhi nahi hai — kalpana If I get leave, I will come ho hi nahi saka If I had a car, I would drive hamesha sach If I had known, I would have come ho sakta hai Jawaab

If you heat ice, it melts — hamesha sach; If I get leave, I will come — ho sakta hai; If I had a car, I would drive — abhi nahi hai — kalpana; If I had known, I would have come — ho hi nahi saka

Zero = niyam. First = asli sambhaavna. Second = aaj ki kalpana. Third = guzri baat, ab nahi badal sakti.

Exercise 13

Ab ye line bol ke dekho — salaah dene wala sabse kaam ka vaakya.

Jawaab

Bolo: If I were you I would not worry about it

Bolte waqt 'If I were you' ko ek hi saans me bolo — ye lagbhag ek phrase ki tarah sunai deta hai. Office aur dosti, dono me ye line roz kaam aati hai.

Aage kya karein

Ek kaam aaj hi karo: apne baare me chaar vaakya banao — ek zero ("If I skip breakfast, I get a headache"), ek first, ek second, ek third. Apne jeevan ki asli baatein likho. Jo vaakya aapka khud ka hota hai, wo formula se zyada tez yaad rehta hai.

docs.title: Chapter 13: Conjunction — jodne wale shabd
docs.text:
Conjunction wo shabd hai jo do shabd, do phrase ya do poore vaakya ko jod deta hai. Inke bina English chhoti-chhoti tooti line bankar reh jaati hai — "I was tired. I went to work." Conjunction lagao, aur wahi baat badi lagti hai — "I was tired, but I went to work." Teen parivaar hain, aur teeno is chapter me.

Ek line me

A conjunction joins words, phrases, or clauses together. Jo do hisson ko jode — wo conjunction. Hindi me "aur, par, kyunki, agar, jab" yahi kaam karte hain.

  • Tea and biscuits. Do shabd jude.
  • I called her, but she did not pick up. Do poore vaakya jude — barabari me.
  • Because it was raining, we stayed home. Ek hissa doosre par tik gaya — ye alag parivaar hai.

docs.title: 13.1 Teen parivaar — ek naksha
docs.text: Figure 13.1. Teen parivaar: barabari me jodne wale, tikaane wale, aur jodi me aane wale.

docs.title: 13.2 Coordinating conjunctions — FANBOYS
docs.text:
Ye saat shabd do barabar hisson ko jodte hain. Dono hisse apne aap me poore hote hain. Yaad rakhne ka tareeka: FANBOYS — pehle akshar se bana shabd.

Shabd Matlab Example F — for kyunki (formal) He stayed in, for it was raining. A — and aur (jodna) She cooked and he cleaned. N — nor na hi He did not call, nor did he write. B — but par (ulta) It is small but comfortable. O — or ya (vikalp) Tea or coffee? Y — yet phir bhi She was tired, yet she kept working. S — so isliye (nateeja) It was late, so we left.

Comma kab lagega

Do poore vaakye jod rahe ho to conjunction se pehle comma — I called her, but she was busy. Sirf do shabd ya chhote hisse jod rahe ho to comma nahi — I called her but got no reply. Test: conjunction ke baad naya subject aa raha hai? Haan to comma.

'nor' ke baad shabdon ka kram palat jaata hai

✓ He did not call, nor did he write. ✗ He did not call, nor he wrote. "nor" ke baad sawaal jaisa kram aata hai — helping verb pehle, subject baad me.

docs.title: 13.3 Subordinating conjunctions — tikaane wale
docs.text:
Ye wo shabd hain jo ek hisse ko doosre par nirbhar bana dete hain. Jis hisse ke aage ye lagta hai, wo akela khada nahi reh sakta — use poora karne ke liye doosra hissa chahiye.

  • Although he was ill, he came to class. "Although he was ill" akela bolo to baat adhoori lagti hai — kuch aur sunne ka mann karta hai. Yahi nirbharta hai.
Kya bata raha hai Shabd Example Kaaran (kyunki) because, since, as I left early because I was tired. Virodh (phir bhi) although, though, even though, whereas, while Though she is young, she is wise. Shart (agar) if, unless, provided that, in case Unless you study, you will fail. Samay (kab) when, while, before, after, until, as soon as, since Call me when you reach. Maqsad (taaki) so that, in order that, lest He ran fast so that he could catch the bus. Tulna than, as…as He is taller than his brother. Jagah where, wherever Sit where you like.

Jagah badli ja sakti hai — bas comma dhyan rakho

Because she was late, we started without her. (pehle aaya → comma lagta hai) We started without her because she was late. (baad me aaya → comma nahi)

docs.title: 13.4 Correlative conjunctions — jodi me aane wale
docs.text:
Ye jodi me aate hain — ek hissa aage, doosra beech me. Inka ek pakka rule hai: dono taraf ek hi tarah ka hissa aana chahiye. Isse "parallel structure" kehte hain.

Jodi Matlab Example either … or ya ye, ya wo Either you come or I go. neither … nor na ye, na wo Neither Ram nor Shyam came. both … and dono She is both clever and kind. not only … but also sirf nahi, balki He not only sang but also danced. whether … or chahe ye, chahe wo I don't know whether he will come or not. no sooner … than jaise hi No sooner did he arrive than it started raining. as … as jitna … utna She is as tall as her mother.

Verb kiske saath milega — paas wale ke saath

either…or aur neither…nor me verb us subject se milta hai jo verb ke sabse paas ho: ✓ Neither the boys nor the teacher was present. (teacher paas hai → was) ✓ Neither the teacher nor the boys were present. (boys paas hain → were)

Parallel structure tootne ki galti

  • Galat: She not only plays the piano but also a good singer.
  • Sahi: She not only plays the piano but also sings beautifully.

  • Kyun: "not only" ke baad verb aaya tha, to "but also" ke baad bhi verb aana chahiye. Ek taraf verb aur doosri taraf noun — ye vaakya ko langda kar deta hai.

  • Galat: He is interested in reading and to write.

  • Sahi: He is interested in reading and writing.
  • Kyun: "and" ke dono taraf ek hi roop — dono gerund, ya dono infinitive. Mila-jula nahi.

docs.title: 13.5 Conjunctive adverbs — jo conjunction lagte hain par hain nahi
docs.text:
however, therefore, moreover, nevertheless, otherwise, hence, besides, meanwhile — ye adverb hain, conjunction nahi. Isliye ye do vaakyon ko comma se nahi jod sakte. Inke saath semicolon ya full stop chahiye.

Comma splice — 'however' ke saath sabse aam galti

  • Galat: I was tired, however I finished the work.
  • Sahi: I was tired; however, I finished the work.
  • Kyun: "however" conjunction nahi hai, isliye wo akela do vaakye nahi jod sakta. Do raaste hain: semicolon lagao, ya seedha "but" use karo. Doosra raasta aasaan bhi hai aur saaf bhi.

docs.title: 13.6 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Conjunction ki aam Indian-English galtiyan

  • Galat: Although he was ill, but he came to work.
  • Sahi: Although he was ill, he came to work.

  • Kyun: Ek matlab ke liye ek hi conjunction. Hindi me "halaanki… lekin" dono aate hain, isliye English me bhi dono lag jaate hain. English me ek chuno: ya "although", ya "but". Isi tarah ✗ "Because he was late, so we left" bhi galat hai.

  • Galat: As she was busy, so she didn't attend.

  • Sahi: As she was busy, she didn't attend.

  • Kyun: Wahi dohraav — "as" pehle se kaaran bata chuka hai, "so" ki zaroorat nahi. Hindi ke "kyunki… isliye" ka seedha asar.

  • Galat: Unless you don't study, you will fail.

  • Sahi: Unless you study, you will fail.

  • Kyun: "Unless" ka matlab hi hai "agar nahi" — usme negative already hai. Doosra "don't" lagane se matlab ulta ho jaata hai.

  • Galat: Neither he or his brother came.

  • Sahi: Neither he nor his brother came.

  • Kyun: Jodi tootti nahi — "neither" ke saath "nor", aur "either" ke saath "or". Partner badalna galat hai.

  • Galat: I don't know that she will come or not.

  • Sahi: I don't know whether she will come or not.

  • Kyun: "or not" ke saath "whether" aata hai, "that" nahi. "if" bhi chalta hai par "whether…or not" zyada saaf hai.

  • Galat: She is more taller than her sister, but still she plays well.

  • Sahi: She is taller than her sister, but she plays well.

  • Kyun: Do galtiyan: "more taller" me double comparison, aur "but still" me dohraav — "but" ya "still", dono nahi.

  • Galat: She is my cousin brother and also my neighbour.

  • Sahi: He is my cousin and also my neighbour.

  • Kyun: "Cousin" apne aap me poora shabd hai — brother jodne ki zaroorat nahi. Baaki vaakya theek tha; "and also" chalta hai, halaanki sirf "and" se bhi kaam ho jaata.

  • Galat: He don't have money and time.

  • Sahi: He doesn't have money or time.
  • Kyun: Do galtiyan: "he" ke saath doesn't, aur negative vaakya me "and" ki jagah "or" aata hai. Negative me "and" dono cheezon ko ek saath jod deta hai, jo matlab badal deta hai.

docs.title: 13.7 Chhota naksha
docs.text:
Parivaar Dono hisse Shabd Comma Coordinating barabar for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so do poore vaakye ho to haan Subordinating ek doosre par tika because, although, if, when, unless, since nirbhar hissa pehle aaye to haan Correlative jodi me, parallel either…or, neither…nor, both…and, not only…but also aksar nahi

Teen pakke rule

1. Ek matlab ke liye ek hi conjunction — although ya but, dono nahi. 2. Correlative jodi ke dono taraf ek hi tarah ka hissa. 3. however, therefore, moreover conjunction nahi hain — unse pehle semicolon ya full stop.

docs.title: 13.8 Practice — Conjunctions
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Kaunsa vaakya sahi hai?

  • Although he was tired, he kept working.
  • Although he was tired, but he kept working.
  • Although he was tired, so he kept working.
  • Although he was tired but so he kept working.

Hint: Ek matlab ke liye kitne conjunction?

Jawaab

Although he was tired, he kept working.

'Although' pehle hi virodh bata chuka hai, isliye 'but' lagana dohraav hai. Hindi me 'halaanki… lekin' dono aate hain, isliye English me bhi dono lag jaate hain.

Exercise 2

Neither Ravi ___ his friends were invited.

  • nor
  • or
  • and
  • but

Hint: Jodi todni nahi hai.

Jawaab

nor

'Neither' ka partner hamesha 'nor' hota hai, jaise 'either' ka 'or'. Jodi badalne se vaakya galat ho jaata hai.

Exercise 3

___ you apologise, she will not talk to you.

  • Unless
  • If
  • Although
  • Because

Hint: Is shabd me negative pehle se chhupa hai.

Jawaab

Unless

'Unless' ka matlab hai 'agar nahi' — usme negative already hai. Isi liye 'unless you don't apologise' likhna matlab ulta kar deta hai.

Exercise 4

FANBOYS me kaunsa shabd nahi aata?

  • because
  • but
  • yet
  • nor

Hint: FANBOYS coordinating conjunctions hain.

Jawaab

because

'because' subordinating hai — wo ek hisse ko doosre par tikaata hai. FANBOYS (for, and, nor, but, or, yet, so) barabar hisson ko jodte hain.

Exercise 5

I was very tired, ___ I finished the report. (ulta batane wala shabd)

Hint: Do barabar vaakya hain, aur baat ulti ja rahi hai.

Jawaab

but

Do poore vaakye barabari me jud rahe hain aur matlab ulta ja raha hai, isliye 'but'. 'however' bhi matlab wahi deta par uske pehle semicolon chahiye hota.

Exercise 6

She studied hard ___ she could clear the exam. (taaki)

Hint: Maqsad batana hai.

Jawaab

so that

Maqsad batane ke liye 'so that' aata hai. Sirf 'so' lagane se wo nateeja ban jaata hai, maqsad nahi — do alag baatein hain.

Exercise 7

Is vaakya me ek shabd extra hai — us par tap karo.

Because it was raining so we cancelled the match.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: so.

Sahi roop: Because it was raining, we cancelled the match.

'Because' pehle hi kaaran bata chuka hai, isliye 'so' extra ho gaya. Hindi ke 'kyunki… isliye' ka seedha asar hai ye.

Exercise 8

Galat shabd dhoondo.

Unless you don't hurry you will miss the train.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: don't.

Sahi roop: Unless you hurry, you will miss the train.

'Unless' me negative pehle se hai, isliye 'don't' lagane se do negative ho gaye aur matlab ulat gaya.

Exercise 9

Ek shabd galat hai.

I was tired, however I completed the task.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: however.

Sahi roop: I was tired; however, I completed the task.

'however' conjunction nahi, adverb hai — wo akele comma se do vaakye nahi jod sakta. Semicolon lagao, ya seedha 'but' use karo.

Exercise 10

Conjunction ko uske kaam se jodo.

A B because shart batata hai although maqsad batata hai unless samay batata hai so that kaaran batata hai as soon as virodh batata hai Jawaab

because — kaaran batata hai; although — virodh batata hai; unless — shart batata hai; so that — maqsad batata hai; as soon as — samay batata hai

Subordinating conjunction ka chunaav uske matlab se hota hai — kaaran, virodh, shart, maqsad ya samay. Galat chunne se poora matlab badal jaata hai.

Exercise 11

Sahi kram me vaakya banao — correlative jodi ka istemaal hai.

Shabd: but / guitar / plays / only / sings / the / not / She / also

Jawaab

She not only sings but also plays the guitar

'not only' ke baad verb aaya hai, to 'but also' ke baad bhi verb aana chahiye — yahi parallel structure hai. Ek taraf verb aur doosri taraf noun vaakya ko langda kar deta hai.

Exercise 12

Ye line bol ke dekho — 'although' ke baad 'but' nahi bolna hai.

Jawaab

Bolo: Although it was raining we went out

Bolte waqt Hindi ki aadat se 'but' nikal jaata hai. Jaan-boojh kar bina 'but' bolne ki practice se ye aadat tootti hai.

Aage kya karein

Aaj apne paanch chhote vaakye lo aur unhe conjunction se jodo. Phir padh kar dekho — kitna behtar lagta hai. Aakhri chapter is hisse ka: Interjection.

docs.title: Chapter 28: Native speed English
docs.text:
Kitaab ki English samajh aati hai, par Netflix, YouTube ya videshi colleague ki English "bahut tez" lagti hai? Asal me wo tez nahi bolte — wo shabdon ko jodte, dabaate aur ghisaate hain. "Did you eat?" ban jaata hai "didja eat?". Is chapter me hum paanch niyam seekhenge jinse ye hota hai. Maqsad: sunte waqt pakadna, aur bolte waqt utna apnana jitna natural lage.

Ek line me

Native speech = weak forms + contractions + linking + elision + assimilation. Shabd wahi hain, bas unke kinaare ghis jaate hain. Isse "tez" mat samjho — ise "juda hua" samjho.

docs.title: 28.1 Tez kyun lagta hai? — paanch niyam
docs.text:
Hindi me hum har akshar ko lagbhag poora bolte hain. English stress-timed hai: zor wale shabd lambe aur saaf, beech ke chhote shabd jaldi-jaldi aur dabe hue (iski buniyaad Rhythm aur stress chapter me hai). Jab chhote shabd dabte hain, to wo aas-paas ke shabdon se chipak jaate hain. Yahi paanch tarike hain:

Niyam Kya hota hai Example Weak forms chhote shabd ki vowel "uh" ban jaati hai for → fuh Contractions do shabd ek ban jaate hain I would → I'd Linking ek shabd ka ant agle se jud jaata hai turn it off → tur-ni-toff Elision koi aawaz gayab ho jaati hai last night → las' night Assimilation do aawazein milkar nayi ban jaati hain did you → didja
  • What do you want to do? Tum kya karna chahte ho? — sunai deta hai: "Whaddaya wanna do?"
  • I don't know. Mujhe nahi pata. — aksar: "I dunno."

docs.title: 28.2 Weak forms — chhote shabd, chhoti aawaz
docs.text:
to, for, of, and, can, was, them jaise function words ke do roop hote hain: strong (akele ya zor ke saath) aur weak (vaakya ke beech, schwa /ə/ "uh" ke saath). Vaakya me 90% baar weak roop hi aata hai. Agar aap har "to" ko "too" bologe, to aapki English bhaari aur rukti hui lagegi.

Shabd Weak Vaakya me Suno to /tə/ tuh I need to go. for /fə/ fuh It's for you. of /əv/ uhv, uh a lot of work and /ən/ un, n rice and dal can /kən/ kun I can help. was /wəz/ wuz It was late. them /ðəm/, /əm/ uhm Tell them. from /frəm/ fruhm She's from Kochi. her /ə/, /hə/ Ask her.

Strong form kab?

Teen jagah poora (strong) roop: vaakya ke ant me (Where are you from?), zor/contrast ke liye, aur akele bolte waqt. Baaki har jagah weak.

  • Who's it for? — It's fuh my mother. Ye kiske liye hai? — Meri maa ke liye. (pehla "for" strong, doosra weak)
  • What are you looking at? Kya dekh rahe ho? — ant me "at" poora.

docs.title: can ya can't? — sunne ka sabse bada jaal
docs.text:
Tez bolne me can't ka "t" aksar sunai hi nahi deta. To farq kaise pakdein? "t" mat dhoondo, vowel suno. can weak aur chhota hai (kun), aur zor agle verb par hota hai. can't strong aur lamba hai (British "kaant", American "kænt"), aur zor usi par hota hai.

Vaakya Sunai deta hai Suno I can come. I kun COME. I can't come. I KAANT come. She can drive, but she can't park. kun DRIVE … KAANT park

docs.title: Contractions — bolne ki default English
docs.text:
Bolte waqt I am, do not, we will lagbhag hamesha jud jaate hain. Poora roop bolna galat nahi, par wo zor jaisa lagta hai: "I do not want it" = "bilkul nahi chahiye".

Poora Contraction Suno I would / I had I'd we will we'll they are they're should have should've ("shuduv") it has / it is it's

✗

You should of told me.

✓

You should have told me. (bola: should've)

have

docs.title: 28.3 Linking — shabd ek-doosre se chipakte hain
docs.text:
Native speaker shabdon ke beech ruke bina bolta hai. Jab ek shabd consonant par khatam ho aur agla vowel se shuru ho, to wo consonant agle shabd ka hissa ban jaata hai. Do vowel milein to beech me ek halki w ya y aa jaati hai. Neeche wale naksha me har pul (arc) ek jod hai.

Figure 28.1. Har arc ek jod hai. Consonant agle vowel par kood jaata hai; do vowel ke beech halki w/y ka pul banta hai; British English me chhupa r agle vowel se pehle jaag jaata hai.
  • Turn it off. Band kar do. — "tur-ni-toff"
  • Pick it up. Utha lo. — "pi-ki-tup"
  • Come on in. Andar aa jao. — "ku-mo-nin"
  • Check it out. Dekho zara. — "che-ki-tout"
  • Go out and see. Bahar ja kar dekho. — "go-wou-tun see"
  • The idea is good. Idea achha hai. — "the-yidea-ris good" (British)

Bolne me kaise laayein

Phrase ko ek lamba shabd maan kar bolo: turnitoff, pickitup. Shabdon ke beech "glottal stop" (jhatka) mat do — hawa chalti rahe. Ye aapki English ko turant smooth bana deta hai.

docs.title: 28.4 Elision — jo aawaz gayab ho jaati hai
docs.text:
Jab t ya d do consonants ke beech fas jaaye, to bolchaal me aksar gayab ho jaata hai. next day me "t" bolne ke liye zubaan ko rukna padega — isliye log seedha "nex day" bol dete hain. Likhte waqt kuch nahi badalta.

Likha Sunai deta hai Suno next day nex' day last night las' night must be mus' be old man ol' man handbag hanbag I don't know I dunno first thing firs' thing
  • I went to bed late last night. Kal raat der se soya. — "las' night"
  • She left the next day. Wo agle din chali gayi. — "nex' day"
  • I walked to the station. Main paidal station gaya. — "-ed" ka "t" aur "to" ka "t" ek ho gaye: "walk-tuh"

Past tense ka '-ed' gayab lagta hai

I walked to work aur I walk to work tez bolne me lagbhag ek jaise lagte hain. Isliye sunte waqt context se tense pakdo — yesterday, last week jaise shabd madad karte hain. Aur likhte waqt "-ed" kabhi mat chhodo. Ek shabd ke andar ki gayab vowel (vegetable, comfortable) Uchchaaran theek karo chapter me hai.

docs.title: 28.5 Assimilation — didja, doncha, gotcha
docs.text:
Kabhi do aawazein milkar teesri aawaz ban jaati hain. Sabse aam: jab t, d, s, z ke baad you / your / year ka "y" aata hai. Hindi bolne walon ke liye ye jaana-pehchana hai — hum bhi "ye to" ko tez me "yetto" bol dete hain.

Figure 28.2. Chaar formula, saikdon phrase. Ye aalas nahi hai — zubaan sabse chhota raasta leti hai. Likha Sunai deta hai Suno Did you eat? Didja eat? Don't you think so? Doncha think so? What are you doing? Wotcha doing? Would you like some tea? Wudja like some tea? I got you. Gotcha. Nice to meet you. Nice tuh meechoo. See you this year. See ya thi-shear.

Kaan ke liye niyam

t + you = ch, d + you = j, s + you = sh. Jab bhi "-cha", "-ja", "-shoo" sunai de, socho: peeche koi you chhupa hai.

docs.title: 28.6 gonna, wanna, gotta — kab bolein, kab likhein
docs.text:
Ye "slang" nahi, balki bolchaal ke asli roop hain — news anchor bhi "gonna" bolte hain. Par likhne me (email, report, exam) inki jagah nahi. Seedha niyam: bolo — chalega; WhatsApp par dost ko — chalega; office me likho — kabhi nahi.

Bolchaal Poora roop Example Suno gonna going to (+ verb) I'm gonna call her. wanna want to / want a Do you wanna come? gotta have got to I gotta go. hafta have to We hafta wait. lemme let me Lemme see. gimme give me Gimme a minute. kinda kind of It's kinda cold. outta out of Get outta here!

✗

I'm gonna Delhi tomorrow.

✓

I'm going to Delhi tomorrow. / I'm gonna visit Delhi tomorrow.

going to + verb

✗

Dear Sir, I wanna apply for the post.

✓

Dear Sir, I would like to apply for the post.

Email likhna

Khud bolein ya nahi?

Pehle sunna seekho. Bolne me "gonna" aur "wanna" casual baat me natural hain — par interview ya presentation me going to aur want to (weak "tuh" ke saath) sabse safe hain. Zabardasti "gotcha, wanna, lemme" har line me ghusaana filmy lagta hai.

docs.title: 28.7 Sawaal aur list ki dhun
docs.text: Basic niyam (statement ↘, yes/no sawaal ↗, WH-sawaal ↘) Rhythm aur stress chapter me hai. Yahan do aise mauke jahan dhun se matlab hi badal jaata hai.

docs.title: Choice ya yes/no?
docs.text: Bolne ka tareeka Matlab Suno Tea ↗ or coffee ↘? Do me se ek chuno. Tea or coffee ↗? Kuch peena hai? (haan/na)

docs.title: Question tags — pakka ya sach me sawaal?
docs.text:
• It's hot today, isn't it ↘ Girti aawaz = "haan na?" — aap sirf haami chahte ho.
  • The meeting is at three, isn't it ↗ Chadhti aawaz = sach me confirm kar rahe ho, pakka nahi pata.
  • I bought milk ↗, bread ↗, eggs ↗ and butter ↘. List me har item par aawaz upar; aakhri par neeche = list khatam.

List khatam hui ya nahi?

Sunte waqt agar aakhri item par aawaz upar rahe, to samjho bolne wala aur jodne wala hai — beech me mat bolo. Neeche gire, to aapki baari.

docs.title: 28.8 Tez English sunne ki strategy
docs.text:
Niyam jaanna aadha kaam hai. Baaki aadha hai kaan ki aadat. Ye paanch tarike sach me kaam karte hain:

Tareeka Kaise 1. Bade shabd pakdo Har shabd nahi — sirf zor wale (noun, verb). "…MEET…STAtion…SIX" se poori baat ban jaati hai. 2. Pehle andaaza Situation se socho kya aane wala hai. Dukaan par "wudja like a bag?" lagbhag pakka hai. 3. Shadowing Audio chalao aur aadha second peeche-peeche wahi bolo, wahi dhun me. 4. Dictation Ek line suno, likho, milao. Jo galat hua, wahi aapka agla niyam hai. 5. Dheere → tez 🐢 dheemi speed par samjho, phir normal par. Subtitles pehle English me, phir band.

Sunte waqt anuvaad nahi

Dimaag me Hindi anuvaad karoge to agla vaakya chhoot jaayega. Zor wale shabd pakdo, baaki context se bharo — native speaker bhi yahi karte hain.

✗

Ek shabd samajh nahi aaya → ruk gaye → poori baat chhoot gayi.

✓

Ek shabd chhoota → aage suno → context se bharo → zaroorat ho to poochho: "Sorry, did you say Tuesday?"

Phone aur video call

docs.title: 28.9 Asli zindagi me — office canteen
docs.text:
Pehle har line ka 🔊 suno bina padhe. Phir dekho "sunai deta hai" wala column — kaunse niyam lage?

Likha hua Sunai deta hai Suno Hey, did you eat yet? Hey, didja eat yet? Not yet. I've got to finish this first. Not yet. I gotta finish this firs'. What are you working on? Wotcha workin' on? The report for Monday. It's kind of a mess. The report fuh Monday. It's kinda-uh mess. Do you want me to help? Dya wan' me tuh help? Let me look at it after lunch. Lemme look a-tit after lunch. Thanks! I'm going to get a sandwich and a cup of tea. Thanks! I'm gonna ge-ta sandwich un-a cuppa tea.

Roz ki 5-minute drill

Upar ki canteen wali baat-cheet ki ek line chuno. Teen baar suno, phir shadow karo, phir bina dekhe likho. Ek hafte me saat lines — aur aapka kaan "tez" English ko "normal" sunne lagega.

docs.title: 28.10 Practice — Native speed English
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Can the speaker stay for lunch?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

I can come to the meeting, but I can't stay for lunch.

  • No
  • Yes
  • Only on Friday
  • It isn't mentioned
Jawaab

No

can (kun) chhota aur dabaa hua; can't lamba aur zor wala. 'can't stay' = nahi ruk sakta.

Exercise 2

What is the speaker asking about?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

What are you going to do this weekend?

  • weekend plans
  • last weekend
  • work today
  • a holiday booking
Jawaab

weekend plans

'Wotcha gonna do' = What are you going to do — future plan.

Exercise 3

What is the speaker offering?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Did you eat? I've got some leftover biryani if you want it.

  • leftover biryani
  • a cup of tea
  • a lift home
  • some money
Jawaab

leftover biryani

'Didja eat?' + 'I've got some leftover biryani' — bachi hui biryani offer kar raha hai.

Exercise 4

What must they turn off?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

We need to leave at half past six. Don't forget your ticket, and turn off the lights.

  • the lights
  • the fan
  • the AC
  • the phone
Jawaab

the lights

'tur-noff the lights' — consonant n agle vowel se jud gaya.

Exercise 5

What are they going to do?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Let me know if you want to come with us. We're going to grab a cup of coffee.

  • have coffee
  • have lunch
  • go shopping
  • go home
Jawaab

have coffee

'gonna grab a cuppa coffee' = going to grab a cup of coffee.

Exercise 6

When will the speaker call back?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

I've got to go now. I'll call you back in an hour.

  • in an hour
  • tonight
  • tomorrow
  • in ten minutes
Jawaab

in an hour

'i-na-nour' — teen shabd linking se ek ho gaye: in an hour.

Exercise 7

Write what you hear (poori, sahi spelling me).

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

What do you want to do tonight?

'Whaddaya wanna do' — par likhte hain poora: What do you want to do.

Exercise 8

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

I don't know what he's going to say.

'I dunno what he's gonna say' — likhai me don't know aur going to.

Exercise 9

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

Could you turn it off, please?

'Cudja tur-ni-toff' — assimilation (could you) + linking (turn it off).

Exercise 10

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

We left the next day.

'nex' day' — t gayab sunai deta hai, par likha jaata hai: next.

Exercise 11

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

Did you tell them about the party?

'Didja tell-uhm' — did you = didja, them weak ho kar 'uhm'.

Exercise 12

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

She has got to finish it by Friday.

'She's gotta finish it' — likhte waqt: has got to.

Exercise 13

Which sentence can naturally become 'gonna' in speech?

  • I'm going to call you later.
  • I'm going to Mumbai tomorrow.
  • She's going to the office.
  • We're going to the market.
Jawaab

I'm going to call you later.

gonna = going to + verb (future). Jagah par jaane wale 'going to' ke saath nahi.

Exercise 14

Fast speech me 'can' aur 'can't' ka farq kaise pakdein?

  • can't ki vowel lambi aur zor wali hoti hai
  • sirf 't' ki aawaz suno
  • can hamesha zor se bola jaata hai
  • koi farq nahi hota
Jawaab

can't ki vowel lambi aur zor wali hoti hai

't' aksar gayab ho jaata hai. can = kun (weak), can't = KAANT (strong, lamba).

Exercise 15

Which is right for a formal email?

  • I would like to apply for the post.
  • I wanna apply for the post.
  • I'm gonna apply for the post.
  • I gotta apply for the post.
Jawaab

I would like to apply for the post.

wanna/gonna/gotta bolne ke roop hain, formal likhai ke nahi.

Exercise 16

Match the spoken form to the full form.

A B gonna have got to wanna let me gotta did you lemme going to didja want to Jawaab

gonna — going to; wanna — want to; gotta — have got to; lemme — let me; didja — did you

Sunne me chhota roop, likhne me hamesha poora roop.

Exercise 17

Say it as one smooth phrase — shabdon ke beech mat ruko.

Jawaab

Bolo: Turn it off and pick it up

tur-ni-toff un pi-ki-tup — consonant agle vowel se judta hai, 'and' weak 'un'.

Aage kya karein

Apna pasandida 2-minute YouTube clip chuno aur upar ki 5-step strategy lagao. Phir Fluency aur filler words chapter me apni bolne ki raftaar par kaam karo, aur Suno aur samjho wale hisse ki kahaniyon se kaan ki roz ki kasrat karo.

docs.title: Chapter 52: CV aur LinkedIn
docs.text:
CV aur LinkedIn — action verbs, bullet points, profile summary

Recruiter ek CV par aksar das-pandrah second lagata hai. Us waqt wo aapki "hard-working and sincere" personality nahi dhoondta — wo dhoondta hai ki aapne kya kiya aur uska kya nateeja nikla. Ye chapter sikhata hai ki CV ka dhaancha kaisa ho, har bullet ek formula se kaise likhein, freshers kya karein, Indian CVs ki purani aadatein kaun si chhodni hain, aur LinkedIn par apna headline aur About kaise likhein.

docs.title: 52.1 CV ya resume — kya farq hai?
docs.text:
India me dono shabd lagbhag ek hi matlab me chalte hain, aur koi aapko "galat shabd" ke liye reject nahi karega. Par farq jaan lena achha hai, khaaskar agar aap bahar apply kar rahe ho.

Baat Resume CV Lambaai 1–2 page UK/India: 2 page · Academic: lamba Kahan zyada US, Canada, India ki private jobs UK, Europe, academic jobs Kya hota hai Is job ke liye chuna hua kaam UK me resume jaisa; academic me poora record Har job ke liye badlo? Haan Haan (academic CV kam)

Ek line me

Fresher ya 10 saal se kam experience: 1 page. Usse zyada: 2 page, bas. Har job ke liye CV ko us job ke shabdon ke hisaab se thoda badlo. Ek CV sab jagah bhejna = kahin bhi fit na hona.

  • Please find my CV attached. Email me CV bhejne ki seedhi line. Poora email Email likhna aur cover note Application aur message me hai.
  • I've tailored my resume to the job description. tailor = naap se silna — yahan: job ke hisaab se badalna.

docs.title: 52.2 Dhaancha — upar se neeche
docs.text:
Recruiter ki aankh upar-baayein se shuru hoti hai aur neeche jaati hai. Isliye sabse zaroori cheez sabse upar. Experience wale log pehle experience, freshers pehle education aur projects.

Figure 52.1. Ek saaf, ek-page CV. Daayein ke note batate hain ki har hisse me kya jaata hai — aur kya nahi. Hissa Kya likhein Kya mat likhein Header Naam, city, phone, email, LinkedIn Poora pata, "Curriculum Vitae" heading Profile 3–4 line ka parichay "Objective: To work in a reputed organisation…" Experience Role, company, saal, 3–5 bullets Har duty ki lambi list Skills Tools, languages, certifications "Hard-working, team player" Education Degree, college, saal, CGPA Class 5 se poori kahani

docs.title: 52.3 Profile summary — teen line ka parichay
docs.text:
Profile summary CV ka "trailer" hai. Ise bina "I" ke, chhote vaakyon me likhte hain. Formula: kaun ho + kitna experience + kis cheez me khaas + ek bada nateeja + ab kya chahte ho.

Summary formula

Role + years + specialty + one result + goal. "Data analyst with 3 years' experience in fintech. Built dashboards that cut reporting time by 50%. Looking to move into product analytics." "I am" aur "my" chhod do — CV me ye apne aap samjha jaata hai.

✗

Objective: To work in a challenging environment where I can utilise my skills for the growth of the organisation.

✓

Profile: Mechanical engineer with 2 years' experience in quality control at an auto-parts plant. Reduced defect rates by 18% through new inspection checklists. Seeking a process-improvement role.

kaun ho

kya kar chuke ho

  • Customer support lead with five years' experience in e-commerce. five years' experience — apostrophe s ke baad (years ka experience).
  • Final-year B.Com student with strong Excel and Tally skills. Fresher ka profile — degree + skills.
  • Seeking an entry-level role in digital marketing. "Seeking" / "Looking to move into" — goal wali aakhri line.

docs.title: 52.4 Action verbs — kaam ko zinda karne wale shabd
docs.text:
"Responsible for" aur "worked on" se recruiter ko pata nahi chalta ki aapne khud kya kiya. Har bullet ek majboot past-tense verb se shuru karo. Abhi wali job ke liye present tense bhi chalta hai — par ek job ke andar ek hi tense rakho.

Kaam ka prakaar Verbs Example Team chalana led, managed, coordinated, mentored Led a team of six. Kuch banana built, designed, developed, launched Launched a mobile app. Behtar karna improved, increased, streamlined Increased sales by 20%. Kam karna reduced, cut, lowered, saved Cut costs by ₹4 lakh. Samajhna analysed, identified, researched Identified a billing error. Baat karna presented, negotiated, trained Trained 40 new staff. Hal nikaalna resolved, fixed, solved Resolved 50+ tickets a day.
  • Led a team of six to deliver the project two weeks early. Chhe logon ki team ke saath project do hafte pehle diya.
  • Built an inventory tracker in Excel used by four branches. Excel me stock tracker banaya — chaar branch use karti hain.
  • Reduced customer complaints by 30% in six months. Chhe mahine me shikayatein 30% kam ki.
  • Negotiated a new contract with the courier partner, saving ₹2 lakh a year. Courier ke saath naya contract — saal ke ₹2 lakh bache.
  • Trained 25 interns on the new billing software. 25 interns ko naya software sikhaya.

Verb ki jagah 'I' nahi

Bullet seedha verb se: Led…, Built…, Reduced… — "I led…" nahi, "I was responsible for…" bilkul nahi. Upgrade wale verbs ke liye Verb upgrade chapter bhi dekho.

✗

Responsible for handling social media.

✓

Grew Instagram followers from 2,000 to 15,000 in a year.

badla

docs.title: 52.5 Bullet ka formula — verb + task + result + number
docs.text:
Har achha bullet chaar tukdon se banta hai. Number na ho to bhi nateeja zaroor likho — kitne log, kitna samay, kitna paisa, kitne percent.

Figure 52.2. Ek line, chaar kaam: kya kiya (verb), kis par (task), kaise (tool), aur kya nateeja nikla (number ke saath).
  • Automated monthly GST reports using Python scripts, cutting preparation time from three days to four hours. "cutting / saving / increasing…" — -ing se nateeja jodo.
  • Redesigned the onboarding emails, which increased trial sign-ups by 22%. "which…" se bhi nateeja jod sakte ho.
  • Streamlined the loan approval process from ten steps to six, halving waiting time. streamline = faaltu kadam hata kar seedha karna; halve = aadha karna.
  • Resolved an average of 45 customer queries a day with a 95% satisfaction score. Number na badle to bhi "kitna" batao — roz kitne, kitna santosh.
  • Identified a pricing error that was costing the company ₹50,000 a month. Chhoti khoj bhi bada nateeja ho sakti hai — paise me batao.

Number kahan se laayein?

Poochho: kitne log? kitna samay? kitna paisa? kitne percent? Pakka number na ho to imaandaar andaaza: about 30%, 50+ clients. Andaaza theek hai, jhooth nahi — interview me poochha jaayega.

✗

Worked on sales.

✓

Closed 40 new B2B accounts in Gujarat, exceeding the annual target by 15%.

✗

Did coding of website and handled the testing part.

✓

Developed a college events website in React and tested it with 300 students before launch.

Developed

tested

✗

Increased sales. Am managing a team of 4. Prepared reports.

✓

Increased sales… · Managed a team of four… · Prepared reports…

docs.title: 52.6 Skills, education aur freshers ka CV
Skills — dikhao, sirf bolo mat
docs.text:
Skills me wo cheezein likho jo test ki ja sakein: software, tools, programming languages, bhaashaayein, certificates. "Hard-working, honest, team player" ko bullets me saboot ke saath dikhao, skills list me nahi.

  • Skills: Excel (pivot tables, VLOOKUP), SQL, Power BI, Tally ERP Bracket me batao ki tool me kya-kya aata hai.
  • Languages: English (fluent), Hindi (native), Marathi (conversational) Level saath me — fluent / native / conversational / basic.

docs.title: Education — degree, college, saal
docs.text:
• B.Tech in Computer Science, Shivaji Institute of Technology, Pune, 2025 · CGPA 8.4/10 Degree in subject, college, saal, score. Score "out of 10" likho — bahar CGPA scale alag hota hai.
  • Class XII (CBSE), 2021 · 91% Experience ho gaya to Class X/XII hata sakte ho.

docs.title: Fresher ho to — experience ki jagah kya?
docs.text:
Fresher ke paas job nahi, par kaam hai: internships, college projects, hackathons, freelance, college fest organise karna, NSS/NCC, tuition padhana. Inhe bhi usi formula se likho — verb + task + result + number. Order: Profile → Education → Projects / Internships → Skills → Achievements.

  • Organised a three-day tech fest with 1,200 participants and a ₹3 lakh budget. College fest bhi asli kaam hai — budget, log, deadline.
  • Completed a two-month internship at a CA firm; reconciled accounts for 15 clients. reconcile = hisaab milaana.
  • Taught maths to 20 Class 8 students as a volunteer; average scores rose by 12 marks. Volunteer kaam + nateeja.

Pehle → baad me: ek fresher ka CV

Pehle

CURRICULUM VITAE · [photo] · Name: Rohit Kumar · Father's Name: Shri R. P. Kumar · DOB: 12/03/2003 · Marital Status: Unmarried · Objective: To work in a reputed company and grow with it. · Strengths: Hard-working, sincere, punctual. · Hobbies: Listening music, surfing net. · Declaration: I hereby declare that the above information is true to the best of my knowledge.

Baad me

  • ROHIT KUMAR · Lucknow · 98xxx xxxxx · rohit.k@mail.com Heading me sirf naam — "Curriculum Vitae" nahi. Photo, pita ka naam, DOB, marital status hata diye.
  • Profile: BBA graduate with a summer internship in retail sales. Comfortable with Excel and customer calls. Seeking a sales-trainee role. Objective ki jagah teen line ka profile.
  • Sales Intern, a fashion retail store, Lucknow (May–July 2024): Helped the store hit its monthly target by upselling accessories; added ₹60,000 in sales. "Hard-working" likhne ki jagah saboot — number ke saath.

Declaration aur hobbies hata diye. Bacha hua space projects aur skills ko diya.

docs.title: 52.7 Indian CV ki aam galtiyan
docs.text:
Kai aadatein purane sarkaari forms se aayi hain. Private companies aur bahar ki naukriyon me ye CV ko purana dikhati hain — aur kuch to bhedbhaav ka khatra bhi badhaati hain. Haan, agar job ad khud photo ya DOB maange (kuch sarkaari, Gulf ya airline jobs), to wahi do.

Ye sab hata do

  • Galat: Photo, Father's Name, Date of Birth, Marital Status, Religion
  • Sahi: Name · City · Phone · Email · LinkedIn

  • Kyun: Inka kaam se koi lena-dena nahi, aur ye unconscious bias badhaate hain. Jagah bachao, kaam dikhao. (Job ad maange tab hi do.)

  • Galat: I hereby declare that the above information is true to the best of my knowledge.

  • Sahi: (Kuch nahi — line hata do.)

  • Kyun: Ye affidavit ki bhasha hai. Private CV me iski zaroorat nahi; sarkaari form khud maange to alag baat.

  • Galat: Heading: CURRICULUM VITAE / RESUME

  • Sahi: Heading: ANANYA IYER

  • Kyun: Sab jaante hain ki ye CV hai. Sabse badi line aapka naam ho.

  • Galat: Hobbies: Listening music, surfing net, reading books.

  • Sahi: Interests: Long-distance running (2 half-marathons), Carnatic music.

  • Kyun: Grammar: listening to music. Aur "surfing net" kuch nahi batata. Hobby tab likho jab wo kuch kahe — warna section hata do.

  • Galat: I have done my B.Com from Delhi University.

  • Sahi: B.Com, University of Delhi, 2024
  • Kyun: CV me poore vaakya nahi, tukde. Bolte waqt: I did / completed my B.Com at Delhi University.

Jhooth aur copy-paste — kabhi nahi

Number badha-chadha ke mat likho. Interview me har bullet par sawaal aa sakta hai: "Walk me through how you cut the time by 50%." Jo bullet aap 2 minute tak samjha nahi sakte, wo CV par mat rakho. Taiyaari ke liye Interview aur office.

  • Walk me through your CV. Interviewer: apna CV shuru se samjhao.
  • Sure. I'll start with my current role and then go back. Jawaab bhi CV ke kram me — naya pehle.

docs.title: 52.8 LinkedIn — headline aur About
docs.text:
LinkedIn par aapka headline naam ke theek neeche dikhta hai — search me bhi yahi aata hai. Default "Student at XYZ College" ki jagah batao ki aap kya karte ho aur kis cheez me achhe ho.

Headline formula

Role | Specialty | Proof ya value — "Data Analyst | SQL & Power BI | Turning sales data into weekly decisions". Lagbhag 220 characters milte hain — chhota aur saaf rakho.

Kamzor headline Majboot headline Looking for opportunities Final-year B.Tech (CSE) | Java & Spring Boot | 2 internships Working at ABC Pvt Ltd HR Executive | Campus hiring | Hired 120+ freshers in 2025 Hard-working professional Chartered Accountant | GST & audit | Helping SMEs stay compliant

docs.title: About section — first person, baat-cheet jaisa
docs.text:
CV ke ulte, LinkedIn ka About section "I" ke saath likhte hain — jaise aap kisi se mil ke apna parichay de rahe ho. Teen chhote paragraph: aap kya karte ho, ek-do nateeje, aur aap kis tarah ke kaam ya logon se judna chahte ho.

  • I'm a data analyst who helps sales teams make faster decisions. Pehli line — aap kya karte ho aur kiske liye.
  • At my current company, I built a weekly dashboard that replaced six manual reports. Ek nateeja — wahi bullet formula, par "I" ke saath.
  • I'm currently exploring roles in product analytics. Feel free to reach out. Aakhri line — kya chahte ho. reach out = sampark karna.

✗

Myself Priya, a passionate and dynamic professional.

✓

I'm Priya, a UX designer who makes banking apps easier for first-time users.

Indian English ki aadatein

karte kya ho

docs.title: 52.9 Practice — CV aur LinkedIn
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Ek fresher ka CV kitne page ka hona chahiye?

  • 1 page
  • 2 pages
  • 3 pages
  • Jitna lamba utna achha
Jawaab

1 page

Fresher ya kam experience: 1 page. 10+ saal: 2 page tak.

Exercise 2

Kaunsa bullet sabse majboot hai?

  • Reduced invoice errors by 40% by adding Excel checks.
  • Responsible for invoices.
  • Worked on invoice-related tasks.
  • I was handling the invoice part.
Jawaab

Reduced invoice errors by 40% by adding Excel checks.

Verb + task + result + number — baaki sirf duty batate hain.

Exercise 3

___ a team of six to deliver the project two weeks early. (lead ka past)

Hint: Team chalaana — past tense.

Jawaab

Led / led

lead → led. CV bullets seedha past-tense verb se shuru hote hain.

Exercise 4

Hobby wali line me galti dhoondo.

Hobbies: listening music and travelling.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: listening.

Sahi roop: Hobbies: listening to music and travelling.

listen ke baad 'to' chahiye: listening to music.

Exercise 5

Private company ke CV me in me se kya rakhna chahiye?

  • LinkedIn profile link
  • Father's name
  • Marital status
  • I hereby declare…
Jawaab

LinkedIn profile link

Header me sirf naam, city, phone, email, LinkedIn. Baaki tab hi jab job ad maange.

Exercise 6

Kaam ko sahi verb se jodo.

A B Team chalaayi Launched Kharcha kam kiya Trained App banaya aur shuru kiya Led Logon ko sikhaya Cut Jawaab

Team chalaayi — Led; Kharcha kam kiya — Cut; App banaya aur shuru kiya — Launched; Logon ko sikhaya — Trained

Har kaam ka ek majboot action verb hota hai.

Exercise 7

Is bullet ka kamzor hissa dhoondo.

Responsible for managing the company Instagram page.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: Responsible.

Sahi roop: Grew the company Instagram page from 2,000 to 15,000 followers.

'Responsible for' sirf duty hai — action verb aur nateeja chahiye.

Exercise 8

Profile summary me kya nahi hona chahiye?

  • To work in a challenging environment for the growth of the organisation
  • Kitne saal ka experience
  • Ek bada nateeja
  • Aap aage kya chahte ho
Jawaab

To work in a challenging environment for the growth of the organisation

Ye purana 'objective' hai — har CV me same, kuch nahi batata.

Exercise 9

Customer support lead with five ___ experience in e-commerce.

Hint: years ka experience — apostrophe kahan?

Jawaab

years' / years’

five years' experience — plural 'years' ke baad apostrophe.

Exercise 10

LinkedIn headline ka sabse achha roop?

  • HR Executive | Campus hiring | Hired 120+ freshers in 2025
  • Looking for opportunities
  • Hard-working and sincere professional
  • Working at ABC Pvt Ltd
Jawaab

HR Executive | Campus hiring | Hired 120+ freshers in 2025

Role | Specialty | Proof — headline formula.

Exercise 11

LinkedIn ka About section kis tarah likhte hain?

  • First person — 'I'm…, I built…'
  • Bina verb ke tukdon me
  • Third person — 'He is…'
  • Sirf skills ki list
Jawaab

First person — 'I'm…, I built…'

CV bina 'I' ke; LinkedIn About 'I' ke saath, baat-cheet jaisa.

Exercise 12

Is baat se kaunsa CV bullet sabse sahi banta hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

In my last job I handled customer complaints. I set up a new ticket system, and our average response time came down from two days to six hours.

  • Set up a ticket system that cut response time from two days to six hours.
  • Responsible for customer complaints.
  • Handled complaints and tickets.
  • Worked in customer support for two days.
Jawaab

Set up a ticket system that cut response time from two days to six hours.

Verb (Set up) + task (ticket system) + result + number (2 din se 6 ghante).

Exercise 13

Response time kitna ho gaya?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

In my last job I handled customer complaints. I set up a new ticket system, and our average response time came down from two days to six hours.

  • Six hours
  • Two days
  • Two hours
  • Six days
Jawaab

Six hours

'came down from two days to six hours' — 2 din se ghat kar 6 ghante.

Exercise 14

Ye bullet suno aur likho.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

Led a team of five to launch the app in three months.

Led (lead ka past) + team + launch + number.

Exercise 15

Bullet ko sahi kram me lagao.

Shabd: complaints / percent / in / 30 / customer / months / by / Reduced / six

Jawaab

Reduced customer complaints by 30 percent in six months

Verb + task + result (by 30 percent) + samay.

Exercise 16

Ek job ke bullets me tense ki galti dhoondo.

Increased sales by 20%. Am managing a team of four.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: Am.

Sahi roop: Increased sales by 20%. Managed a team of four.

CV bullet me 'am' jaisa helping verb nahi, aur ek job me ek hi tense.

Exercise 17

Interview me apna ek bullet bol ke dekho.

Jawaab

Bolo: I reduced customer complaints by thirty per cent

Bolte waqt 'I' lagao — CV me nahi likhte, par baat-cheet me zaroori.

Aage kya karein

Aaj apne CV ke teen bullets formula se dobara likho. Phir CV ke saath bhejne wala cover note Application aur message se, aur interview ki taiyaari Interview aur office se.

docs.title: Chapter 7: some, any, much, many
docs.text:
Determiners — noun se pehle ka chhota faisla

Noun bolne se pehle hum aksar ek chhota shabd lagaate hain jo batata hai — kaunsa, kitna, ya kiska. Hindi me "ye, wo, kuch, bahut, har, mera" se kaam chal jaata hai. English me wahi "bahut" kabhi many banta hai, kabhi much, aur "kuch" kabhi some, kabhi a few. Ye faisla ek hi sawaal se hota hai — aur wo sawaal is chapter ki chaabi hai.

Ek line me

A determiner comes before a noun and tells us which one, how many / how much, or whose. Articles (a, an, the) bhi determiners hi hain — unka apna chapter alag hai.

  • These mangoes are sweet. Kaunse? — ye wale. (which)
  • We don't have much time. Kitna? — zyada nahi. (how much)
  • Is this your bag? Kiska? — tumhara. (whose)

docs.title: 7.1 Pehla sawaal hamesha — gin sakte ho ya nahi?
docs.text:
Lagbhag har determiner ki galti ek hi jagah se aati hai: humne socha nahi ki noun gina ja sakta hai ya nahi. Ye sawaal pehle poochh lo, to aadhe determiners apne aap sahi lagne lagenge.

Figure 7.1. Pehle poochho gin sakte ho? , phir ek ya kai? — determiner apne aap mil jaayega.

Sabse pehla sawaal

Determiner chunne se pehle poochho: noun gina ja sakta hai ya nahi? Countable ho to ek ya kai — a, many, a few, these. Uncountable ho to — much, a little, this. Kuch dono ke saath chalte hain: some, any, all, enough.

Ye shabd English me gine nahi jaate

work, advice, information, furniture, luggage, equipment, news, homework, traffic — inka plural nahi banta aur inke saath a / many nahi lagta. Ginna ho to tukda jodo: a piece of advice, two pieces of furniture, an item of news. Hindi me "do salaah" bol dete hain, isliye yahan sabse zyada galti hoti hai.

docs.title: 7.2 this, that, these, those — paas ya door
docs.text:
Ye chaar shabd ungli ki tarah kaam karte hain — kisi cheez ki taraf ishaara karte hain. Do hi sawaal: cheez paas hai ya door, aur ek hai ya kai.

Figure 7.2. Upar ki line ek cheez ke liye, neeche ki line kai cheezon ke liye. Baayein paas, daayein door.

Paas-door, ek-kai

this (paas, ek) · these (paas, kai) · that (door, ek) · those (door, kai). Determiner aur noun dono ek hi number me hone chahiye: this book, these books.

'These type of' — sabse aam chook

  • Galat: These type of questions are easy.
  • Sahi: This type of question is easy. / These types of questions are easy.
  • Kyun: "these" plural hai, to uske baad wala noun bhi plural chahiye — types. Ya phir dono singular rakho.

docs.title: 7.3 some aur any — haan wale aur na wale vaakya
docs.text:
Dono ka matlab lagbhag "kuch" hai, aur dono countable plural aur uncountable — dono ke saath chalte hain. Farq vaakya ke mood ka hai: seedhi baat hai, inkaar hai, ya sawaal.

Vaakya Shabd Example Seedhi (positive) baat some I bought some apples. Negative any I didn't buy any apples. Aam sawaal any Do you have any questions? Offer ya request some Would you like some tea? "Koi bhi" (positive me) any Take any seat you like.

some vs any

some — positive vaakya, offer aur request me. any — negative aur aam sawaal me, ya "koi bhi" ke matlab me. Chai offer karte waqt "some" — kyunki aap "haan" ki umeed kar rahe ho.

  • There isn't any milk in the fridge. Fridge me bilkul doodh nahi hai.
  • Can I have some water, please? Request hai, isliye sawaal hote hue bhi "some".

docs.title: 7.4 much, many, a lot of — kitna aur kitne
docs.text:
Hindi ka ek "bahut" English me do raaste leta hai. Yahan countable ka sawaal seedha kaam aata hai — many ginti wale noun ke liye, much dher wale ke liye.

Shabd Kiske saath Kahan zyada Example many countable plural har jagah How many students came? much uncountable negative, sawaal I don't have much money. a lot of / lots of dono positive, bolchaal She has a lot of friends / patience. fewer countable tulna fewer cars less uncountable tulna less traffic

much vs many

many + countable plural (many books), much + uncountable (much water). Positive baat me "a lot of" zyada natural lagta hai — dono ke saath chal jaata hai.

'How much' ya 'How many'?

How much is this shirt? — daam (paisa uncountable hai). How many shirts did you buy? — ginti.

docs.title: 7.5 a few / few, a little / little — "a" ka jaadu
docs.text:
Yahan ek chhota sa "a" poora mood badal deta hai. "a" ke saath baat positive hai — thoda hai, aur kaafi hai. Bina "a" ke baat negative hai — bahut kam hai, kami khal rahi hai.

Figure 7.3. a laga = glass aadha bhara dikh raha hai. a hata = glass khaali dikh raha hai.

'a' positive, bina 'a' negative

a few (countable) / a little (uncountable) = thoda hai, kaafi hai. few / little = bahut kam hai, kami hai. I have a little money → chai pee sakte hain. I have little money → mushkil hai.

  • She has a few good friends in Chennai. Kuch achhe dost hain — wo akeli nahi hai.
  • Few people came to the meeting. Gine-chune log hi aaye — umeed se kam.

docs.title: 7.6 each, every, both, either, neither, all
docs.text:
Ye shabd group ke baare me baat karte hain — poore group ki, do me se ek ki, ya ek-ek karke sabki. Inki sabse badi pehchaan: inke baad noun singular aata hai ya plural, ye pakka hai.

Figure 7.4. both ke alawa sab singular noun lete hain. all teen ya zyada ke liye — all students, all water.

Group wale determiners

each, every, either, neither + singular noun + singular verb (Every student has a book). both = do, plural. all = teen ya zyada, ya poora dher (all the milk).
