'can you bring your speaker? Mine's broken.' Board games to cafe me hi hain.

Exercise 14

What can we guess about Riya?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Let's meet at six-ish outside the station. And please don't be late this time, okay? I'm joking. Well, mostly!

  • She was late last time.
  • She lives far from the station.
  • She doesn't like cafes.
  • She is Tanvi's sister.
Jawaab

She was late last time.

'this time' + 'Well, mostly!' — pichhli baar wo late thi, aur Tanvi aadhi seriously keh rahi hai.

Exercise 15

Phrase ko uske context wale matlab se jodo.

A B sum up nahi aa paana take over dono taraf ka fayda can't make it saar me batana the best of both worlds kisi ka kaam sambhaalna Jawaab

sum up — saar me batana; take over — kisi ka kaam sambhaalna; can't make it — nahi aa paana; the best of both worlds — dono taraf ka fayda

Ye phrases shabd-dar-shabd nahi, poore matlab se samjho — context hi chaabi hai.

Exercise 16

Kaunsi line informal (dost ke voice note jaisi) hai?

  • I'm kind of bored of movies, so six-ish?
  • Thank you for your patience.
  • May I have your customer ID, please?
  • Let me quickly sum up today's meeting.

Hint: -ish aur kind of dhoondo.

Jawaab

I'm kind of bored of movies, so six-ish?

'kind of' aur 'six-ish' informal baat-cheet ke nishaan hain. Baaki teen office ya customer care ki English hain.

Exercise 17

Suno aur likho.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

The testing team needs one more week.

'team' singular → 'needs' (-s ke saath).

Exercise 18

Suno aur likho.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

My internet has been down since last night.

'has been … since' = present perfect, kal raat se ab tak.

Exercise 19

Suno aur likho.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

While we were standing in the queue, I realised that I had left my ID card at home.

Teen tense ek saath: were standing (chal raha tha), realised (ghatna), had left (usse pehle).

Exercise 20

Kavita ki tarah team se ye kaho — dostana, par saaf.

Jawaab

Bolo: Have a think and let me know by Friday

'let me know' jud kar 'lemme know' jaisa; 'by Friday' = Friday tak, usse pehle bhi chalega.

Next step

Har tukda ek baar shadowing karo — audio ke saath-saath, aadha second peeche, wahi bolo. Jab Kavita ka summary aur Tanvi ka voice note bina ruke bol pao, tab chalo Asli duniya ki English par: station announcements, news aur interviews.

docs.title: Chapter 59: IELTS, TOEFL aur aapka level
docs.text:
IELTS, TOEFL aur aapka level — A1 se C2 tak

"Meri English kaisi hai?" — iska jawaab "achhi" ya "theek-thaak" nahi, ek level hai. Duniya bhar me English ko chhe seedhiyon me naapa jaata hai: A1 se C2. Is chapter me har level par aap kya kar sakte ho (apne aap check karne ki list ke saath), bade exams — IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, Cambridge — ka seedha parichay, kitne ghante lagte hain, aur har level ke liye is kitaab ke kaunse chapters padhne hain.

docs.title: 59.1 CEFR — chhe seedhiyan
docs.text:
CEFR (Common European Framework of Reference) ek international paimaana hai. Iske teen bade hisse hain: A = shuruaat (basic user), B = apne dam par (independent user), C = mahir (proficient user). Har hisse me do level. Zyaadatar naukri aur university B2 ya C1 maangti hain.

Figure 59.1. Ghante = shuruaat se us level tak ka lagbhag kul padhai ka samay (guided learning hours ka aam andaaza). IELTS band sirf moti tulna hai — har exam ki apni official table hoti hai.

Level ek line me

A = survive karna · B = apna kaam khud chalana · C = jaisa chaho waisa kehna. Har agla level pichhle se zyada samay leta hai. B1 se B2 ka safar aksar A1 se B1 jitna lamba lagta hai — ghabraao mat, ye normal hai.

  • My English is at B2 level, but my speaking is closer to B1. Apna level batane ka sahi tareeka — "at B2 level".
  • I'd like to reach C1 by the end of next year. Lakshya — reach + level + by + samay.
  • Which level do I need for this job? Naukri ke liye kitna level chahiye?

docs.title: 59.2 A1 aur A2 — shuruaat
docs.text: Har level ko "can-do" vaakyon se samjhaya jaata hai — yaani aap kya kar sakte ho. Neeche ki list padho aur imaandaari se tick karo. Zyaadatar "haan" = aap us level par ho.

docs.title: A1 — Beginner
docs.text:
• ☐ Main apna naam, umr, sheher aur kaam bata sakta/sakti hoon.
  • ☐ Main aasaan sawaal poochh aur samajh sakta hoon: What's your name? Where do you live?
  • ☐ Main number, keemat aur samay samajh leta hoon jab koi dheere bole.

  • ☐ Main ek chhota form bhar sakta hoon (naam, pata, phone).

  • Hi, I'm Pooja. I'm from Indore. I'm a nurse. A1 — chhote, pakke vaakya.

  • How much is this? Can you say that again, please? A1 — keemat poochhna, dobara bolne ko kehna.

docs.title: A2 — Elementary
docs.text:
• ☐ Main apne parivaar, kaam aur roz ki routine ke baare me kuch line bol sakta hoon.
  • ☐ Main dukaan, bank ya station par aam kaam kar leta hoon.
  • ☐ Main chhota message ya note likh sakta hoon: I'm late. See you at 6.

  • ☐ Main beete kal ke baare me aasaan baat kar sakta hoon: Last Sunday I went to…

  • I work in a hospital. I usually start at eight and finish at four. A2 — routine, "usually", do vaakya jude hue.

  • Last weekend I visited my aunt in Bhopal. We went to the lake. A2 — simple past ke saath chhoti kahani.

docs.title: 59.3 B1 aur B2 — apne dam par
B1 — Intermediate
docs.text:
• ☐ Safar me aane wali zyaadatar situations main khud sambhaal leta hoon.
  • ☐ Main apne anubhav, sapne aur plans ke baare me jud-jud ke bol sakta hoon.
  • ☐ Main apni raay ki chhoti wajah de sakta hoon: I prefer trains because…
  • ☐ Main jaani-pehchaani cheezon par seedha email ya chhota paragraph likh sakta hoon.

  • ☐ Saaf, aam raftaar ki English me main main baat samajh leta hoon.

  • I prefer working in a team because I learn a lot from other people. B1 — raay + "because" wali wajah.

  • When I was in college, I wanted to be a pilot, but I changed my mind. B1 — anubhav aur plans, jud-jud ke.

docs.title: B2 — Upper-intermediate
docs.text:
• ☐ Main native speakers se bina zyada ruke, aaram se baat kar leta hoon — dono taraf tension nahi.
  • ☐ Main kisi mudde par apni raay fayde-nuksaan ke saath samjha sakta hoon.
  • ☐ Main news, lambe articles aur apne field ke technical text ka main point pakad leta hoon.
  • ☐ Main saaf, vistaar wala text likh sakta hoon — jaise essay ya report.

  • ☐ Main apni galti aksar khud pakad ke sudhaar leta hoon.

  • Working from home saves time, but it can make teamwork harder, especially for new joiners. B2 — fayda + nuksaan + "especially" se baarikee.

  • The article argues that cities should ban cars, although it doesn't really explain how. B2 — lambe text ka main point + apni aalochna.

B1 aur B2 ka asli farq

B1 = kaam chal jaata hai. B2 = aaram se chalta hai — tez baat samajh lete ho, aur raay ko kaaran aur example ke saath rakhte ho. Zyaadatar Indian graduates B1 aur B2 ke beech hote hain. Is kitaab ka bada hissa isi chhalaang ke liye hai.

docs.title: C1 — Advanced
docs.text:
• ☐ Main shabd dhoonde bina, behte hue bol leta hoon.
  • ☐ Main lambe, mushkil text samajh leta hoon — aur jo seedha nahi kaha gaya (implied meaning) wo bhi.
  • ☐ Main meeting, presentation aur padhai me English ko lachila tareeke se use karta hoon.

  • ☐ Main mushkil vishay par achhe dhaanche wala, jude hue vaakyon ka text likh leta hoon.

  • I take your point, but I'm not convinced the savings would outweigh the risks. C1 — vinamra asehmati, "outweigh" jaisa sateek shabd.

  • What she didn't say was more telling than what she did. C1 — ankahi baat samajhna (implied meaning).

docs.title: C2 — Proficient
docs.text:
• ☐ Main sunaayi aur padhi lagbhag har cheez aasaani se samajh leta hoon.
  • ☐ Main alag-alag srot ki jaankari ka saar bana kar, jud-jud ke samjha sakta hoon.

  • ☐ Main baarik farq bhi sahi shabdon me keh leta hoon — mazaak, vyang, ishaara bhi.

  • It's not that the plan is wrong, exactly; it's more that it's been oversold. C2 — baarik farq: galat nahi, bas zyada badha-chadha ke bataaya gaya.

  • Taken together, the three reports suggest a slowdown rather than a crisis. C2 — kai srot ka saar, sateek nateeja.

Har skill ka level alag ho sakta hai

Bahut log reading me B2 aur speaking me B1 hote hain. Ye bilkul normal hai. Isliye exams har skill ka alag score dete hain — aur aapko apni sabse kamzor skill par sabse zyada kaam karna chahiye.

docs.title: 59.5 Bade exams — ek nazar me
docs.text:
Neeche har exam ka moti jaankari wala parichay hai. Format, fees, score aur niyam samay-samay par badalte hain — exam book karne se pehle hamesha official website par current details check karo, aur jahan apply kar rahe ho (university, visa, company) wahan ki zaroorat bhi.

Exam Format (moti baat) Score IELTS Academic Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking · lagbhag 2 ghante 45 minute · speaking examiner ke saamne Band 0–9 (aadhe band bhi) IELTS General Training Wahi chaar hisse; Reading aur Writing roz ki zindagi aur kaam ke text par Band 0–9 TOEFL iBT Reading, Listening, Speaking, Writing · computer par · speaking mic me record 2026 se naya 1–6 scale (purana 0–120 kuch samay saath) PTE Academic Speaking & Writing, Reading, Listening · computer par, lagbhag 2 ghante · computer score karta hai 10–90 Cambridge B2 First / C1 Advanced Reading & Use of English, Writing, Listening, Speaking (aksar jodi me) Cambridge English Scale + grade

docs.title: IELTS — Academic ya General Training?
docs.text:
Academic = university me padhai ya professional registration (jaise doctors, nurses). General Training = kaam, migration, ya school-level padhai. Listening aur Speaking dono me same hote hain; Reading aur Writing alag. Writing Task 1 Academic me graph ya chart samjhana hai, General me ek letter likhna.

  • I'm taking IELTS Academic next month. I need a band seven overall. "take" an exam; "band seven overall" — kul milaakar 7.
  • The speaking test is a face-to-face conversation with an examiner. IELTS speaking — examiner se aamne-saamne baat (lagbhag 11–14 minute).
  • Most universities accept scores that are less than two years old. IELTS, TOEFL, PTE ke score aam taur par 2 saal tak maane jaate hain. Cambridge certificate expire nahi hota — par koi institution recent result maang sakti hai.

Exam pass-fail nahi hota

IELTS, TOEFL aur PTE me pass ya fail nahi hota — sirf score. Sawaal ye hai ki aapki manzil kitna score maangti hai. Isliye "IELTS clear karna hai" ki jagah: "I need a band 7 in IELTS."

docs.title: 59.6 Kaunsa exam chunein?
docs.text:
Exam chunne ka pehla sawaal English nahi, manzil hai: kahan jaana hai aur kyun? Wahi institution batayegi ki kaunse exam maanya hain.

Figure 59.2. Ek hi desh me bhi alag-alag university ya visa alag exam maanti hai. Apply karne se pehle unki website par English language requirements padho.

Exam chunne ka niyam

Manzil → uski list → aapka comfort. Computer par typing aur mic me bolna aaram se ho to TOEFL/PTE; insaan se baat karna behtar lage to IELTS ka speaking. Do exam ek saath taiyaar mat karo — ek chuno, uske sample test do.

  • Which English tests does your university accept? University se poochhne ki pehli line.
  • What's the minimum score for each skill? Kai jagah har skill ka alag minimum hota hai.
  • I'm aiming for at least a seven in writing. aim for = nishaana rakhna.
  • I've booked the computer-delivered test for the fifteenth of March. computer-delivered = computer par hone wala test.

docs.title: 59.7 Kitna samay lagega? — study plan
docs.text:
Ek level upar jaane me aam taur par 150 se 250 ghante lagte hain, aur upar ke levels par zyada. Roz ek ghanta = mahine ke lagbhag 30 ghante. Yaani B1 se B2: lagbhag 6 se 8 mahine, agar roz padhai ho.

Din Kya karein Samay Roz Is kitaab ka ek hissa, sab kuch zor se bol ke 15–20 min Roz English sunna — podcast, news, YouTube (subtitles English me) 20 min Roz 5 naye tukde (chunks) phone ke note me 5 min Hafte me 3 din Likhna — email, paragraph ya essay 20–40 min Hafte me 2 din Kisi se bolna, ya khud ko record karke sunna 15 min Mahine me ek baar Ek mock test ya chapter ka quiz dobara 1 ghanta
  • I study for an hour every day, and I take a mock test once a month. Apni routine English me bolna — wo bhi practice hai.
  • My weakest skill is speaking, so I record myself twice a week. Sabse kamzor skill par sabse zyada samay.
  • I've improved a lot, but I still make mistakes with articles. Apni pragati imaandaari se batana.

Ghante gino, din nahi

"Teen mahine me IELTS" ka koi matlab nahi jab tak ye na pata ho ki roz kitne ghante. Ek chhoti diary rakho: tareekh + minute + kya kiya. Hafte ke 5 ghante x 30 hafte = 150 ghante = lagbhag ek level.

docs.title: 59.8 Aapka level, is kitaab ke chapters
docs.text:
Upar ki list se apna level chuno, phir neeche us level ke chapters par dhyan do. Neeche wale level ke chapters ek baar dohra lo — wahi buniyaad hai.

Level · focus Ye chapters padho A1 · Aawaz, shabd, seedha vaakya Is kitaab ko kaise padhein · English ki aawazein · Shabd ke 8 prakaar · Vaakya ki banawat · Noun — naam wale shabd · a, an, the · Pronoun — naam ki jagah · Verb — kaam wale shabd A2 · Roz ki zindagi sambhaalna Saare 12 tenses · Adjective — kaisa hai · Adverb — kaise, kab, kahan · Preposition — rishta jodne wale · Conjunction — jodne wale shabd · Interjection — bhaav wale shabd · some, any, much, many · Sawaal poochhna · Subject-verb agreement · Roz ki baat-cheet · Number, date, time, paise · Roz ke vishay B1 · Jud-jud ke bolna aur likhna can, could, should, must · to do ya doing? · If wale vaakya · Uchchaaran theek karo · Small talk aur raay dena · Phone aur video call · Viraam chinh · Spelling ke niyam · Vaakya se paragraph · Email likhna · Application aur message · Phrasal verbs · Kaunsa shabd kiske saath · Chhoti kahaniyan · Indian English ki aadatein B2 · Tez English, raay, kaam ki likhai Chhote se bade vaakya · Active aur Passive · Kisi ki baat aage batana · used to, wish, had better · Rhythm aur stress · Native speed English · Interview aur office · Presentation dena · Ek shabd se das shabd · Kaam aur duniya · Milte-julte shabd · CV aur LinkedIn · Roz ki kahaniyan · 50 sabse aam galtiyan C1 · Sateek shabd, lachila style Asar daar vaakya · Fluency aur filler words · Essay aur report · Idioms · Basic se Native · Verb upgrade · Sahi adjective chuno · Asli duniya ki English C2 · Baarikee aur andaaz Advanced shabd · Aakhri imtihaan — aur phir asli kitaabein, podcasts, behas

Kitaab ko seedhi ki tarah use karo

Apne level ke chapters ke quiz do. 80% se upar = agla level. Neeche = wahi chapter ek baar aur, is baar sab kuch zor se bol ke. Poori kitaab ka mixed test Aakhri imtihaan me hai.

docs.title: 59.9 Exam ki English — wo galtiyan jo hum bolte hain
docs.text:
Exam ke baare me baat karte waqt bhi kuch aam Indian English aadatein aati hain. Interview ya visa officer ke saamne ye saaf roop bolo.

✗

I have given IELTS last month.

✓

I took IELTS last month. / I sat the IELTS test last month. (UK)

dete

take

sit

✗

I got 7 bands in IELTS.

✓

I got a band 7 / an overall band score of 7.

I got 6.5 in writing.

✗

I want to clear IELTS.

✓

I need a band 7 in IELTS for my university.

✗

Speaking me rata hua jawaab: "Well, that's a very interesting question. Since my childhood…"

✓

Seedha, apna jawaab: "I'd say my favourite place is the old market near my house, mainly because…"

dhaancha

  • I'd say my favourite place is the old market near my house, mainly because of the food. "I'd say…" + "mainly because…" — speaking test ki natural shuruaat.
  • Sorry, could you repeat the question, please? Sawaal samajh na aaye to poochhna bilkul theek hai.
  • That's not something I've thought about much, but I suppose… Mushkil sawaal par sochne ka samay lena — chup rehne se behtar.

docs.title: 59.10 Practice — Exams aur level
docs.text:
Exercise 1

CEFR me sabse ooncha level kaunsa hai?

  • C2
  • C1
  • B2
  • A1
Jawaab

C2

A1 → A2 → B1 → B2 → C1 → C2. C2 = proficient.

Exercise 2

'Main safar ki zyaadatar situations khud sambhaal leta hoon, aur apne anubhav jod ke bata sakta hoon.' — ye kaunsa level hai?

  • B1
  • A1
  • C1
  • C2
Jawaab

B1

B1 = independent user ki shuruaat — travel, anubhav, chhoti wajah.

Exercise 3

Level ko uske bade hisse se jodo.

A B A1, A2 Independent user B1, B2 Proficient user C1, C2 Basic user Jawaab

A1, A2 — Basic user; B1, B2 — Independent user; C1, C2 — Proficient user

A = shuruaat, B = apne dam par, C = mahir.

Exercise 4

IELTS me Academic aur General Training me kya alag hota hai?

  • Reading aur Writing
  • Listening aur Speaking
  • Sirf Speaking
  • Kuch nahi
Jawaab

Reading aur Writing

Listening aur Speaking dono me same; Reading aur Writing alag.

Exercise 5

IELTS ka score kis scale par aata hai?

  • Band 0–9
  • 10–90
  • 0–100 percent
  • A se F grade
Jawaab

Band 0–9

IELTS: band 0–9, aadhe band bhi (6.5). PTE: 10–90.

Exercise 6

Galat shabd par tap karo.

I have given IELTS last month.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: given.

Sahi roop: I took IELTS last month.

Exam 'take' kiya jaata hai (UK: sit). Last month = simple past.

Exercise 7

Score ki galti dhoondo.

I got 7 bands in IELTS.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: bands.

Sahi roop: I got a band 7 in IELTS.

Band ek score hai — 'a band 7' ya 'an overall band score of 7'.

Exercise 8

I'm ___ IELTS Academic next month. (exam dena)

Hint: give nahi.

Jawaab

taking / sitting

take an exam (UK me sit an exam bhi).

Exercise 9

Kaunsa exam computer score karta hai aur 10–90 scale par result deta hai?

  • PTE Academic
  • IELTS
  • Cambridge B2 First
  • Koi nahi
Jawaab

PTE Academic

PTE Academic computer-based aur automated scoring wala hai, score 10–90.

Exercise 10

Exam chunne ka sabse pehla kadam kya hai?

  • Manzil (university / visa) ki official list dekhna
  • Sabse sasta exam
  • Dost ne jo diya wahi
  • Sabse aasaan lagne wala
Jawaab

Manzil (university / visa) ki official list dekhna

Pehle manzil ki list, phir exam — wahi batati hai kaunsa score maanya hai.

Exercise 11

IELTS speaking test kiske saath hota hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

The IELTS test has four parts: listening, reading, writing and speaking. The speaking test is a face-to-face conversation with an examiner, and it lasts between eleven and fourteen minutes.

  • With an examiner
  • With a computer
  • With another candidate
  • On the phone
Jawaab

With an examiner

'a face-to-face conversation with an examiner'.

Exercise 12

Speaking test kitni der chalta hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

The IELTS test has four parts: listening, reading, writing and speaking. The speaking test is a face-to-face conversation with an examiner, and it lasts between eleven and fourteen minutes.

  • 11 to 14 minutes
  • 40 minutes
  • 2 hours
  • 5 minutes
Jawaab

11 to 14 minutes

'it lasts between eleven and fourteen minutes'.

Exercise 13

Arjun ka level sabse zyada kaunsa lagta hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Hi, I'm Arjun. I can talk about my work and my family, and I can handle most situations when I travel. But in meetings, when people speak fast, I often get lost.

  • B1
  • A1
  • C1
  • C2
Jawaab

B1

Travel aur roz ki baat sambhaal leta hai (B1), par tez baat me kho jaata hai — abhi B2 nahi.

Exercise 14

Arjun ko sabse zyada dikkat kahan hoti hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Hi, I'm Arjun. I can talk about my work and my family, and I can handle most situations when I travel. But in meetings, when people speak fast, I often get lost.

  • In meetings when people speak fast
  • When he travels
  • Talking about his family
  • Writing emails
Jawaab

In meetings when people speak fast

'in meetings, when people speak fast, I often get lost' — iske liye 'Native speed English' chapter.

Exercise 15

Suno aur likho.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

I need an overall band score of seven to study in Canada.

an overall band score of seven — score bolne ka sahi tareeka.

Exercise 16

B1 se B2 tak pahunchne me roz ek ghanta padhai se lagbhag kitna samay?

  • 6 se 8 mahine
  • 2 hafte
  • 1 mahina
  • 5 saal
Jawaab

6 se 8 mahine

Ek level ≈ 150–250 ghante; roz 1 ghanta ≈ 30 ghante mahina.

Exercise 17

Sahi kram me lagao.

Shabd: every / weakest / is / I / skill / speaking / so / practise / My / day

Jawaab

My weakest skill is speaking so I practise every day

Sabse kamzor skill + uska hal — apni taiyaari ke baare me natural line.

Exercise 18

Ab bol ke dekho.

Jawaab

Bolo: I need a band seven in IELTS

'clear IELTS' nahi — score batao.

Aage kya karein

Aaj apni self-check list ke tick gino aur apna level likh lo. Phir us level ke do chapters chuno aur is hafte poore karo. Mahine ke ant me Aakhri imtihaan do — aur dekho aap kitna upar chadhe.

docs.title: Chapter 60: Aakhri imtihaan
docs.text:
Aakhri imtihaan — poori kitaab ek saath

Yahan kuch naya nahi sikhaya jaayega. Ye test sirf ye dekhne ke liye hai ki kitaab ka kaunsa hissa aapke andar baith gaya aur kaunsa dobara khola jaana chahiye. Sawaal jaanbujh kar mila-jula hai — ek sawaal tense ka, agla phrasal verb ka, phir article ka. Asli zindagi me bhi aisa hi hota hai: koi aapko pehle nahi batata ki ab grammar ka chapter aa raha hai.

Kaise dein

Ek hi baithak me poora karo, aur jawaab dekhne se pehle ek baar khud socho. Galti hona bura nahi hai — galti kyun hui, wo "Dhyan do" wale hisse me likha hai. Score 80% se upar aaye to kitaab aapki ho gayi. 50 se neeche aaye to koi baat nahi, dobara shuru karo — par is baar sirf un chapters par ruko jahan galti hui.

docs.title: 60.1 Test me kya-kya hai
docs.text:
Neeche ki patti dikhati hai ki 30 sawaal kitaab ke paanch hisson me kaise baate gaye hain. Agar aapki galtiyan ek hi rang me jamaa ho rahi hain, to seedha us hisse me waapas jaao — poori kitaab dohraane ki zaroorat nahi.

Figure 60.1. Test ka naksha. Score se zyada zaroori ye hai ki galtiyan kis rang me jamaa hui hain.

Chhe tarah ke sawaal

Chunno (MCQ) · khaali jagah bharo (fill) · galti dhoondo (spot) · shabd jamao (reorder) · jodi banao (match) · bol kar dikhao (speak). "Bol kar dikhao" wale sawaal me mic chahiye. Na ho to sun kar dohra lo aur aage badh jao — score par asar nahi padta.

docs.title: 60.2 Shuru karne se pehle — teen minute ka warm-up
docs.text:
Ye teen galtiyan poori kitaab me sabse zyada baar aayi hain. Ek baar dekh lo, sudhre hue vaakya ek baar bol lo, phir test shuru karo.

Teen cheezein, aakhri baar

  • Galat: I am working here since three years.
  • Sahi: I've been working here for three years.

  • Kyun: Duration ke saath for, point ke saath since. Aur chalta hua kaam = have been + -ing.

  • Galat: She is doctor and she is good in surgery.

  • Sahi: She's a doctor and she's good at surgery.

  • Kyun: Pesha ke saath hamesha a/an, aur mahir hona = good at.

  • Galat: Tell me where is the lift.

  • Sahi: Could you tell me where the lift is?
  • Kyun: Sawaal jab bade vaakya ke andar aata hai, to kram seedha ho jaata hai — verb peechhe.

docs.title: 60.3 Aakhri imtihaan — poori kitaab
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Is vaakya me 'quickly' kaunsa part of speech hai? — She finished the report quickly.

  • Adverb
  • Adjective
  • Verb
  • Preposition

Hint: Ye batata hai ki kaam kaise hua.

Jawaab

Adverb

Adverb verb ke baare me batata hai — kaise, kab, kahan. Yahan 'quickly' batata hai ki 'finished' kaise hua.

Exercise 2

Ravi and I finished the work ___ .

Hint: Hum dono ne khud — reflexive roop.

Jawaab

ourselves

Reflexive pronoun subject se milta hai: I → myself, we → ourselves. Dhyan rakho: 'ourself' nahi hota.

Exercise 3

Kaunsa vaakya sahi hai?

  • I have been waiting for twenty minutes.
  • I am waiting since twenty minutes.
  • I wait since twenty minutes.
  • I have waited since twenty minutes.
Jawaab

I have been waiting for twenty minutes.

Jo kaam pehle shuru hua aur abhi chal raha hai = have been + -ing. Aur duration ke saath 'for', point ke saath 'since'.

Exercise 4

Galat shabd dhoondo.

She didn't came to the meeting yesterday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: came.

Sahi roop: She didn't come to the meeting yesterday.

'Did' pehle se past bata deta hai, isliye verb apne pehle roop me aata hai — didn't come.

Exercise 5

By the time we reached the platform, the train ___ .

  • had left
  • has left
  • left
  • was leaving

Hint: Past me do kaam — kaun pehle hua?

Jawaab

had left

Past me do kaam hon, to jo pehle hua uske saath 'had' lagta hai. Isi ko past perfect kehte hain.

Exercise 6

She ___ the answer, so just ask her.

Hint: Soch wale verbs continuous me nahi jaate.

Jawaab

knows

Know, understand, believe, like, want — ye continuous me nahi jaate. 'She is knowing' galat hai.

Exercise 7

Kaunsa vaakya sahi hai?

  • It took an hour to find a university nearby.
  • It took a hour to find an university nearby.
  • It took an hour to find an university nearby.
  • It took a hour to find a university nearby.

Hint: a/an aawaz se tay hota hai.

Jawaab

It took an hour to find a university nearby.

Hour ka H chup hai, aawaz 'aa' se shuru — an. University ki aawaz 'yoo' se shuru hoti hai, jo consonant jaisi hai — a.

Exercise 8

Ek shabd bekaar hai — us par tap karo.

I really enjoy the music in my free time.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: the.

Sahi roop: I really enjoy music in my free time.

Aam baat (general) me 'the' nahi lagta. 'The music' matlab wo khaas music jo abhi baj raha hai.

Exercise 9

My sister is very good ___ mathematics.

Hint: Mahir hona.

Jawaab

at

Kisi vishay me mahir hona = good at. Good with = cheezein ya log sambhalne me achha.

Exercise 10

Ek shabd hata dena chahiye — use dhoondo.

Let us discuss about the new policy on Monday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: about.

Sahi roop: Let's discuss the new policy on Monday.

Discuss ke andar hi 'about' shaamil hai. Isi family me: enter the room, reach Delhi, order two teas.

Exercise 11

The meeting is ___ 4 pm ___ Monday ___ July.

  • at / on / in
  • in / at / on
  • on / in / at
  • at / in / on
Jawaab

at / on / in

Exact time = at, din/taarikh = on, mahina/saal = in. Khaas se bada — yahi tarteeb hai.

Exercise 12

Each of the three teams ___ its own budget.

Hint: Each singular hai ya plural?

Jawaab

has

Each, every, everyone, nobody — sab singular hain, chahe baad me plural dikhe.

Exercise 13

Sawaal sahi kram me banao.

Shabd: jacket / Where / you / did / that / buy

Jawaab

Where did you buy that jacket

Sawaal me helping verb (did) subject (you) se pehle aata hai, aur uske baad verb apne pehle roop me.

Exercise 14

Kram galat hai — galat jagah wale shabd par tap karo.

Could you tell me where is the lift?

Jawaab

Galat shabd: is.

Sahi roop: Could you tell me where the lift is?

Jab sawaal bade vaakya ke andar aa jaaye, to kram seedha ho jaata hai — verb peechhe chala jaata hai.

Exercise 15

'The report was approved by the committee' ka active roop kaunsa hai?

  • The committee approved the report.
  • The report approved the committee.
  • The committee was approving by the report.
  • The report has approved the committee.
Jawaab

The committee approved the report.

Passive se active me jaate waqt 'by' wala hissa subject ban jaata hai, aur purana subject object.

Exercise 16

Rekha said that she ___ busy that evening.

Hint: Reported speech me tense ek kadam peechhe.

Jawaab

was

Kisi ki baat aage batate waqt tense ek kadam peechhe jaata hai: 'I am busy' → she said she was busy.

Exercise 17

Kaunsa vaakya punctuation ke hisaab se sahi hai?

  • It's raining, so take its cover along.
  • Its raining, so take it's cover along.
  • Its raining, so take its cover along.
  • It's raining, so take it's cover along.
Jawaab

It's raining, so take its cover along.

It's = it is. Its = uska. Apostrophe yahan possession nahi, shortcut batata hai.

Exercise 18

'Village' me zor kahan padta hai?

  • Pehle hisse par — VIL-lage
  • Doosre hisse par — vil-LAGE
  • Dono par barabar
  • Kahin nahi, saari aawaz barabar

Hint: Do hisse hain — VIL-lage.

Jawaab

Pehle hisse par — VIL-lage

English ke do-hisse wale zyada tar nouns me zor pehle hisse par aata hai. Yahi rhythm fluency banata hai.

Exercise 19

Bolte waqt soch ke liye waqt chahiye. Sabse behtar kya hai?

  • That's a good question — let me think for a second.
  • Basically basically wo aisa hai ki…
  • Actually actually main batata hoon…
  • Chup reh kar bees second rukna
Jawaab

That's a good question — let me think for a second.

Filler shabd (basically, actually) dohraane se bharosa girta hai. Ek poora chhota vaakya bol kar waqt lena natural lagta hai.

Exercise 20

Meeting me kisi ki baat samajh nahi aayi. Sabse natural line?

  • Sorry, I'm not following.
  • I am not understanding.
  • I have a doubt in your talk.
  • Please repeat it again.
Jawaab

Sorry, I'm not following.

'I'm not following' neutral hai — na aap kamzor lagte ho, na saamne wala galat. 'Repeat it again' me 'again' bekaar hai.

Exercise 21

This was lovely, but I should get ___ — it's getting late.

Hint: Nikalne ka narm tareeka.

Jawaab

going

'I should get going' = mujhe ab nikalna chahiye. 'I need to leave' se zyada polite aur zyada natural.

Exercise 22

'Naye form ne lagbhag saari galtiyan khatam kar dein' — kaunsa verb?

  • eliminated
  • enhanced
  • authorized
  • demonstrated
Jawaab

eliminated

Eliminate = poori tarah hata dena. Enhance achhe ko behtar karna hai, authorize adhikaar se ijaazat dena.

Exercise 23

Ek shabd bekaar hai — us par tap karo.

After two night shifts I was very exhausted.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: very.

Sahi roop: After two night shifts I was exhausted.

Exhausted pehle se sabse tez shabd hai. Zor chahiye to 'utterly exhausted' bolo, 'very' nahi.

Exercise 24

Interview me apne baare me kaunsa advanced shabd sabse achha lagta hai?

  • pragmatic
  • enigmatic
  • nefarious
  • onerous
Jawaab

pragmatic

Pragmatic = vyavhaarik, nateeja dekhne wala — taareef ka shabd hai. Enigmatic ka matlab hoga ki aapko koi samajh nahi paata.

Exercise 25

Music bahut tez hai. Sahi vaakya kaunsa hai?

  • Please turn it down.
  • Please turn down it.
  • Please turn down.
  • Please it turn down.

Hint: Pronoun kahan jaata hai?

Jawaab

Please turn it down.

Turn down separable hai, aur pronoun (it) majboori se beech me aata hai. 'Turn down it' kabhi sahi nahi hota.

Exercise 26

Kram galat hai — galat shabd par tap karo.

She will look the baby after this evening.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: after.

Sahi roop: She will look after the baby this evening.

Look after inseparable hai — object particle ke baad hi aayega, beech me kabhi nahi.

Exercise 27

Idiom ko uske matlab se jodo.

A B on the same page aaj ka kaam band karna the ball is in their court ummeed kam, par koshish call it a day ek hi samajh par hona a long shot ab faisla unka hai Jawaab

on the same page — ek hi samajh par hona; the ball is in their court — ab faisla unka hai; call it a day — aaj ka kaam band karna; a long shot — ummeed kam, par koshish

Ye chaaron office me roz sunai dete hain. Pehchaanna zaroori hai, bolna optional.

Exercise 28

Indian English ki aadat ko uske international roop se jodo.

A B Myself Ravi move the call up I have a doubt graduated in 2019 prepone the call I'm Ravi passed out in 2019 I have a question Jawaab

Myself Ravi — I'm Ravi; I have a doubt — I have a question; prepone the call — move the call up; passed out in 2019 — graduated in 2019

Chaaron India me poori tarah saaf hain — bas international call ke liye doosra gear chahiye.

Exercise 29

Email ki ek saaf line banao — bina 'kindly' aur 'needful' ke.

Shabd: can / we / so / release / invoice / Could / by / the / Friday / approve / you / payment

Jawaab

Could you approve the invoice by Friday so we can release payment

Formula: kya karna hai + kisko + kab tak. Teeno ek line me, aur baat bilkul saaf.

Exercise 30

Ye line bol kar dikhao. 'I have been' ko ek saath jodkar bolo, aur 'at' par halka zor.

Jawaab

Bolo: I have been working here for three years and I am good at my job

Ek line me teen cheezein theek hain — tense, preposition aur word order. Interview me yahi aapka pehla jawaab ban sakta hai.

Score ka matlab

80% se upar — kitaab aapki ho gayi. Ab practice ki jagah kitaab nahi, asli baat-cheet hai. Roz das minute kisi se English me baat karo. 50 se 80 — buniyaad majboot hai, bas kuch jagah dheeli hai. Chart dekho, galtiyon ka rang pehchaano, aur sirf un do-teen chapters par waapas jao. 50 se neeche — koi baat nahi, aur ye bura score bilkul nahi hai. Iska matlab sirf ye hai ki kitaab ek baar aur padhni hai. Doosri baar me cheezein bahut jaldi baithti hain, kyunki dimaag unhe pehchaanta hai.

docs.title: 60.4 Galti kahan hui? Seedha wahan waapas jaao
docs.text:
Score note kar lo, par usse zyada zaroori ye hai ki kis tarah ke sawaal me galti hui. Neeche ki table batati hai ki kahan waapas jaana hai.

Galti is kism ki thi Ye chapter dobara kholo a / an / the chhoot gaya ya galat laga a, an, the since / for, had / have, didn't + verb Saare 12 tenses in / on / at, good in, afraid from Preposition · 50 sabse aam galtiyan Sawaal ka kram, "where is the lift" Sawaal poochhna has / have, each, news Subject-verb agreement Passive se active, reported speech Active aur Passive · Kisi ki baat aage batana it's / its, comma, capital Viraam chinh Zor kahan padta hai, filler words Rhythm aur stress · Fluency Natural phrase galat ya ajeeb laga Basic se Native Bada verb ya adjective galat jagah par Verb upgrade · Sahi adjective chuno turn down it, look the baby after Phrasal verbs Idiom ka matlab ya jagah galat Idioms Myself, revert back, prepone, doubt Indian English ki aadatein can / must / should, have to can, could, should, must enjoy to read, want going to do ya doing? who / which / that, lambe vaakya jodna Chhote se bade vaakya used to / be used to, I wish, had better used to, wish, had better get it done, Never have I…, What I need is… Asar daar vaakya Tez English samajh nahi aayi (gonna, wanna) Native speed English 15 ya 50, date, ₹ ki rakam bolna Number, date, time, paise Baat shuru karna, raay dena, call par baat Small talk aur raay dena · Phone aur video call Presentation ki shuruaat ya ant Presentation dena happy / unhappy / happiness — galat roop Ek shabd se das shabd do a mistake, strong rain jaisi jodi Kaunsa shabd kiske saath Doctor, bank, safar ya office ka shabd nahi mila Roz ke vishay · Kaam aur duniya affect / effect, lose / loose, borrow / lend Milte-julte shabd Spelling ki galti Spelling ke niyam Paragraph, email ya application ka dhaancha Vaakya se paragraph · Email likhna · Application aur message CV bullet, essay ya report CV aur LinkedIn · Essay aur report Sunkar samajhna ya dictation Chhoti kahaniyan · Roz ki kahaniyan · Asli duniya ki English Apna level aur agla kadam jaanna hai IELTS, TOEFL aur aapka level

Aakhri baat

English ek imtihaan nahi hai — ek aadat hai. Is kitaab ka asli maqsad ye nahi tha ki aap sab rules yaad kar lein. Maqsad ye tha ki jab aap English bolein, to aapke dimaag me "galti ho jaayegi" ka dar na rahe. Wo dar hat gaya, to baaki sab apne aap aa jaayega — thoda thoda, roz. Jo bolta hai wo seekhta hai. Jo galti se darta hai wo chup reh jaata hai. Aap bolne wale banein.

docs.title: Chapter 29: Fluency aur filler words
docs.text:
Fluency — rukna seekho, "basically" chhodo

Fluency ka matlab tez bolna nahi hai. Fluency ka matlab hai bina ghabraye bolte rehna — ruk kar bhi. Duniya ke sabse achche bolne wale log dheere bolte hain aur bahut rukte hain. Farq ye hai ki wo rukte waqt "um, uh, basically, matlab" se khaali jagah nahi bharte — wo chup rehte hain, ya ek taiyaar phrase bol dete hain jo unhe sochne ka waqt de deta hai. Yahi hunar is chapter me hai.

Fluency ka asli matlab

Fluency = bolna jaari rehna, galti ke baad bhi, atakne ke baad bhi. Ek fluent insaan wo hai jo beech vaakya me phas kar bhi baat poori kar deta hai. Tezi, perfect grammar aur bada vocabulary — teeno baad ki cheezein hain.

docs.title: 29.1 Filler ki aadat — seedhi baat
docs.text:
Hum sab fillers use karte hain. Thode fillers normal hain — native log bhi karte hain. Dikkat tab hoti hai jab wo har teen shabd ke baad aate hain, kyunki phir sunne wala aapki baat nahi, aapki aadat sunta hai. Apni list imaandari se dekho:

Filler Asli dikkat Kya karein basically Lagbhag hamesha bemaani hota hai. "Basically I went to the market" me "basically" ka koi kaam nahi. Bilkul hata do. Vaakya usse behtar ho jaayega. actually Iska sahi matlab hai "asal me / sachchai ye hai". Hum ise har vaakya me jod dete hain, jisse wo apna matlab kho deta hai. Sirf tab bolo jab aap kisi galatfehmi ko theek kar rahe ho. like "It was like, you know, like very big." — ek vaakya me teen baar. Umar se chhota aur taiyaari se kamzor lagta hai. Ruk jao. Chuppi "like" se behtar hai. matlab Sabse aam Hinglish filler. English baat-cheet ke beech Hindi filler turant pakda jaata hai. Badlo: "I mean…" ya "What I'm trying to say is…" na / haan / theek hai na Vaakya ke aakhir me jud jaata hai: "It is good, na?" Badlo: "…, isn't it?" / "…, right?" only (galat jagah) "I am from Delhi only." — yahan "only" ka English me koi matlab nahi banta. Hata do: "I'm from Delhi." you know Jab aap maan lete hain ki saamne wala jaanta hai, par wo nahi jaanta. Jo kehna hai poora kaho. Ya "Let me explain…" umm / uhh Ye sabse natural hai — par lambi "ummmm" ghabraahat dikhati hai. Us jagah chup raho. 2 second ki chuppi confident lagti hai.

Pehle galat, phir sahi

  • Galat: Basically, umm, I am, like, working in sales only, matlab since two years.
  • Sahi: I work in sales. I've been there for two years.

  • Kyun: Chhote vaakye todo. Teen chhote vaakye ek lambe atakte vaakya se bahut behtar hain.

  • Galat: Actually the thing is that actually I actually forgot.

  • Sahi: To be honest, I forgot.

  • Kyun: Ek vaakya me ek hi "signpost" shabd. Baar-baar aane se wo apna asar kho deta hai.

  • Galat: It is very good, na?

  • Sahi: It's really good, isn't it?
  • Kyun: "na" ki jagah question tag. Yahi kaam karta hai, par English me.

docs.title: 29.2 Chuppi ka hunar — ruko, bharo mat
docs.text:
Jab dimaag agla shabd dhoondh raha ho, hamara muh us khaali jagah ko bharne lagta hai. Asli ilaaj ye hai: us jagah ko khaali rehne do. Do second ki chuppi aapko sochne wala dikhati hai; do second ki "ummmm" ghabraya hua.

Figure 29.1. Dono baat me waqt lagbhag barabar laga. Farq sirf ye hai ki doosri me khaali jagah chuppi aur ek taiyaar phrase ne bhari, um ne nahi.

docs.title: 29.3 Sochne ka waqt khareedne wale phrase
docs.text:
Ye is chapter ka sabse qeemti hissa hai. In phrases ko rat lo — itna ki bina soche nikal jaayein. Ye aapko 2-4 second de dete hain, aur sunne wale ko lagta hai aap soch-samajh kar bol rahe hain.

Kaam Phrase Suno Sawaal ke baad waqt chahiye That's a good question. Let me think about that for a second. Hmm, I haven't thought about it that way. Well, it depends. Baat shuru karne se pehle The way I see it… To be honest with you… In my experience… Baat ko dobara samjhana What I mean is… Let me put it another way. In other words… Beech me atak gaye Sorry, what's the word… give me a second. How do I say this… I'm blanking on the word — it's the thing you use for… Samajh nahi aaya Sorry, could you repeat that? I didn't catch the last part.

Teen phrase se shuru karo

Poori list ratne ki koshish mat karo. Aaj sirf teen chuno — mera sujhaav: "That's a good question." · "What I mean is…" · "Sorry, could you repeat that?" Inhe 20 baar bolo, aaj. Kal ye khud nikal aayenge.

docs.title: 29.4 Speed control — dheere bolna taqat hai
docs.text:
Ghabraahat me hum tez bolne lagte hain, aur tez bolne me aawazein mil jaati hain, aur phir samajh me nahi aata, aur phir aur ghabraahat hoti hai. Ye chakkar todna hai.

Haalat Speed Kyun Interview, presentation Dheere — rozmarra se bhi dheere Dheere bolna confident lagta hai, aur aapko sochne ka waqt deta hai. Phone par Dheere + saaf Phone par aadhi aawazein kat jaati hain. Number aur naam ek-ek akshar me bolo. Apna naam / email batate waqt Bahut dheere, tod kar "R-A-M-E-S-H. Ramesh." Dohraana shishtachaar hai, kamzori nahi. Dost ke saath Jo aaraam se nikle Yahan practice karo — galti ki keemat kam hai.
  • Let me slow down — my name is Ramesh. R for Rakesh, A, M, E, S, H. Phone par naam batane ka sabse saaf tareeka. Akshar ko shabd se jodo.
  • Sorry, I'm speaking too fast. Let me start again. Khud ko theek karna sabse professional cheez hai. Isme sharam ki koi baat nahi.

docs.title: 29.5 Beech vaakya me atak gaye — ab kya?
docs.text:
Sabse badi ghabraahat yahi hoti hai: aadhe vaakya me shabd nahi mila, aur dimaag khaali ho gaya. Iske teen pakke ilaaj hain. Teeno sikhe hue hunar hain, qismat nahi.

Ilaaj 1 — Ghuma kar kaho (paraphrase)

Shabd nahi mil raha? Us cheez ka kaam bata do. Ye sabse taqatwar hunar hai — isi se log 500 shabd me poori duniya ki baat kar lete hain.

Shabd yaad nahi Aise keh do Suno stapler The thing you use to join papers together. landlord The person who owns the house I live in. deadline The last date to finish the work. puncture There's a hole in my tyre — the air went out.

Ilaaj 2 — Shuru se dobara shuru karo

Vaakya ulajh gaya? Use bachaane ki koshish mat karo. Chhoti si maafi ke saath nayi, chhoti line se dobara shuru karo. "Sorry, let me start that again." Native log ye roz karte hain. Ye galti nahi, tareeka hai.

Ilaaj 3 — Madad maang lo

Kisi cheez ka English naam poochhna kamzori nahi hai — ye seekhne wale ka sahi vyavhaar hai. "What do you call the thing that…?" "Is that the right word?"

docs.title: 29.6 Galti ke baad — ruko mat, sudhaar kar aage badho
docs.text:
English me khud ko sudhaarne ka ek chhota, natural tareeka hai: galat shabd bolo, phir "sorry" ya "I mean" bol kar sahi shabd daal do, aur chalte raho. Rukna aur maafi maangna zaroori nahi.

  • I went there yesterday — sorry, last week. Galti pakdi, ek shabd me theek kar diya, aage badh gaye.
  • She don't— she doesn't work here any more. Grammar galti ko beech me hi theek kar liya. Yahi sabse natural tareeka hai.
  • We have three— I mean four meetings today. "I mean" sudhaar ka sabse aam aur sahi auzaar hai.

Jo bilkul nahi karna

Galti hone par "Sorry, sorry, my English is very poor, sorry" wala chakkar mat shuru karo. Ek chhoti maafi kaafi hai, aur usse bhi behtar ye hai ki aap bina rukey sahi shabd daal kar aage badh jao. Baar-baar maafi maangne se sunne wala aapki baat par dhyan hi nahi de paata.

docs.title: 29.7 Vaakya ko lamba karne ka saancha
docs.text:
Fluent lagne ka ek saral trick: ek-shabd ke jawaab mat do. Har jawaab me ek jaankari + ek wajah jodo. Isse baat chalti rehti hai aur aapko sochne ka waqt bhi mil jaata hai.

Sawaal Kamzor jawaab Fluent jawaab Suno Do you like cricket? Yes. Yes, I do. I watch most matches, especially the one-day games. Where are you from? Delhi. I'm from Delhi, but I've been living in Pune for three years now. How was your weekend? Good. It was good, thanks. I mostly stayed home and caught up on sleep. Can you finish it today? No. Not today, I'm afraid. I could have it ready by tomorrow afternoon.

Saancha yaad rakho

Jawaab + ek detail + ek wajah ya aage ki baat. Teen hissa, bas. Isse zyada ki zaroorat nahi, aur isse kam me baat ruk jaati hai.

docs.title: 29.8 Roz ki fluency drill — 5 minute
docs.text:
Ek minute ka monologue

Phone ka timer 60 second par lagao. Ek aam vishay chuno — aaj ka din, apna kamra, apna kaam — aur 60 second lagataar bolo. Niyam sirf ek: ruk kar chuppi theek hai, par Hindi me switch nahi karna. Shabd na mile to ghuma kar kaho (Ilaaj 1). Roz ek minute. Do hafte me aap khud farq sunenge.

  • Today I woke up at seven, had tea, and then I checked my phone for a while. Monologue aise shuru karo — chhote vaakye, "and then" se jode hue.
  • It's hard to explain, but let me try. Atak jao to ye line bol do — aur phir koshish karo. Ye bilkul native wali line hai.

docs.title: 29.9 Practice — Fluency
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Fluency ka sahi matlab kya hai?

  • Bina ghabraye bolte rehna, ruk kar bhi
  • Bahut tez bolna
  • Bina ek bhi galti bolna
  • Bada vocabulary hona

Hint: Tezi ka isse koi lena-dena nahi.

Jawaab

Bina ghabraye bolte rehna, ruk kar bhi

Achche bolne wale dheere bolte hain aur bahut rukte hain. Farq sirf ye hai ki wo khaali jagah filler se nahi bharte.

Exercise 2

'basically' ke saath sabse bada masla kya hai?

  • Zyadatar vaakyon me iska koi matlab hi nahi hota
  • Ye ek galat shabd hai
  • Iska uchchaaran mushkil hai
  • Ye sirf likhne me chalta hai
Jawaab

Zyadatar vaakyon me iska koi matlab hi nahi hota

'Basically I went to the market' me usse hata do — vaakya behtar ho jaata hai. Shabd galat nahi hai, uski aadat galat hai.

Exercise 3

Agla shabd soch rahe hain. Sabse behtar kya karein?

  • Chup raho, ya ek taiyaar phrase bolo
  • Lambi 'ummmmm' kheencho
  • Tez bolne lago
  • Hindi me keh do
Jawaab

Chup raho, ya ek taiyaar phrase bolo

Do second ki chuppi sochta hua dikhati hai; do second ki 'ummmm' ghabraya hua. Dono me waqt barabar lagta hai.

Exercise 4

Kisi cheez ka English naam yaad nahi aa raha. Sabse achcha tareeka?

  • Us cheez ka kaam bata do — 'the thing you use to…'
  • Baat chhod do
  • Hindi shabd daal do
  • Chup ho jao jab tak yaad na aaye

Hint: Ilaaj 1.

Jawaab

Us cheez ka kaam bata do — 'the thing you use to…'

Ghuma kar kehna sabse taqatwar hunar hai. Isi se log kam shabdon me har baat keh lete hain.

Exercise 5

Interview me speed kaisi rakhein?

  • Rozmarra se bhi dheere
  • Jitna tez ho sake
  • Bahut tez, taaki waqt bach jaaye
  • Shuru me tez, baad me dheere
Jawaab

Rozmarra se bhi dheere

Dheere bolna confident lagta hai aur aapko agla vaakya sochne ka waqt deta hai. Tezi me aawazein mil jaati hain.

Exercise 6

Beech vaakya me grammar galti ho gayi. Sahi tareeka?

  • 'I mean' ya 'sorry' bol kar sahi shabd daal do aur aage badho
  • Poora vaakya dobara se bolo, bina kuch kahe
  • Baar-baar maafi maango
  • Galti chhod do, kuch mat karo
Jawaab

'I mean' ya 'sorry' bol kar sahi shabd daal do aur aage badho

Native log bilkul yahi karte hain: 'She don't— she doesn't work here.' Ruk kar lambi maafi maangna baat ko todta hai.

Exercise 7

'matlab' ki jagah English me bolo: What I ___ is…

Hint: Baat dobara samjhane wala shabd.

Jawaab

mean

'What I mean is…' — 'matlab' ka seedha English roop, aur sochne ka waqt bhi de deta hai.

Exercise 8

'It is good, na?' ko theek karo: It's good, ___ it?

Hint: Question tag.

Jawaab

isn't / isnt / is not

Hindi ka 'na' English me question tag banta hai: isn't it? / right? / don't you think?

Exercise 9

Is vaakya me ek shabd faltu hai — us par tap karo.

I am from Mumbai only.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: only.

Sahi roop: I'm from Mumbai.

Hindi ke 'hi / sirf' ki aadat se 'only' jud jaata hai. English me yahan uska koi matlab nahi banta.

Exercise 10

Filler shabd dhoondo jo kaat dena chahiye.

Basically I finished the report yesterday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: Basically.

Sahi roop: I finished the report yesterday.

Hata do aur vaakya saaf ho jaata hai. Yahi test hai: hatane se matlab na badle to wo filler hai.

Exercise 11

Filler ko uske sahi English badle se jodo.

A B matlab do second ki chuppi na? kuch nahi — hata do ummmm What I mean is… basically isn't it? Jawaab

matlab — What I mean is…; na? — isn't it?; ummmm — do second ki chuppi; basically — kuch nahi — hata do

Har Hinglish filler ka ek saaf English roop hai. Ek baar rat lo, phir khud nikalne lagta hai.

Exercise 12

Sochne ka waqt khareedne wala phrase banao.

Shabd: for / that / about / a / Let / me / think / second

Jawaab

Let me think about that for a second

Ye 3-4 second de deta hai aur sunne wale ko lagta hai aap gaur kar rahe hain.

Exercise 13

Sawaal ke baad waqt khareedo. Aaraam se bolo.

Jawaab

Bolo: That's a good question. Let me think about that for a second

Do phrase ek saath — 5 second mil gaye. Interview me ye sona hai.

Exercise 14

Baat dobara samjhao — 'matlab' nahi bolna.

Jawaab

Bolo: What I mean is we should wait one more week

'What I mean is' ke baad poora vaakya. Filler ki jagah ek kaam ka phrase.

Exercise 15

Shabd nahi mil raha — ghuma kar kaho.

Jawaab

Bolo: It's the thing you use to join papers together

stapler yaad nahi aaya to kaam bata do. Baat ruk hi nahi — yahi fluency hai.

Exercise 16

Ulajh gaye. Nayi shuruaat karo.

Jawaab

Bolo: Sorry, let me start that again

Chhoti maafi, nayi chhoti line. Native log roz ye karte hain.

Exercise 17

Ek-shabd ke jawaab ki jagah fluent jawaab do — 'Where are you from?'

Jawaab

Bolo: I'm from Delhi but I've been living in Pune for three years now

Jawaab + detail + aage ki baat. Teen hissa — isi se baat chalti rehti hai.

Exercise 18

Samajh nahi aaya. Politely poochho.

Jawaab

Bolo: Sorry, could you repeat that

Aakhir me aawaz halki oopar. Ye line roz kaam aayegi — isliye bina soche nikalni chahiye.

Exercise 19

Atak gaye par himmat nahi haari. Ye line bolo.

Jawaab

Bolo: It's hard to explain but let me try

Bilkul native wali line. Ye bolte hi aapko sochne ka waqt bhi mil jaata hai.

Aage kya karein

Aaj ka kaam: teen thinking phrases chuno aur 20 baar bolo. Aur ek minute ka monologue karo — aaj hi, abhi. Agla chapter: Roz ki baat-cheet — dukaan, auto, doctor, phone. Wahan aapko taiyaar lines milengi jo kal se kaam aa jaayengi.

docs.title: Chapter 19: to do ya doing?
docs.text:
Gerund ya Infinitive — doing ya to do?

Jab ek verb ke baad doosra verb aata hai, to doosra verb ya to -ing leta hai (enjoy reading) ya to + V1 (want to read). Hindi me dono jagah "padhna" hi rehta hai — "padhna pasand hai", "padhna chahta hoon" — isliye hum andaaze se chunte hain. Is chapter me andaaza nahi, pakka tareeka seekhenge.

Ek line me

A gerund is a verb + -ing used as a noun (Swimming is fun). An infinitive is to + base verb (I want to swim). Dono me verb "kaam ka naam" ban jaata hai — jaise Hindi me "tairna".

  • I enjoy cooking. Mujhe khana banana achha lagta hai. — enjoy + -ing
  • I want to cook tonight. Main aaj raat khana banana chahta hoon. — want + to

docs.title: 19.1 Faisla pehla verb karta hai
docs.text:
Sabse zaroori baat: doosre verb ka roop aap nahi chunte — pehla verb chunta hai. Har verb ki apni pasand hoti hai. Isliye verbs ko teen dabbon me baant ke yaad karna sabse aasaan raasta hai.

Figure 19.1. Pehla verb dekho, phir dabba yaad karo. Beech wale dabbe ke verbs dono le sakte hain — par matlab alag.

Pehla verb tay karta hai

Doosre verb ka roop (-ing ya to + V1) pehla verb tay karta hai. Moti pehchaan: -ing asli, chal rahe ya ho chuke kaam ki taraf dekhta hai; to aage hone wale kaam ki taraf.

Subject ki jagah -ing zyada natural

Walking is good for health. — sabse aam aur natural. To walk is good for health. — sahi hai, par kitaabi lagta hai.

docs.title: 19.2 Verb + -ing: enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest
docs.text:
Ye verb aksar kisi asli ya chal rahe kaam ki baat karte hain — jo aapko pasand hai, jisse bachte ho, jo khatam kiya. Inke baad "to" lagaana sabse aam galti hai.

Verb Matlab Example enjoy maza lena We enjoyed watching the match. avoid bachna Avoid eating junk food. finish khatam karna Have you finished writing? suggest sujhaav dena She suggested taking a taxi. mind bura maanna Do you mind waiting? keep karte rehna He kept calling me. practise abhyaas karna Practise speaking every day. give up chhod dena My uncle gave up smoking.

-ing wale verbs

enjoy, avoid, finish, suggest, mind, keep, practise, consider, give up — inke baad hamesha verb-ing, kabhi "to" nahi. ✓ I enjoy reading. ✗ I enjoy to read.

suggest ke saath insaan kaise lagaayein

  • Galat: He suggested me to go by train.
  • Sahi: He suggested going by train. / He suggested that I go by train.
  • Kyun: "suggest" ke baad "insaan + to" ka pattern nahi hota. Ya to -ing lagao, ya "that + insaan + V1".

docs.title: 19.3 Verb + to: want, decide, hope, plan
docs.text:
Ye verb zyaadatar aage ki soch batate hain — iccha, faisla, umeed, yojana. Kaam abhi hua nahi, hone wala hai. Isliye "to" — jaise kaam ki taraf ek teer.

Verb Matlab Example want chahna I want to learn French. decide faisla karna They decided to move to Pune. hope umeed karna We hope to see you soon. plan yojana banana She plans to start a business. agree / refuse maan jaana / mana karna He refused to sign. promise vaada karna I promise to call you. manage kisi tarah kar paana We managed to finish on time.

to wale verbs

want, decide, hope, plan, agree, refuse, promise, manage, need, expect — inke baad to + V1. Insaan beech me aaye to: want / ask / tell / advise someone to do.

  • My mother wants me to become a doctor. Maa chahti hain ki main doctor banoon. — "that I become" nahi, seedha "me to become".
  • The teacher told us to sit down. tell, ask, advise, allow, remind — sab "insaan + to" lete hain.

docs.title: 19.4 Dono le sakte hain — par matlab badal jaata hai
docs.text:
Kuch verb dono roop lete hain, aur yahi sabse dilchasp hissa hai. Yahan galat roop chunne se galti nahi, bilkul alag matlab nikalta hai — isliye inhe dhyan se samjho.

Figure 19.2. -ing ka teer peeche, to ka teer aage. Yahi ek tasveer stop, remember aur forget teeno samjha deti hai.

stop, remember, forget, try

-ing = pehle ka ya asli kaam: remember meeting (mil chuke). to = aage ka kaam: remember to meet (milna hai). try doing = karke dekho; try to do = koshish karo.

Verb + -ing + to V1 stop kaam band karna — stop talking kisi aur kaam ke liye rukna — stop to talk remember beeta kaam yaad hona — remember meeting her aage ka kaam yaad rakhna — remember to call forget beeta pal bhool jaana — I'll never forget seeing the Taj karna bhool jaana — I forgot to lock it try tareeka aazma kar dekhna — try restarting the phone mushkil kaam ki koshish — try to lift the box

Kuch verbs me farq bahut kam hai

like, love, hate, start, begin, continue — dono roop chalte hain aur matlab lagbhag wahi rehta hai: It started raining = It started to rain.

docs.title: 19.5 Preposition ke baad hamesha -ing
docs.text:
Ye is chapter ka sabse aasaan aur sabse pakka niyam hai. Preposition ke baad noun aata hai — aur jab wahan verb lagaana ho, to use noun jaisa banana padta hai, yaani -ing.

  • I am interested in learning Japanese. Mujhe Japanese seekhne me dilchaspi hai.
  • She is good at solving puzzles. Wo paheliyan suljhaane me achhi hai.
  • Thank you for coming. Aane ke liye shukriya.
  • Wash your hands before eating. Khane se pehle haath dho lo. — before, after, without, instead of, by — sab ke baad -ing.

Preposition + -ing

in, at, of, for, about, before, after, without, by, instead of — inke baad verb aaye to hamesha -ing: interested in learning, tired of waiting, without asking. Kabhi "to + V1" nahi.

docs.title: 19.6 "to" ka dhokha — look forward to meeting
docs.text:
Har "to" infinitive wala nahi hota. Kabhi-kabhi "to" asal me preposition hota hai — aur pichhle section ka niyam yaad hai? Preposition ke baad -ing. Bas pehchaanna hai ki kaunsa "to" kaunsa hai.

Figure 19.3. to ke baad the party jaisa noun baith jaaye, to wo preposition hai — aur verb -ing lega.

Preposition wala 'to'

look forward to, be used to, get used to, object to, be committed to, when it comes to — inme "to" preposition hai, isliye -ing: I look forward to meeting you.

  • I am used to working late. Mujhe der tak kaam karne ki aadat hai. (test: used to late nights ✓)
  • When it comes to cooking, my father is the best. Khana banane ki baat aaye to papa sabse aage hain.

docs.title: 19.7 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
-ing aur to ki sabse aam Indian-English galtiyan

  • Galat: I look forward to meet you.
  • Sahi: I look forward to meeting you.

  • Kyun: Har formal email ke aakhir me ye galti dikhti hai. Yahan "to" preposition hai (look forward to the meeting ✓), isliye -ing.

  • Galat: I am interested to learn coding.

  • Sahi: I am interested in learning coding.

  • Kyun: "interested" ke saath preposition "in" aata hai, aur preposition ke baad -ing. Dilchaspi batani ho to hamesha "interested in + -ing".

  • Galat: He suggested me to go home.

  • Sahi: He suggested that I go home. / He suggested going home.

  • Kyun: "suggest" "insaan + to" nahi leta. Ye pattern "advise" ka hai: He advised me to go home.

  • Galat: I enjoy to travel.

  • Sahi: I enjoy travelling.

  • Kyun: "enjoy" -ing wale dabbe ka verb hai. Hindi ke "ghoomna pasand hai" se "to" aa jaata hai — par "enjoy" ke baad kabhi nahi.

  • Galat: Thank you for give me this chance.

  • Sahi: Thank you for giving me this chance.
  • Kyun: "for" preposition hai — uske baad verb hamesha -ing roop me.

docs.title: 19.8 Practice — Gerunds & infinitives
docs.text:
Exercise 1

We have decided ___ a new car.

  • to buy
  • buying
  • buy
  • to buying

Hint: 'decide' kaunse dabbe me hai?

Jawaab

to buy

'decide' aage ke faisle ki baat hai — to wale dabbe ka verb. Isliye decide + to + V1.

Exercise 2

Please avoid ___ your phone while driving.

  • using
  • to use
  • use
  • used
Jawaab

using

'avoid' hamesha -ing leta hai — avoid using, avoid eating. 'avoid to use' bahut aam galti hai.

Exercise 3

I clearly remember ___ the gas. I'm sure it's off.

  • switching off
  • to switch off
  • switch off
  • to switching off

Hint: Kaam pehle ho chuka hai, aur wo yaad hai.

Jawaab

switching off

Gas band karna pehle ho chuka — aur abhi wo yaad hai. Beete kaam ki yaad = remember + -ing.

Exercise 4

The driver stopped ___ some tea, then continued the journey.

  • to have
  • having
  • have
  • had

Hint: Wo kis liye ruka?

Jawaab

to have

Driver chai peene ke liye ruka — yaani ek kaam rok ke doosra kaam karne ke liye. stop + to = rukna taaki kuch kar sako. 'stopped having tea' ka matlab hota ki chai peena chhod diya.

Exercise 5

I look forward to ___ from you soon. (hear)

Hint: Ye 'to' preposition hai.

Jawaab

hearing

'look forward to' me 'to' preposition hai (look forward to your reply ✓), aur preposition ke baad -ing. Isliye 'hearing'.

Exercise 6

She is very good at ___ people laugh. (make)

Hint: 'at' ke baad kya aata hai?

Jawaab

making

'at' preposition hai. Preposition ke baad verb hamesha -ing roop me — good at making.

Exercise 7

Galat shabd par tap karo.

My manager suggested me to take a short break.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: me.

Sahi roop: My manager suggested that I take a short break.

'suggest' ke baad 'me to' wala pattern nahi chalta. 'suggested that I take' ya 'suggested taking' bolo.

Exercise 8

Ek shabd galat roop me hai — dhoondo.

I am interested in join the music class.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: join.

Sahi roop: I am interested in joining the music class.

'in' preposition hai, to uske baad verb -ing lega — joining.

Exercise 9

Verb ko uske sahi pattern se jodo.

A B enjoy + verb-ing (preposition) want + to V1 (insaan ke baad) interested in + verb-ing advise someone + to V1 Jawaab

enjoy — + verb-ing; want — + to V1; interested in — + verb-ing (preposition); advise someone — + to V1 (insaan ke baad)

enjoy -ing dabbe ka hai, want to wale dabbe ka. 'in' preposition hai to -ing. advise ke baad insaan aur phir to + V1.

Exercise 10

Sahi kram me vaakya banao.

Shabd: the / midnight / She / report / at / writing / finished

Jawaab

She finished writing the report at midnight

'finish' ke baad -ing aata hai — finished writing. Phir object (the report) aur samay (at midnight).

Exercise 11

Ye vaakya banao — 'insaan + to' pattern.

Shabd: study / want / parents / me / to / My / abroad

Jawaab

My parents want me to study abroad

'want' ke baad insaan (me) aur phir to + V1 (to study). Hindi ki tarah 'want that I study' nahi bolte.

Exercise 12

Email ki ye last line bolo — 'meeting' par dhyan do.

Jawaab

Bolo: I look forward to meeting you

Ye line itni baar galat likhi jaati hai ki zor se sahi bolna sabse achha ilaaj hai. 'to' preposition hai, isliye 'meeting'.

Aage kya karein

Teen dabbe kaagaz par banao — "-ing", "to", "dono". Roz jo bhi naya verb padho, use kisi dabbe me daalo. Ek mahine me aapke paas apna khud ka sorter hoga, aur andaaze ki zaroorat khatam.

docs.title: Chapter 24: used to, wish, had better
docs.text:
"Pehle main roz cricket khelta tha", "mujhe aadat hai", "kaash maine padhai ki hoti", "tum jaldi nikal jao warna…" — ye chaar baatein Hindi me hum din me das baar bolte hain. English me inke liye chhote, pakke structures hain: used to, be used to, I wish, had better, would rather. Inhe ek baar saaf samajh lo, to aapki English turant zyada natural lagne lagegi.

Ek line me

used to + V1 = pehle hota tha, ab nahi. be used to + -ing = aadat hai. wish + past = kaash. had better + V1 = warna mushkil hogi. Har structure ke saath verb ka roop pakka hai — wahi is chapter ka asli khel hai.

docs.title: 24.1 Pehle naksha — kaunsa "aadat" kab?
docs.text:
Hindi me "aadat" ek hi shabd hai, par English me teen alag structures hain — aur teeno ka matlab bilkul alag hai. Galti yahin hoti hai. Bolne se pehle khud se ek sawaal poochho: ye baat beete kal ki hai, ya aaj ki aadat ki, ya nayi aadat ban rahi hai?

Figure 24.1. Teen raaste, teen structures. Pehle wale me used to ke baad V1 ; baaki do me to ke baad -ing ya noun .

Hindi se seedha naksha

"pehle karta tha" → used to do · "aadat hai" → be used to doing · "aadat pad jaayegi" → get used to doing.

docs.title: 24.2 used to + V1 — pehle hota tha, ab nahi
docs.text:
used to beete samay ki wo aadat ya haalat batata hai jo ab khatam ho chuki hai. Iske baad hamesha verb ka pehla roop (V1) aata hai. Ye action (karna) aur state (hona, rehna, paas hona) dono ke liye chalta hai.

  • I used to live in Patna. Main pehle Patna me rehta tha (ab nahi rehta).
  • We used to walk to school every day. Hum roz paidal school jaate the.
  • Priya used to have very long hair. Priya ke baal pehle bahut lambe the.
  • There used to be a cinema hall here. Yahan pehle ek cinema hall hua karta tha.

docs.title: Negative aur sawaal — "d" gayab ho jaata hai
docs.text:
Jab did / didn't aa jaata hai, to past wo dikha deta hai — isliye used ka "d" hat jaata hai: didn't use to, Did you use to…? Bilkul waise hi jaise didn't went nahi, didn't go hota hai.

Roop Formula Example Positive used to + V1 I used to smoke. Negative didn't use to + V1 I didn't use to like coffee. Negative (zor) never used to + V1 He never used to call. Sawaal Did … use to + V1? Did you use to play cricket?
  • I didn't use to like coffee, but now I love it. Pehle mujhe coffee pasand nahi thi, ab bahut pasand hai.
  • Did you use to play cricket in college? Kya tum college me cricket khelte the?

Uchchaaran: 'yoos-tuh'

used to ko "yooz-d too" mat bolo. Bolte hain /ˈjuːstə/ — "yoos-tuh", "s" ki aawaz ke saath, aur use to bhi bilkul waise hi sunai deta hai.

docs.title: used to ka present nahi hota
docs.text:
Ye sabse aam Indian galti hai. Aaj ki aadat ke liye use to nahi — seedha present simple, aksar usually ke saath (dekho Saare 12 tenses).

✗

I use to drink tea every morning.

✓

I usually drink tea every morning.

✗

I used to go to Goa three times.

✓

I went to Goa three times.

docs.title: 24.3 would — purani yaadon ki kahani
docs.text:
Purani baatein sunate waqt (nani ke ghar ki garmiyan, school ke din) English bolne wale ek baar used to se mahaul banate hain, aur phir would + V1 se kahani aage badhate hain. Ye thoda kitaabi, yaadon wala andaaz hai.

  • Every summer, we used to go to Nani's village. Har garmi hum nani ke gaon jaate the.
  • We'd climb the mango trees all afternoon. Hum poori dopahar aam ke pedon par chadhte rehte the.
  • In the evening, Nani would tell us ghost stories. Shaam ko nani hume bhoot ki kahaniyan sunati thi.

would = sirf baar-baar ka kaam

would purani actions ke liye (khelna, jaana, sunana), states ke liye kabhi nahi (be, have, live, like, know). States ke liye sirf used to.

✗

We would have a dog called Moti.

✓

We used to have a dog called Moti.

Verb used to? would? play, go, visit (action) ✓ ✓ live, be, have (state) ✓ ✗ like, love, know, believe ✓ ✗ Kahani ki pehli line ✓ (behtar) Pehle time batao

docs.title: 24.4 be used to / get used to + -ing — Hindi speakers ki no. 1 uljhan
docs.text:
Yahan used ek adjective jaisa hai (= aadi, accustomed) aur to ek preposition hai, infinitive wala "to" nahi. Preposition ke baad noun, pronoun ya -ing aata hai — kabhi V1 nahi. Ye wahi niyam hai jo to do ya doing? chapter me look forward to meeting ke saath dekha tha.

  • I am used to waking up early. Mujhe jaldi uthne ki aadat hai.
  • She isn't used to spicy food. Use teekhe khaane ki aadat nahi hai.
  • Are you used to the Delhi winters yet? Kya tumhe ab tak Delhi ki sardi ki aadat padi?
  • I'm getting used to my new job. Mujhe nayi naukri ki aadat pad rahi hai.
  • Don't worry, you'll get used to it. Fikar mat karo, aadat pad jaayegi.
  • It took me months to get used to driving in Bengaluru traffic. Bengaluru ke traffic me gaadi chalane ki aadat padne me mahine lag gaye.

be used to vs get used to

be used to = aadat hai (haalat). get used to = aadat pad rahi / padegi (badlaav). Dono ke baad -ing ya noun, aur "be/get" har tense me badal sakta hai: was used to, will get used to, have got used to.

Sabse aam galti

  • Galat: I am used to wake up early.
  • Sahi: I am used to waking up early.
  • Kyun: Yahan "to" preposition hai, to uske baad -ing. Agar matlab "pehle uthta tha" hai, to "am" hatao: I used to wake up early.

✗

I used to living alone, so I don't mind it.

✓

I'm used to living alone, so I don't mind it.

Structure Matlab Example used to + V1 pehle karta tha I used to work nights. be used to + -ing aadat hai I'm used to working nights. get used to + -ing aadat pad rahi hai I'm getting used to working nights.

Formal shabd

Likhte waqt be accustomed to + -ing bhi chalta hai: The staff are accustomed to working under pressure.

docs.title: 24.5 I wish / If only — teen tarah ka "kaash"
docs.text:
"Kaash" bolne ke liye English me I wish ya zyada bhaavuk If only aata hai. Chaal ye hai ki wish ke baad verb ek kadam peeche chala jaata hai — kyunki hum jo chahte hain wo sach nahi hai. Ye wahi backshift hai jo If wale vaakya chapter ke second aur third conditional me hota hai.

Figure 24.2. Jitna peeche ka afsos, utna peeche ka tense. Abhi ki ichchha → past simple; beete kal ka afsos → past perfect; doosron se chidh → would.

docs.title: (a) Abhi ki ichchha — wish + past simple
docs.text:
• I wish I had a car. Kaash mere paas car hoti. (abhi nahi hai)
  • I wish I knew the answer. Kaash mujhe jawaab pata hota.
  • I wish I could swim. Kaash main tair paata.
  • If only we lived closer to the office! Kaash hum office ke paas rehte!
  • I wish I were taller. Kaash main thoda lamba hota.

were ya was?

I wish I were formal aur exam-safe hai; bolchaal me I wish I **was bhi bilkul chalta hai. Exam aur formal likhai me were likho.

docs.title: (b) Beete kal ka afsos — wish + had + V3
docs.text:
• I wish I had studied harder for the exam. Kaash maine exam ke liye zyada mehnat ki hoti.
  • I wish I hadn't said that to her. Kaash maine use wo baat na kahi hoti.
  • If only we'd left ten minutes earlier! Kaash hum das minute pehle nikal gaye hote! (train chhoot gayi)

docs.title: (c) Doosron se shikayat — wish + would
docs.text:
wish + someone + would tab, jab koi aur (ya mausam!) kuch karta rahe aur aap chahte ho ki wo badle. Isme halki chidh hoti hai.

  • I wish you would stop interrupting me. Kaash tum mujhe beech me tokna band karo.
  • I wish it would stop raining. Kaash baarish ruk jaaye.

✗

I wish I would speak French.

✓

I wish I could speak French.

docs.title: wish ya hope?
docs.text:
Jo ho sakta hai uske liye hope (+ normal tense). Jo sach nahi hai uske liye wish (+ past). Aur wish + person + noun sirf shubhkaamna ke fixed phrase me: I wish you a happy birthday.

✗

I wish you will pass the exam.

✓

I hope you pass the exam.

I wish you all the best for the exam.

  • I hope you get the job. Ummeed hai tumhe naukri mil jaaye.
  • I wish you all the best. Tumhe dher saari shubhkaamnayein.

docs.title: 24.6 had better — salaah jisme chetaavni chhupi hai
docs.text:
had better + V1 (bolne me 'd better) ka matlab hai "kar lo, warna mushkil hogi". Naam me "had" hai, par ye abhi ya aage ki baat hai, beete kal ki nahi. Aur iske baad "to" kabhi nahi.

  • You'd better leave now, or you'll miss the train. Abhi nikal jao, warna train chhoot jaayegi.
  • We'd better not tell Mummy about this. Mummy ko ye baat na hi batayein to achha.
  • I'd better charge my phone before the meeting. Meeting se pehle phone charge kar lena chahiye, warna dikkat hogi.

had better

'd better + V1 / 'd better not + V1 — "kar lo, warna…". "to" nahi, past ka matlab nahi, aur should se zyada sakht.

✗

You had better to submit it today.

✓

You'd better submit it today.

had better not go

Boss ko 'had better' mat bolo

"Sir, you had better check the file." dhamki jaisa sunai deta hai. Seniors ko "You might want to check the file" ya "It might be a good idea to…" bolo. Aam salaah ke liye should kaafi hai (dekho can, could, should, must).

docs.title: 24.7 would rather — "isse achha to…"
docs.text: would rather ('d rather) pasand ya chunaav batata hai — "main to ye karna pasand karunga". Iske do pattern hain, aur doosra wala advanced learners ko bhi chaunka deta hai.

docs.title: (a) Apni pasand — would rather + V1 (than + V1)
docs.text:
• I'd rather walk than take an auto. Auto lene se achha main paidal chal lunga.
  • Would you rather have tea or coffee? Aap chai lenge ya coffee?
  • I'd rather not talk about it. Main is baare me baat na karun to behtar.

docs.title: (b) Doosre se chahna — would rather + someone + past
docs.text:
Jab aap chahte ho ki koi aur kuch kare, to naya subject aur verb past me — bilkul wish ki tarah, chahe baat abhi ki ho.

  • I'd rather you didn't smoke in the car. Achha ho ki aap gaadi me cigarette na piyein.
  • I'd rather you came on Monday. Main chahunga ki tum Monday ko aao.

✗

I would rather to stay at home.

✓

I'd rather stay at home. / I'd prefer to stay at home.

I prefer tea to coffee.

Pattern Example would rather + V1 I'd rather stay. would rather + V1 + than + V1 I'd rather walk than wait. would rather + person + V2 I'd rather you stayed. would prefer + to + V1 I'd prefer to stay. prefer + noun/-ing + to I prefer tea to coffee.

docs.title: 24.8 It's time — "ab to waqt ho gaya"
docs.text:
Seedha waqt batana ho to It's time to + V1 ya It's time for + noun. Par agar matlab hai "ye to pehle hi ho jaana chahiye tha", to It's (high / about) time + subject + past simple.

  • It's time to go. Chalne ka waqt ho gaya.
  • It's time for lunch. Lunch ka time ho gaya.
  • It's time we left — it's nearly midnight. Ab hume nikal jaana chahiye — lagbhag aadhi raat ho gayi.
  • It's high time you got a proper job. Ab to tumhe dhang ki naukri le hi leni chahiye.
  • It's about time the government fixed this road. Sarkar ko ab tak ye sadak theek kar deni chahiye thi.

✗

It's high time you get married.

✓

It's high time you got married.

Ek pattern, chaar jagah

I wish you came · If only you **came · I'd rather you came · It's time you **came — "jo sach nahi hai" wali baat me abhi ka matlab bhi past simple se banta hai.

docs.title: 24.9 Asli zindagi me — ek phone call
docs.text:
Meera ne naya job join kiya hai aur Pune shift hui hai. Papa ka phone aata hai. Poori baat suno, phir har line ka structure pehchano.

Kaun Kya kehta hai Suno Papa So, are you used to the new place yet? Meera Slowly. I'm still getting used to cooking for myself. Papa At home you never used to enter the kitchen! Meera I know. I wish I'd learnt a few recipes from Mummy. Papa Well, you'd better not live on Maggi! Meera Honestly, I'd rather order food than cook after work. Papa Then it's high time you found a good tiffin service. Galat Sahi Kyun I am used to wake early. I'm used to waking early. to = preposition → -ing I use to go to the gym. I usually go to the gym. used to ka present nahi Did you used to…? Did you use to…? did ke baad "d" nahi I wish you will come. I hope you can come. mumkin baat = hope You had better to go. You'd better go. had better + V1 I'd rather you don't. I'd rather you didn't. doosra subject → past

docs.title: 24.10 Practice — used to, wish, had better
docs.text:
Exercise 1

I moved to Shimla last year. I'm still not used to ___ in the cold.

  • drive
  • driving
  • drove
  • driven

Hint: 'be used to' ke baad kya aata hai?

Jawaab

driving

be used to me 'to' preposition hai, to uske baad -ing: used to driving.

Exercise 2

When I was a child, I ___ to hate vegetables. Now I love them.

Hint: Pehle hota tha, ab nahi.

Jawaab

used

Purani aadat jo ab khatam ho gayi = used to + V1.

Exercise 3

Did you ___ to play cricket in school?

Hint: 'did' ke baad 'd' rehta hai kya?

Jawaab

use

did / didn't past dikha dete hain, isliye 'use to' — 'Did you used to' galat hai.

Exercise 4

We ___ a dog called Moti when we lived in Lucknow.

  • would have
  • used to have
  • are used to having
  • got used to have
Jawaab

used to have

'have' (paas hona) state hai. States ke saath 'would' nahi, sirf 'used to'.

Exercise 5

Tap the wrong word.

After ten years in the army, he is used to wake up at five.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: wake.

Sahi roop: After ten years in the army, he is used to waking up at five.

'is used to' = aadat hai, aur preposition 'to' ke baad -ing: waking.

Exercise 6

I wish I ___ more free time. (abhi nahi hai)

  • have
  • had
  • will have
  • am having
Jawaab

had

Abhi ki ichchha jo sach nahi: wish + past simple.

Exercise 7

I wish I ___ (not / eat) that street food last night. My stomach hurts!

Hint: Beete kal ka afsos.

Jawaab

hadn't eaten / had not eaten

Past ka afsos = wish + had (not) + V3.

Exercise 8

My neighbour plays loud music every night. I wish he ___ it.

  • stops
  • would stop
  • will stop
  • had stop
Jawaab

would stop

Doosre ke rawaiye se chidh = wish + someone + would + V1.

Exercise 9

Your friend has an interview tomorrow. You say: 'I ___ you get the job!'

  • wish
  • hope
  • would rather
  • had better
Jawaab

hope

Naukri milna mumkin hai — ummeed = hope + normal tense. 'wish' unreal ke liye hai.

Exercise 10

Tap the extra word.

You had better to leave now or you will miss the bus.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: to.

Sahi roop: You had better leave now or you will miss the bus.

had better ke baad seedha V1, 'to' nahi.

Exercise 11

I'd rather you ___ (not / smoke) inside the house.

Hint: would rather + doosra subject → past

Jawaab

didn't smoke / did not smoke

would rather + someone + past simple, chahe matlab abhi ka ho.

Exercise 12

Put the words in order.

Shabd: time / it's / we / money / high / saving / started

Jawaab

it's high time we started saving money

It's high time + subject + past simple = ye to pehle ho jaana chahiye tha.

Exercise 13

Match each structure to its meaning.

A B used to + V1 aadat pad rahi hai be used to + -ing kar lo, warna dikkat get used to + -ing pehle karta tha, ab nahi had better + V1 aadat hai Jawaab

used to + V1 — pehle karta tha, ab nahi; be used to + -ing — aadat hai; get used to + -ing — aadat pad rahi hai; had better + V1 — kar lo, warna dikkat

Teen 'used to' — teen alag matlab. Aur had better me chetaavni chhupi hai.

Exercise 14

What does the speaker do now?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

When I was in college, I used to take the bus everywhere. Now I drive to work, but I'm still not used to the traffic.

  • drives to work
  • takes the bus
  • walks to work
  • works from home
Jawaab

drives to work

'used to take the bus' = pehle. 'Now I drive to work' = ab.

Exercise 15

How does the speaker feel about the traffic?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

When I was in college, I used to take the bus everywhere. Now I drive to work, but I'm still not used to the traffic.

  • it still feels difficult
  • they enjoy it
  • they never notice it
  • it was worse in college
Jawaab

it still feels difficult

'still not used to' = abhi tak aadat nahi padi — matlab mushkil lagta hai.

Exercise 16

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

I wish I had listened to my mother.

Beete kal ka afsos: wish + had + V3 (listened).

Exercise 17

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

You had better take an umbrella. It is going to rain.

had better + V1 (take) — 'warna bheeg jaoge' wala bhaav.

Exercise 18

Say it aloud — 'used' me 's' ki aawaz.

Jawaab

Bolo: I'm getting used to my new job

get used to + noun = aadat pad rahi hai. 'used to' = 'yoos-tuh'.

Aage kya karein

Aaj raat paanch vaakya likho: do used to (bachpan ki aadatein), ek I'm used to, ek I wish I had… aur ek I'd rather…. Phir unhe zor se bolo. Agla chapter, Asar daar vaakya, aapke vaakyon me zor aur vazan jodega.

docs.title: Chapter 1: Is kitaab ko kaise padhein
docs.text:
Agar aap ye page khol kar bhi thoda ghabra rahe hain — ki "mujhe kuch nahi aata", "main bolne me atak jaata hoon" — to aap bilkul sahi jagah par hain. Ye kitaab aapko English ke baare me padhaane ke liye nahi hai. Ye aapko English bolwaane ke liye hai. Aur bolne ka ek hi tareeka hai: bolna. Aaj se, akele kamre me, zor se.

Poori kitaab ka ek hi niyam

Jo bhi English line is kitaab me dikhe — use aankhon se mat padho, muh se bolo. Chup-chaap padhi hui English kabhi zubaan par nahi aati. Silent reading se samajh aati hai; bolne se fluency aati hai. Dono alag cheezein hain.

docs.title: 1.1 Roz 15 minute — bas itna
docs.text:
Hafte me ek din do ghante padhne se kuch nahi hota. Roz 15 minute se sab hota hai. Dimaag bhasha ko dohraav se seekhta hai, lambai se nahi. 15 minute ko aise todo:

Figure 1.1. Dhyan do: sabse bada hissa narangi hai — bolna . Padhna sirf chauthai hissa hai.

15 minute kahan se laayein

Nahane se pehle. Bus ya metro me. Raat ko sone se pehle bistar par. Ek fix jagah aur fix waqt chun lo — phir yaad rakhne ki zaroorat hi nahi padegi, aadat khud kheench legi.

docs.title: 1.2 Har cheez zor se bolo — yahi poora khel hai
docs.text:
Log saalon tak grammar padhte hain aur phir bhi bolte waqt atakte hain. Kyun? Kyunki grammar dimaag me chali gayi, par zubaan ki muscle me nahi gayi. English ki aawazein banane ke liye aapke hoth, zubaan aur jabde ko nayi position seekhni padti hai — aur muscle sirf dohraav se seekhti hai, samajhne se nahi.

  • I am learning English, and I am getting better every day. Pehli line jo aaj bolni hai. 🔊 dabao, suno, phir teen baar khud bolo.
  • I make mistakes, but I keep speaking. Galti karta hoon, par bolna band nahi karta. Isi vaakya ko apna niyam bana lo.
  • Could you say that again, please? Samajh na aaye to ye poochhna hai — sharmaana nahi hai. Ye line native log bhi roz bolte hain.

Akele kamre me bolna — 'pagalpan' nahi, tareeka hai

Bahut log soch kar ruk jaate hain: "akele kaise bolun, bewkoof lagega." Sach ye hai ki har fluent bolne wale insaan ne pehle akele hazaar baar bola hota hai. Darwaza band karo, aaina saamne rakho, aur bolo. Kisi ko sunai nahi de raha — isliye galti ki koi keemat nahi hai. Yahi sabse surakshit practice hai jo mil sakti hai.

docs.title: 1.3 🔊 button aur 🎤 mic — kaise kaam karte hain
docs.text:
Cheez Kya karti hai Aapko kya karna hai 🔊 Say button Us line ko aapke device ki aawaz me bolta hai. Pehle suno. Phir rok kar wahi line khud bolo. Phir dobara suno aur milao. Dheemi aawaz Kuch mushkil lines dheere boli jaati hain, taaki har aawaz saaf pakdi jaaye. Pehli baar dheere bolo. Tez baad me aayega — tez bolna lakshya nahi hai, saaf bolna hai. Quiz ke 6 prakaar MCQ, khaali jagah, galti dhoondo, vaakya jodo, jodi milao, aur bol kar dikhao. Sab karo. Chhodo mat. Galat jawaab ke baad jo explanation aata hai, wo sabse qeemti hissa hai. 🎤 Bolo (mic) "Bol kar dikhao" wale sawaal me mic aapki aawaz sun kar check karta hai. Pehli baar browser permission maangega — "Allow" dabao. Shaant kamre me, phone se 20 cm door bolo.

Mic na chale to?
