Is chapter me paanch upgrades gehraai se, phir bees se zyada ki poori list, unke rules, aur sabse zaroori sawaal — kab nahi bolna.

Ek line me

Jahan do ya teen shabd milkar ek kaam bata rahe hain, wahan aksar ek verb maujood hai jo wahi kaam zyada saaf karta hai. Kam shabd, zyada asar — ye English likhne ka pehla niyam hai.

docs.title: show clearly → demonstrate
docs.text:
Demonstrate ka matlab sirf dikhana nahi — karke ya sabooot dekar sabit karna. Isi liye ye lab, class, product demo aur report me fit baithta hai. Agar aap bas ungli se jagah dikha rahe ho, to show hi sahi verb hai.

  • The trial demonstrated that the cheaper design works just as well. Trial ne sabit kar diya ki sasta design bhi utna hi theek chalta hai.
  • Let me demonstrate the new feature before we discuss pricing. Pricing se pehle main naya feature karke dikha deta hoon.

Kab nahi

"Demonstrate me the way to the station" — ye ajeeb hai. Raasta dikhane ke liye show. Yaad rakho: demonstrate ke peeche saboot ya process hona chahiye.

docs.title: make better → enhance
docs.text:
Enhance ka matlab hai jo pehle se theek hai, use aur behtar karna. Isliye jo cheez tooti hui hai use "enhance" nahi karte — use fix karte hain. Jo kamzor hai use improve. Enhance me ek upar ka suron wala, polish wala bhaav hai.

  • Better lighting would really enhance these photos. Achhi roshni in photos ko aur nikhaar degi.
  • We added search to enhance the reading experience. Padhne ka anubhav behtar karne ke liye humne search joda.

Teen 'better' alag hain

fix = toota hua theek karna · improve = kamzor ko behtar karna · enhance = achhe ko aur achha karna. "Enhance the bug" nahi bolte — bug fix hota hai.

docs.title: get rid of → eliminate
docs.text:
Eliminate matlab poori tarah hata dena, ek bhi na chhodna. Ye bhaari verb hai — numbers, process, risk, waste ke saath achha lagta hai. Apne purane kapde "eliminate" nahi karte, wo get rid of hi hote hain.

  • The new form eliminated almost all data-entry errors. Naye form ne data bharne ki lagbhag saari galtiyan khatam kar dein.
  • We can eliminate two steps and still get the same result. Hum do step hata sakte hain aur natija phir bhi wahi rahega.

docs.title: give permission → authorize
docs.text:
Authorize sirf "haan bol dena" nahi hai — isme adhikaar hai. Jo authorize karta hai uske paas official power honi chahiye: manager, bank, government, system. Maa bachche ko bahar jaane ki ijaazat deti hai — lets him go — authorize nahi karti.

  • Only the finance head can authorize a refund above fifty thousand. Pachas hazaar se upar ka refund sirf finance head hi manzoor kar sakte hain.
  • I'm not authorized to share those figures — let me check with my manager. Mujhe wo aankde batane ka adhikaar nahi hai — manager se pooch leta hoon.

Ek bahut kaam ki line

"I'm not authorized to do that" interview, support call aur office — teeno me sona hai. Ye mana karne ka polite aur professional tareeka hai, isme aapki galti nahi hai.

docs.title: take into account → consider
docs.text:
Consider do kaam karta hai: (1) soch-vichaar karna aur (2) dhyan me rakhna. Dono me ye take into account se chhota aur saaf hai. Dhyan do — consider ke baad about kabhi nahi aata.

  • We should consider the delivery cost before choosing a vendor. Vendor chunne se pehle delivery ka kharcha dhyan me rakhna chahiye.
  • Have you considered doing it the other way round? Kya aapne ulta karke dekhne ke baare me socha hai?

Consider ke do pakke rules

  • Galat: Please consider about my request.
  • Sahi: Please consider my request.

  • Kyun: Consider ke baad seedha cheez aati hai — koi preposition nahi.

  • Galat: Have you considered to change the design?

  • Sahi: Have you considered changing the design?
  • Kyun: Consider ke baad verb hamesha -ing me jaata hai, "to" wala roop nahi.

docs.title: 44.2 Ek weak verb, kai sahi verb
docs.text:
Sabse badi galti ye hai ki log ek weak phrase ke badle hamesha ek hi bada shabd rakh dete hain. Sach ye hai ki har weak phrase kai dishaon me khulta hai — kaunsa chunoge, ye arth tay karta hai.

Figure 44.1. Ek dheela phrase, chaar alag matlab. Shabd chunne se pehle sawaal poocho: cheez tooti hai, kamzor hai, achhi hai, ya dheemi hai?

docs.title: 44.3 Bade upgrade ki table
docs.text:
Yahan sirf shabd nahi — teesra column batata hai ki ye upgrade kahan fit baithta hai. Bina us column ke ye table khatarnak hai.

Dheela phrase Ek verb Kahan sahi lagta hai show clearly / prove by doing demonstrate Report, presentation, class, product demo make better (jo pehle se achha ho) enhance Product, design, anubhav, swaad get rid of (poori tarah) eliminate Risk, waste, error, step, cost give permission (adhikaar se) authorize Office, bank, payment, access take into account consider Har jagah — bolna aur likhna dono make smaller / kam karna reduce Cost, time, size — bahut aam make bigger / badhana expand Business, team, scope find out / pata lagana determine Jaanch, report, official likhai put in place / lagu karna implement Office, software, policy say sorry formally apologize Email, customer support make sure ensure Email, process, instructions give out / baant dena distribute Stock, salary, files look into / dekhna-parakhna examine / investigate Jaanch, audit, problem keep up / banaye rakhna maintain Machine, record, standard cut down slowly taper Dawai, kharcha — thoda technical take part in participate Event, survey, training

docs.title: 44.4 Pandrah aur upgrades — make, give, get, have, take
docs.text: Ye wahi "halka verb + noun" wale phrases hain jo hum roz bolte hain. Har ek ke saath ek asli vaakya hai (🔊 dabao) aur aakhri column me register — kyunki inme se kuch shabd bolne me bhaari ya ajeeb lagte hain.

docs.title: make ___ wale phrases
docs.text: Normal → Advanced Example Matlab Kab use karein make worse → aggravate Skipping physio will only aggravate the injury. Pehle se bigdi cheez ko aur bigaad dena. Formal — chot, bimari, jhagda, samasya. Casual me "make it worse" behtar. make possible → enable The new app enables farmers to check prices instantly. Kisi ke liye koi kaam mumkin bana dena. Neutral, office aur tech me bahut aam. Pattern: enable + someone + to + verb. make certain → ensure Please ensure that all files are backed up by Friday. Pakka kar lena ki aisa ho. Email aur instructions. Bolchaal me "make sure" hi natural hai. make clear → elucidate The professor elucidated the theory with two simple diagrams. Mushkil baat ko khol kar saaf samjhana. Bahut kitaabi — research paper, lecture. Rozmarra me "explain" ya "clarify" bolo. make use of → utilize The plant now utilizes waste heat to warm the offices. Kisi cheez ko kaam me laana. Technical/report. 90% jagah seedha "use" behtar — "utilize" bina wajah bhaari lagta hai.

docs.title: give / get / find wale phrases
docs.text: Normal → Advanced Example Matlab Kab use karein give information → provide Could you provide details of the payment? Jaankari ya cheez muhaiya karana. Office aur email me safe. Pattern: provide something, provide someone with something. give an example → exemplify This project exemplifies what a small team can do. Kisi baat ki misaal ban jaana. Formal likhai. Bolne me "is a great example of" zyada natural. get involved → participate Over two hundred students participated in the survey. Kisi kaam me hissa lena. Neutral. Hamesha participate in. Dosti me "get involved" ya "join in" chalta hai. find a solution → resolve The support team resolved the issue within an hour. Masla suljha dena. Office, support, jhagde. Bahut kaam ka. Chhoti cheez ke liye "sort out" bhi chalta hai.

docs.title: have / come / reach / take / keep wale phrases
docs.text:
Normal → Advanced Example Matlab Kab use karein have an effect → influence Reviews strongly influence what people buy online. Kisi par asar daalna. Har jagah safe. Dhyan do: influence ke baad on nahi — "influence people", "have an influence on people". have a need → require This role requires three years of experience. Kisi cheez ki zaroorat hona. Rules, job post, instructions. Baat-cheet me "need" — "I require water" robot jaisa lagta hai. come to a decision → determine The committee will determine the final budget next week. Soch-samajh kar tay karna. Official. Bolne me "decide" zyada aam. Determine ka doosra matlab: pata lagana. reach an agreement → reconcile The mediator helped them reconcile their differences. Matbhed mita kar do paksh ko ek karna. Reconcile = rishte ya matbhed suljhana, ya hisaab milaana. Sirf "samjhauta ho gaya" ke liye reach a consensus ya agree. take control → assume authority The deputy will assume authority while the director is away. Official taur par kamaan sambhalna. Bahut formal — notice, report. Rozmarra aur office me take charge: "She took charge of the project." keep safe → safeguard Strong passwords help safeguard your data. Nuksaan se bachaye rakhna, hifaazat karna. Formal aur policy ki bhasha — data, hak, interest. Bachche ya bag ke liye "keep safe" hi theek.

Jahan simple verb hi jeetta hai

use > utilize · explain > elucidate · need > require · decide > determine · make sure > ensure · take charge > assume authority — ye sab baat-cheet me. Bhaari roop report, policy aur formal email ke liye rakho. Dost se "Can you elucidate?" poochoge to wo hasega. Bade verb ki jagah likhai hai, chai ki tapri nahi.

docs.title: 44.5 Teen sawaal — upgrade karne se pehle
docs.text:
Bada shabd hamesha behtar nahi hota. Kisi bhi weak phrase ko badalne se pehle khud se teen sawaal poocho:

Upgrade ka test

1. Kya matlab wahi reh raha hai? — "eliminate the poor" ka matlab bilkul alag ho jaata hai. Shabd badalne se arth badal sakta hai. 2. Kya ye maahaul isko jhel paayega? — chai ki tapri par "Could you authorize one more cup?" mazaak lagta hai. 3. Kya main ise aaram se bol sakta hoon? — agar bolte waqt zabaan atak rahi hai, wo shabd abhi aapka nahi hua.

Interview ki sachchai

Interviewer ko bade shabd se zyada saaf soch pasand hai. Ek sahi verb achha lagta hai; har line me teen bhaari verb aapko rata hua dikhata hai. Ek paragraph me ek-do upgrade bas kaafi hai. Masala utna hi daalo jitna khaana jhel sake.

docs.title: 44.6 Wo galtiyan jo in verbs ke saath hoti hain
docs.text:
Dhyan se

  • Galat: He demonstrated me his new phone.
  • Sahi: He showed me his new phone.

  • Kyun: Demonstrate ka matlab hai karke ya sabooot dekar sabit karna. Phone dikhane ke liye seedha "show".

  • Galat: Please enhance this broken link.

  • Sahi: Please fix this broken link.

  • Kyun: Jo toota hai wo fix hota hai. Enhance sirf us cheez ke liye jo pehle se kaam kar rahi hai.

  • Galat: My father authorized me to go to the party.

  • Sahi: My father let me go to the party.

  • Kyun: Authorize me official adhikaar hota hai. Ghar me "let", "allowed me to", ya "gave me permission" bolo.

  • Galat: We will eliminate the old sofa this weekend.

  • Sahi: We will get rid of the old sofa this weekend.

  • Kyun: Rozmarra ki cheezein hatane ke liye "get rid of" hi natural hai. Eliminate risk, error, cost jaisi abstract cheezon ke liye.

  • Galat: Kindly consider about my application.

  • Sahi: Please consider my application.

  • Kyun: Consider ke baad preposition nahi lagta — aur "kindly" ki jagah "please" zyada natural hai.

  • Galat: We implemented a new chair in the office.

  • Sahi: We got a new chair for the office.
  • Kyun: Implement process, system aur policy ke liye hai — cheezon ke liye nahi.

docs.title: 44.7 Ek paragraph, do roop
docs.text:
Neeche ek chhoti si office update hai. Pehle dheela roop, phir upgrade kiya hua. Dhyan do ki doosra roop chhota bhi hai — yahi asli faayda hai.

Pehle

We made the checkout page better and we got rid of two steps. The data shows clearly that people finish faster now. Before we do it on the live site, the manager has to give permission, and we should also take into account the extra server cost.

Baad me

We enhanced the checkout page and eliminated two steps. The data demonstrates that people finish faster now. Before we go live, the manager has to authorize it, and we should also consider the extra server cost.

docs.title: 44.8 Practice — Verb upgrades
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Report me likhna hai ki aankdon ne baat sabit kar di. Kaunsa verb?

  • demonstrate
  • enhance
  • authorize
  • maintain

Hint: Saboot ke saath dikhana.

Jawaab

demonstrate

Demonstrate = karke ya saboot dekar sabit karna. Report aur presentation ki bhasha me yahi fit hai.

Exercise 2

Website pehle se theek chal rahi hai, par hum use aur behtar banana chahte hain.

  • enhance
  • fix
  • eliminate
  • demonstrate
Jawaab

enhance

Jo achha hai use aur achha karna = enhance. Toota hua hota to 'fix'.

Exercise 3

Kaunsa vaakya galat hai?

  • We will eliminate the old sofa this weekend.
  • The new form eliminated most errors.
  • We eliminated two unnecessary steps.
  • This change eliminates the risk of double billing.

Hint: Ek me bada shabd galat jagah par hai.

Jawaab

We will eliminate the old sofa this weekend.

Rozmarra ki cheez ke liye 'get rid of'. Eliminate risk, error, step, cost jaisi cheezon ke saath.

Exercise 4

Only the finance head can ___ a refund above fifty thousand.

Hint: Adhikaar ke saath ijaazat dena.

Jawaab

authorize / authorise

Authorize = official power ke saath manzoori dena. Ghar wali ijaazat ke liye 'let' ya 'allow'.

Exercise 5

Have you ___ changing the layout instead?

Hint: take into account ka ek-shabd roop.

Jawaab

considered

Consider ke baad verb -ing me aata hai: considered changing, not 'considered to change'.

Exercise 6

Ek shabd yahan bekaar hai — use dhoondo.

Please consider about my application carefully.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: about.

Sahi roop: Please consider my application carefully.

Consider ke baad koi preposition nahi lagta. Yahi galti 'discuss about' me bhi hoti hai.

Exercise 7

Verb galat chuna gaya hai — us par tap karo.

He demonstrated me his new bike yesterday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: demonstrated.

Sahi roop: He showed me his new bike yesterday.

Bike dikhana sirf 'show' hai. Demonstrate ke peeche process ya saboot hona chahiye.

Exercise 8

Dheele phrase ko uske sahi ek-shabd roop se jodo.

A B get rid of completely consider give permission officially demonstrate take into account eliminate show by proving authorize Jawaab

get rid of completely — eliminate; give permission officially — authorize; take into account — consider; show by proving — demonstrate

Chaaron upgrades ka asli matlab yaad rakho — shabd nahi, uske peeche ka bhaav.

Exercise 9

Sahi 'better' chuno.

A B toota hua theek karna enhance kamzor ko behtar karna optimize achhe ko nikhaarna fix speed ke liye best banana improve Jawaab

toota hua theek karna — fix; kamzor ko behtar karna — improve; achhe ko nikhaarna — enhance; speed ke liye best banana — optimize

Ek hi Hindi soch 'behtar karna' ke English me chaar alag verbs hain. Cheez ki halat dekh kar chuno.

Exercise 10

Upgrade ki hui line banao.

Shabd: all / eliminated / almost / errors / process / The / new / data / entry

Jawaab

The new process eliminated almost all data entry errors

Yahi vaakya 'got rid of almost all errors in data entry' se chhota aur saaf hai.

Exercise 11

Ek paragraph me kitne bhaari verbs theek rehte hain?

  • Ek ya do
  • Har vaakya me ek
  • Jitne zyada utna achha
  • Kam se kam paanch
Jawaab

Ek ya do

Zyada bhaari verbs likhai ko rata hua bana dete hain. Saaf soch bade shabdon se zyada asar karti hai.

Exercise 12

Do teams ke beech purana matbhed tha. Mediator ne unhe phir se ek kar diya. Kaunsa verb?

  • reconcile
  • aggravate
  • utilize
  • exemplify

Hint: Differences suljhana.

Jawaab

reconcile

Reconcile = matbhed mita kar ek karna (reconcile their differences). Aggravate ulta hai — baat aur bigaadna.

Exercise 13

Dost se baat kar rahe ho: 'We utilize this app for groceries.' Isse natural kya hoga?

  • We use this app for groceries.
  • We elucidate this app for groceries.
  • We safeguard this app for groceries.
  • We require this app for groceries.
Jawaab

We use this app for groceries.

Rozmarra me 'use' hi sahi verb hai. 'Utilize' technical report ka shabd hai — bolchaal me bina wajah bhaari lagta hai.

Exercise 14

Please ___ that the door is locked before you leave.

Hint: make certain ka ek-shabd roop.

Jawaab

ensure / make sure

Ensure = pakka karna. Instructions aur email me ensure, baat-cheet me 'make sure' — dono sahi.

Exercise 15

Ek verb is maahaul ke liye bahut bhaari hai — use dhoondo.

Hey, can you elucidate where the washroom is?

Jawaab

Galat shabd: elucidate.

Sahi roop: Hey, can you tell me where the washroom is?

Elucidate lecture aur research ka shabd hai. Raasta poochne ke liye 'tell me' ya 'show me'.

Exercise 16

Normal phrase ko advanced verb se jodo.

A B make worse safeguard make possible resolve keep safe aggravate find a solution enable Jawaab

make worse — aggravate; make possible — enable; keep safe — safeguard; find a solution — resolve

Charon formal likhai me kaam ke hain. Bolte waqt simple roop bhi bilkul theek hai.

Exercise 17

Ye line bolo. 'Authorized' me zor doosre hisse par — a-THO-rized.

Jawaab

Bolo: I am not authorized to share those figures

Ye line support call aur office dono me kaam aati hai, aur isme aapki galti nahi dikhti — sirf niyam.

Aage kya karein

Apna koi purana email kholo aur sirf verbs par nishaan lagao. Jahan do-teen shabd milkar ek kaam bata rahe hain, wahan ek verb rakh kar dekho. Pandrah minute ki ye exercise kisi bhi vocabulary list se zyada sikhati hai.

docs.title: Chapter 5: Noun — naam wale shabd
docs.text:
Noun wo shabd hai jo kisi insaan, jagah, cheez ya bhaav ka naam batata hai. Har vaakya ki buniyaad yahi hai — pehle koi hota hai, phir wo kuch karta hai. Noun ke teen hisse hain jo Indian speakers ko sabse zyada pakadte hain: countable vs uncountable, plural banana, aur apostrophe kahan lagta hai. Teeno is chapter me.

Ek line me

A noun is a word that names a person, place, thing, animal, or idea. Jiska naam liya ja sake — wo noun hai.

  • My brother works in Chennai. Mera bhai Chennai me kaam karta hai. (insaan + jagah)
  • Honesty is the best policy. Imaandaari bhi noun hai — chhua nahi ja sakta, par naam hai.
  • The team won two matches. Samooh ka naam bhi noun, cheez ka naam bhi noun.

docs.title: 5.1 Noun ke prakaar — ek naksha
docs.text:
Noun ko do tarah se baanta jaata hai, aur dono baantein saath chalti hain. Pehle naam ke hisaab se (proper, common, collective, abstract, material), aur phir ginti ke hisaab se (countable, uncountable). Ek hi noun dono list me hoga — jaise "water" common hai aur uncountable bhi.

Figure 5.1. Noun ka ped — upar naam ke hisaab se paanch shaakhaayein, neeche ginti ke hisaab se do.

docs.title: 5.2 Paanch prakaar, thoda detail me
docs.text:
Prakaar Matlab Examples Dhyan Proper Kisi khaas ek cheez ka apna naam Ravi, Ganga, India, Diwali, Toyota Hamesha capital letter se Common Poori jaati ka aam naam boy, river, country, festival, car Small letter, aur a/an/the lagta hai Collective Bahut saari cheezon ka ek samooh team, family, crowd, class, herd Dikhne me ek, matlab me bahut Abstract Jo chhua na ja sake — bhaav, gun, haalat honesty, anger, childhood, freedom Aksar uncountable hote hain Material Jis cheez se kuch bana ho gold, cotton, rice, water, iron Uncountable, isliye "a gold" nahi

Collective noun — singular ya plural?

Jab poora samooh ek saath kaam kar raha ho to singular: The team is playing well. Jab samooh ke log alag-alag kaam kar rahe hon to plural bhi theek hai: The team are arguing among themselves. Bharat me pehla roop zyada chalta hai — doubt ho to singular lagao.

docs.title: Quick guide — saare prakaar ek nazar me
docs.text:
Naam ke hisaab se paanch prakaar upar the. Iske alawa do aur tarah se noun ko dekha jaata hai — gin sakte hain ya nahi (countable / uncountable), aur kitne shabdon se bana (compound).

Type Pehchaan ka sawaal Examples Proper Kisi ek ka khaas naam? (capital) Ravi, Delhi, Ganga Common Poori jaati ka aam naam? boy, city, river Collective Ek samooh ka naam? team, army, herd Material Kis cheez se bana? gold, wood, cotton Abstract Chhu nahi sakte — bhaav, gun, haalat? love, honesty, childhood Countable Gin sakte hain? (a / an, plural) a pen, two pens Uncountable Gin nahi sakte? (no a / an, no plural) water, advice, furniture Compound Do ya zyada shabd milkar ek naam? toothpaste, bus stop, mother-in-law

Compound noun ke teen roop

Ek shabd me judkar — toothbrush, classroom, sunlight Alag-alag likhkar — bus stop, ice cream, post office Hyphen ke saath — mother-in-law, passer-by, well-wisher Kaunsa roop sahi hai, ye dictionary batati hai — rule se nahi, aadat se aata hai.

docs.title: 5.3 Countable aur Uncountable — yahi sabse badi gadbad hai
docs.text:
Hindi me hum "ek paani", "do advice" bol dete hain aur baat samajh aa jaati hai. English me aisa nahi chalta. Kuch noun English ki nazar me dher hain, tukde nahi — aur dher ko ginaa nahi jaata, naapa jaata hai.

Countable Uncountable a / an a book, an apple ✗ a water, ✗ an advice Plural books, apples ✗ waters, ✗ advices Kitne? many, few, a few, number of much, little, a little, amount of Ginti two books two glasses of water Verb These books are new. This water is cold.

Ye noun uncountable hain — inka plural kabhi na banao

information, advice, furniture, luggage, equipment, machinery, stationery, news, work, bread, rice, money, traffic, scenery, knowledge, progress, homework, research, hair (sar ke baal, poore). Inke peeche -s lagte hi vaakya galat ho jaata hai.

Ginti karni ho to maapne wala shabd aage lagao — yahi asli tareeka hai:

Galat Sahi two informations two pieces of information many advices a lot of advice / several pieces of advice three furnitures three pieces of furniture two breads two slices / loaves of bread four luggages four bags of luggage a news a piece of news / some news

Kuch noun dono hote hain — matlab badal jaata hai

Shabd Uncountable me Countable me hair her hair is long (poore baal) two hairs in my food (do baal) time I have no time (samay) three times (baar) paper I need paper (kaagaz) today's paper (akhbaar) water drink water (paani) the waters of the Ganga (saahityik) experience he has experience (tajurba) a strange experience (ek ghatna)

docs.title: 5.4 Plural banane ke rule
docs.text:
Aksar sirf -s lagta hai. Par aath jagah thoda alag hota hai. Ek baar table dekh lo, zyadatar kaam ho jaayega.

Shabd kaise khatam hota hai Kya karo Example Normal + s book → books, pen → pens -s, -ss, -sh, -ch, -x, -z + es bus → buses, box → boxes, watch → watches consonant + y y → ies city → cities, baby → babies vowel + y + s (y rehta hai) boy → boys, day → days -f, -fe (kuch me) f → ves leaf → leaves, knife → knives, wife → wives -o (kuch me) + es mango → mangoes, hero → heroes, potato → potatoes -o (videshi shabd) + s photos, pianos, radios, zoos Bilkul alag (irregular) yaad karo man → men, child → children, tooth → teeth

docs.title: Wo plurals jo kisi rule me nahi aate
docs.text:
Singular Plural Singular Plural man men woman women child children person people tooth teeth foot feet mouse mice goose geese ox oxen louse lice sheep sheep deer deer fish fish series series criterion criteria analysis analyses

Ye hamesha plural hote hain

trousers, jeans, scissors, spectacles, glasses, clothes, goods, thanks, surroundings, premises, scales — inka singular nahi hota. Ek jodi batana ho to: a pair of trousers. "My trouser is dirty" nahi — "My trousers are dirty".

Compound noun ka plural

Asli shabd par -s lagta hai, aakhir me nahi: brothers-in-law, passers-by, *Commanders-in-Chief. Par aaj ki English me son-in-laws* bhi suna jaata hai — exam me purana roop hi likho.

docs.title: 5.5 Possessive — apostrophe kahan lagega
docs.text:
Hindi me "ka, ki, ke" hota hai. English me 's ya of. Niyam seedha hai — pehle ye dekho ki noun singular hai ya plural, aur plural pehle se -s par khatam ho raha hai ya nahi.

Figure 5.2. Ek sawaal — -s par khatam ho raha hai? — aur apostrophe ki jagah tay ho jaati hai. Haalat Rule Example Singular noun + 's my sister's phone Plural -s par khatam sirf ' the students' hostel Irregular plural + 's the children's books, men's shoes Do log, ek cheez aakhir wale par 's Ram and Shyam's shop (ek hi dukaan) Do log, alag cheezein dono par 's Ram's and Shyam's shops (do dukaanein) Bejaan cheez of use karo the roof of the house Samay / naap 's chalta hai a day's work, two weeks' notice

its vs it's — ye 90% log galat likhte hain

  • Galat: The dog wagged it's tail.
  • Sahi: The dog wagged its tail.
  • Kyun: its = uska (possessive). it's = it is. Test: vaakya me "it is" rakh kar padho — agar bemaani lage to apostrophe hata do.

docs.title: 5.6 Noun vaakya me kahan baithta hai
docs.text: Kaam Example Matlab Subject Ravi called me. kaam karne wala Object I called Ravi. jis par kaam hua Indirect object I gave Ravi a pen. kiske liye Complement He became a doctor. subject ke baare me Preposition ke baad She sat on the chair. object of preposition Address karna Sir, may I come in? jise bula rahe hain

docs.title: 5.7 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Noun ki sabse aam Indian-English galtiyan

  • Galat: She is one of my friend.
  • Sahi: She is one of my friends.

  • Kyun: "One of" ka matlab hai — bahut me se ek. Jab bahut hain to noun plural hoga. Pehle group banao (my friends), phir usme se ek nikaalo (one of).

  • Galat: Please give me some informations.

  • Sahi: Please give me some information.

  • Kyun: Information uncountable hai — English use dher maanti hai, tukde nahi. Ginti karni ho to two pieces of information.

  • Galat: He gave me many good advices.

  • Sahi: He gave me a lot of good advice.

  • Kyun: Advice ka plural nahi hota, aur uske saath "many" bhi nahi — "much" ya "a lot of". Dhyan rakho: advice noun hai, advise verb.

  • Galat: She is my cousin sister.

  • Sahi: She is my cousin.

  • Kyun: "Cousin" ek poora noun hai — usme bhai/behen jodna zaroori nahi. Agar rishta saaf karna ho to kaho: She is my cousin — my uncle's daughter.

  • Galat: I bought two new furnitures.

  • Sahi: I bought two new pieces of furniture.

  • Kyun: Furniture poora samaan hai, ek-ek item nahi. Ek item batana ho to naam lo: a table, a sofa.

  • Galat: My all luggages are in the car.

  • Sahi: All my luggage is in the car.

  • Kyun: Do galtiyan ek saath: luggage uncountable hai (plural nahi), aur kram "all my" hota hai, "my all" nahi. Uncountable ke saath verb bhi singular — is.

  • Galat: The peoples of my village are very kind.

  • Sahi: The people of my village are very kind.

  • Kyun: "People" khud hi plural hai — person ka plural. "Peoples" sirf tab chalta hai jab alag-alag jaatiyon ki baat ho: the peoples of Asia.

  • Galat: I have two womens in my team.

  • Sahi: I have two women in my team.
  • Kyun: "Women" pehle se plural hai. Irregular plurals par dobara -s kabhi nahi lagta — na "childrens", na "mens", na "teeths".

docs.title: 5.8 Yaad rakhne wali chhoti baat
docs.text:
Teen sawaal, har noun ke liye

1. Gina ja sakta hai? → haan to a/an aur plural; nahi to bina a/an, singular verb. 2. Kiska hai? → -s par khatam hai to sirf ', warna 's. 3. Ek hai ya bahut? → verb ko usi ke hisaab se badlo.

docs.title: 5.9 Practice — Nouns
docs.text:
Exercise 1

She is one of my ___ from college.

  • friends
  • friend
  • friend's
  • friends'

Hint: 'One of' ke baad group aata hai.

Jawaab

friends

'One of' ka matlab hai bahut me se ek — to group plural hona chahiye. Pehle group (friends), phir usme se ek chuna gaya.

Exercise 2

I need some ___ about the admission process.

  • information
  • informations
  • an information
  • informations'

Hint: Ye noun uncountable hai.

Jawaab

information

Information uncountable hai — English usse dher maanti hai, isliye na -s lagta hai, na a/an. Ginti karni ho to 'two pieces of information'.

Exercise 3

Kaunsa plural sahi hai?

  • children
  • childrens
  • childs
  • childrens'
Jawaab

children

Child ka plural children hai — ye irregular hai. Irregular plural par dobara -s nahi lagta, isliye 'childrens' hamesha galat hai.

Exercise 4

The ___ hostel is behind the library. (bahut saare students ka hostel)

  • students'
  • student's
  • students
  • students's

Hint: Plural pehle se -s par khatam ho raha hai.

Jawaab

students'

Plural 'students' pehle se -s par khatam hai, isliye sirf apostrophe lagta hai — koi doosra s nahi. Ek student ka hota to student's.

Exercise 5

The dog wagged ___ tail happily.

Hint: Possessive chahiye, 'it is' nahi.

Jawaab

its

'its' possessive hai — uska. 'it's' ka matlab 'it is' hota hai, aur yahan 'the dog wagged it is tail' bemaani ho jaata.

Exercise 6

Three ___ of furniture arrived yesterday. (ginti ka shabd)

Hint: Uncountable noun ko ginane ke liye beech me ek shabd chahiye.

Jawaab

pieces

Furniture uncountable hai, isliye seedha gin nahi sakte. Beech me maapne wala shabd — pieces — lagaate hain.

Exercise 7

Is vaakya me ek galti hai — galat shabd par tap karo.

She is my cousin sister from Nagpur.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: sister.

Sahi roop: She is my cousin from Nagpur.

English me 'cousin' apne aap me poora shabd hai — usme sister ya brother jodne ki zaroorat nahi. Hindi ke 'cousin behen' se ye aadat aati hai.

Exercise 8

Galat shabd dhoondo.

He gave me many advices about the exam.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: advices.

Sahi roop: He gave me a lot of advice about the exam.

Advice uncountable hai — na plural banta hai, na 'many' chalta hai. Uske saath 'much' ya 'a lot of' aata hai.

Exercise 9

Ek shabd galat hai — dhoondo.

My trouser is lying on the bed.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: trouser.

Sahi roop: My trousers are lying on the bed.

Trousers hamesha plural hota hai, kyunki do paay hoti hain. Isi liye verb bhi 'are' hoga. Ek jodi batana ho to 'a pair of trousers'.

Exercise 10

'Toothpaste', 'bus stop' aur 'mother-in-law' — teeno kis prakaar ke noun hain?

  • Compound
  • Collective
  • Abstract
  • Material

Hint: Kitne shabdon se bane hain?

Jawaab

Compound

Do ya zyada shabd milkar ek naam banayein to compound noun — chahe jude hon (toothpaste), alag hon (bus stop), ya hyphen ke saath (mother-in-law).

Exercise 11

Kaunsa noun uncountable hai?

  • luggage
  • bag
  • suitcase
  • ticket

Hint: Iske saath 'a' nahi lagta, plural bhi nahi banta.

Jawaab

luggage

'luggage' uncountable hai — 'a luggage' ya 'luggages' nahi. Ginna ho to 'two pieces of luggage' ya 'two bags'. Baaki teeno countable hain.

Exercise 12

Noun ko uske prakaar se jodo.

A B Mumbai abstract noun crowd material noun kindness common noun cotton proper noun chair collective noun Jawaab

Mumbai — proper noun; crowd — collective noun; kindness — abstract noun; cotton — material noun; chair — common noun

Khaas naam proper, samooh collective, bhaav abstract, banane wali cheez material, aur poori jaati ka aam naam common hota hai.

Exercise 13

Sahi kram me vaakya banao — possessive ka istemaal hai.

Shabd: phone / is / the / My / sister's / on / table

Jawaab

My sister's phone is on the table

Possessive 's hamesha us noun ke turant baad aata hai jiski cheez hai, aur cheez ka naam uske foran baad — sister's phone.

Exercise 14

Ye line bol ke dekho. 'friends' ke aakhir me -s ki aawaz saaf nikaalni hai.

Jawaab

Bolo: She is one of my closest friends

Hum log aakhir ka -s nigal jaate hain, isliye 'one of my friend' sunai deta hai. Jaan-boojh kar -s ko bahar nikaalo — yahi sudhaar hai.

Aage kya karein

Apne roz ke dus vaakya likho aur har noun ke neeche line khincho — phir poochho "countable hai ya nahi?". Do din me uncountable list dimaag me bas jaayegi. Agla chapter Pronoun — noun ka shortcut.

docs.title: Chapter 31: Number, date, time, paise
docs.text:
Number bolna aasaan lagta hai — jab tak auto wala "fifty" ki jagah "fifteen" na sun le, ya foreign client "twelve lakh" sun kar chup na ho jaaye. Is chapter me hum number, paise, saal, tareekh, time aur phone number saaf aur sahi tarike se bolna seekhenge — aur lakh-crore ko million me badalna bhi. Har line ke saath 🔊 dabao aur zor se dohraao.

Ek line me

-teen par zor aakhir me, -ty par shuru me · hundred and · 10 lakh = 1 million · twenty twenty-six · quarter past / half past / quarter to. Number me ek chhoti si galti = galat paise, galat train, galat din.

docs.title: 31.1 13 ya 30? — sabse mehnga confusion
docs.text:
thirteen aur thirty, fifteen aur fifty — likhne me alag, par bolne me Indian speakers aksar ek jaise bol dete hain. Farq do cheezon me hai: zor kahan hai, aur aakhri hissa lamba hai ya chhota.

Figure 31.1. Bada dabba = zor wala hissa. -teen me aakhri hissa bada aur lamba; -ty me pehla hissa bada aur aakhri jhatke se khatam. -teen Suno -ty Suno 13 thirTEEN 30 THIRty 14 fourTEEN 40 FORty 15 fifTEEN 50 FIFty 16 sixTEEN 60 SIXty 18 eighTEEN 80 EIGHty
  • She's fifteen, not fifty! Wo pandrah saal ki hai, pachaas ki nahi!
  • Platform thirteen, please. Platform terah, please.

Shak ho to tod kar bolo

Paise ya platform jaise zaroori number me confusion ho sakta hai, to saaf kar do: "Fifteen — one five." ya "Fifty — five zero." Native speakers bhi phone par yahi karte hain.

docs.title: 31.2 100 ke upar — hundred, thousand aur "and"
docs.text:
British aur Indian English me hundred ke baad and aata hai: a hundred and twenty. American English me "and" aksar chhod dete hain. Aur ek pakka niyam: number ke saath hundred / thousand / million ka plural nahi.

Number Bolo Suno 100 a hundred / one hundred 120 a hundred and twenty 305 three hundred and five 999 nine hundred and ninety-nine 1,500 one thousand five hundred / fifteen hundred 4,250 four thousand two hundred and fifty 70,000 seventy thousand

✗

There were three hundreds people at the wedding.

✓

There were three hundred people at the wedding.

hundreds of people

thousands of rupees

  • Hundreds of people were waiting at the station. Station par saikdon log intezaar kar rahe the.

docs.title: 31.3 Lakh, crore aur million — dono duniya ka pul
docs.text:
India me hum lakh aur crore me sochte hain, aur Indian English me ye bilkul sahi shabd hain. Par videshi client, international exam (IELTS) ya global meeting me thousand, million, billion chahiye. Comma bhi alag jagah lagta hai: Indian 1,25,000 = international 125,000.

Figure 31.2. Do jaadui jodiyan yaad rakho: 10 lakh = 1 million aur 1 crore = 10 million . Baaki sab inhi se nikal aata hai. Rakam Indian English International ₹1,25,000 one lakh twenty-five thousand a hundred and twenty-five thousand ₹8,50,000 eight and a half lakh eight hundred and fifty thousand ₹25,00,000 twenty-five lakh two and a half million ₹3,00,00,000 three crore thirty million ₹1,500 crore fifteen hundred crore fifteen billion
  • The bike costs one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees. Bike ₹1,25,000 ki hai. (India me baat ho rahi ho to)
  • That's about a hundred and twenty-five thousand rupees. Wahi rakam, videshi dost ke liye.
  • Our app has two and a half million users — that's twenty-five lakh. Hamare app ke pachchees lakh user hain.
  • The film made three hundred crore — about thirty-six million dollars. Film ne teen sau crore kamaaye.

✗

My salary is twelve lakhs per annum. (US client se)

✓

My salary is about 1.2 million rupees a year — roughly fourteen thousand dollars.

docs.title: 31.4 Decimal, fraction aur percentage
docs.text:
Decimal ke baad har ank alag-alag bolte hain: 3.14 = "three point one four", "three point fourteen" nahi. 0 ko "zero", British me "nought" bhi; aur 0.5 ko seedha "point five" bhi bol dete hain.

Likha Bolo Suno 2.5 two point five 3.14 three point one four 0.75 zero point seven five ½ a half 1½ one and a half ⅓ · ⅔ a third · two thirds ¼ · ¾ a quarter · three quarters 50% fifty per cent 7.5% seven point five per cent
  • One and a half kilos of tomatoes, please. Dedh kilo tamatar dena.
  • Two thirds of the class passed with distinction. Class ke do-tihaai bachche distinction se paas hue.
  • Prices went up by twelve per cent this year. Is saal daam baarah pratishat badhe.

Chhoti baatein

British/Indian likhai me per cent, American me percent — bolne me ek hi. One and a half hours (plural), par half an hour. Aur "dedh" = one and a half, "dhai" = two and a half.

docs.title: 31.5 Paise aur daam
docs.text:
Likhte hain ₹250 ya Rs 250 — symbol pehle; par bolte hain "two hundred and fifty rupees" — rupees baad me. Dukaan aur bazaar me chhota roop bhi chalta hai: ₹499 = "four ninety-nine".

Likha Bolo Suno ₹50 fifty rupees ₹499 four hundred and ninety-nine rupees / four ninety-nine ₹2.50 two rupees fifty (paise) ₹1,200 one thousand two hundred / twelve hundred $3.99 three ninety-nine / three dollars ninety-nine cents £15 fifteen pounds
  • How much is this kurta? — It's eight hundred rupees. Ye kurta kitne ka hai? — Aath sau rupaye ka.
  • Could you do it for six fifty? Saadhe chhe sau me de doge? (mol-bhaav)
  • The bill comes to two thousand three hundred and forty rupees. Bill ₹2,340 ka bana.
  • Can you split it? That's about six hundred each. Baant lein? Har kisi ka lagbhag chhe sau.

✗

It costs rupees two hundred.

✓

It costs two hundred rupees.

baad

'k' sirf informal

Dosto me "fifteen k" (15,000) chalta hai. Office email ya interview me poora bolo: fifteen thousand. Salary ke liye: "twelve lakh a year" ya "twelve lakh per annum", "12 LPA" bolne me nahi.

docs.title: Saal — do-do ank ke jode
docs.text:
Saal ko aksar do hisson me bolte hain: 19|98 = nineteen ninety-eight. Sirf 2000 se 2009 tak "two thousand (and) …" chalta hai. 2010 ke baad dono chalte hain, par twenty twenty-six zyada aam hai.

Saal Bolo Suno 1947 nineteen forty-seven 1900 nineteen hundred 2000 the year two thousand 2005 two thousand and five (US: two thousand five) 2026 twenty twenty-six 1990s the nineties

docs.title: Ordinal numbers — pehla, doosra, teesra
docs.text:
Tareekh hamesha ordinal me bolte hain: the fifth, "the five" nahi. Dhyan do 11/12/13 par (eleventh, twelfth, thirteenth) aur 21/22/23 par (twenty-first, twenty-second, twenty-third).

Ank Ordinal Suno 1st · 2nd · 3rd first · second · third 5th · 8th · 9th fifth · eighth · ninth 11th · 12th · 13th eleventh · twelfth · thirteenth 20th · 21st · 22nd twentieth · twenty-first · twenty-second 30th · 31st thirtieth · thirty-first

docs.title: Tareekh — British ya American?
docs.text:
Style Likha Bola British / Indian 5 May 2026 the fifth of May, twenty twenty-six American May 5, 2026 May fifth, twenty twenty-six India/UK number 05/06/2026 5 June US number 05/06/2026 May 6
  • My birthday is on the twenty-first of October. Mera janamdin 21 October ko hai.
  • The exam is on March the third. Exam teen March ko hai.
  • I was born in two thousand and five. Mera janam 2005 me hua.
  • India became independent on the fifteenth of August, nineteen forty-seven. Bharat 15 August 1947 ko aazaad hua.

✗

The meeting is on five May.

✓

The meeting is on the fifth of May. / on May fifth.

on

in

Preposition — rishta jodne wale

05/06 ka jaal

US client ke liye 05/06 = 6 May, aapke liye 5 June. International email me hamesha mahina shabd me likho: 5 June 2026. Gadbad khatam.

docs.title: 31.7 Time batana — o'clock se "7 sharp" tak
docs.text:
Do tarike hain: digital (seven fifteen) — aasaan aur hamesha sahi; aur past / to wala (quarter past seven) — roz ki baat-cheet me bahut aam. Dono samajhne zaroori hain.

Time past / to Digital Suno 7:00 seven o'clock seven 7:05 five past seven seven oh five 7:15 quarter past seven seven fifteen 7:30 half past seven seven thirty 7:40 twenty to eight seven forty 7:45 quarter to eight seven forty-five

past aur to

Pehle 30 minute: minute + past + abhi ka ghanta. Baad ke 30: minute + to + agla ghanta. 15 = quarter, 30 = half. Shak ho to digital bolo: seven forty-five kabhi galat nahi.

Hindi Time English sawa saat 7:15 quarter past seven saadhe saat 7:30 half past seven paune aath 7:45 quarter to eight dedh baje 1:30 half past one dhai baje 2:30 half past two
  • The meeting starts at ten sharp. Meeting theek das baje shuru hogi — ek minute bhi late nahi.
  • Let's meet around six. / Let's meet at six-ish. Chhe baje ke aas-paas milte hain.
  • My flight is at eleven forty-five p.m. Meri flight raat 11:45 ki hai.
  • The train departs at nineteen hundred hours. Train 19:00 (shaam 7 baje) chhootegi. 24-ghante wala time announcements me.
  • What time is it? — It's half past four. Kitne baje hain? — Saadhe chaar.

✗

I'll come at 7 o'clock in the evening p.m.

✓

I'll come at 7 p.m. / at seven in the evening.

seven o'clock

British 'half seven'

UK me log "half seven" bolte hain — matlab 7:30 (half past seven). 6:30 nahi!

docs.title: Phone number — ek-ek ank, jodiyon me
docs.text:
Phone number ka har ank alag bolo, chhote groups me, aur group ke beech halka sa ruko. Do ek jaise ank = double, teen = triple. 0 ko "oh" ya "zero" — dono chalte hain.

  • 98450 22301 → nine eight four five oh, double two three oh one. Paanch-paanch ke do group.
  • My extension is triple four. Mera extension 444 hai.
  • Sorry, was that five oh or five four? Sorry, 50 tha ya 54? (dobara confirm karna)

docs.title: Naap-tol, tapmaan aur score
docs.text:
Likha Bolo Suno 5'8" five foot eight / five feet eight inches 70 kg seventy kilos 12 km twelve kilometres 2 BHK, 1,100 sq ft a two B-H-K, eleven hundred square feet 38°C thirty-eight degrees (Celsius) −5°C minus five degrees 250/3 (cricket) two fifty for three 2–0 (football) two nil / two-zero
  • It was forty-four degrees in Nagpur yesterday! Kal Nagpur me 44 degree tha!
  • I'm five foot six and I weigh about sixty kilos. Meri lambai 5'6" hai aur wazan lagbhag 60 kilo.

✗

The office is 12 kms from here. / It's 38 degree.

✓

The office is 12 km (twelve kilometres) from here. / It's 38 degrees.

docs.title: 31.9 Asli zindagi me — cab booking aur bill
docs.text:
Ankit airport ke liye cab book kar raha hai aur phir dukaan par bill chuka raha hai. Har line suno aur dohraao — numbers par khaas dhyan.

Kaun Kya kehta hai Suno Agent What time is your flight, sir? Ankit It's at six forty-five a.m. on the thirteenth. Agent Sorry — the thirteenth or the thirtieth? Ankit The thirteenth. One three. Agent Then the driver will pick you up at four sharp. The fare is eight hundred and fifty rupees. Ankit Great. My number is nine eight one oh, double seven, four five two six. Cashier That's one thousand two hundred and forty, sir. Card or UPI?

Roz ki 3-minute drill

Raste me jo number dikhe — gaadi ki plate, dukaan ka daam, ghadi ka time — man me English me bolo. "Seven forty-five… quarter to eight." Ek hafte me number bolna dimaag ka nahi, zubaan ka kaam ban jaayega.

docs.title: 31.10 Practice — Numbers, dates, time & money
docs.text:
Exercise 1

When is the meeting?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

The meeting has been moved to the thirteenth of March.

  • 13 March
  • 30 March
  • 3 March
  • 13 May
Jawaab

13 March

thir-TEEN — zor aakhir me aur lambi 'ee'. 30 hota to THIR-tieth.

Exercise 2

How much does the driver want?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

That will be fifty rupees, please.

  • ₹15
  • ₹50
  • ₹500
  • ₹5
Jawaab

₹50

FIF-ty: zor shuru me, aakhir chhota. Fifteen me zor 'teen' par hota.

Exercise 3

What time does the flight leave?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

My flight leaves at a quarter to nine.

  • 8:45
  • 9:15
  • 8:15
  • 9:45
Jawaab

8:45

quarter to nine = nau bajne me pandrah minute = 8:45 (paune nau).

Exercise 4

What is the price of the flat?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

The flat costs one crore twenty lakh rupees.

  • ₹1,20,00,000
  • ₹12,00,000
  • ₹1,20,000
  • ₹1,02,00,000
Jawaab

₹1,20,00,000

1 crore + 20 lakh = 1,20,00,000 (= 12 million).

Exercise 5

How many users is that in lakh?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Our app now has about one point five million users.

  • 15 lakh
  • 1.5 lakh
  • 150 lakh
  • 1.5 crore
Jawaab

15 lakh

1 million = 10 lakh, to 1.5 million = 15 lakh.

Exercise 6

What is Kavya's number?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Hi, it's Kavya. Please call me back on nine eight four five oh, double two, three oh one.

  • 98450 22301
  • 98450 23011
  • 98405 22301
  • 98450 22310
Jawaab

98450 22301

oh = 0, double two = 22. Phone number me har ank alag bola jaata hai.

Exercise 7

When does the train leave?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Train number one two nine five one will depart from platform four at nineteen hundred hours.

  • 7 p.m.
  • 9 p.m.
  • 7 a.m.
  • 9 a.m.
Jawaab

7 p.m.

Nineteen hundred hours = 19:00 = shaam 7 baje. Announcements me 24-ghante ka time.

Exercise 8

Which platform?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Train number one two nine five one will depart from platform four at nineteen hundred hours.

  • 4
  • 14
  • 19
  • 1
Jawaab

4

platform four. 12951 train number hai, 19 time ka hissa.

Exercise 9

Write what you hear. (Number ank me ya shabd me — dono chalega)

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

The tickets cost two hundred and fifty rupees each.

two hundred and fifty = 250. Rupees number ke baad.

Exercise 10

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

My birthday is on the twenty-first of October.

Tareekh ordinal me: twenty-first (21st).

Exercise 11

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

I was born in two thousand and five.

2000–2009: two thousand (and) five.

Exercise 12

Write what you hear.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

The shop opens at half past ten.

half past ten = 10:30 (saadhe das).

Exercise 13

How do people usually say the year 2026?

  • twenty twenty-six
  • two zero two six
  • twenty hundred twenty-six
  • two thousand twenty-six hundred
Jawaab

twenty twenty-six

Saal ko do jodon me: 20|26 = twenty twenty-six. ('two thousand and twenty-six' bhi sahi hai, par kam aam.)

Exercise 14

A US client asks your budget. ₹1,25,000 in international English is…

  • a hundred and twenty-five thousand rupees
  • twelve lakh fifty thousand rupees
  • one million two hundred and fifty thousand rupees
  • twelve thousand five hundred rupees
Jawaab

a hundred and twenty-five thousand rupees

1,25,000 = 125,000 = a hundred and twenty-five thousand.

Exercise 15

An American email says the deadline is 05/06. What date do they mean?

  • 6 May
  • 5 June
  • 5 May
  • 6 June
Jawaab

6 May

US style: month/day. Isliye international email me mahina shabd me likho.

Exercise 16

7:45 = a quarter ___ eight.

Hint: Agla ghanta aane wala hai.

Jawaab

to

30 minute ke baad: minute + to + agla ghanta.

Exercise 17

Tap the wrong word.

There were three hundreds people at the wedding.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: hundreds.

Sahi roop: There were three hundred people at the wedding.

Number ke saath hundred singular: three hundred people.

Exercise 18

Match the ordinals.

A B 1st twelfth 3rd twenty-first 12th first 21st third Jawaab

1st — first; 3rd — third; 12th — twelfth; 21st — twenty-first

1, 2, 3 aur unke saath khatam hone wale (21, 22, 23) alag hain; 12 = twelfth.

Exercise 19

Say it aloud — thir-TEEN vs THIR-ty ka farq saaf ho.

Jawaab

Bolo: The train leaves from platform thirteen, not thirty

thir-TEEN: zor aakhir me, lambi 'ee'. THIR-ty: zor shuru me, aakhir chhota.

Aage kya karein

Apna phone number, janamdin aur pichhle mahine ka bijli bill English me zor se bolo — teen baar. Phir Phone aur video call chapter me ye number asli call me use karo, aur Native speed English me suno ki tez bolne par shabd kaise jud jaate hain.

docs.title: Chapter 33: Phone aur video call
docs.text:
Phone aur video call — bina chehra dekhe baat karna

Aamne-saamne baat me haath, aankhein aur muskaan madad karti hain. Phone par sirf aawaaz hai — isi liye wahan English sabse mushkil lagti hai. Achhi khabar ye hai ki phone ki English bahut fixed hoti hai: gine-chune vaakya baar-baar aate hain. Wo vaakya rat lo, aur aadhi ghabraahat khatam. Is chapter me call uthane se lekar "You're on mute" tak sab hai — har line par 🔊 ke saath.

docs.title: 33.1 Call uthana aur call karna
docs.text:
Call ke pehle das second tay karte hain ki baaki call kaisi jaayegi. Saamne wale ko teen cheezein turant chahiye: aap kaun ho, kahan se ho, aur kyon call kiya.

Figure 33.1. Har call isi naqshe par chalti hai — aap call karo ya uthao. Beech ka sawaal ( available hain? ) hi tay karta hai ki raasta kaunsa hoga.
  • Hello, Priya speaking. Call uthate waqt apna naam — office me sabse saaf tareeka.
  • Good morning, Sharma Traders. How can I help you? Company ka phone uthaate waqt.
  • Hi, this is Arjun from BlueLeaf Design. Phone par apna naam = "This is…", "I am…" nahi.
  • Could I speak to Ms Rao, please? Kisi khaas insaan se baat karni ho.
  • I'm calling about the invoice you sent last week. "I'm calling about…" = main is baare me call kar raha hoon.
  • Is this a good time to talk? Abhi baat kar sakte ho? — izzat wala sawaal, khaas kar mobile par.

Pehle das second

Greeting + naam + kaam: "Hi, this is Arjun from BlueLeaf. I'm calling about the invoice." Phone par apna naam hamesha "This is…" se — "I am Arjun this side" nahi.

docs.title: 33.2 Kaun bol raha hai — poochhna, rukwaana, message lena
docs.text:
Office ya ghar ka phone aap uthao aur call kisi aur ke liye ho, to teen kaam aate hain: caller ka naam poochhna, unhe rukwaana, ya message lena. Teeno ke liye seedhe "Who are you?" ki jagah naram lines hain.

Kehna hai English line Suno Aap kaun? May I ask who's calling? Ek minute ruko Could you hold on a moment, please? Main jod deta hoon I'll put you through. Wo abhi nahi hain I'm afraid she's in a meeting right now. Kuch kehna hai? Can I take a message? Unse callback karwa dena Could you ask her to call me back? Galat number Sorry, I think you have the wrong number.

Naram sawaal, saaf kaam

"Who are you?" ki jagah "May I ask who's calling?" Aur bura khabar dene se pehle "I'm afraid…" lagao — "I'm afraid he's not in today." "I'm afraid" yahan darr nahi, "maaf kijiye, par…" ka matlab hai.

Mini-dialogue — office reception

Haalat: aap reception par ho. Kisi ka call aata hai jo aapki manager Ms Rao se baat karna chahta hai, par wo meeting me hain.

  • Aap: Good afternoon, Zenith Travels. How can I help you? Greeting + company + madad ki peshkash.
  • Caller: Hi, could I speak to Ms Rao, please? Caller ne naam nahi bataya — ab aapko poochhna hai.
  • Aap: Of course. May I ask who's calling? "Who are you?" nahi — ye naram tareeka hai.
  • Caller: It's Karan Mehta from Skyline Hotels. Phone par "It's…" ya "This is…" — dono sahi.
  • Aap: Thank you, Mr Mehta. I'm afraid she's in a meeting right now. Can I take a message? Bura khabar "I'm afraid" ke saath, turant hal ke saath.
  • Caller: Yes, could you ask her to call me back before five? Message: paanch baje se pehle callback.
  • Aap: Sure. I'll make sure she gets the message. Bharosa dilaane wali line.

docs.title: 33.3 Sunai nahi diya, samajh nahi aaya
docs.text:
Phone par aadhi galtiyan English ki nahi, network ki hoti hain. Darr ye hota hai ki dobara poochha to bura lagega — par andaaze se "yes, yes" bolna usse kahin zyada mehnga padta hai. Problem pehchaano, aur uski line bolo.

Figure 33.2. Pehle problem pehchaano, phir uski line. Aur jo bhi date, time, number ya naam ho — use apne shabdon me dohra ke pakka karo.
  • Sorry, could you repeat that? Sabse kaam ki line. "Sorry?" akela bhi chalta hai — aawaaz upar le jaao.
  • Sorry, I didn't catch your name. "catch" = pakadna — naam sunai nahi diya.
  • Sorry, you're breaking up. Can I call you back? Aawaaz toot rahi hai — main dobara call karta hoon.
  • Could you speak a little more slowly, please? Thoda dheere — koi bura nahi maanta.
  • Just to confirm, you said Thursday at three? Pakka kar loon — gurubaar, teen baje? Galatfahmi yahin rukti hai.

Andaaza nahi, sawaal

Samajh na aaye to "What?" ya "Haan?" nahi — "Sorry, could you repeat that?" Aur har zaroori date, time, number ko "Just to confirm…" ke saath dohraao. Andaaze se bola gaya "yes, yes" sabse mehngi galti hai.

docs.title: 33.4 Naam aur number spell karna
docs.text:
Phone par B, D, P, V aur T ek jaise sunai dete hain; M aur N bhi; F aur S bhi. Isliye har letter ke saath ek pehchaan wala shabd jodo. Duniya bhar me ye list chalti hai — rat lo, ya kam se kam apne naam ke letters.

Figure 33.3. B for Bombay jaise desi shabd bhi India me chal jaate hain — bas shabd saaf aur jaana-pehchaana ho. International call par upar wali list sabse safe hai.
  • My surname is Rawat. That's R for Romeo, A for Alpha, W for Whiskey, A for Alpha, T for Tango. "That's…" se spelling shuru karo, har letter ke baad zara ruko.
  • My number is nine eight two zero one, four five six seven eight. Number ko 5 + 5 ke tukdon me bolo, beech me ruk kar. Ek saans me das ank koi nahi likh paata.
  • That's double seven, not one seven. "77" = double seven. India aur UK me aam hai; American log "seven seven" bolte hain.
  • My email is priya dot sharma at gmail dot com. . = dot, @ = at, _ = underscore, - = hyphen ya dash, / = slash.

Spell karne ka tareeka

Letter + for + shabd: "S for Sierra, H for Hotel." Number tukdon me bolo (98201 · 45678), aur email me dot, at, underscore. Apne naam, surname aur email ki spelling aaj hi ek baar zor se bol kar taiyaar kar lo.

docs.title: 33.5 Voicemail chhodna
docs.text:
Beep ke baad kai log ghabra ke call kaat dete hain, ya bina ruke kuch bhi bol dete hain. Voicemail ek chhota sa script hai — tees second, paanch hisse. Pehle se socha ho to aasaan hai.

Figure 33.4. Kadam 4 sabse zaroori hai — sunne wala pen dhoondh raha hota hai, isliye number do baar.
  • Hi, this is Neha Kapoor from Zenith Travels. Naam + company.
  • I'm calling about your booking for Goa next month. Call ki wajah — ek line me.
  • Could you call me back to confirm the dates? Unhe kya karna hai — saaf shabdon me.
  • My number is nine eight two zero one, four five six seven eight. Again, nine eight two zero one, four five six seven eight. Number do baar, aur jaan-boojh kar dheere.
  • Before six today would be great. Thanks, bye! Kab tak + shukriya. Bas — tees second poore.

Voicemail ka saancha

Naam → wajah → kya chahiye → number (do baar, dheere) → kab tak + thanks. Tees second se zyada nahi. Beep se pehle hi pehli line dimaag me taiyaar rakho — "Hi, this is…"

docs.title: 33.6 Video call — "You're on mute"
docs.text:
Video call me teen nayi museebatein hain — mute, camera aur screen share. Aur inke liye English me bilkul taiyaar lines hain jo har meeting me baar-baar aati hain. Inhe sunte hi pehchaan lo.

Figure 33.5. Teeno sabse aam lines ek hi tasveer me — mic, screen aur atki hui video. Inhe sunte hi turant samajh jaao. Haalat English line Suno Shuruaat me Can everyone hear me OK? Kisi ka mic band Sorry, I think you're on mute. Aapka mic band tha Sorry, I was on mute. Screen dikhaani hai Let me share my screen. Dikh raha hai? Can you see my screen? Video atak gayi You froze for a second there. Dono ek saath bole Sorry, go ahead. Net kamzor I'll turn my camera off. My connection is a bit weak.

Video call ke chaar niyam

Na bolo to mute. Camera aankh ke level par. Do minute pehle join karo. Badi meeting me bolne se pehle naam: "This is Ravi — quick question." Aur dono ek saath bol pade to: "Sorry, go ahead." — pehle doosre ko mauka.

docs.title: 33.7 Call khatam karna
docs.text:
Phone par "bye" achaanak aata hai to lagta hai call kaat di. Ant me teen cheezein: kya tay hua, agla kadam, aur shukriya. Phir bye — aur bye ke baad thoda ruk kar phone rakho.

  • So, just to sum up, you'll send the report by Friday. Kya tay hua — ek line me dohraao.
  • I'll send you an email with the details. Agla kadam — aapki taraf se.
  • Is there anything else I can help you with? Kuch aur? — jab aap madad wali taraf ho.
  • Thanks for your time. Talk to you soon. Bye! Shukriya + jald baat karenge + bye.

Mini-dialogue — vendor se call ka ant

Haalat: aapne printer company se order ke baare me baat ki. Ab call samet rahe ho.

  • Aap: Great. So, just to confirm, the delivery is on Tuesday morning? Kya tay hua — pakka karo.
  • Vendor: That's right, between nine and eleven. "That's right" = haan, sahi.
  • Aap: Perfect. Could you send me the invoice by email? Agla kadam unki taraf se.
  • Vendor: Sure, I'll send it this afternoon. Anything else? "Anything else?" — ab ant ka signal.
  • Aap: No, that's everything. Thanks for your help. "Bas itna hi" — saaf aur polite.
  • Vendor: You're welcome. Have a good day! Garam ant.
  • Aap: You too. Bye! Bye ke baad ek second ruko, phir phone rakho.

docs.title: 33.8 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Ye lines India me roz sunai deti hain aur desh ke andar sab samajh bhi lete hain. Par client, interview ya videsh ki call par yahi lines turant "translated" lagti hain.

Phone ki aam galtiyan

  • Galat: Hello, I am Rahul this side.
  • Sahi: Hi, this is Rahul from Infotech.

  • Kyun: "Is taraf se Rahul" ka anuvaad. Phone par apna naam = "This is…" ya "It's…"

  • Galat: Who is speaking? / Who are you?

  • Sahi: May I ask who's calling?

  • Kyun: Seedha "Who are you?" bahut rookha lagta hai. Office me hamesha naram wala sawaal.

  • Galat: Am I audible?

  • Sahi: Can you hear me OK?

  • Kyun: "Audible" sahi shabd hai, par is sawaal me Indian English hi bolta hai. Duniya bhar me "Can you hear me?"

  • Galat: Your voice is cutting.

  • Sahi: You're breaking up. / The line is bad.

  • Kyun: "Aawaaz kat rahi hai" ka anuvaad. English me aawaaz "break up" hoti hai.

  • Galat: (Phone uthaate hi) Tell me.

  • Sahi: Hi Rahul! How can I help? / Hi, what's up?
  • Kyun: "Haan, bolo" ka anuvaad — English me hukum jaisa lagta hai. Pehle greeting, phir sawaal.

docs.title: 33.9 Practice — Phone aur video call
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Aap reception par ho. Caller ka naam jaanna hai. Sabse polite line kaunsi hai?

  • May I ask who's calling?
  • Who are you?
  • Who is speaking there?
  • Tell your name first.
Jawaab

May I ask who's calling?

'May I ask…' naram sawaal hai. 'Who are you?' phone par rookha aur shak bhara lagta hai.

Exercise 2

Network kharab hai aur saamne wale ki aawaaz toot rahi hai. Kya bologe?

  • Sorry, you're breaking up.
  • Your voice is cutting.
  • Am I audible?
  • What? What?
Jawaab

Sorry, you're breaking up.

English me phone ki aawaaz 'break up' hoti hai. 'Your voice is cutting' Hindi ka seedha anuvaad hai.

Exercise 3

Email address me '_' ko phone par kaise bolte hain?

  • underscore
  • dash
  • slash
  • dot
Jawaab

underscore

_ = underscore, - = hyphen ya dash, / = slash, . = dot. Email galat gaya to poora kaam atak jaata hai.

Exercise 4

Hi, ___ is Arjun from BlueLeaf Design.

Hint: Phone par apna naam batane ka shabd — 'I am' nahi.

Jawaab

this

Phone par 'This is Arjun' ya 'It's Arjun'. Saamne wala aapko dekh nahi raha, isliye 'this'.

Exercise 5

Sorry, could you ___ that, please? The line is bad.

Hint: Dobara bolna.

Jawaab

repeat / say

'Could you repeat that?' — sunai na de to sabse kaam ki line. Andaaza lagane se behtar.

Exercise 6

Video call ki is line me ek shabd Indian English wala hai — us par tap karo.

Hi everyone, am I audible?

Jawaab

Galat shabd: audible.

Sahi roop: Hi everyone, can you hear me?

'Am I audible?' sirf India me bola jaata hai. Duniya bhar me 'Can you hear me?'

Exercise 7

Sahi kram me lagao — kisi khaas insaan se baat karni hai.

Shabd: to / Could / speak / Ms / I / Rao / please

Jawaab

Could I speak to Ms Rao please

Could I + verb… — request ka sabse polite saancha.

Exercise 8

Line ko uske matlab se jodo.

A B You're on mute. wo nahi hain, kuch kehna hai? I'll put you through. aapki video atak gayi Can I take a message? aapka mic band hai You froze. call aage jod raha hoon Jawaab

You're on mute. — aapka mic band hai; I'll put you through. — call aage jod raha hoon; Can I take a message? — wo nahi hain, kuch kehna hai?; You froze. — aapki video atak gayi

Ye chaaron lines itni aam hain ki inhe sunte hi matlab samajh aana chahiye — bina anuvaad ke.

Exercise 9

Saamne wale ki baat sunai nahi di. Ye line bolo.

Jawaab

Bolo: Sorry, could you repeat that

'could you' ko jodkar 'kud-ju' bolo. 'Sorry' se shuru karne se line naram ho jaati hai.

Exercise 10

Meeting me ek colleague bol raha hai par aawaaz nahi aa rahi. Use batao.

Jawaab

Bolo: You're on mute

'You're' = 'yor'. Teen shabd, ek saans — aur saath me muskura do.

Exercise 11

Screen share kiya hai. Ab poochho.

Jawaab

Bolo: Can you see my screen

Haan/na wala sawaal — 'screen' par aawaaz upar.

Aage kya karein

Aaj apne naam, surname aur email ki spelling "for" wale shabdon ke saath zor se teen baar bolo. Agli baar customer care ko call karo to kam se kam ek line yahan se use karo.

docs.title: Chapter 40: Phrasal verbs
docs.text:
Phrasal verbs — do shabd, naya matlab

Phrasal verb matlab verb + ek chhota shabd (up, off, out, after…) jo milkar bilkul naya matlab bana dete hain. Give = dena. Up = upar. Par give up = haar maan lena. Yahi wajah hai ki shabdon ka matlab aata ho phir bhi English samajh nahi aati — aur yahi wajah hai ki phrasal verbs seekhna vocabulary ka sabse zyada faayde wala kaam hai. Native log inhe bade shabdon se zyada bolte hain.

Ek line me

Phrasal verb ko ek shabd ki tarah yaad karo — hisson ko jod kar matlab nikaalne ki koshish mat karo. "Look after" ko dekhna+baad me nahi, seedha "dekhbhaal karna" yaad karo.

docs.title: 40.1 Chhote shabd ka apna mijaaj
docs.text:
Har particle (up, off, out…) ka ek bhaav hota hai jo lagbhag har phrasal verb me jhalakta hai. Ye bhaav samajh lo to naye phrasal verbs ka andaza khud lagne lagega.

Figure 40.1. Aath particles, unka asli bhaav, aur har ek ke teen aam phrasal verbs.

docs.title: 40.2 Separable vs inseparable — asli rule
docs.text:
Yahi hissa sabse zyada galtiyan karwata hai. Sawaal ye hai: object (jiske saath kaam ho raha hai) particle se pehle aayega ya baad me?

Teen kism ke phrasal verbs

A. Separable — object beech me bhi aa sakta hai, baad me bhi: Turn down the offer ✓ · Turn the offer down ✓ B. Inseparable — object hamesha particle ke baad: Look after the baby ✓ · Look the baby after ✗ C. Bina object — kuch lagta hi nahi: Please carry on. · Don't give up.

Pronoun ka pakka niyam — ise mat bhoolo

Separable phrasal verb ke saath jab object it, him, her, them, us, me ho, to wo majboori se beech me aayega. Yahan choice khatam ho jaati hai. ✓ Turn it down. · ✗ Turn down it. ✓ Pick her up at six. · ✗ Pick up her at six. ✓ Put it off till Monday. · ✗ Put off it till Monday. Pronoun chhota aur halka hai — wo peechhe latak nahi sakta, beech me baith jaata hai.

Ek aur aasaan pehchaan: agar phrasal verb ke baad pehle se ek preposition lagta hai (get along with, run out of), wo hamesha inseparable hai.

docs.title: 40.3 Group ke hisaab se — gyarah zaroori phrasal verbs
A. Logon ke saath — rishte aur dekhbhaal
docs.text:
Phrasal verb Matlab Kism look after dekhbhaal karna Inseparable get along (with) nibhna, patri baithna Inseparable bring up paalna-poshna; ya baat chhedna Separable
  • Can you look after my bag for ten minutes? Dus minute mera bag dekh lenge?
  • I get along with almost everyone on the team. Team me lagbhag sabke saath meri patri baithti hai.
  • She brought up the budget issue at the end of the call. Usne call ke aakhir me budget ki baat chhedi.
  • He was brought up by his grandparents in Nagpur. Uski parvarish Nagpur me uske dada-dadi ne ki.

Interview ki line

"I get along well with people from different teams." "I am a good team player" se zyada natural aur zyada sach lagta hai.

docs.title: B. Shuru, jaari, aur khatam
docs.text:
Phrasal verb Matlab Kism give up haar maan lena; chhod dena (aadat) Separable / bina object carry on jaari rakhna Bina object (ya "with") run out of khatam ho jaana (stock) Inseparable
  • Don't give up now — you're two days from finishing. Abhi haar mat maano — khatam hone me do din bache hain.
  • He gave up sugar in January and hasn't looked back. Usne January me cheeni chhod di aur phir palat kar nahi dekha.
  • Sorry to interrupt — please carry on. Beech me bolne ke liye maaf kijiye — aap jaari rakhein.
  • We've run out of milk again. Doodh phir khatam ho gaya.

run out of — do galtiyan

  • Galat: The milk run out.
  • Sahi: We've run out of milk. / The milk has run out.

  • Kyun: Jab aap bolo ki kiski kami hai, to "of" zaroori hai. Bina "of" ke sirf cheez subject ban sakti hai.

  • Galat: I am running out from time.

  • Sahi: I'm running out of time.
  • Kyun: Hamesha "out of" — "out from" kabhi nahi.

docs.title: C. Faisle aur kaam — office ke phrasal verbs
docs.text:
Phrasal verb Matlab Kism put off taalna, aage badhana Separable turn down mana karna (offer, request); aawaz kam karna Separable sort out suljhana, theek karna, chhaantna Separable
  • Let's put the review off until Thursday. Review Thursday tak taal dein.
  • She turned down the offer — the pay was good but the city wasn't. Usne offer thukra diya — tankhwah achhi thi par shehar nahi.
  • Give me an hour and I'll sort it out. Ek ghanta do, main sab theek kar deta hoon.

'I'll sort it out' — sona hai

Office me koi gadbad ho jaaye, to ye teen shabd sabse zyada bharosa jagate hain. Isse aage kuch bolne ki zaroorat nahi.

docs.title: D. Ittefaq aur seekhna
docs.text:
Phrasal verb Matlab Kism come across achaanak mil jaana; ya kaisa lagna Inseparable pick up uthana; lene jaana; seekh lena Separable
  • I came across an old photo of us while clearing my desk. Desk saaf karte waqt humari ek purani photo achaanak mil gayi.
  • He comes across as shy, but he isn't. Wo sharmila lagta hai, par hai nahi.
  • Can you pick the kids up at four? Bachchon ko chaar baje le aaoge?
  • She picked up Tamil just by living there. Wahan reh kar hi usne Tamil seekh li.

'comes across as' — bahut kaam ka

Kisi ke baare me narmi se raay dene ka tareeka: "The email comes across as a bit harsh." Aap ye nahi keh rahe ki wo kharab hai — bas ye ki aisa lag raha hai. Office me ye farq bada hai.

docs.title: 40.4 Ek nazar me — poori list
docs.text: Phrasal verb Matlab Separable? Pronoun ke saath give up haar maanna / chhod dena Haan give it up look after dekhbhaal karna Nahi look after her pick up uthana / lene jaana / seekhna Haan pick it up put off taalna Haan put it off turn down mana karna / aawaz kam karna Haan turn it down come across achaanak milna / aisa lagna Nahi come across it carry on jaari rakhna Object nahi carry on run out of khatam ho jaana Nahi run out of it sort out suljhana Haan sort it out get along (with) nibhna Nahi get along with him bring up paalna / baat chhedna Haan bring it up

docs.title: 40.5 Galtiyan jo sabse zyada hoti hain
docs.text:
Dhyan do

  • Galat: Please turn down it, the music is too loud.
  • Sahi: Please turn it down, the music is too loud.

  • Kyun: Pronoun (it, him, her, them) separable phrasal verb ke beech me majboori se aata hai.

  • Galat: She will look the baby after.

  • Sahi: She will look after the baby.

  • Kyun: Look after inseparable hai — object kabhi beech me nahi aata, chahe wo pronoun ho: look after her.

  • Galat: I gave up from the exam.

  • Sahi: I gave up on the exam.

  • Kyun: Kisi cheez ki ummeed chhodna = give up on. "Give up from" nahi hota.

  • Galat: We are running out from seats.

  • Sahi: We are running out of seats.

  • Kyun: Hamesha "out of". Ye jodi ek hi shabd jaisi yaad karo.

  • Galat: Let's prepone the meeting to Monday.

  • Sahi: Let's move the meeting up to Monday.

  • Kyun: "Prepone" sirf India me samajh aata hai. Aage karna = move up / bring forward. Peechhe karna = put off / push back.

  • Galat: I get along my manager very well.

  • Sahi: I get along with my manager very well.

  • Kyun: Insaan ke saath "with" zaroori hai. Bina "with" ke matlab hota hai "guzaara ho raha hai".

  • Galat: He came across very rude.

  • Sahi: He came across as very rude.
  • Kyun: Jab matlab "aisa lagna" ho, to "as" lagta hai. Bina "as" ke matlab hota hai "takra gaya".

docs.title: 40.6 Ek chhoti baat-cheet — saat phrasal verbs ek saath
docs.text:
Zor se do baar padho

A: We've run out of chairs, and I've still got forty forms to sort out. B: Don't give up — I'll pick some up from the store room. Should we put the briefing off by an hour? A: Good idea. Can you bring that up with Meera? She gets along with the facilities team. B: Done. You carry on with the forms.

docs.title: 40.7 Practice — Phrasal verbs
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Music bahut tez hai. Sahi vaakya kaunsa hai?

  • Please turn it down.
  • Please turn down it.
  • Please turn down.
  • Please it turn down.

Hint: Pronoun kahan jaata hai?

Jawaab

Please turn it down.

Turn down separable hai, aur pronoun (it) majboori se beech me aata hai. 'Turn down it' kabhi sahi nahi hota.

Exercise 2

Kaunsa phrasal verb inseparable hai — object kabhi beech me nahi aata?

  • look after
  • put off
  • sort out
  • bring up
Jawaab

look after

Look after inseparable hai: look after her ✓, look her after ✗. Baaki teeno separable hain.

Exercise 3

'He comes across as shy' ka matlab kya hai?

  • Wo sharmila lagta hai
  • Wo sharmile logon se milta hai
  • Wo sharmila ban gaya
  • Wo sharmila nahi hai
Jawaab

Wo sharmila lagta hai

'Come across as' = aisa lagna, aisa impression dena. Dhyan rakho: 'as' zaroori hai.

Exercise 4

Meeting ko pehle karna hai, baad me nahi. Kya bologe?

  • Let's move the meeting up.
  • Let's prepone the meeting.
  • Let's put the meeting off.
  • Let's turn the meeting down.

Hint: 'Prepone' bahar samajh nahi aata.

Jawaab

Let's move the meeting up.

Aage laana = move up / bring forward. Put off ka ulta matlab hai (taalna), aur turn down matlab mana karna.

Exercise 5

We've run ___ of printer paper again.

Hint: Ye jodi kabhi badalti nahi.

Jawaab

out

Hamesha 'run out of' — 'run out from' ya sirf 'run out' + cheez galat hai.

Exercise 6

I ___ along with everyone on my team.

Hint: Nibhna, patri baithna.

Jawaab

get

Get along with = nibhna. Insaan ke saath 'with' zaroori hai.

Exercise 7

She ___ up the budget problem right at the end of the call.

Hint: Baat chhedna.

Jawaab

brought

Bring up ke do matlab hain: paalna-poshna, aur baat chhedna. Yahan doosra matlab hai.

Exercise 8

Is vaakya me kram galat hai — galat shabd par tap karo.

She will look the baby after this evening.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: after.

Sahi roop: She will look after the baby this evening.

Look after inseparable hai — object particle ke baad hi aayega, beech me kabhi nahi.

Exercise 9

Ek shabd galat hai — use dhoondo.

I finally gave up from trying to fix the printer.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: from.

Sahi roop: I finally gave up on trying to fix the printer.

Ummeed chhodna = give up on. 'Give up from' angrezi me nahi hota.

Exercise 10

Phrasal verb ko uske matlab se jodo.

A B put off suljha dena turn down achaanak mil jaana sort out taal dena come across mana kar dena Jawaab

put off — taal dena; turn down — mana kar dena; sort out — suljha dena; come across — achaanak mil jaana

Chaaron office me roz kaam aate hain. Dhyan rakho: pehle teen separable hain, come across nahi.

Exercise 11

Particle ko uske asli bhaav se jodo.

A B up jaari rakhna off saath-saath chalna on poora ho jaana, khatam along alag hona, hat jaana Jawaab

up — poora ho jaana, khatam; off — alag hona, hat jaana; on — jaari rakhna; along — saath-saath chalna

Particle ka bhaav samajh aa jaaye to naye phrasal verbs ka matlab aadha khud guess ho jaata hai.

Exercise 12

Sahi kram banao — pronoun ka dhyan rakhna.

Shabd: hour / it / an / out / sort / Give / I / and / me / will

Jawaab

Give me an hour and I will sort it out

'Sort it out' — pronoun beech me. 'Sort out it' galat hota hai.

Exercise 13

Vaakya banao.

Shabd: four / you / Can / pick / kids / at / up / the

Jawaab

Can you pick the kids up at four

Separable phrasal verb ke saath noun beech me bhi chalta hai aur baad me bhi: 'pick up the kids' bhi sahi hai.

Exercise 14

Ye line bolo. 'Sort it out' teeno shabd jud kar ek saath bahte hain.

Jawaab

Bolo: Don't worry I will sort it out

Office me gadbad hone par ye sabse bharosemand line hai. Bolte waqt 'sort-it-out' ek lehar ki tarah nikalta hai.

Aage kya karein

Gyarah phrasal verbs ek saath mat rato. Aaj sirf teen chuno — sort out, get along with, put off — aur unhe apni asli zindagi ke vaakyon me daalo (apne kaam, apne log, apne naam). Jo vaakya aapka hai, wahi yaad rehta hai.

docs.title: Chapter 45: Sahi adjective chuno
docs.text:
Sahi adjective chuno — "very" ko chhutti do

Very English ka sabse mehnati aur sabse bekaar shabd hai. Wo kuch nahi batata — bas aawaz oonchi kar deta hai. Very hot sunke pata nahi chalta ki garmi 43 degree hai ya 33. Par sweltering sunte hi pasina mehsoos hota hai. Is chapter ka maqsad ek hi hai: jahan aap very + adjective bolte ho, wahan ek sahi shabd rakhna seekho — aur jaan lo ki wo shabd kahan fit hai aur kahan nahi.

Ek line me

very + adjective ka matlab hai ki sahi shabd abhi nahi mila. Dhoondh lo, aur "very" khud hat jaayega. Ek theek shabd, do dheele shabdon se hamesha bhaari padta hai.

docs.title: very upset → distraught
docs.text:
Distraught ka matlab hai itna dukhi ya ghabraya hua ki insaan sambhal nahi raha — haath kaanp rahe hain, baat poori nahi ho rahi. Ye bahut bhaari shabd hai. Train chhoot gayi to aap annoyed ho, upset ho — distraught nahi. Bachcha kho jaaye, tab distraught.

  • She was distraught when she heard about the accident. Haadse ki khabar sunkar wo bilkul toot gayi thi.

Casual chat me ajeeb

Dost ko WhatsApp par "I'm distraught, the cafe was closed" likhna mazaak lagega. Wahan gutted (casual, nirash), annoyed ya seedha bummed chalega. Bada shabd chhoti baat par lagane se wo baat majaak ban jaati hai.

docs.title: very hot → sweltering
docs.text:
Sweltering us garmi ke liye hai jo chipchipi, dum ghotne wali ho — Mumbai ka May, ya band kamre ki bheed. Dhyan rakho: ye sirf mausam aur jagah ke liye hai. Chai ke liye kabhi nahi — chai scalding ya piping hot hoti hai.

  • It was sweltering on the platform — no fan, no breeze. Platform par dum ghutne wali garmi thi — na pankha, na hawa.

Garmi ke teen alag shabd

sweltering = chipchipi garmi (mausam) · scorching = jhulsa dene wali dhoop · scalding = jalaane wala garam paani ya chai.

docs.title: very rude → boorish
docs.text:
Boorish ka matlab hai ganwaar, badtameez, doosron ka khayal hi nahi — tez bolna, beech me kaatna, line todna. Ye shabd thoda kitaabi hai, aur bolte waqt kam sunai deta hai. Likhai me, review me, ya kisi ki shikayat likhte waqt ye bahut strong hai. Aam baat-cheet me obnoxious ya incredibly rude zyada natural lagta hai.

  • His boorish behaviour at the dinner embarrassed everyone. Dinner par uski ganwaar harkaton ne sabko sharminda kar diya.

docs.title: very big → mammoth
docs.text:
Mammoth (us purane barfani haathi se bana shabd) ka matlab hai bahut bada, sambhalne me mushkil. Ye zyada tar kaam, project, task, effort ke saath aata hai — size se zyada paimane ki baat karta hai.

  • Shifting the whole office in one weekend was a mammoth task. Ek weekend me poora office shift karna ek bahut bada kaam tha.

'Bada' ke chaar roop

mammoth = bada kaam ya paimana · colossal = dekhne me vishaal (building, statue) · vast = door tak faila (maidan, samudra, farq) · hefty = bhaari (bill, fine, kitaab).

docs.title: very hungry → ravenous
docs.text:
Ravenous matlab bhookh se bechain, jo kuch mile kha jaane wali haalat. Achhi baat ye hai ki ye shabd bhaari hone ke baawjood casual me bhi chalta hai — mazaak aur exaggeration ke saath. Starving isi ka zyada aam roop hai.

  • We skipped lunch, so by eight we were ravenous. Humne lunch chhoda tha, to aath baje tak bhookh se haal kharab tha.

docs.title: 45.2 Teevrata ki seedhi — kahan khade ho
docs.text:
Adjectives ek seedhi par chadhte hain. Galti tab hoti hai jab hum sabse upar wala shabd uthakar sabse neeche wali baat par chipka dete hain. Neeche ki tasveer dhyan se dekho — isi se overcorrection rukti hai.

Figure 45.1. Teen seedhiyan: halka, aam, aur sabse tez. Baat chhoti ho to neeche wala shabd chuno — warna English natural nahi, nakli lagti hai.

docs.title: 45.3 Badi swap table
docs.text:
Teesra column phir se sabse zaroori hai. Shabd yaad karna aasaan hai; uski jagah yaad rakhna asli hunar hai.

very + … Ek shabd Kab theek, kab nahi very upset distraught Sirf gehre sadme me. Chhoti nirasha par mazaak lagta hai. very hot (mausam) sweltering Garmi aur jagah ke liye. Khaane ya chai ke liye bilkul nahi. very rude boorish Likhai aur shikayat me strong. Bolne me obnoxious natural. very big (kaam) mammoth Task, project, effort. Kamre ya kitaab ke liye large. very hungry ravenous Casual me bhi chalta hai, mazaak ke saath bhi. very tired exhausted Har jagah safe — office, doctor, dost. very cold freezing Bahut aam aur bilkul natural. Rozmarra ki pehli pasand. very happy thrilled Khushkhabri par. Email me bhi achha: "I'm thrilled to…" very scared terrified Har jagah chalta hai. Petrified isse bhi tez. very surprised astonished Thoda formal. Casual me stunned. very dirty filthy Rozmarra. Kapde, kamra, haath — sab chalta hai. very tasty delicious Har jagah. Mouth-watering dekhne se pehle ke liye. very boring tedious Kaam aur process ke liye. Film ke liye dull. very important crucial Office aur likhai dono me strong aur saaf. very interested keen Interview me sona: "I'm keen to learn." very expensive exorbitant Shikayat ya report me. Casual me pricey. very poor (quality) shoddy Kaam aur saamaan ke liye. Insaan ke liye nahi. very busy (jagah) bustling Bazaar, station, shehar. Insaan ke liye swamped.

docs.title: 45.4 Chaudah aur ek-shabd swaps
docs.text: Ye list do hisson me hai. Pehle wale shabd aap aaj se bol sakte ho. Doosre wale kitaabi ya rare hain — padhte waqt pehchaano, likhai me kabhi-kabhi lagao, par baat-cheet me sambhal kar. Har line par 🔊 dabao.

docs.title: Roz kaam aane wale
docs.text: very + … → ek shabd Example Matlab Kab use karein very wet → drenched We got drenched walking back from the station. Poori tarah bheeg jaana, nichodne laayak. Har jagah, bahut natural. Soaked bhi isi jaisa. very angry → incensed Residents were incensed by the sudden fare hike. Anyaay par bhadka hua gussa. News aur likhai me strong. Bolne me furious zyada aam. very happy → jubilant The jubilant crowd danced outside the stadium. Jeet ya safalta par jhoom uthne wali khushi. Bheed, team, jashn ke liye. Akele shaant khushi ke liye delighted. very scared → terror-stricken The terror-stricken passengers ran for the exits. Dehshat se sun, dar ke maare jaam. Bahut bhaari — haadsa, aag, hamla. Bolne me terrified kaafi hai. very friendly → affable Our new manager is affable and easy to talk to. Milansaar, jisse baat karna aasaan ho. Taareef me — reference letter, review. Thoda formal; dost ke liye really friendly. very empty → desolate After midnight the highway looked desolate. Sunsaan, veeran — khaali aur udaas. Jagah ke liye (sadak, gaon, maidan). Isme udaasi hai — khaali dabba desolate nahi hota. elegant → sophisticated She has a sophisticated taste in music. Nafees, duniya ki samajh rakhne wala; ya (machine) bahut advanced. Har jagah safe. Elegant = sundar saadgi; sophisticated = samajh aur parishkaar. talented → consummate He is a consummate professional — always prepared. Apne kaam me poora maahir, nipun. Noun se pehle hi: a consummate professional / musician. "He is consummate" akela nahi bolte.

docs.title: Kitaabi ya rare — pehchaano, sambhal kar bolo
docs.text:
very + … → ek shabd Example Matlab Kab use karein very tired → enervated The long heatwave left everyone enervated. Andar se taaqat nichod li gayi ho, nidhaal. Literary aur rare. Dhoka mat khao — iska matlab energized nahi, ulta hai. Bolne me drained. very wise → sagacious Her sagacious advice saved the company. Doorandesh, gehri samajh wala.
