Bahut kitaabi — bolne me ajeeb lagega. Wise ya shrewd zyada natural. very rich → opulent They stayed in an opulent palace hotel in Udaipur. Shaahi, daulat aur shaan-o-shaukat se bhara. Cheez aur lifestyle ke liye (hotel, shaadi, interior). Insaan ke liye wealthy ya affluent. very funny → jocular He kept the meeting light with his jocular remarks. Mazaakiya, halke-phulke andaaz wala. Formal/literary — insaan ya lehja ke liye. Joke ya film bahut funny ho to hilarious. very confused → nonplussed I was nonplussed when he suddenly resigned. Itna hairaan-pareshaan ki samajh na aaye kya kahein. Asli matlab: confused, stumped. Par American bolchaal me log ise ulta "unbothered" bhi bolte hain — isliye ghalatfehmi ho sakti hai. Saaf kehna ho to baffled. very noisy → cacophonous The cacophonous traffic made it hard to think. Kaan phodne wala, besura shor. Likhai ka shabd, bolne me rare. Rozmarra me deafening ya really loud.

Teen jaal is list me

enervated ≠ energized — matlab thaka hua, josh se bhara nahi · opulent cheezon ke liye, insaan wealthy / affluent hota hai · jocular insaan ka andaaz hai — chutkula hilarious hota hai. Rare shabd galat matlab me bolna, simple shabd bolne se kahin zyada bura lagta hai.

docs.title: 45.5 Teen rules jo bachate hain
docs.text:
a) 'very' + sabse tez shabd kabhi nahi

Exhausted, freezing, terrified, delicious — ye pehle se sabse upar hain. Inke aage "very" lagana jaise "bilkul poora pura" bolna. ✗ very exhausted · ✓ utterly exhausted ya sirf exhausted. Agar zor dena hi hai to 'absolutely', 'utterly', 'completely' lagao.

b) Insaan aur cheez ke shabd alag hote hain

Jagah bustling hoti hai, insaan swamped. Kaam shoddy hota hai, insaan careless. Shabd uthane se pehle dekho ki wo kis par lagta hai.

c) Ek vaakya me ek hi tez shabd

✗ It was a sweltering, mammoth, tedious day. — teen tez shabd ek saath, aur asar zero. ✓ It was a sweltering day, and the work was tedious.

docs.title: 45.6 Galtiyan jo asal me hoti hain
docs.text:
Dhyan do

  • Galat: The tea was sweltering, I burnt my tongue.
  • Sahi: The tea was scalding, I burnt my tongue.

  • Kyun: Sweltering sirf mausam aur jagah ke liye. Jalaane wale garam liquid ke liye scalding.

  • Galat: I was distraught because the shop was closed.

  • Sahi: I was annoyed because the shop was closed.

  • Kyun: Distraught gehre sadme ke liye hai. Chhoti baat par lagane se aap over-dramatic lagte ho.

  • Galat: He is a very exhausted man today.

  • Sahi: He is exhausted today.

  • Kyun: Exhausted pehle se sabse upar hai — "very" bekaar hai. Zor chahiye to "utterly exhausted".

  • Galat: The market was very swamped on Sunday.

  • Sahi: The market was bustling on Sunday.

  • Kyun: Insaan swamped hota hai (kaam me dabaa hua), jagah bustling hoti hai (bheed se bhari).

  • Galat: My room is mammoth dirty.

  • Sahi: My room is filthy.

  • Kyun: Mammoth adverb nahi hai — wo "very" ki jagah nahi le sakta. Gandagi ka ek shabd: filthy.

  • Galat: She was very keen interested in the role.

  • Sahi: She was keen to take on the role.
  • Kyun: Keen ka matlab khud "bahut interested" hai — dono ek saath nahi aate.

docs.title: 45.7 Ek paragraph, do roop
docs.text:
Pehle — paanch 'very'

It was a very hot day. The road was very dirty, the auto driver was very rude, and by the time I reached the office I was very tired. The meeting was very boring, but the news at the end made me very happy.

Baad me — ek bhi 'very' nahi

It was a sweltering day. The road was filthy, the auto driver was obnoxious, and by the time I reached the office I was exhausted. The meeting was tedious, but the news at the end left me thrilled.

docs.title: 45.8 Practice — Precise adjectives
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Mumbai ka May — chipchipi, dum ghotne wali garmi. Kaunsa shabd?

  • sweltering
  • scalding
  • piping hot
  • warm

Hint: Mausam ke liye khaas shabd.

Jawaab

sweltering

Sweltering = chipchipi, bhaari garmi, sirf mausam aur jagah ke liye. Scalding garam liquid ke liye hai.

Exercise 2

Kaunsa vaakya galat hai?

  • I was distraught because my pen stopped working.
  • She was distraught after the accident.
  • He was distraught when his dog went missing.
  • They were distraught at the news.
Jawaab

I was distraught because my pen stopped working.

Distraught gehre sadme ke liye hai. Pen band hone par bolna over-dramatic — wahan 'annoyed' sahi hai.

Exercise 3

Ek hi weekend me poora office shift karna — kaisa kaam tha?

  • a mammoth task
  • a colossal task
  • a hefty task
  • a vast task
Jawaab

a mammoth task

Mammoth kaam aur paimane ke liye hai. Colossal dekhne me vishaal cheez, hefty bhaari bill ya fine, vast door tak faila maidan.

Exercise 4

'Very exhausted' galat kyun hai?

  • Exhausted pehle se sabse tez shabd hai
  • Exhausted adjective nahi hai
  • Exhausted sirf likhai me chalta hai
  • 'Very' ke baad -ed shabd nahi aate

Hint: Shabd kitna tez pehle se hai?

Jawaab

Exhausted pehle se sabse tez shabd hai

Jo shabd apne aap me 'sabse upar' hai, uske aage 'very' bekaar hai. Zor chahiye to 'utterly' ya 'absolutely' lagao.

Exercise 5

We skipped lunch, so by eight we were ___.

Hint: very hungry ka ek shabd.

Jawaab

ravenous / starving

Ravenous = bhookh se bechain. Ye bhaari shabd hone ke baawjood casual baat me bhi chalta hai.

Exercise 6

The Sunday market was ___ with shoppers.

Hint: Jagah ke liye shabd, insaan ke liye nahi.

Jawaab

bustling

Jagah bustling hoti hai (bheed se bhari), insaan swamped hota hai (kaam me dabaa hua).

Exercise 7

Ek shabd galat jagah par hai — use dhoondo.

Careful, the soup is sweltering hot.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: sweltering.

Sahi roop: Careful, the soup is scalding hot.

Sweltering sirf mausam aur jagah ke liye. Jalaane wale garam khaane ya drink ke liye scalding.

Exercise 8

Ek shabd bekaar hai — us par tap karo.

I am very freezing in this room.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: very.

Sahi roop: I am freezing in this room.

Freezing pehle se sabse tez hai, isliye 'very' ki zaroorat nahi.

Exercise 9

Gun ko uske sabse tez shabd se jodo.

A B very hungry distraught very rude mammoth very upset ravenous very big a task boorish Jawaab

very hungry — ravenous; very rude — boorish; very upset — distraught; very big a task — mammoth

Yaad rakho: ye sab seedhi ke sabse upar wale shabd hain — chhoti baat par inhe mat lagao.

Exercise 10

Shabd ko uske sahi istemaal se jodo.

A B bustling kaam — ghatiya quality swamped daam — behad mehnga shoddy jagah — bheed bhari exorbitant insaan — kaam me dabaa Jawaab

bustling — jagah — bheed bhari; swamped — insaan — kaam me dabaa; shoddy — kaam — ghatiya quality; exorbitant — daam — behad mehnga

Har tez adjective kisi ek kism ki cheez par lagta hai. Galat cheez par lagane se vaakya ajeeb ho jaata hai.

Exercise 11

Bina 'very' ke vaakya banao.

Shabd: tedious / the / was / sweltering / and / meeting / day / a / was / It

Jawaab

It was a sweltering day and the meeting was tedious

Ek vaakya me ek-ek tez shabd, apni jagah par. Teen tez shabd ek saath thoos dene se asar khatam ho jaata hai.

Exercise 12

Baarish me chhaata nahi tha — kapde nichodne laayak geele. Kaunsa shabd?

  • drenched
  • desolate
  • opulent
  • affable
Jawaab

drenched

Drenched = poori tarah bheega hua. Ye roz ka, bilkul natural shabd hai — kisi bhi maahaul me chalega.

Exercise 13

'The heat left us enervated.' Iska matlab kya hai?

  • Garmi ne humari saari taaqat nichod li
  • Garmi ne humein josh se bhar diya
  • Garmi se hum gusse me the
  • Garmi se hum dar gaye

Hint: Shabd 'energy' jaisa dikhta hai, par dhoka hai.

Jawaab

Garmi ne humari saari taaqat nichod li

Enervated = nidhaal, taaqat khatam. Ye 'energized' ka ulta hai — aur kitaabi shabd hai, bolne me 'drained' behtar.

Exercise 14

Ye shabd insaan ke liye nahi, cheez ya lifestyle ke liye hai — use dhoondo.

My uncle is an opulent businessman from Surat.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: opulent.

Sahi roop: My uncle is a wealthy businessman from Surat.

Opulent hotel, shaadi, mahal ke liye. Ameer insaan wealthy ya affluent hota hai.

Exercise 15

When India won the final, the crowd outside was ___.

Hint: very happy — jashn wali khushi, ek shabd.

Jawaab

jubilant / ecstatic / elated / overjoyed

Jubilant = jeet par jhoom uthne wali khushi, khaas kar bheed ya team ke liye.

Exercise 16

very + adjective ko uske ek shabd se jodo.

A B very angry sagacious very friendly cacophonous very wise incensed very noisy affable Jawaab

very angry — incensed; very friendly — affable; very wise — sagacious; very noisy — cacophonous

Incensed aur affable likhai me aaram se chalte hain. Sagacious aur cacophonous rare hain — pehchaano, bolo kam.

Exercise 17

Ye line bolo. 'Ravenous' me zor pehle hisse par — RA-ve-nus.

Jawaab

Bolo: We skipped lunch so by eight we were ravenous

Teen hisse hain par pehla hi zor leta hai. Bolne me ye shabd mushkil nahi, bas aadat chahiye.

Aage kya karein

Ek hafte ka challenge: jab bhi "very" bolne ja rahe ho, ek pal ruk kar socho — iski jagah ek shabd kya hoga? Jawaab na mile to "very" bol do, koi harj nahi. Par wo ek pal ka rukna hi aapki vocabulary badhata hai.

docs.title: Chapter 12: Preposition — rishta jodne wale
docs.text:
Preposition — rishta jodne wale shabd

Preposition wo chhota shabd hai jo batata hai ki ek cheez ka doosri cheez se rishta kya hai — kahan hai, kab hai, kaise hai. Hindi me ye kaam "me, par, se, tak, ke paas" karte hain, aur wahi se sabse badi gadbad shuru hoti hai: Hindi ka ek shabd English me teen alag prepositions ban jaata hai.

Ek line me

A preposition is a word placed before a noun or pronoun to show its relationship with another word in the sentence. Noun se pehle aane wala shabd, jo rishta batata hai.

  • The book is on the table. Kitaab mez par hai.
  • She went to school. Wo school gayi.
  • The cat is under the chair. Billi kursi ke neeche hai.

docs.title: 12.1 Jagah ke prepositions — ek hi tasveer me
docs.text:
Yaad karne ki sabse aasaan trick: inhe shabd ki tarah nahi, tasveer ki tarah yaad karo. Neeche wali picture ek baar dhyan se dekh lo — phir kabhi confusion nahi hoga.

Figure 12.1. Narangi gola = jis cheez ki baat ho rahi hai. Dabba = jiske sandarbh me baat ho rahi hai.

Bade se chhota

Jagah batate waqt kram yaad rakho — in → on → at: in the country → in the city → on the street → at the address. Jitni badi jagah, utna "in"; jitna khaas point, utna "at".

docs.title: 12.2 Samay ke prepositions — at, on, in
docs.text:
Yahi teen shabd time ke liye bhi aate hain, aur rule bilkul wahi hai: khaas se bada.

Preposition Kab Examples at Exact time at 6 o'clock · at noon · at midnight · at night on Din / taarikh on Monday · on 15 August · on my birthday · on Diwali in Mahina, saal, mausam, lamba samay in July · in 2026 · in winter · in the morning

Teeno ek hi vaakya me: The meeting is at 4 pm on Monday in July.

docs.title: Doosre time prepositions
docs.text:
Shabd Matlab Example before se pehle before lunch after ke baad after school during ke dauraan during summer since jab se (shuruaat ka point) since Monday for kitni der tak (duration) for two hours until / till tak until evening

since vs for — ye bahut pakda jaata hai

  • Galat: I am working here since three years.
  • Sahi: I have been working here for three years.
  • Kyun: for = kitni der (duration) → for three years. since = kab se (point) → since 2023.

docs.title: 12.3 Prepositions ke aath prakaar (8 types)
docs.text:
Jagah aur samay ke alawa, prepositions aur bhi rishte batate hain. Har prakaar ek sawaal ka jawaab deta hai:

Type Sawaal Common shabd Example 1. Place (jagah) Kahan? in, on, at, under, near, behind, beside, between The pen is in the box. 2. Time (samay) Kab? at, on, in, before, after, since, for, during I wake up at six. 3. Direction / Movement (disha) Kahan ko? to, into, onto, from, through, across, towards, along She walked into the room. 4. Manner / Instrument (tareeka, auzaar) Kaise? Kisse? by, with, in, on He wrote it with a pen. · We went by bus. 5. Agent (karta) Kisne (passive me)? by The poem was written by Tagore. 6. Purpose (maqsad) Kis liye? for, to He went for vegetables. 7. Possession (kiska) Kiska? Kiske paas? of, with The colour of the sky is blue. · a girl with long hair 8. Source (srot) Kahan se? from, of, out of We get milk from cows.

docs.title: Direction ke aath shabd — kis taraf ja rahe hain
docs.text:
Direction wale prepositions chalne, jaane, aane wale verbs (go, walk, run, jump, come) ke saath aate hain. Dhyan do — yahan cheez ruki nahi, hil rahi hai.

Shabd Matlab Example to manzil tak (ki taraf, pahunchna) She goes to school. into bahar se andar He jumped into the pool. onto neeche se upar, surface par The cat climbed onto the roof. from shuruaat ka point (se) I came from Patna. through andar se hokar, ek sire se doosre sire The train went through a tunnel. across ek kinare se doosre kinare, aar-paar They swam across the river. towards ki taraf (pahunchna zaroori nahi) The dog ran towards me. along lambaai ke saath-saath, kinare-kinare We walked along the beach.
  • The children ran towards the gate. Bachche gate ki taraf bhaage — pahunche ya nahi, pata nahi.
  • There are shops along the road. Sadak ke saath-saath dukaanein hain — poori lambaai me.

to vs towards — ek chhota farq

to = manzil tak pahunchna — He walked to the station. (pahunch gaya) towards = sirf disha — He walked towards the station. (us taraf chal raha tha) British English me "towards", American me aksar "toward" — dono sahi.

across vs through vs along

across = surface ke upar, ek taraf se doosri taraf — across the road through = kisi cheez ke andar se hokar — through the forest along = lambaai ke saath, paar nahi karna — along the river

docs.title: 12.4 Important differences — paanch jodiyan jo hamesha confuse karti hain
docs.text:
in vs into

in = position (pehle se andar) — He is in the room. into = movement (bahar se andar) — He walked into the room.

between vs among

between = do cheezein — The pen is between Ram and Shyam. among = do se zyada — He was sitting among his friends.

beside vs besides

beside = bagal me — Sit beside me. besides = iske alawa — Besides English, I know Hindi.

on vs onto

on = position — The book is on the table. onto = movement — The cat jumped onto the table.

by vs with

by = karne wala (agent) ya zariya (bus, train, email) — The letter was written by Ravi. · I came by train. with = auzaar jo haath me pakda — He cut the cake with a knife. Trick: insaan ya safar ka zariya → by; haath ka auzaar → with. "Written by a pen" galat hai — "written with a pen".

docs.title: 12.5 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Sabse aam preposition galtiyan

  • Galat: Let us discuss about the plan.
  • Sahi: Let us discuss the plan.

  • Kyun: "Discuss" ke baad koi preposition nahi lagta. Isi tarah: enter the room, not "enter into".

  • Galat: He is good in English.

  • Sahi: He is good at English.

  • Kyun: Kisi kaam me mahir hona = good at. Yaad rakho: good at maths, good at cricket.

  • Galat: I will reach at Delhi tomorrow.

  • Sahi: I will reach Delhi tomorrow.

  • Kyun: "Reach" ke baad seedha jagah aati hai. Par "arrive" ke saath lagta hai: arrive in Delhi.

  • Galat: She is married with a doctor.

  • Sahi: She is married to a doctor.

  • Kyun: Shaadi hamesha "married to" hoti hai.

  • Galat: I am afraid from dogs.

  • Sahi: I am afraid of dogs.

  • Kyun: Dar hamesha "afraid of" hota hai.

  • Galat: Please explain me this.

  • Sahi: Please explain this to me.
  • Kyun: "Explain" ke baad pehle cheez, phir "to" + insaan.

docs.title: 12.6 Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeka
docs.text:
Preposition chunne se pehle khud se ek sawaal poochho — jawaab batayega ki kaunse dabbe se shabd uthaana hai.

Figure 12.2. Pehle sawaal, phir shabd: Where? → place, When? → time, Where to? → direction, How / with what? → manner, Why / for what? → purpose.

Sabse common prepositions — inhe pehle pakka karo

of · in · to · for · with · on · at · from · by · about · into · through · over · under · after · before · between · among · during · without · against · around · near · behind · across · along · towards · since · until · like Pehle das (of se about tak) English ke har page par sabse zyada aate hain — inhe sahi bol liya to aadhi ladaai jeet li.

docs.title: 12.7 Practice — Prepositions
docs.text:
Exercise 1

The class starts ___ 9 am.

  • at
  • on
  • in
  • for

Hint: Exact time ke liye kaunsa?

Jawaab

at

Exact time ke saath hamesha 'at' — at 9 am, at noon, at midnight.

Exercise 2

My birthday is ___ December.

  • at
  • on
  • in
  • to
Jawaab

in

Mahine ke saath 'in' — in December, in 2026, in winter.

Exercise 3

The medical store is ___ the bank and the school.

  • between
  • among
  • near
  • beside

Hint: Do cheezein hain.

Jawaab

between

Do cheezon ke beech = between. Do se zyada hote to 'among'.

Exercise 4

Is vaakya me ek galti hai — us shabd par tap karo.

Let us discuss about the budget tomorrow.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: about.

Sahi roop: Let us discuss the budget tomorrow.

'Discuss' ke baad 'about' nahi lagta — seedha cheez aati hai.

Exercise 5

Galat shabd dhoondo.

She is very good in mathematics.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: in.

Sahi roop: She is very good at mathematics.

Kisi vishay me mahir hona = good at.

Exercise 6

I have been waiting ___ two hours.

Hint: Duration hai ya point?

Jawaab

for

Kitni der = for. Agar 'since 3 o'clock' hota to point hota.

Exercise 7

The keys are ___ the table.

Hint: Mez ke upar rakhi hain.

Jawaab

on

Kisi surface par = on.

Exercise 8

The dog ran ___ me, but stopped halfway.

  • towards
  • into
  • onto
  • at

Hint: Disha batani hai, pahunchna nahi.

Jawaab

towards

'towards' sirf disha batata hai — us taraf, pahunchna zaroori nahi. 'to' hota to lagta ki pahunch gaya.

Exercise 9

We took a long walk ___ the beach. (kinare-kinare)

Hint: Lambaai ke saath-saath chalna.

Jawaab

along

Kisi lambi cheez (road, river, beach) ke saath-saath chalna = along. Paar karna hota to 'across'.

Exercise 10

He opened the lock ___ a hairpin.

  • with
  • by
  • from
  • of

Hint: Haath me pakda auzaar.

Jawaab

with

Auzaar (instrument) ke liye 'with' — with a key, with a knife. 'by' karne wale (agent) ya safar ke zariye ke liye hai: by Ravi, by bus.

Exercise 11

'Where to?' sawaal ka jawaab kaunse type ke prepositions dete hain?

  • Direction / Movement
  • Place
  • Time
  • Purpose

Hint: Yaad rakhne wala grid dekho.

Jawaab

Direction / Movement

Where? = place, When? = time, Where to? = direction (to, into, through, across, towards, along), How? = manner, Why? = purpose.

Exercise 12

Preposition ko uske matlab se jodo.

A B into bilkul bagal me among iske alawa beside bahar se andar jaana besides do se zyada ke beech Jawaab

into — bahar se andar jaana; among — do se zyada ke beech; beside — bilkul bagal me; besides — iske alawa

into = movement, among = 2+ ke beech, beside = bagal, besides = iske alawa.

Exercise 13

Sahi kram me vaakya banao.

Shabd: stop / shop / The / is / to / bus / the / next

Jawaab

The shop is next to the bus stop

Subject + verb + preposition phrase — yahi seedha English kram hai.

Exercise 14

Ab ye line bol ke dekho — 'next to' ko jodkar bolna hai.

Jawaab

Bolo: The shop is next to the bus stop

Bolte waqt 'next to' lagbhag ek shabd jaisa sunai deta hai — nekstu.

Aage kya karein

Prepositions ratne se nahi, sunne se aate hain. Aaj se jab bhi English sunein, dhyan dein ki chhote shabd kahan aa rahe hain. Ek hafte me farq dikhega.

docs.title: Chapter 35: Presentation dena
docs.text:
Presentation dena — shuruaat, beech, ant

College ka seminar ho, office ki Monday meeting ho ya client ka pitch — sabke saamne khade hokar English bolna sabse bada darr hai. Par achhe presenter ki English sabse fancy nahi hoti; uska dhaancha sabse saaf hota hai. Sunne wale ko har pal pata hota hai ki hum kahan hain aur kahan ja rahe hain. Is chapter me wahi dhaancha hai — taiyaar lines, ek kahani ka saancha, sawaal-jawaab ka tareeka, aur ghabraahat sambhaalne ke nuskhe.

docs.title: 35.1 Presentation ka dhaancha — open, signpost, body, close
docs.text:
Sunne wala page palat kar peeche nahi ja sakta — jo ek baar nikal gaya, wo gaya. Isliye bolne wali English me dhaancha likhne se bhi zyada zaroori hai. Purana niyam aaj bhi sabse kaam ka hai: batao kya bataoge, batao, phir batao kya bataya.

Figure 35.1. Open aur Close chhote hain, Body lamba. Beech ke chhote pill — signposts — sunne wale ko batate hain ki ek hissa khatam hua aur naya shuru.

Dhaancha

Open → Signpost → Body → Close. Batao kya bataoge, batao, phir batao kya bataya. Body me teen point se zyada nahi, aur har point ke saath ek example. Teen point log yaad rakhte hain; saat point sab bhool jaate hain.

docs.title: 35.2 Shuruaat — pehle tees second
docs.text:
Pehle tees second me sunne wale tay kar lete hain ki phone dekhna hai ya aapko. "Mic check" aur "sorry" me wo waqt barbaad mat karo — seedha ek hook do, phir apna parichay.

  • Good morning, everyone. Thanks for being here. Greeting + shukriya — saaf aur garam shuruaat.
  • Let me start with a quick question. How many of you checked your phone in the last ten minutes? Hook: sawaal. Log haath uthate hain — aur jaag jaate hain.
  • Here's a number that surprised me: we lose three customers every single day. Hook: chaunkaane wala number.
  • I'm Neha, and I lead the design team at Brightline. Parichay — ek line, bas. Poora resume nahi.
  • Today, I'm going to talk about how we can fix that. Aaj ka vishay — "talk about", "talk on the topic of" nahi.
  • I'll take about fifteen minutes, and there'll be time for questions at the end. Kitna samay aur sawaal kab — sunne wale ko sukoon milta hai.

Hook pehle, parichay baad me

Shuruaat sawaal, number ya ek line ki kahani se karo. Kabhi "Sorry, I'm not a good speaker" ya "Am I audible?" se nahi. Maafi maangne se sunne wala aapko kamzor maan leta hai — aapke bolne se pehle hi.

docs.title: 35.3 Signposting — sunne walon ko raasta dikhana
docs.text:
Sunne wale aapki slide nahi, aapki aawaaz follow kar rahe hain. Signpost wo chhote phrase hain jo sadak ke board ki tarah batate hain: ab hum yahan hain, ab yahan mud rahe hain.

Figure 35.2. Sadak = aapki presentation. Board na hon to sunne wala bhatak jaata hai, chahe aapki English kitni bhi achhi ho. Kaam Signpost Suno Naksha dena I've divided this talk into three parts. Pehla point Let's start with the problem. Aage badhna That brings me to my second point. Misaal Let me give you an example. Peeche jodna As I mentioned earlier, cost is the big issue. Zor dena The key point here is this. Sametna So, to sum up, we need three things.

Har mod par ek board

Har naye hisse se pehle ek signpost: "Moving on…", "That brings me to…", "Let me give you an example.", "To sum up…" Signpost ke baad ek pal ruko — sunne wala mud jaata hai, phir aap aage badho.

docs.title: 35.4 Kahani sunana — ek chhota arc
docs.text:
Number aur bullet points log shaam tak bhool jaate hain; kahani hafton yaad rehti hai. Har achhi chhoti kahani ek hi pahaad chadhti hai — shaant shuruaat, mushkil, koshish, mod, nateeja aur seekh.

Figure 35.3. Pahaad ki choti = mod, jahan sab badla. Wahan aawaaz dheemi karo aur ek pal ruko.
  • Last year, our app had about ten thousand users. Situation — sab theek chal raha tha.
  • Then, in March, half of them suddenly stopped using it. Problem — kahani me jaan yahin aati hai.
  • We tried discounts, new features, even a new logo. Nothing worked. Koshish — "Nothing worked" ke baad ruko.
  • Then we called twenty users, and we realised the login was too slow. Turning point — "we realised" = humein samajh aaya.
  • We fixed the login in two weeks, and people started coming back. Result.
  • What I learnt was simple: ask your users before you guess. Lesson — yahi line log ghar le jaate hain.

Kahani ka saancha

Situation → Problem → Koshish → Turning point → Result → Lesson. Ek minute se chhoti, past tense me, aur ant me hamesha ek seekh. Bina lesson ki kahani sirf qissa hai; lesson usse aapki baat ka saboot bana deta hai.

docs.title: 35.5 Ant — jo yaad reh jaaye
docs.text:
Hum aksar ant me sabse kamzor hote hain — thak jaate hain aur "that's all" bol kar bhaag lete hain. Par sunne wale ko aakhri line sabse zyada yaad rehti hai. Use pehle se likh kar rakho.

  • So, to sum up, we covered three things: the problem, the plan, and the cost. Summary — teen point dobara, ek line me.
  • If you remember just one thing from today, remember this: speed matters more than features. Ek takeaway — "remember this" ke baad ruko.
  • So my request is simple: let's run a two-week trial. Agar kuch chahiye — saaf maango.
  • Thank you. I'm happy to take any questions. "That's all from my side" ki jagah — ye line.

Ant ka formula

Summary + ek takeaway + shukriya. "That's all from my side" ki jagah: "Thank you. I'm happy to take questions." Aakhri line pehle se likh lo aur zubaani yaad rakho — ghabraahat me bhi nikal aayegi.

docs.title: 35.6 Sawaal-jawaab — jab pata ho, aur jab na pata ho
docs.text:
Q&A me log sabse zyada darte hain, kyonki wahan script nahi hoti. Par jawaab ka bhi ek saancha hai — aur sabse badi baat: jo pata nahi, use banana nahi hai.

Figure 35.4. Dohraane se do faayde: sabne sawaal sun liya, aur aapko sochne ke teen second mil gaye.
  • That's a really good question. Kabhi-kabhi — har sawaal par bologe to khokhla lagega.
  • If I understand correctly, you're asking about the timeline. Dohraana — "agar main sahi samjha…"
  • I don't have that number with me, but I'll email it to you today. Na pata ho — imaandaari + vaada.
  • Can I come back to that at the end? Beech me sawaal aaye aur abhi jawaab dene se flow toote.
  • Does that answer your question? Jawaab ke baad check — darwaaza band karne ka sharif tareeka.

Pata na ho to banao mat

Akela "I don't know" kamzor lagta hai, banaya hua jawaab usse bhi bura. "I don't have that right now, but I'll get back to you by Friday" — imaandaar bhi, mazboot bhi. Aur vaada kiya hai to Friday tak email zaroor bhejo.

Mini-dialogue — presentation ke baad sawaal

Haalat: aapne naye software ka trial propose kiya. Manager ke do sawaal hain — ek ka jawaab aapko pata hai, ek ka nahi.

  • Manager: How long will the trial take? Trial kitna lamba chalega?
  • Aap: So you're asking about the timeline. It'll take about two weeks. Dohraao + chhota jawaab.
  • Manager: And what will it cost us? Ab mushkil sawaal — aapke paas exact number nahi.
  • Aap: I don't have the exact figure with me, but I'll email it to you this afternoon. Imaandaari + vaada, time ke saath.
  • Manager: That's fine. Thanks, Neha. Banaaye hue number se kahin behtar asar.
  • Aap: Thank you. Does anyone else have a question? Agle sawaal ke liye darwaaza kholo.

docs.title: 35.7 Ghabraahat, aawaaz aur raftaar
docs.text:
Ghabraahat sabko hoti hai — bade-bade speakers ko bhi. Fark sirf itna hai ki taiyaar log use sambhaal lete hain. Aur ghabraahat ka sabse pehla asar hota hai raftaar par: hum tez bolne lagte hain.

Figure 35.5. Dhadkan dheemi hoti hai to aawaaz bhi dheemi aur gehri ho jaati hai. Ek minute ka kaam hai.

Ghabraahat ke liye paanch kaam

1. Pehli teen lines zubaani yaad karo — shuruaat nikal gayi to baaki nikal jaata hai. 2. Kam se kam teen baar khade hokar, zor se practice — mann me padhna practice nahi hai. 3. Jaane se pehle box breathing ke teen round. 4. Audience me do-teen muskuraate chehre dhoondho aur unse baat karo. 5. Shabd atke to "umm" mat bharo — ek pal chup raho. Chuppi aapko jitni lambi lagti hai, utni hoti nahi.

Raftaar aur zor: jitna aapko "dheere" lagta hai, sunne wale ke liye wo bilkul sahi hota hai. Har comma par chhota ruko, full stop par poori saans, aur zaroori shabd par zor. Suno:

  • Last year / we lost / our biggest client. // Today / I'll show you / how we won them back. / = chhota ruko, // = poori saans. Mote shabdon par zor. Statement ke ant me aawaaz neeche.

docs.title: 35.8 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Inme se zyaadatar galtiyan college ke seminar se chali aa rahi hain — sabne suna, sabne dohraya. Ek baar pakad lo, to aapki presentation turant zyada professional lagegi.

Presentation ki aam galtiyan

  • Galat: Myself Neha and today I will be presenting on the topic of sales.
  • Sahi: Hi, I'm Neha. Today I'll talk about our sales.

  • Kyun: "Myself…" se parichay nahi hota, aur "presenting on the topic of" bhaari hai. Chhota aur seedha.

  • Galat: I will explain about the new process.

  • Sahi: I'll explain the new process.

  • Kyun: "Explain" aur "discuss" ke baad "about" nahi lagta. "Talk about" me lagta hai.

  • Galat: Any doubts?

  • Sahi: Any questions?

  • Kyun: Indian English me "doubt" = sawaal. Baaki duniya me "doubt" = shak — "Any doubts?" ka matlab lagta hai "kisi ko mujh par shak hai?"

  • Galat: That's all from my side.

  • Sahi: Thank you. I'm happy to take questions.

  • Kyun: "Meri taraf se itna hi" ka anuvaad — ant ko phika kar deta hai. Ant me summary aur garam shukriya.

  • Galat: As you can see in this slide…

  • Sahi: As you can see on this slide…
  • Kyun: Slide, screen aur page ek surface hain — on the slide, on the screen, on page 5.

docs.title: 35.9 Practice — Presentations
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Presentation ki sabse achhi shuruaat kaunsi hai?

  • Let me start with a quick question.
  • Sorry, I am not a good speaker.
  • Am I audible to all?
  • Myself Neha, I will present.
Jawaab

Let me start with a quick question.

Hook pehle — sawaal, number ya kahani. Maafi ya mic check se shuru karne par pehle tees second barbaad ho jaate hain.

Exercise 2

Pehla point khatam hua, ab doosre par jaana hai. Sahi signpost kaunsa hai?

  • That brings me to my second point.
  • Now second point is coming.
  • Next is the next point.
  • Please see second.
Jawaab

That brings me to my second point.

'That brings me to…' sunne wale ko saaf batata hai ki ek hissa khatam hua aur naya shuru.

Exercise 3

Q&A me aisa sawaal aaya jiska jawaab aapko nahi pata. Sabse achha jawaab?

  • I don't have that figure now, but I'll email it to you today.
  • (Andaaze se koi bhi number bata do)
  • That question is not relevant.
  • (Chup rehkar agli slide par chale jao)
Jawaab

I don't have that figure now, but I'll email it to you today.

Imaandaari + vaada. Banaya hua jawaab pakda gaya to poori presentation par se bharosa uth jaata hai.

Exercise 4

So, to sum ___, we need more time and a bigger team.

Hint: Ant ka signpost — 'sametna'.

Jawaab

up

'To sum up' = saar me kahun to. Ant ka sabse aam signpost.

Exercise 5

Let me give you an ___. Last month, two clients left.

Hint: Misaal.

Jawaab

example

'Let me give you an example' — point ke baad misaal, taaki baat zameen par utre.

Exercise 6

Is line me ek preposition galat hai — us par tap karo.

As you can see in this slide, sales went up.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: in.

Sahi roop: As you can see on this slide, sales went up.

Slide ek surface hai — on the slide, on the screen, on page 5.

Exercise 7

Sahi kram me lagao — audience ko naksha do.

Shabd: have / I / talk / parts / divided / three / into / this

Jawaab

I have divided this talk into three parts

Present perfect (have divided) + 'into three parts' — shuruaat me roadmap dene ki line.

Exercise 8

Kahani ki line ko arc ke hisse se jodo.

A B Last year, we had ten thousand users. Turning point Then half of them suddenly left. Lesson Then we realised the login was slow. Situation What I learnt was simple: ask first. Problem Jawaab

Last year, we had ten thousand users. — Situation; Then half of them suddenly left. — Problem; Then we realised the login was slow. — Turning point; What I learnt was simple: ask first. — Lesson

Situation se shuru, problem se tension, turning point par mod, aur lesson par ant — yahi arc hai.

Exercise 9

Presentation ki pehli line bolo — muskura kar.

Jawaab

Bolo: Good morning, everyone. Thanks for being here

'everyone' ke baad chhota ruko. 'Thanks for' ko jodkar — 'thanks-fer'.

Exercise 10

Ab ek signpost bolo.

Jawaab

Bolo: That brings me to my second point

'second' par zor do — sunne wale ko pata chale ki naya hissa shuru hua.

Exercise 11

Presentation ka ant — 'That's all from my side' ki jagah.

Jawaab

Bolo: Thank you. I'm happy to take questions

'Thank you' ke baad poori saans. Ant me aawaaz neeche aur aankhein audience par.

Aage kya karein

Apne kaam ya padhai par do minute ki presentation banao — ek hook, teen point, ek chhoti kahani, ek ant. Phone par record karo, ek baar suno, aur sirf ek cheez sudhaaro: raftaar.

docs.title: Chapter 8: Pronoun — naam ki jagah
docs.text:
Pronoun — naam ki jagah lene wale shabd

Pronoun wo shabd hai jo noun ki jagah le leta hai, taaki wahi naam baar-baar na bolna pade. Chhote shabd hain — I, me, my, he, him, who, this — par inme hui galti sabse zyada sunai deti hai. "Myself Ravi", "Me and my friend went", "Between you and I" — teeno pronoun ki galtiyan hain, aur teeno is chapter me theek ho jaayengi.

Ek line me

A pronoun is a word used in place of a noun. Jo noun ke badle me aaye — wo pronoun. Jis noun ki jagah leta hai use antecedent kehte hain.

  • Priya lost her keys, so she called me. "she" = Priya. Ek baar naam lene ke baad pronoun — yahi natural English hai.
  • This is mine, and that is yours. Ye mera hai, wo tumhara. Bina kisi noun ke poori baat ho gayi.

docs.title: 8.1 Personal pronouns — poori table ek jagah
docs.text:
Yahi sabse zaroori table hai. Ek baar iska column samajh gaye to I/me, he/him, we/us ki gadbad khatam. Column ka matlab hai — pronoun vaakya me kahan baith raha hai.

Kaun Subject(kaam karne wala) Object(jis par kaam hua) Possessive adj.(noun ke saath) Possessive pron.(akela) Reflexive(khud) Main I me my mine myself Tum / aap you you your yours yourself / yourselves Wo (ladka) he him his his himself Wo (ladki) she her her hers herself Wo (cheez) it it its — itself Hum we us our ours ourselves Wo (bahut log) they them their theirs themselves Figure 8.1. Pronoun ka roop uski jagah se tay hota hai — verb se pehle subject, verb ke baad object.

docs.title: 8.2 I ya me? — ek second ka test
docs.text:
Sabse bada confusion yahan aata hai jab do log ho jaate hain: "Ravi and I" ya "Ravi and me"? Rule yaad karne ki zaroorat nahi — doosre insaan ko hata do aur padh ke dekho.

Hatao-aur-sunlo test

Ravi and __ went to the market. → "Ravi and" hatao → "I went to the market." ✓ ("Me went" galat lagta hai) → isliye Ravi and I. She invited Ravi and __. → hatao → "She invited me." ✓ ("She invited I" galat lagta hai) → isliye Ravi and me. Kaan khud bata deta hai, bas doosra naam beech se hata do.

Teen galtiyan jo roz sunai deti hain

  • Galat: Me and my friend went to the mall.
  • Sahi: My friend and I went to the mall.

  • Kyun: Do baatein: subject hai isliye "I", aur politeness me doosre ka naam pehle aata hai. Test: "Me went" — galat lagta hai.

  • Galat: Between you and I…

  • Sahi: Between you and me…

  • Kyun: "Between" ek preposition hai, aur preposition ke baad hamesha object wali list aati hai — me, him, her, us, them. Log "I" ko zyada shuddh samajh kar galti karte hain.

  • Galat: He is taller than me. (bolchaal me chalta hai)

  • Sahi: He is taller than I am. (likhne me behtar)
  • Kyun: Poora vaakya hai "than I am tall" — isliye formal English me "than I". Bolchaal me "than me" aam hai, par exam ya email me "than I am" likho.

docs.title: 8.3 Possessive — my, mine aur ka farq
docs.text:
Do list hain: ek jo noun ke saath aati hai, aur ek jo akeli khadi hoti hai.

Noun ke saath Example Akela Example my This is my pen. mine This pen is mine. your your seat yours The seat is yours. his his bike his The bike is his. her her bag hers The bag is hers. our our house ours The house is ours. their their car theirs The car is theirs.

Inme apostrophe kabhi nahi lagta

its, hers, ours, yours, theirs — in paanch me apostrophe lagana hamesha galat hai. Kyunki ye khud possessive hain, inhe apostrophe ki madad ki zaroorat nahi. ✗ her's, ✗ our's, ✗ their's, ✗ it's (possessive ke liye)

docs.title: 8.4 Reflexive pronouns — jab kaam khud par palat aaye
docs.text:
-self / -selves wale pronouns tab aate hain jab kaam karne wala aur jis par kaam hua — wahi ek insaan ho.

  • She hurt herself while cooking. Chot usi ko lagi jo kaam kar rahi thi — isliye herself.
  • I made this cake myself. Yahan "myself" zor dene ke liye hai — kisi aur ne nahi, maine khud. Is kaam ko emphatic kehte hain (neeche dekho).
  • The children behaved themselves at the wedding. Bahut log hain, isliye -selves.

docs.title: Emphatic pronouns — wahi shabd, alag kaam
docs.text:
myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves — yahi shabd jab sirf zor dene ke liye aayein, to unhe emphatic pronoun kehte hain. Ye aksar noun/pronoun ke turant baad, ya vaakya ke aakhir me aate hain. Hindi ka "khud", "swayam", "apne aap".

  • I myself saw the accident. Maine khud dekha — kisi se suna nahi.
  • She herself cooked the whole dinner. Usne swayam banaya — kisi cook ne nahi.
  • The Principal himself gave us the prizes. Principal ne khud diye — baat ki ahmiyat badh gayi.
Reflexive Emphatic Kaam kaam karne wale par hi palat kar aata hai (object) sirf zor deta hai — "khud, kisi aur ne nahi" Hata do to? vaakya adhoora / galat ho jaata hai vaakya poora rehta hai, sirf zor chala jaata hai Jagah verb ya preposition ke baad subject ke turant baad, ya aakhir me Example She hurt herself. She herself called me.

Hatao-test — reflexive ya emphatic?

He cut himself. → "He cut." adhoora hai → reflexive. He himself cut the cake. → "He cut the cake." poora hai → emphatic. Dono me emphatic bhi subject ki jagah akela nahi aata — "Himself cut the cake" galat hai. Pehle subject, phir zor.

'Myself Ravi' — Indian English ki sabse pehchaani galti

  • Galat: Myself Ravi Kumar, from Lucknow.
  • Sahi: I am Ravi Kumar, from Lucknow.

  • Kyun: Reflexive pronoun kabhi subject nahi ban sakta — uske aage hone ke liye pehle ek normal subject (I) chahiye. Hindi ka "main Ravi" seedha utaarne se "myself" aa jaata hai. Interview me ye pehle teen second me pakad liya jaata hai.

  • Galat: My friend and myself attended the class.

  • Sahi: My friend and I attended the class.

  • Kyun: Yahan subject chahiye — I. "Myself" tab aata jab maine khud par kuch kiya hota.

  • Galat: Please send the file to myself.

  • Sahi: Please send the file to me.
  • Kyun: Preposition ke baad object pronoun aata hai — to me. Office email me "to myself" formal lagta hai par galat hai.

docs.title: 8.5 Demonstrative pronouns — this, that, these, those
docs.text:
Ye chaar shabd ungli uthane ka kaam karte hain — ye wala, wo wala.

Paas (near) Door (far) Ek this that Bahut these those
  • This is my seat, and those are theirs. Ye meri seat hai, aur wo unki.

Pronoun ya adjective?

Agar iske baad noun aa raha hai to ye adjective hai — this book. Agar akela khada hai to pronoun — This is good. Kaam se pehchaan, shabd se nahi.

docs.title: 8.6 Relative pronouns — who, whom, which, that, whose
docs.text:
Ye do vaakyon ko jod kar ek bana dete hain, aur beech me ek chhoti si jaankari ghusa dete hain. Inke bina English bahut katee-katee lagti hai.

Shabd Kiske liye Example who insaan — subject The man who called is my uncle. whom insaan — object (formal) The man whom I met is a doctor. whose kiska (possession) The boy whose bag was lost is crying. which cheez / jaanwar The phone which I bought is heavy. that dono — zaroori jaankari me The book that you lent me is great.

who ya whom — ek choti trick

Jawaab me he aata hai to who, aur him aata hai to whom. Dono me "m" hai — yahi jodi yaad rakho. __ called? → He called. → Who called? You met __? → I met him. → Whom did you meet?

docs.title: 8.7 Baaki prakaar — ek-ek line me
docs.text:
Prakaar Shabd Example Interrogative (sawaal) who, whom, whose, which, what What is your name? Indefinite (anishchit) someone, anyone, everyone, nobody, something, all, few, many Someone is knocking. Reciprocal (ek doosre ko) each other, one another They love each other. Emphatic (zor) myself, herself, themselves… (subject ke baad) I myself checked it. Distributive (alag-alag) each, either, neither Each of the boys has a bat.

Indefinite pronouns aur verb

everyone, everybody, someone, nobody, each, either, neither — ye sab dikhne me "bahut" lagte hain par grammar me singular hain. ✓ Everyone is ready. ✗ Everyone are ready. ✓ Neither of them knows the answer.

docs.title: 8.8 Pronoun kiska hai — ye saaf hona chahiye
docs.text:
Pronoun ka kaam tabhi poora hota hai jab sunne wale ko pata ho ki wo kiski jagah le raha hai. Agar do log ho to pronoun confuse kar deta hai:

✗

Ravi told Mohan that he had failed. (kaun fail hua — Ravi ya Mohan?)

✓

Ravi told Mohan, "You have failed." (ya) Ravi admitted to Mohan that he himself had failed.

docs.title: 8.9 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Pronoun ki aam Indian-English galtiyan

  • Galat: Myself Ravi, and myself working in an IT company.
  • Sahi: I am Ravi, and I work in an IT company.

  • Kyun: Reflexive pronoun subject nahi ban sakta, aur verb bhi chhoot gaya tha. Intro ka safe formula: "My name is ___ . I am from ___ . I work as ___ ."

  • Galat: She is my cousin sister, and she don't speak Hindi.

  • Sahi: She is my cousin, and she doesn't speak Hindi.

  • Kyun: "Cousin" apne aap me poora shabd hai. Aur "she" third person singular hai, isliye helping verb "does" — she doesn't.

  • Galat: I am having a car, and it's colour is red.

  • Sahi: I have a car, and its colour is red.

  • Kyun: Do galtiyan: "have" ko continuous me nahi daalte jab possession ki baat ho, aur possessive "its" me apostrophe nahi lagta. "it's" sirf "it is" ka chhota roop hai.

  • Galat: Me and my brother are going to Goa.

  • Sahi: My brother and I are going to Goa.

  • Kyun: Subject hai to "I" chahiye — "Me am going" galat lagta hai, na? Doosra naam pehle rakhna politeness hai.

  • Galat: Everyone have submitted their forms.

  • Sahi: Everyone has submitted their forms.

  • Kyun: "Everyone" dikhta bahut logon jaisa hai, par grammar me singular hai — isliye "has". Aage "their" aana aaj ki English me bilkul theek hai.

  • Galat: One of my friend gave I a gift.

  • Sahi: One of my friends gave me a gift.

  • Kyun: "One of" ke baad plural noun, aur verb ke baad object pronoun — me, na ki I.

  • Galat: The two brothers help themself.

  • Sahi: The two brothers help each other.
  • Kyun: "themself" shabd hi nahi hai. Aur matlab bhi badal gaya — ek doosre ki madad ke liye "each other" chahiye; "themselves" ka matlab hota apni-apni madad.

Teen pakke rule, bas

1. Verb se pehle → I, he, she, we, they. Verb ya preposition ke baad → me, him, her, us, them. 2. -self wala shabd kabhi subject nahi banta. 3. its, hers, ours, yours, theirs me apostrophe kabhi nahi.

docs.title: 8.10 Practice — Pronouns
docs.text:
Exercise 1

___ and I went to the station together.

  • My sister
  • Me
  • Myself
  • Mine

Hint: Hatao-aur-sunlo test lagao.

Jawaab

My sister

Subject do log hain, aur 'I' pehle se sahi roop me hai. Politeness me doosre ka naam pehle aata hai — 'My sister and I'.

Exercise 2

This is a secret between you and ___.

  • me
  • I
  • myself
  • mine

Hint: 'Between' kaunsa part of speech hai?

Jawaab

me

'Between' preposition hai, aur preposition ke baad hamesha object pronoun aata hai — me, him, her, us, them. 'I' zyada shuddh lagta hai par galat hai.

Exercise 3

Introduction ka sahi tareeka kaunsa hai?

  • I am Ravi from Patna.
  • Myself Ravi from Patna.
  • Myself is Ravi from Patna.
  • Me Ravi from Patna.
Jawaab

I am Ravi from Patna.

Reflexive pronoun 'myself' subject nahi ban sakta, aur vaakya me verb bhi chahiye. 'I am ___' me dono cheezein hain.

Exercise 4

The girl ___ bag was stolen is in my class.

  • whose
  • who
  • whom
  • which

Hint: Kiska bag? — possession.

Jawaab

whose

'Whose' possession batata hai — kiska. 'Who' subject ke liye hai aur 'whom' object ke liye, par yahan bag ka maalik batana hai.

Exercise 5

She cut ___ while chopping onions. (wo khud)

Hint: Kaam karne wala aur jis par kaam hua — wahi insaan.

Jawaab

herself

Chot usi ko lagi jo kaam kar rahi thi, isliye reflexive pronoun chahiye — herself. 'her' hota to koi doosri ladki hoti.

Exercise 6

The dog hurt ___ paw. (possessive)

Hint: Apostrophe lagta hai ya nahi?

Jawaab

its

Possessive 'its' me apostrophe nahi lagta. 'it's' ka matlab 'it is' hai, aur 'the dog hurt it is paw' bemaani hai.

Exercise 7

Is vaakya me galat shabd par tap karo.

Please send the report to myself by evening.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: myself.

Sahi roop: Please send the report to me by evening.

Preposition 'to' ke baad object pronoun aata hai — me. 'Myself' tab aata jab main khud ko kuch bhejta, jo yahan ho hi nahi raha.

Exercise 8

Galat shabd dhoondo.

Everyone have finished their homework.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: have.

Sahi roop: Everyone has finished their homework.

'Everyone' dikhne me bahut log lagta hai par grammar me singular hai, isliye 'has'. Aage 'their' aana aaj ki English me theek hai.

Exercise 9

Ek shabd galat hai.

Me and Rohit watched the match yesterday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: Me.

Sahi roop: Rohit and I watched the match yesterday.

Subject ke liye 'I' chahiye — 'Me watched' galat lagta hai. Rohit ko hata ke padho, kaan khud bata dega.

Exercise 10

Kis vaakya me 'herself' EMPHATIC pronoun hai?

  • She herself solved the puzzle.
  • She hurt herself.
  • She looked at herself in the mirror.
  • She introduced herself.

Hint: Hata ke dekho — vaakya poora rehta hai ya nahi?

Jawaab

She herself solved the puzzle.

'She solved the puzzle' hataane ke baad bhi poora hai — 'herself' sirf zor de raha tha, isliye emphatic. Baaki teeno me kaam usi par palat raha hai — reflexive.

Exercise 11

The Prime Minister ___ opened the new bridge. (khud, zor ke liye)

Hint: Prime Minister — he.

Jawaab

himself

Zor dene ke liye subject ke turant baad emphatic pronoun — himself. Hata do to bhi vaakya poora hai.

Exercise 12

Pronoun ko uske prakaar se jodo.

A B himself relative those indefinite which possessive somebody reflexive theirs demonstrative Jawaab

himself — reflexive; those — demonstrative; which — relative; somebody — indefinite; theirs — possessive

Reflexive me -self/-selves hota hai, demonstrative ungli uthata hai, relative do vaakye jodta hai, indefinite kisi anjaan ki baat karta hai, aur possessive maalikana dikhata hai.

Exercise 13

Sahi kram me vaakya banao — subject aur object pronoun dono hain.

Shabd: notebook / She / me / gave / old / her

Jawaab

She gave me her old notebook

Kram hai: subject pronoun (She) + verb (gave) + jise diya (me) + kya diya (her old notebook). Object pronoun verb ke baad hi aata hai.

Exercise 14

Ye introduction bol ke dekho — 'myself' ki jagah 'I am' ki aadat daalni hai.

Jawaab

Bolo: I am Ravi and I work in Pune

Interview me pehli line hi pehchaan ban jaati hai. 'I am' se shuru karne ki aadat padi to 'Myself Ravi' kabhi muh se nahi niklega.

Aage kya karein

Aaj se ek kaam: jab bhi "myself" bolne ka man kare, ruk kar socho — "yahan I chahiye ya me?" Do din me aadat badal jaayegi. Agla chapter Verb hai — vaakya ka dil.

docs.title: Chapter 26: Uchchaaran theek karo
docs.text:
Accent badalne ki zaroorat nahi hai — Indian accent me koi kharaabi nahi. Jo badalna hai wo hai wo chhah-saat aawazein jo galat jagah se nikal rahi hain, kyunki unki wajah se log kuch shabd samajh nahi paate. Is chapter me har aawaz ke liye saaf nirdesh hai: hoth kahan, zubaan kahan, aawaz hai ya sirf hawa. Padho aur usi waqt karo. Padh kar chhod dena bekaar hai.

Teen kadam ka tareeka — har aawaz ke liye wahi

1. 🔊 dabao aur suno. 2. Nirdesh padho aur muh ko wahi position do — bina aawaz, sirf position. 3. Ab aawaz nikalo, dheere, paanch baar. Tez bolna lakshya nahi hai. Saaf bolna lakshya hai. Tezi apne aap aa jaati hai.

docs.title: 26.1 V aur W — sabse badi ladaai
docs.text:
Hindi me ek hi "व" hai. English me do bilkul alag aawazein hain, aur dono ka muh alag hota hai. Yahi ek cheez theek kar lo to aapki English turant saaf lagne lagegi — kyunki ye aawazein roz sau baar aati hain.

V — kaise banao

Apne upar ke daant neeche ke hoth par rakho — halka sa dabao, jaise hoth ko kaat rahe ho par bilkul halke se. Ab gale se aawaz nikalo: vvvvv. Hawa daant aur hoth ke beech se ragad kar nikalti hai. Hoth gol nahi hote. Gale par ungli rakho — kampan hona chahiye.

W — kaise banao

Daant bilkul nahi lagte. Dono hoth ko gol karo — jaise "oo" bolne ja rahe ho, ya jaise mombatti bujhani ho. Phir usi gol position se aawaz shuru karo aur hoth kholte jao: oo-wet. W ek phisalti hui aawaz hai, ragad wali nahi.

Figure 26.1. Pehchaan ka sabse aasaan tareeka: aaine me dekho. V bolte waqt aapke upar ke daant dikhne chahiye. W bolte waqt bilkul nahi.

docs.title: Minimal pairs — V banaam W
docs.text:
Dono bajao, farq suno, phir khud bolo. Ye hi asli test hai.

V Suno W Suno Matlab vet wet jaanwaron ka doctor / geela vine wine bel / sharaab vest west baniyan / pashchim veil whale ghoonghat / whale machhli verse worse kavita ki pankti / aur bura vary wary badalna / satark
  • We were very worried about the weather. Teen W aur ek V ek hi line me. "very" par daant lagao, baaki teen par gol hoth.
  • The vet gave the dog water. vet aur gave me daant; water me gol hoth. Ek vaakye me dono.

Dhyan — ulti galti bhi hoti hai

Bahut log V theek karne ke chakkar me har jagah daant lagane lag jaate hain — "wery" ki jagah "vater", "vindow", "ve are". Ye pehli galti se zyada ajeeb lagta hai. Niyam seedha hai: jo W likha hai, wo W hi hai. Jo V likha hai, wo V.

docs.title: 26.2 TH — do aawazein, ek position
docs.text:
TH ke liye zubaan ko bahar nikalna padta hai — ye kisi ko ajeeb lagta hai, par yahi sahi hai. Hindi ka "थ" aur "ध" dono daanton ke peeche se nikalte hain; English ka TH daanton ke beech se.

TH — kadam-ba-kadam

1. Zubaan ki patli nok upar ke do saamne ke daanton ke neeche se zara bahar nikalo — bas 2-3 millimetre, zubaan baahar latkani nahi hai. 2. Daant halke se zubaan ko chhuein. 3. Ab hawa bahar phenko: thhh — ye think wali TH hai (sirf hawa). 4. Wahi position rakho, par ab gale se aawaz do: dhhh — ye this wali TH hai (kampan).

Pakka test

Haath apne muh ke saamne rakho. "think" bolo — hawa ka jhonka mehsoos hona chahiye. Agar nahi hua, to aap "tink" ya "sink" bol rahe hain, "think" nahi.

TH (sirf hawa) Suno Jo galti se nikalta hai Suno think sink (basin) three tree (ped) thin tin (dabba) thank tank (tanki) mouth mouse (chooha) path pass TH (kampan wali) Suno Note this, that, these, those Roz sabse zyada aane wale chaar shabd — inhi par sabse pehle kaam karo. the "da" nahi — zubaan daanton ke beech, phir halki "uh". they, them, their "de, dem, der" sabse aam Indian pattern hai. Zubaan bahar nikalo. mother, father, brother, other Beech me aane wali TH sabse zyada chhoot jaati hai.
  • I think this is the third thing. Chaar TH ek line me — do hawa wali (think, third, thing) aur do kampan wali (this, the).
  • My brother and my mother both thanked them. Beech wali TH ki drill. Dheere bolo — har TH par zubaan bahar.

docs.title: 26.3 P aur F — Hindi ka "फ" beech me aata hai
docs.text:
Hindi ka "फ" dono hoth se banta hai. English ka F daant aur hoth se. Isi liye "coffee" kabhi "copy" jaisa, aur "phone" kabhi "pone" jaisa sunai deta hai.

F vs P — position ka farq

P: dono hoth bilkul band, hawa ko rok kar ek dum chhodo — phat se. Hawa ka dhakka hota hai. F: upar ke daant neeche ke hoth par (bilkul V ki tarah), par gale se aawaz nahi — sirf lambi, patli hawa: ffff. Hoth band nahi hote, hawa rukti hi nahi.

P Suno F Suno Matlab pan fan kadhai / pankha pin fin pin / machhli ka par copy coffee nakal / coffee pool fool talaab / bewkoof supper suffer raat ka khaana / takleef sehna
  • Please put the fan near the phone. put me dono hoth, fan aur phone me daant-hoth. Teeno ek line me.

docs.title: 26.4 S aur SH — zubaan kitni peeche
docs.text:
S vs SH

S: zubaan ki nok upar ke daanton ke bilkul peeche, hoth chaudaa (jaise halki muskaan). Patli, teekhi hawa: ssss — jaise saanp. SH: zubaan ko thoda peeche sarkao (talu ki taraf) aur hoth gol karo, aage dhakelo. Mote, bhaari hawa: shhh — jaise chup karaana.

S Suno SH Suno Matlab sea she samudra / wo (ladki) sip ship ghoont / jahaaz save shave bachaana / shave karna sort short chhaantna / chhota seat sheet seat / chaadar

docs.title: 26.5 Z aur J — bhanbhanaahat vs jhatka
docs.text:
/z/ Hindi me nahi hai, isliye hum ya "s" bol dete hain ya "j". Dono galat hain.

Z vs J — ek lagataar, doosra ek dum

Z: /s/ ki bilkul wahi position — zubaan daanton ke peeche — par gale ka kampan jodo. Aawaz lagataar chalti rahegi: zzzzzz, jitni der saans chale. J: zubaan talu se chipka kar hawa roko, phir ek dum chhodo — jhatka hota hai. Aawaz kheench nahi sakte. Test: "zzzz" 5 second tak kheench sakte hain. "j" nahi kheench sakte.

Z Suno J / S Suno Note zoo Jew Z kheenchti hai, J jhatka hai buzz bus bhanbhanaana / bus prize price inaam / keemat — roz kaam aata hai eyes ice aankhein / baraf rise rice uthna / chawal

Chhota par bahut kaam ka niyam

Plural aur third-person ka "s" bahut baar /z/ bolta hai, "s" nahi: dogs = dogz, jobs = jobz, plays = playz, comes = comz, is = iz, was = woz. Agar pehle wali aawaz me gale ka kampan hai, to "s" bhi /z/ ban jaata hai.

docs.title: 26.6 "school" — "iskool" nahi
docs.text:
Hindi me shabd do consonant se shuru nahi hote, isliye hamari zubaan aaraam ke liye aage ek chhoti "i" jod deti hai. Ilaaj seedha hai, aur 5 minute me kaam karta hai:

Teen-kadam ka ilaaj

Kadam 1: Sirf ssssssss bolo, 3 second — koi vowel nahi. Kadam 2: Usi saans ko tode bina aage jodo: sssss-kool. Kadam 3: Dheere-dheere "sss" chhota karte jao: sss-kool → ss-kool → school. Asli trick ye hai ki beech me saans na toote. Saans toota = "i" aa gaya.

Galat Sahi Suno iskool school istation station istudy study ispeak / isport speak / sport istreet street iskin skin filim film pleeze / pilees please
  • I study at a school near the station. Teen "s" jode — study, school, station. Ek bhi "i" nahi.
  • The street is small but the sky is clear. street, small, sky — teeno jude consonant. Saans todna nahi.

docs.title: 26.7 Chup akshar — bolne hi nahi hain
docs.text: Shabd Chup akshar Bolo aise Suno know, knife, knock K no, naif, nok write, wrong W rait, rong thumb, climb, bomb B tham, klaim, bom talk, walk, calm, half L tok, wok, kaam, haaf Wednesday D + beech wali e WENZ-day vegetable beech wali e VEJ-tuh-bul (teen hisse, chaar nahi) comfortable beech wali o KUMF-tuh-bul business beech wali i BIZ-nis receipt P ri-SEET island, aisle S AI-land, ail

docs.title: 26.8 Dus shabd jo Indian speakers sabse zyada galat bolte hain
docs.text:
Ek baar theek kar lo, zindagi bhar ke liye

Shabd Aam galti Sahi Suno determine de-ter-MINE di-TER-min develop DEV-lup di-VEL-up jewellery joo-la-REE JOOL-ri mischievous mis-CHEE-vi-us MIS-chi-vus pronunciation pro-NOUN-ciation pruh-nun-si-AY-shun often OFF-ten (T zor se) OF-un (T lagbhag chup) salmon SAL-mon SAM-un (L chup) colonel ko-lo-NEL KER-nul schedule SHED-yool / ske-DYOOL SKEJ-ool (US) / SHED-yool (UK) — dono theek February FEB-u-ary FEB-roo-ri

docs.title: 26.9 Aaj ki drill — ek hafte ka plan
docs.text: Din Kis par kaam Drill line Som V / W We were very worried about the weather. Mangal TH I think this is the third thing. Budh P / F Please put the fan near the phone. Guru S / SH She sells sheets by the sea. Shukra Z The prize is zero rupees. Shani s- jod I study at a school near the station. Ravi Sab mila kar Three of those women work in a very small school.

docs.title: 26.10 Practice — Uchchaaran
docs.text:
Exercise 1

W bolte waqt daant kahan hote hain?

  • Kahin nahi lagte — hoth gol hote hain
  • Upar ke daant neeche ke hoth par
  • Zubaan daanton ke beech
  • Dono hoth band

Hint: Aaine me kya dikhega?

Jawaab

Kahin nahi lagte — hoth gol hote hain

W me daant kaam me nahi aate. Daant lagte hi wo V ban jaata hai.

Exercise 2

'think' bolte waqt haath muh ke saamne rakhein to kya mehsoos hona chahiye?

  • Hawa ka jhonka
  • Kuch nahi
  • Gale ka kampan sirf
  • Hoth ka dhakka
Jawaab

Hawa ka jhonka

/θ/ me hawa daanton aur zubaan ke beech se bahar nikalti hai. Hawa nahi aayi = 'tink' ya 'sink' bola gaya.

Exercise 3

English ka F aur Hindi ka 'फ' me kya farq hai?

  • F me daant hoth par lagte hain; 'फ' me dono hoth lagte hain
  • Koi farq nahi
  • F me zubaan daanton ke beech aati hai
  • F me gale ka kampan hota hai
Jawaab

F me daant hoth par lagte hain; 'फ' me dono hoth lagte hain

Isi liye 'coffee' kabhi 'copy' jaisa sunai deta hai. F ki position V jaisi hai, bas aawaz nahi — sirf hawa.

Exercise 4

Z aur J me pehchaan ka sabse aasaan test kya hai?

  • Z ko 5 second kheench sakte hain, J ko nahi
  • J me gale ka kampan hota hai, Z me nahi
  • Z me hoth gol hote hain
  • J me zubaan daanton ke beech aati hai

Hint: Ek aawaz kheench sakte hain, doosri nahi.

Jawaab

Z ko 5 second kheench sakte hain, J ko nahi

Z lagataar bhanbhanaahat hai; J ek jhatka hai jisme hawa pehle rukti hai.

Exercise 5

'dogs' ka aakhri 's' asal me kaunsi aawaz hai?

  • /z/ — dogz
  • /s/ — dogs
  • Chup rehta hai
  • /sh/
Jawaab

/z/ — dogz

Pehle wali aawaz (g) me gale ka kampan hai, isliye 's' bhi /z/ ban jaata hai: jobz, playz, comz.

Exercise 6

'iskool' ki aadat chhodne ka sahi tareeka?

  • 'sss' kheencho, phir bina saans tode 'kool' jodo
  • 'school' ko tez bolo
  • Pehle 'i' bolo phir chhod do
  • 'k' ko chup rakho
Jawaab

'sss' kheencho, phir bina saans tode 'kool' jodo

Saans toote hi vowel ghus jaati hai. Ek hi saans me jod kar bolo: sss-kool, phir chhota karte jao.

Exercise 7

Is vaakya me ek shabd galat uchchaaran se likha gaya hai — us par tap karo.

My brother studies in a iskool near my house.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: iskool.

Sahi roop: My brother studies in a school near my house.

school — seedha 's' se. Aage jodi gayi 'i' Hindi ki aadat hai.

Exercise 8

Galat likha hua shabd dhoondo.

We are going to see a filim tonight.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: filim.

Sahi roop: We are going to see a film tonight.

film — 'l' aur 'm' ek saath, beech me koi 'i' nahi. Dheere bolo: fi-lm.

Exercise 9

Minimal pair ke matlab jodo.

A B vet teen wet ped three jaanwaron ka doctor tree geela Jawaab

vet — jaanwaron ka doctor; wet — geela; three — teen; tree — ped

Ek aawaz ka farq, poora matlab badal gaya. Isi liye in jodiyon par kaam karna zaroori hai.

Exercise 10

Shabd ko uski chup akshar wali sahi aawaz se jodo.

A B know wok thumb ri-seet walk no receipt tham Jawaab

know — no; thumb — tham; walk — wok; receipt — ri-seet

K, B, L aur P — chaaron chup. Jo likha hai wo bolna zaroori nahi.

Exercise 11

V aur W ek saath. Aaine me dekho — kahan daant dikhne chahiye?

Jawaab

Bolo: We were very worried about the weather

'very' par upar ke daant neeche ke hoth par. 'we, were, worried, weather' me hoth gol, daant nahi.

Exercise 12

TH ki drill. Zubaan daanton ke beech se bahar.

Jawaab

Bolo: I think this is the third thing

think, third, thing = sirf hawa. this, the = gale ka kampan. Position dono me ek hi.

Exercise 13

V aur F — dono me daant hoth par, par ek me aawaz hai.

Jawaab

Bolo: Very few of my friends have a van

very, have, van me kampan (V). few, friends me sirf hawa (F).

Exercise 14

S aur SH ka farq. Zubaan ko peeche sarkao aur hoth gol karo SH ke liye.

Jawaab

Bolo: She sells sheets by the sea

She, sheets me SH (gol hoth). sells, sea me S (chaudaa hoth, patli hawa).

Exercise 15

/z/ ki drill. Gale par ungli rakh kar bolo.

Jawaab

Bolo: The prize is zero rupees

prize, is, zero, rupees — chaaron me /z/. 'price' bol diya to matlab badal gaya.

Exercise 16

Jude consonant — 'i' bilkul nahi lagana.

Jawaab

Bolo: I study at a school near the station

study, school, station — teeno seedha 's' se. Ek hi saans me jodo.

Exercise 17

Aakhri imtihaan — saari aawazein ek saath.

Jawaab

Bolo: Three of those women work in a very small school

Three (hawa TH), those (kampan TH), women (W), very (V), small aur school (s- jod). Dheere bolo, poora bolo.

Aage kya karein

Ek baat yaad rakho: aawazein theek ho jaayein, phir bhi agar aap har shabd barabar zor se bolenge to English robotic lagegi. Agla chapter — Rhythm aur stress — wahi hissa hai jo sach me "fluent" wali feeling deta hai.

docs.title: Chapter 47: Viraam chinh
docs.text:
Viraam chinh — chhote nishaan, bada farq

Bolte waqt hum saans lete hain, ruk jaate hain, aawaz uthaate hain — isse sunne wale ko matlab saaf ho jaata hai. Likhi hui English me ye kaam viraam chinh karte hain. Ye sirf "sundar likhne" ki baat nahi hai: ek comma idhar-udhar hone se matlab badal jaata hai, aur ek apostrophe galat jagah lagne se padhne wale ko turant pata chal jaata hai. Achhi khabar — gine-chune rule hain, aur wo sab is chapter me hain.

Ek line me

Punctuation marks tell the reader where to pause, where to stop, and how to read. Viraam chinh padhne wale ke liye traffic ke nishaan hain — kahan dheema karna hai, kahan rukna hai, aur kahan sawaal hai.

docs.title: 47.1 Rukne ki lambai — ek sadak ki tarah dekho
docs.text:
Sabse pehle ye samajh lo ki kaunsa nishaan kitni der rukwaata hai. Yahi ek tasveer aadhi confusion khatam kar deti hai.

Figure 47.1. Chaar nishaan, chaar lambai ke breaks. Narangi = halka ruknaa, laal = poora ruknaa.

docs.title: 47.2 Full stop — sabse zaroori aur sabse andekha
docs.text:
Hindi me hum "।" lagate hain; English me ek chhota bindu. Lamba WhatsApp message bina full stop ke ek hi saans jaisa lagta hai aur padhne wala thak jaata hai.

  • I called him twice. He did not pick up. I will try again tomorrow. Teen chhote vaakya — padhne me saaf. Ek lamba vaakya banane se baat uljh jaati hai.

Full stop short form me bhi aata hai — Dr. Sharma, Mr. Khan, a.m., p.m., etc. — par aaj ki English me UK, USA, NGO, IIT jaise naam bina bindu likhe jaate hain.

docs.title: 47.3 Comma — saat asli kaam
docs.text:
Kaam Example List banane me I bought rice, dal, oil and sugar. Shuruaati phrase ke baad After the meeting, we went for tea. Do poore vaakye ko and/but/so se jodte waqt I called him, but he did not answer. Beech me aayi gair-zaroori jaankari My uncle, who lives in Surat, is a tailor. Kisi ko pukaarte waqt Ravi, please close the window. Haan / nahi ke baad Yes, I understand. Taarikh aur pate me She was born on 14 March, 1998, in Kanpur.

Comma matlab badal deta hai

My brother, who lives in Pune, is a doctor. Mera ek hi bhai hai — wo Pune me rehta hai (extra jaankari). My brother who lives in Pune is a doctor. Mere kai bhai hain — jo Pune me rehta hai, wo doctor hai (zaroori jaankari).

Comma splice — do vaakya comma se nahi jude

  • Galat: It was raining, we stayed at home.
  • Sahi: It was raining, so we stayed at home.
  • Kyun: Do poore vaakye ko jodne ke liye comma kaafi nahi. Ya full stop lagao, ya comma ke saath and / but / so / because jaisa jodne wala shabd lao, ya semicolon use karo.

docs.title: 47.4 Semicolon aur colon — kam use, par kaam ke
docs.text: Nishaan Kaam Example ; Do poore vaakye jo matlab se jude hain The road was blocked; we had to take a longer route. : Aage list aa rahi hai Bring three things: a pen, a notebook and your ID card. : Aage wajah ya khulaasa aa raha hai There was one problem: nobody had the keys.

docs.title: 47.5 Apostrophe — do kaam, teen galtiyan
docs.text:
Apostrophe ( ' ) sirf do kaam karta hai: kiska batata hai, ya chhoota hua akshar dikhata hai. Teesra kaam — plural banana — wo kabhi nahi karta.

Figure 47.2. Hara = sahi jagah. Laal = wo galti jo dukaan ke board se lekar office ke email tak sab jagah dikhti hai.

docs.title: its vs it's — sabse mehanga confusion
docs.text:
Roop Matlab Example it's it is / it has It's raining. · It's been a long day. its uska (possessive) The dog hurt its leg.

Pakka test

Jahan "it's" likha hai, wahan "it is" bolkar padho. Agar vaakya banta hai to apostrophe sahi hai; nahi banta to "its" chahiye. Yahi test your's/yours, their's/theirs ke saath bhi chalta hai — possessive pronouns me apostrophe kabhi nahi lagta: yours, hers, ours, theirs, its.

docs.title: 47.6 Capital letters — aath pakke mauke
docs.text:
Mauka Example Vaakya ka pehla akshar The bus was late. "I" hamesha bada Ravi and I went together. Logon ke naam Anita Sharma Jagah, desh, nadi, shehar Mumbai, India, the Ganga Din, mahina, tyohaar Monday, August, Diwali Bhasha aur desh wale shabd Hindi, English, Indian Sanstha aur kitaab-film ke naam Delhi University, The Guide Padvi jab naam ke saath ho Dr. Verma, Prime Minister Nehru

Jahan capital NAHI lagta

Mausam (summer, winter), vishay (science, history — jab subject ka official naam na ho), dishaayein (north, south), aur aam naam (school, bank, doctor — jab kisi khaas ka naam na ho). I go to school in the summer. ✓ I go to School in the Summer. ✗

docs.title: 47.7 Quotation marks — kisi ke shabd jaise ke taise
docs.text:
Jab kisi ki baat jaise ki waise likhni ho, to quotation marks lagte hain. Do baatein yaad rakho: baat ka pehla akshar bada hota hai, aur andar ka viraam chinh quotes ke andar rehta hai.

  • She said, "I will call you tomorrow." "said" ke baad comma, baat ka pehla akshar bada, full stop quotes ke andar.
  • "Where are you going?" he asked. Sawaal pehle aaya to question mark quotes ke andar, aur "he" chhota.

docs.title: 47.8 Question aur exclamation mark
docs.text:
Nishaan Kab Example ? Seedha sawaal Have you eaten? . Reported ya shisht sawaal jo asal me request hai He asked where I lived. · Could you pass the salt. ! Tez bhaav — khushi, hairaani, chetawni What a match! · Watch out!

Ek hi kaafi hai

Thank you so much!!! → Thank you so much! Teen exclamation lagane se baat teen guna zyada nahi hoti — bas kachchi lagti hai. Professional email me exclamation ek-do se zyada nahi.

docs.title: 47.9 Hyphen aur dash
docs.text: Nishaan Kaam Example - hyphen Do shabd jodkar ek adjective banana a well-known singer · a five-year plan - hyphen Ginti ke shabd twenty-one, sixty-five — dash Achaanak jodi gayi baat He agreed — after an hour of arguing.

docs.title: 47.10 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Punctuation ki top galtiyan

  • Galat: Fresh Mango's available here.
  • Sahi: Fresh mangoes available here.

  • Kyun: Plural banane me apostrophe kabhi nahi lagta. Ye galti dukaan ke board par sabse zyada dikhti hai.

  • Galat: The company has lost it's way.

  • Sahi: The company has lost its way.

  • Kyun: "it is lost its way" nahi banta — isliye apostrophe nahi. Possessive "its" chahiye.

  • Galat: Please send the file , I need it today.

  • Sahi: Please send the file. I need it today.

  • Kyun: Do alag vaakya hain. Comma se nahi judenge — full stop lagao (ya "as" / "because" jodo).

  • Galat: Respected Sir ,

  • Sahi: Dear Sir,

  • Kyun: Viraam chinh se pehle space nahi, baad me space. Aur aaj ke English email me "Dear Sir" chalta hai — "Respected Sir" purani sarkaari bhasha hai.

  • Galat: she lives in mumbai and speaks marathi.

  • Sahi: She lives in Mumbai and speaks Marathi.

  • Kyun: Vaakya ka pehla akshar, shehar ka naam aur bhasha ka naam — teeno capital.

  • Galat: My brothers bike is new. (ek bhai ki baat)

  • Sahi: My brother's bike is new.

  • Kyun: "Kiska" batane ke liye apostrophe zaroori hai. Bina apostrophe matlab "mere kai bhai" ho jaata hai.

  • Galat: He said that "he was busy".

  • Sahi: He said that he was busy.
  • Kyun: "that" wale reported vaakya me quotes nahi lagte. Quotes sirf jab shabd jaise ke taise likhe jaayein.

Teen aadat jo likhai turant sudhaar deti hain

1. Ek vaakya me ek baat. Lamba ho raha hai to full stop lagao. 2. Apostrophe lagane se pehle poochho — "kiska?" ya "kaunsa akshar chhoota?" Dono nahi, to apostrophe nahi. 3. Nishaan se pehle space nahi, baad me ek space.

docs.title: 47.11 Practice — Viraam chinh
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Kaunsa vaakya sahi hai?

  • The cat licked it's paw.
  • The cat licked its paw.
  • The cat licked its' paw.
  • The cat licked it is paw.

Hint: it's = it is. Test karke dekho.

Jawaab

The cat licked its paw.

Yahan matlab 'uska panja' hai — possessive. 'It is paw' bemaani hai, isliye apostrophe nahi lagta.

Exercise 2

Sahi roop chuno: ladkon ka common room

  • boy's common room
  • boys's common room
  • boys' common room
  • boys common room

Hint: 'boys' pehle se s par khatam hai.

Jawaab

boys' common room

Plural noun jo s par khatam hota hai, usme sirf apostrophe lagta hai — boys'. Ek ladke ka hota to boy's.

Exercise 3

Kaunsa vaakya sahi punctuation ke saath likha hai?

  • It was late, we went home.
  • It was late we went home.
  • It was late, so we went home.
  • It was late; so we went home.

Hint: Dono hisse poore vaakya hain ya nahi?

Jawaab

It was late, so we went home.

Do poore vaakye ko comma akela nahi jod sakta (comma splice). Comma ke saath 'so' jaisa jodne wala shabd chahiye, ya full stop.

Exercise 4

Is me se kis shabd me capital letter NAHI chahiye?

  • monday
  • diwali
  • summer
  • marathi

Hint: Mausam aur dishaayein socho.

Jawaab

summer

Din (Monday), tyohaar (Diwali) aur bhasha (Marathi) capital se likhte hain, par mausam (summer, winter) chhote akshar se.

Exercise 5

Do poore vaakye ko aapas me jodne wale nishaan ka naam ___ hai.

Hint: Comma se bada ruknaa, full stop se chhota.

Jawaab

semicolon

Semicolon ( ; ) do poore vaakye jodta hai jab unka matlab juda hua ho — 'The road was blocked; we took another route.'

Exercise 6

Aage aane wali list ko kholne wale nishaan ka naam ___ hai.

Hint: Do bindu, ek ke upar ek.

Jawaab

colon

Colon ( : ) list ya khulaasa kholta hai — 'Bring three things: a pen, a notebook and your ID.'

Exercise 7

Bhasha, shehar aur din ke naam hamesha ___ letter se shuru hote hain.

Hint: Bada ya chhota akshar?

Jawaab

capital

English, Mumbai, Monday — khaas naam hamesha capital letter se. Par mausam aur dishaayein chhote akshar se.

Exercise 8

Is vaakya me ek shabd galat likha hai — us par tap karo.

We sell fresh mango's and bananas.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: mango's.

Sahi roop: We sell fresh mangoes and bananas.

Plural banane me apostrophe kabhi nahi lagta. 'Mangoes' sahi roop hai.

Exercise 9

Galat shabd dhoondo.

My father works in a bank and he speaks english fluently.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: english.

Sahi roop: My father works in a bank and he speaks English fluently.

Bhasha ka naam hamesha capital letter se — English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil.

Exercise 10

Ek shabd galat hai — pakdo.

The company changed it's name last year.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: it's.

Sahi roop: The company changed its name last year.

Yahan matlab 'uska naam' hai. 'It is name' bemaani hai, isliye apostrophe hatana padega — 'its'.

Exercise 11

Sahi kram me vaakya banao (comma apne aap sahi jagah aa jaayega).

Shabd: meeting / the / After / for / we / out / tea / went

Jawaab

After the meeting we went out for tea

Likhte waqt isme shuruaati phrase ke baad comma lagega — 'After the meeting, we went out for tea.' Shuruaat me aaye phrase ke baad comma lagta hai.

Exercise 12

Nishaan ko uske kaam se jodo.

A B , aage list ya khulaasa ; kiska, ya chhoota akshar : tez bhaav ' chhota ruknaa, list aur phrase ! do jude poore vaakya Jawaab

, — chhota ruknaa, list aur phrase; ; — do jude poore vaakya; : — aage list ya khulaasa; ' — kiska, ya chhoota akshar; ! — tez bhaav

Comma sabse halka break, semicolon do vaakya jodta hai, colon aage ki baat kholta hai, apostrophe possessive ya contraction, exclamation bhaav.

Exercise 13

Ab ye line bol ke dekho — comma wali jagah par halka ruknaa hai.

Jawaab

Bolo: After the meeting we had tea and then we went home

Likhne me yahan do comma aayenge — 'After the meeting, we had tea, and then we went home.' Bolte waqt wahi do jagah halka rukte hain. Punctuation asal me aapki saans ka naksha hai.

Aage kya karein

Sabse badhiya practice: apna likha hua zor se padho. Jahan saans lene ka man kare, wahan comma chahiye. Jahan baat poori ho jaaye, wahan full stop. Aapke kaan aapke vyaakaran se zyada jaante hain — unki sunno.

docs.title: Chapter 18: Sawaal poochhna
docs.text:
Sawaal poochhna — kram badalta hai, shabd nahi

Hindi me sawaal poochhna bahut aasaan hai: "Tum ja rahe ho." aur "Tum ja rahe ho?" — shabd wahi hain, bas sur (tone) badla. English me ye nahi chalta. English me sawaal banate waqt shabdon ka kram badalna padta hai — helping verb subject se aage aa jaata hai. Isiliye "Where you are going?" kaan ko kharaab lagta hai, aur "Where are you going?" bilkul theek.

Ek line me

In an English question, the helping verb comes before the subject. Helping verb (am/is/are/was/were/do/does/did/have/has/will/can…) subject se pehle chala jaata hai. Bas yahi poora rule hai.

docs.title: 18.1 Sawaal ki machine — ek tasveer me
docs.text:
Neeche dekho: ek seedha vaakya hai, aur usse do tarah ke sawaal banaye gaye hain. Dhyaan do ki helping verb kaise chhalaang lagaakar subject ke aage aa jaata hai.

Figure 18.1. Narangi dabba = helping verb. Wo subject ke aage chhalaang lagata hai. Gulabi dotted dabba = WH-word, jo hamesha sabse aage baithta hai.

docs.title: (a) Jab vaakya me pehle se helping verb hai
docs.text:
Bas usko aage le aao. Kuch jodna nahi padta.

Seedha vaakya Sawaal She is ready. Is she ready? They were late. Were they late? He has finished. Has he finished? You can swim. Can you swim? It will rain. Will it rain?

docs.title: (b) Jab koi helping verb nahi hai — do / does / did bulao
docs.text:
Present Simple aur Past Simple me helping verb chhipa hua hota hai. Sawaal banate waqt wo bahar aa jaata hai — aur tab main verb V1 me wapas chala jaata hai.

Seedha vaakya Sawaal Dhyaan do You play cricket. Do you play cricket? I/you/we/they → do She plays cricket. Does she play cricket? -s "does" me chala gaya He went home. Did he go home? past "did" me chala gaya, verb V1

Ek hi jagah tense dikhega

Does she plays? ✗ · Does she play? ✓ Did you went? ✗ · Did you go? ✓ Tense ka kaam do/does/did kar chuka — main verb ab saada rehta hai.

docs.title: (c) "am / is / are" khud hi helping verb hai
docs.text:
• Are you free tomorrow? Kal khaali ho? — "Do you are free" aisa kabhi nahi hota.
  • Is this seat taken? Ye seat li hui hai?

docs.title: 18.3 WH-words — jab "haan/naa" se kaam nahi chalta
docs.text:
WH-word hamesha sabse aage aata hai, aur uske baad wahi kram chalta hai jo yes/no sawaal me tha: WH + helping + subject + verb.

WH-word Kya poochhta hai Example What cheez / kaam What do you want? Who insaan (subject) Who called you? Whom insaan (object) Whom did you call? Whose kiska Whose bag is this? Which diye gaye options me se kaunsa Which shirt do you like? When samay When does the bus leave? Where jagah Where are you going? Why wajah Why did she leave early? How tareeka / haal How did you come? How much kitna (uncountable) How much sugar do we need? How many kitne (countable) How many brothers do you have? How long kitni der / kitna lamba How long have you worked here? How often kitni baar How often do you exercise? How far kitni doori How far is the station?

Subject wala sawaal — yahan do/does/did nahi lagta

Agar WH-word hi subject hai (kisne? kya hua?), to kram badalne ki zaroorat hi nahi — kyunki subject pehle se hi sabse aage hai. Who broke the window? "Who did break the window?" galat hai. Kaanch kisne toda — "Who broke". What happened yesterday?

docs.title: 18.4 Question tags — "hai na?"
docs.text:
Hindi me hum vaakya ke aakhir me "na?", "hai na?", "theek hai?" jod dete hain. English me bhi yahi hota hai, par tag vaakya ka ulta hota hai: positive vaakya ke baad negative tag, negative vaakya ke baad positive tag.

Vaakya Tag Poora roop Positive negative You are tired, aren't you? Negative positive She doesn't smoke, does she? Positive, past negative He came late, didn't he? Positive, perfect negative They have left, haven't they? Positive, modal negative You can drive, can't you?

Tag banane ke teen kadam

1. Helping verb uthao (na ho to do/does/did lao). 2. Ulta kar do — positive → negative, negative → positive. 3. Subject ko pronoun bana do — Ravi → he, my sisters → they, this book → it.

docs.title: Chaar khaas tag jo yaad rakhne padte hain
docs.text:
Vaakya Tag Kyun I am late, … aren't I? "amn't" angrezi me nahi hota Let's go, … shall we? Let's = suggestion Open the door, … will you? Order / request ke saath Nobody came, … did they? nobody / everybody ka pronoun "they" hota hai There is a problem, … isn't there? "there" hi subject ki jagah lega

'isn't it?' sab jagah nahi chalta

  • Galat: You are coming tomorrow, isn't it?
  • Sahi: You are coming tomorrow, aren't you?

  • Kyun: Tag ka helping verb aur pronoun vaakya se uthana padta hai. "isn't it" sirf tab theek hai jab subject hi "it" ho — It is cold, isn't it?

  • Galat: He finished the work, no?

  • Sahi: He finished the work, didn't he?
  • Kyun: Hindi ka "na?" seedha "no?" nahi banta — poora tag banana padta hai.

docs.title: 18.5 Shisht sawaal — kram wapas seedha ho jaata hai
docs.text:
Jab sawaal ke andar sawaal aata hai (polite ya indirect question), to andar wala hissa seedhe vaakya ki tarah likha jaata hai. Ye bahut log galat karte hain.

Seedha sawaal Shisht roop Where is the station? Could you tell me where the station is? What time does it start? Do you know what time it starts? Why did he leave? I wonder why he left. Can I sit here? Would you mind if I sat here?
  • Could you please tell me where the ticket counter is? Dhyaan do — "where is the ticket counter" nahi, "where the ticket counter is".

docs.title: 18.6 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Sawaal ki top galtiyan

  • Galat: Where you are going?
  • Sahi: Where are you going?

  • Kyun: Helping verb "are" subject "you" ke pehle aayega. Hindi ka kram seedha utha lena yahan sabse aam galti hai.

  • Galat: Why you did not come yesterday?

  • Sahi: Why didn't you come yesterday?

  • Kyun: WH + helping + subject + verb. "didn't" pehle, "you" baad me.

  • Galat: What is your good name?

  • Sahi: May I know your name? / What's your name?

  • Kyun: "Good name" Hindi ke "shubh naam" ka seedha anuvaad hai — English me aisa nahi bolte. Shisht lagna ho to "May I know your name?" sabse achha hai.

  • Galat: Does she knows the answer?

  • Sahi: Does she know the answer?

  • Kyun: "does" ne -s le liya, isliye main verb bina -s rahega.

  • Galat: Tell me where is the office.

  • Sahi: Tell me where the office is.

  • Kyun: Indirect question ke andar kram seedha rehta hai — helping verb peeche jaata hai.

  • Galat: He is your brother, isn't it?

  • Sahi: He is your brother, isn't he?

  • Kyun: Pronoun vaakya se uthana hai. Subject "he" hai, isliye tag me bhi "he".

  • Galat: What you do?

  • Sahi: What do you do?
  • Kyun: Kaam-dhandha poochhne ka ye standard sawaal hai, aur isme "do" do baar aata hai — ek helping, ek main verb.

docs.title: 18.7 Chhota naksha
docs.text: Sawaal ki kism Kram Yes / No HELPING + subject + verb + baaki? WH (object wala) WH + HELPING + subject + verb? WH (subject wala) WH + verb + baaki? (do/does/did nahi) Question tag Vaakya + ulta helping + pronoun? Indirect / polite Polite shuruaat + WH + subject + verb

docs.title: 18.8 Practice — Sawaal aur question tags
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Kaunsa sahi hai?

  • Where you are going?
  • Where are you going?
  • Where you going are?
  • Where going you are?

Hint: Helping verb kahan baithta hai?

Jawaab

Where are you going?

Kram hai WH + helping + subject + verb. 'are' ko 'you' se pehle aana hoga.

Exercise 2

___ she live in Delhi?

  • Do
  • Does
  • Did
  • Is

Hint: Present Simple, subject 'she'.

Jawaab

Does

He/she/it ke saath 'Does'. Aur dhyaan rakho — iske baad verb bina -s rahega: 'Does she live', not 'lives'.

Exercise 3

You have finished the project, ___ ?

  • isn't it
  • haven't you
  • have you
  • didn't you

Hint: Vaakya positive hai, to tag kaisa hoga?

Jawaab

haven't you

Positive vaakya → negative tag. Helping verb 'have' hai aur subject 'you' hai, isliye 'haven't you'.
