Shabd Matlab Example try on pehen ke dekhna Can I try this on? fitting room trial room Where's the fitting room? fit size sahi hona It doesn't fit. suit jachna (rang, style) Blue really suits you. receipt bill ki parchi Keep the receipt. exchange badalna Can I exchange it? refund paisa wapas I'd like a refund. out of stock khatam ho gaya It's out of stock. on sale discount par These are on sale.
  • Do you have this in a bigger size? Ye ek size bada milega?
  • Do you have it in any other colour? Koi aur rang hai? (UK: colour, US: color.)
  • The jacket fits well, but the colour doesn't really suit me. Size theek hai, par rang mujh par nahi jach raha.
  • What's your return policy? Wapas karne ke niyam kya hain?
  • The parcel arrived damaged, so I'd like to return it. Parcel toota hua aaya, isliye wapas karna hai. (Online return ki line.)
  • When will I get my refund? Paisa kab wapas aayega?

Mini-dialogue — return counter

Haalat: kal ek shirt li thi, ghar jaake chhoti nikli.

  • Aap: Hi, I bought this shirt yesterday, but it's too tight. Kab liya + kya dikkat hai.
  • Staff: No problem. Would you like to exchange it or get a refund? Badalna hai ya paisa wapas?
  • Aap: I'd like to exchange it for a large, please. exchange X for Y.
  • Staff: Sure. Do you have the receipt? receipt — "p" chup hai: ri-SEET.
  • Aap: Yes, here you go. Cheez dete waqt — "ye lijiye".

✗

This shirt is not fitting me. Give one size big.

✓

This shirt doesn't fit. Could I try a size bigger?

fit

it fits / it doesn't fit

Could I try…?

✗

I want to return back this phone.

✓

I'd like to return this phone.

return

docs.title: 38.5 Safar — booking se platform tak
docs.text:
Train ho ya flight, safar ek seedhi line me chalta hai: book karo, check in karo, board karo, pahuncho. Har kadam ke apne shabd hain — aur dikkat wale shabd bhi: delayed, cancelled, missed.

Figure 38.2. Upar ke shabd = kadam (verb ya noun). Neeche = wo chhota phrase jo us kadam par sunoge ya bologe. Shabd Matlab Example book (verb) ticket karwana I booked a seat. one-way / return ek taraf / aana-jaana a return ticket boarding pass plane me ghusne ki parchi Show your boarding pass. board chadhna Boarding starts at 6:40. delayed der se The flight is delayed. connecting flight aage ki doosri flight I have a connecting flight. layover beech ka rukna a three-hour layover platform platform It leaves from platform 5. waitlisted WL, seat pakki nahi My ticket is waitlisted.
  • Which platform does the Shatabdi leave from? Shatabdi kaunse platform se chhootegi?
  • The train is running forty minutes late. Train chaalis minute late chal rahi hai.
  • My flight was delayed, and I missed my connecting flight. Flight late hui, aage wali flight chhoot gayi.
  • Could I have a window seat, please? Khidki wali seat mil sakti hai? (aisle seat = raaste wali)
  • Is this flight on time? Flight samay par hai?

Mini-dialogue — airport check-in counter

Haalat: Pune se Delhi, phir Delhi se Guwahati.

  • Staff: Good morning. May I see your ID and booking, please? Pehchaan patra aur booking.
  • Aap: Here you are. I have a connecting flight to Guwahati. Aage ki flight hai — pehle hi bata do.
  • Staff: Your bag will be checked through to Guwahati. Boarding is at gate 9. Bag seedha Guwahati pahunchega.
  • Aap: The layover is only fifty minutes. Is that enough? Beech me sirf pachaas minute — kaafi hai?

✗

I will get down at Pune.

✓

I'll get off at Pune.

get off

get on

get in / get out of

✗

My flight got preponed to 6 am.

✓

My flight has been moved earlier / brought forward to 6 am.

Indian English ki aadatein

docs.title: 38.6 Ghar aur marammat — kuch kharab ho gaya
docs.text:
Nal tapak raha hai, light chali gayi, AC thanda nahi kar raha — landlord, plumber ya society office ko batana ho to saancha seedha hai: cheez + kya ho raha hai. The tap is leaking. The fan isn't working.

Dikkat English me Kisko bulao Nal tapak raha The tap is leaking. plumber Naali band The drain is blocked. plumber Bijli chali gayi The power's gone. / There's a power cut. — Fuse ud gaya A fuse has blown. electrician Plug point kharab The socket isn't working. electrician AC thanda nahi The AC isn't cooling. AC technician Deewar me seelan There's damp on the wall. landlord Darwaza atak raha The door is stuck. carpenter
  • The kitchen tap has been leaking since last night. Kal raat se kitchen ka nal tapak raha hai. (US: faucet)
  • The power's gone again. Is it just our building? Phir bijli gayi. Sirf hamari building me?
  • Could you turn on the fan, please? Pankha chala doge? (turn on / switch on — dono sahi)
  • We need to get the geyser fixed before winter. Sardi se pehle geyser theek karwana hai. ("get something fixed" — dekho Asar daar vaakya.)
  • The rent includes maintenance, but not electricity. Kiraye me maintenance shaamil hai, bijli nahi.

Mini-dialogue — landlord ko phone

Haalat: bathroom ka nal tapak raha hai aur ek din ho gaya.

  • Aap: Hi Mr Sharma, it's Neha from flat 302. The bathroom tap is leaking quite badly. Kaun + kya dikkat. "quite badly" = kaafi zyada.
  • Landlord: Oh, sorry about that. I'll send a plumber tomorrow morning. Kal subah plumber bhejunga.
  • Aap: Thanks. Could he come before ten? I leave for work at half past ten. Samay pakka karo — vinamra sawaal ke saath.

✗

Please on the fan and off the light.

✓

Please turn on the fan and turn off the light.

on / off

turn on / switch on

turn off / switch off

✗

Light has gone.

✓

The power's gone. / There's a power cut.

power

electricity

docs.title: 38.7 Chhoti par aam galtiyan — aur aage kya
docs.text:
Kuch shabd vishay ke nahi, par roz ki baat me aate hain — parivaar, kaam se chhutti, ghar se bahar hona. Ye teen sabse zyada sunai dete hain.

✗

He is my cousin brother.

✓

He's my cousin.

cousin

my cousin, Rahul

my male cousin

my brother

✗

The doctor gave me a medicine for three days.

✓

The doctor gave me some medicine / some tablets for three days.

medicine

some medicine

tablets, capsules

✗

I have less balance in my account.

✓

My balance is low. / I don't have enough money in my account.

low / high

not enough

low balance

Apna vishay, apni list

Har vishay ke liye phone me ek note banao: 5 tukde jo aap is hafte bologe. Chemist jaana hai? Pehle 3 lines zor se bolo, phir jaao. Jo shabd use nahi hota, wo do hafte me bhool jaata hai. Jo bola gaya, wo reh jaata hai.

docs.title: 38.8 Practice — Roz ke vishay
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Doctor: What seems to be the problem? You: I've got a sore ___.

  • throat
  • neck
  • voice
  • mouth

Hint: Gala dukh raha hai.

Jawaab

throat

Gale ka dard = a sore throat. Neck = gardan (bahar se).

Exercise 2

I've ___ a fever since last night.

Hint: since + present perfect; have ka teesra roop.

Jawaab

had

Abhi tak chal raha hai aur 'since' hai → I've had a fever since last night.

Exercise 3

Galat shabd par tap karo.

My head is paining since morning.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: paining.

Sahi roop: I've had a headache since morning.

Dard ke liye 'hurt' ya '...ache': My head hurts / I've got a headache.

Exercise 4

Bank ke shabd ko matlab se jodo.

A B withdraw har mahine ki kisht deposit byaaj EMI paisa nikaalna interest paisa jama karna Jawaab

withdraw — paisa nikaalna; deposit — paisa jama karna; EMI — har mahine ki kisht; interest — byaaj

withdraw = nikaalna, deposit = jama, EMI = monthly instalment, interest = byaaj.

Exercise 5

Do you have change ___ a 500-rupee note?

  • for
  • of
  • to
  • in
Jawaab

for

Note todne ke liye 'change for': change for a 500-rupee note.

Exercise 6

Ek shabd galat hai — dhoondo.

Please do the payment by Friday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: do.

Sahi roop: Please make the payment by Friday.

Payment ki jodi 'make' ke saath hai: make a payment.

Exercise 7

This shirt doesn't ___. Do you have it in a bigger size?

Hint: Size sahi hona.

Jawaab

fit

Size ke liye 'fit'; rang ya style jachne ke liye 'suit'.

Exercise 8

Passengers ko intezaar kyun karna hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Attention please. Flight 452 to Kolkata is delayed by forty minutes. The new departure time is seven fifteen pm. Passengers are requested to wait near gate twelve.

  • The flight is delayed
  • The flight is cancelled
  • The gate has changed
  • Boarding has started
Jawaab

The flight is delayed

'is delayed by forty minutes' = chaalis minute late.

Exercise 9

Naya departure time kya hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Attention please. Flight 452 to Kolkata is delayed by forty minutes. The new departure time is seven fifteen pm. Passengers are requested to wait near gate twelve.

  • 7:15 pm
  • 6:35 pm
  • 7:50 pm
  • 6:15 pm
Jawaab

7:15 pm

'seven fifteen pm' = 7:15 pm.

Exercise 10

Train se utarna: 'I'll get ___ at Pune.'

  • off
  • down
  • out
  • away
Jawaab

off

Train, bus, plane: get on / get off. Car, auto: get in / get out of.

Exercise 11

Galti kahan hai?

Please on the fan, it is very hot.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: on.

Sahi roop: Please turn on the fan, it's very hot.

'on' akela verb nahi — turn on / switch on.

Exercise 12

Bijli chali gayi — natural English kaunsa hai?

  • There's a power cut.
  • Light has gone.
  • Current is not there.
  • Electric went off.
Jawaab

There's a power cut.

Poore ghar ki bijli = power: There's a power cut / The power's gone.

Exercise 13

Syrup din me kitni baar lena hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Can you suggest something for a cough? Is it a dry cough? Yes, and my throat is a bit sore. Try this syrup. Two spoons, three times a day. If it doesn't get better in three days, please see a doctor.

  • Three times a day
  • Twice a day
  • Once at night
  • Every three hours
Jawaab

Three times a day

'Two spoons, three times a day' — do chammach, din me teen baar.

Exercise 14

Teen din me theek na ho to kya karna hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Can you suggest something for a cough? Is it a dry cough? Yes, and my throat is a bit sore. Try this syrup. Two spoons, three times a day. If it doesn't get better in three days, please see a doctor.

  • See a doctor
  • Buy a new syrup
  • Take four spoons
  • Come back to the shop
Jawaab

See a doctor

'please see a doctor' — doctor ko dikhao.

Exercise 15

Jo suno, wahi likho.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

The kitchen tap is leaking. Could you send a plumber today?

tap = nal, leaking = tapakna; 'Could you…?' vinamra request.

Exercise 16

Sahi kram me lagao.

Shabd: a / I / to / would / like / it / exchange / large / for

Jawaab

I would like to exchange it for a large

exchange X for Y — 'I would like to' vinamra shuruaat.

Exercise 17

'He is my cousin brother' ka natural roop?

  • He's my cousin.
  • He's my cousin-brother.
  • He's my brother cousin.
  • He's my real cousin brother.
Jawaab

He's my cousin.

English me 'cousin' dono ke liye — brother/sister nahi jodte.

Exercise 18

Ab chemist se bol ke dekho.

Jawaab

Bolo: I've had a sore throat since yesterday

I've had + since — abhi tak chal rahi takleef.

Aage kya padhein

Ab office aur duniya ke shabd: Kaam aur duniya. Aur in shabdon ko poori baat-cheet me use karne ke liye Roz ki baat-cheet par waapas jao.

docs.title: Chapter 39: Kaam aur duniya
docs.text:
Kaam aur duniya — office, technology, environment, khabrein

Meeting me "stakeholder" aur "deliverable" sunte ho, news me "inflation" aur "emissions", aur IELTS essay me inhi shabdon ki zaroorat padti hai. Ye chapter chaar bade vishayon ke shabd deta hai — par akele nahi. Har shabd ke saath uska parivaar (economy, economic, economical) aur uski jodi (meet a deadline, reduce emissions). Yahi do cheezein B1 ko B2–C1 banati hain.

docs.title: 39.1 Ek shabd, poora parivaar, pakki jodi
docs.text:
B2–C1 level par aapse sirf shabd ka matlab nahi poochha jaata — aapko pata hona chahiye ki wo noun hai ya adjective, aur uske saath kaunsa verb lagta hai. Ek shabd seekho to uske chaar-paanch roop saath me seekh lo.

Figure 39.1. Ek jad, chhe roop. Har roop ki apni jodi hai — economic growth, par economical car. (US spelling: economize.)

Teen sawaal har naye shabd par

(1) Iska parivaar kya hai? (2) Iske saath kaunsa verb ya adjective lagta hai? (3) Ek apna vaakya kya banega? Prefix-suffix ke liye Ek shabd se das shabd, jodiyon ke liye Kaunsa shabd kiske saath.

docs.title: 39.2 Office aur meetings
docs.text:
Meeting se pehle agenda, beech me discussion, baad me minutes aur action items, aur phir sabka follow-up — jab tak deadline na aa jaaye. Ye ek chakra hai.

Figure 39.2. Ek meeting ka poora safar — har shabd apne verb ke saath: circulate the agenda, take the minutes, meet the deadline. Shabd Matlab Pakki jodi agenda meeting ke mudde set / circulate the agenda minutes meeting ka likhit record take / share the minutes deadline aakhri taarikh meet / miss / extend a deadline follow up (v) / follow-up (n) baad me pata karna follow up on the order stakeholder jiska is kaam me hit judaa key stakeholders deliverable jo cheez deni hai agree on the deliverables priority pehle kya a top priority · prioritise escalate upar tak le jaana escalate an issue delegate kaam saunpna delegate a task to someone bandwidth (bolchaal) waqt aur himmat I don't have the bandwidth.
  • I'll circulate the agenda by Monday evening. Somvaar shaam tak agenda sabko bhej dunga.
  • We're on track to meet the deadline. Hum deadline tak kaam poora kar lenge. (on track = sahi raaste par)
  • Could we extend the deadline to Friday? Deadline Friday tak badha sakte hain?
  • I'll follow up with the vendor and update everyone. Vendor se pata karke sabko bataunga.
  • We need sign-off from all the key stakeholders. Sabhi khaas logon ki manzoori chahiye. (sign-off = final haan)
  • If the client doesn't reply by Wednesday, let's escalate it. Budhvaar tak jawaab na aaye to upar baat karte hain.

follow up ya follow-up?

Verb = do shabd: I'll follow up tomorrow. Noun / adjective = hyphen: a follow-up email, a quick follow-up. Yahi niyam log in / login, set up / setup, back up / backup par. Kaam karna hai to do shabd; cheez ka naam hai to ek shabd.

✗

I will do the follow up and revert back.

✓

I'll follow up and get back to you.

follow up

Indian English ki aadatein

✗

We must finish before deadline.

✓

We must meet the deadline. / We must finish before the deadline.

deadline

meet the deadline

Meeting me bolne ki lines (interrupt karna, sehmat hona, kaam lena) Interview aur office me hain — yahan sirf shabd.

docs.title: 39.3 Technology
docs.text:
Tech ke zyaadatar shabd hum English me hi bolte hain, isliye galti shabd me nahi, verb aur preposition me hoti hai: log in to the app, download **from, upload to**.

Shabd Matlab Jodi download / upload utaarna / chadhaana upload a file to the drive log in / log out andar / bahar log in to your account sign up naya account banana sign up for a free trial update naya version install the latest update crash achanak band hona The app keeps crashing. freeze atak jaana (hang) My laptop froze. back up copy bachaakar rakhna back up your photos bandwidth net ki chaudaai low bandwidth outage service band a network outage encrypted code me band, surakshit end-to-end encrypted
  • I can't log in to the portal. It says my password has expired. Portal me login nahi ho raha — password expire ho gaya.
  • The app has been crashing since the last update. Pichhle update ke baad se app baar-baar band ho raha hai. ("since" ke saath has been + -ing; bina since: "It keeps crashing.")
  • Please back up your files before you install the update. Update se pehle files ki copy bana lo.
  • The video call keeps breaking up. I think my bandwidth is low. Call toot-toot ke aa raha hai — net dheema hai.
  • There was a nationwide outage, so payments failed for two hours. Poore desh me service band thi, do ghante payment fail hue.

✗

My laptop got hanged.

✓

My laptop froze. / My laptop hung.

hang

hung

froze

stopped responding

✗

I will login and check.

✓

I'll log in and check.

log in

login

your login details

the login page

✗

Please send me the soft copy.

✓

Please send me the file / a PDF.

the file, a digital copy, a printed copy / a printout

docs.title: 39.4 Environment — pollution se renewable tak
docs.text:
Environment ke shabd essays, news aur interviews — teeno me aate hain. Yahan parivaar wala niyam sabse zyada kaam aata hai: pollute (verb), pollution (noun), polluted (adj), pollutant (pradooshan wala padarth).

Shabd Matlab Jodi pollution pradooshan air / water / noise pollution emissions dhuaan, gas ka nikalna cut / reduce emissions carbon footprint aapki wajah se nikla carbon reduce your carbon footprint renewable khatam na hone wala renewable energy fossil fuels koyla, petrol, gas depend on fossil fuels sustainable lambe samay tak chal sake sustainable development deforestation jangal katna tackle deforestation biodiversity jeev-jantu ki vividhta loss of biodiversity climate change mausam ka lamba badlaav tackle / address climate change
  • Every winter, air pollution in Delhi reaches dangerous levels. Har sardi Delhi me pradooshan khatarnaak star tak pahunchta hai.
  • The AQI is over 400 today, so schools are closed. AQI = Air Quality Index. "over" = se zyada.
  • India wants to get half its electricity from renewable sources. Aadhi bijli renewable (solar, wind) se.
  • Electric buses could cut the city's emissions significantly. Electric bus se shahar ka dhuaan kaafi kam ho sakta hai.
  • Growth has to be sustainable, not just fast. Vikas lamba chalne wala ho, sirf tez nahi.

sustain ka parivaar

sustain (v) → sustainable (adj) → sustainability (n) → sustainably (adv) → unsustainable (ulta). "The current pace of growth is unsustainable" — essay ke liye ek majboot line.

✗

The pollution is very much in Delhi.

✓

Pollution is very high in Delhi. / Delhi's air is badly polluted.

high / low

docs.title: 39.5 Khabrein aur samaaj — economy, election, policy
docs.text:
Akhbaar padhna ho, news sunna ho ya essay likhna ho — ye shabd baar-baar aayenge. Inke saath badhne-ghatne wale verb bhi seekho: rise, fall, grow, drop, remain stable.

Shabd Matlab Jodi economy arthvyavastha the economy grew by 7% inflation mehngaai ki dar inflation rose / fell to 5% unemployment berozgaari high youth unemployment budget sarkaari aay-vyay present the budget election chunaav hold / win an election turnout kitne logon ne vote diya a record turnout policy niti announce / introduce a policy survey sarvekshan conduct a survey · the survey found… subsidy sarkaari chhoot a fuel subsidy
  • Inflation fell to four per cent last month. Pichhle mahine mehngaai dar 4% par aa gayi. (fell to = us star tak; fell by = itni kam hui)
  • The government has announced a new policy on electric vehicles. Sarkaar ne EV par nayi niti ghoshit ki.
  • Voter turnout was the highest in thirty years. Tees saal me sabse zyada matdaan hua.
  • A recent survey found that 60 per cent of young people want to work abroad. Survey found that — essay aur report ki pakki shuruaat.
  • The new tax is controversial; small traders strongly oppose it. Naya tax vivaadit hai — chhote vyapari khilaaf hain.

✗

Unemployment is an economical problem.

✓

Unemployment is an economic problem.

economic

economical

✗

The survey says 60% people use UPI daily.

✓

The survey found that 60% of people use UPI daily.

of

of

of

found / showed

docs.title: 39.6 Headline English — chhote shabd, bada matlab
docs.text:
Akhbaar ki headline apni hi grammar me likhi jaati hai: articles gaayab, present simple = beeta hua kal, to + verb = aane wala kal, aur chhote-chhote shabd. Inhe samajh liya to news bahut aasaan ho jaati hai.

Headline Poora matlab Trick RBI holds rates steady The RBI has kept interest rates unchanged. present = ho chuka Govt to launch EV policy The government is going to launch a policy. to = hone wala Floods hit Assam Floods have affected Assam. hit = asar daala Minister quits A minister has resigned. quit = istifa Prices soar Prices have risen sharply. soar = bahut badhna Talks fail Negotiations have failed. talks = baatcheet
  • RBI holds rates steady as inflation eases. Mehngaai kam hui, isliye RBI ne byaaj dar nahi badli. (ease = narm padna)
  • Govt to boost spending on rural roads. Sarkaar gaon ki sadkon par kharch badhaayegi. (boost = badhaana)
  • Heatwave grips north India; schools shut. Uttar Bharat me loo ka kehar, school band. (grip = jakad lena)

Headline ke chhote shabd

bid = koshish · curb = rokna/seemit karna · slam = kadi aalochna · probe = jaanch · row = vivaad · back = samarthan karna · axe = khatam karna. News sunne ki practice ke liye Asli duniya ki English dekho.

docs.title: 39.7 B2–C1 shabd — ek shabd, teen jodiyan
docs.text:
Ye das shabd meeting, news aur essay — teeno me kaam aate hain. Har ek ke saath uski jodi aur parivaar seekho; tabhi wo aapki apni English ka hissa banenge. (Bade verbs ke liye Verb upgrade aur Advanced shabd bhi dekho.)

Shabd (level) Matlab Jodi · parivaar significant (B2) kaafi bada, ahem a significant increase · significantly implement (B2) laagu karna implement a plan · implementation allocate (B2) baantna (paisa, samay) allocate funds · allocation mitigate (C1) asar kam karna mitigate the risk · mitigation unprecedented (C1) pehle kabhi nahi hua an unprecedented rise substantial (C1) bada, thos a substantial amount · substantially transparent (B2) khula, saaf a transparent process · transparency accountable (C1) jawaabdeh hold someone accountable · accountability viable (C1) chal sakne layak a viable option · viability scalable (C1) bada kiya ja sake a scalable solution · scale up
  • We need a backup supplier to mitigate the risk of delays. Der ka khatra kam karne ke liye ek aur supplier chahiye.
  • The city has allocated ₹200 crore to clean the river. Nadi saaf karne ke liye ₹200 crore rakhe gaye.
  • Leaders must be held accountable for their promises. Netaon ko apne vaadon ke liye jawaabdeh banana chahiye.
  • Solar power is now a viable option for most homes. Ab zyaadatar gharon ke liye solar ek chalne layak vikalp hai.
  • The pandemic caused an unprecedented shift to online work. Mahamari ne online kaam ki taraf aisa badlaav laaya jo pehle kabhi nahi hua.

Ek paragraph — chaaron vishay ek saath

  • At this week's meeting, the key stakeholders agreed to implement the new travel policy. Most meetings will now be online, which should cut emissions and save a substantial amount of money. A staff survey found that 70 per cent of employees support the change. Office (stakeholders, implement), environment (cut emissions), khabar (survey found) — aur ek C1 shabd (substantial).

docs.title: 39.8 Practice — Kaam aur duniya
docs.text:
Exercise 1

We're on track to ___ the deadline.

  • meet
  • do
  • reach
  • make

Hint: Deadline ki sabse pakki jodi.

Jawaab

meet

meet / miss / extend a deadline.

Exercise 2

I'll ___ up with the client tomorrow and let you know.

Hint: Baad me pata karna — do shabd ka verb.

Jawaab

follow

follow up (verb) — follow-up (noun): a follow-up email.

Exercise 3

Galat shabd par tap karo.

My laptop got hanged during the meeting.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: hanged.

Sahi roop: My laptop froze during the meeting.

Computer ke liye hung / froze. 'Hanged' sirf faansi ke liye.

Exercise 4

Sahi kaunsa hai?

  • I'll log in and check.
  • I'll login and check.
  • I'll do login and check.
  • I'll log-in and check.
Jawaab

I'll log in and check.

Verb = log in (do shabd). login = noun: login details.

Exercise 5

Shabd ko matlab se jodo.

A B emissions kitne logon ne vote diya renewable sarkaari chhoot turnout dhuaan aur gas ka nikalna subsidy khatam na hone wala Jawaab

emissions — dhuaan aur gas ka nikalna; renewable — khatam na hone wala; turnout — kitne logon ne vote diya; subsidy — sarkaari chhoot

emissions, renewable — environment; turnout, subsidy — khabron ke shabd.

Exercise 6

Ek shabd galat hai.

Unemployment is a serious economical problem.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: economical.

Sahi roop: Unemployment is a serious economic problem.

economic = arthvyavastha ka; economical = kifayati.

Exercise 7

A recent survey found that 60 per cent ___ young people want to work abroad.

Hint: Percentage ke baad chhota shabd.

Jawaab

of

60 per cent of people, half of the class.

Exercise 8

Headline: 'Govt to launch EV policy'. Iska matlab?

  • The government is going to launch it.
  • The government has launched it.
  • The government launched it last year.
  • The government refused to launch it.
Jawaab

The government is going to launch it.

Headline me 'to + verb' = aane wala kal.

Exercise 9

Electric buses could ___ the city's emissions.

  • cut
  • do
  • make
  • low
Jawaab

cut

cut / reduce emissions — pakki jodi.

Exercise 10

Inflation ke saath kya hua?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Here is the business news. Inflation fell to four point two per cent in September, the lowest level this year. Economists say lower food prices were the main reason. The central bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged next week.

  • It fell
  • It rose
  • It stayed the same
  • It doubled
Jawaab

It fell

'Inflation fell to four point two per cent' — gir kar 4.2% par aayi.

Exercise 11

Economists ke hisaab se main reason kya tha?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Here is the business news. Inflation fell to four point two per cent in September, the lowest level this year. Economists say lower food prices were the main reason. The central bank is expected to keep interest rates unchanged next week.

  • Lower food prices
  • Higher interest rates
  • Cheaper petrol
  • A new tax
Jawaab

Lower food prices

'lower food prices were the main reason' — khaane ki keemat kam hui.

Exercise 12

Minutes kaun bhejega?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Okay, let's wrap up. Priya will send the minutes by this evening. Arjun, can you follow up with the client about the budget? And just a reminder, the deadline for the first draft is Thursday.

  • Priya
  • Arjun
  • The client
  • Nobody
Jawaab

Priya

'Priya will send the minutes by this evening.'

Exercise 13

First draft ki deadline kab hai?

Ise zor se padho, ya kisi se padhwao:

Okay, let's wrap up. Priya will send the minutes by this evening. Arjun, can you follow up with the client about the budget? And just a reminder, the deadline for the first draft is Thursday.

  • Thursday
  • This evening
  • Tuesday
  • Next week
Jawaab

Thursday

'the deadline for the first draft is Thursday.'

Exercise 14

Suno aur likho.

Dictation. Kisi se ye vaakya zor se padhwao, phir likh lo.

Jawaab

The server crashed last night, so please back up your files.

crash = achanak band hona; back up (verb) do shabd me.

Exercise 15

'mitigate the risk' ka matlab?

  • khatre ka asar kam karna
  • khatra badhaana
  • khatre ko nazarandaaz karna
  • khatre ko maapna
Jawaab

khatre ka asar kam karna

mitigate (C1) = asar kam karna; noun: mitigation.

Exercise 16

Sahi kram me lagao.

Shabd: very / Pollution / Delhi / winter / in / high / is / this

Jawaab

Pollution is very high in Delhi this winter

Pollution 'high' hota hai, 'very much' nahi.

Exercise 17

Meeting me ye line bolo.

Jawaab

Bolo: Could we extend the deadline to Friday

extend a deadline — vinamra 'Could we…?' ke saath.

Aage kya padhein

In shabdon ko likhai me lagao: Essay aur report me poora dhaancha hai, aur CV aur LinkedIn me office ke action verbs. Roz ke shabdon ke liye Roz ke vishay.

docs.title: Chapter 10: Verb — kaam wale shabd
docs.text:
Verb — vaakya ka dil

Verb wo shabd hai jo kaam, hona ya haalat batata hai. Agar poori English grammar me ek hi cheez theek karni ho, to verb karo — kyunki tense, voice, agreement, question banana, sab verb par tikaa hai. Ye chapter thoda lamba hai, par iske baad bahut saare chapters apne aap aasaan lagne lagenge.

Ek line me

A verb shows an action, a state, an occurrence or possession. Kaam (action), haalat (state), kuch ghatna (occurrence), ya kisi cheez ka hona / paas hona (possession) — ye chaaron verb batata hai. Bina verb koi vaakya poora nahi hota.

  • She writes a letter. Action — kaam ho raha hai: wo chitthi likhti hai.
  • He is happy. State — koi kaam nahi, sirf haalat: wo khush hai.
  • It rained yesterday. Occurrence — kuch ghata, kisi ne kiya nahi: kal baarish hui.
  • They have a car. Possession — kisi ke paas kuch hai: unke paas gaadi hai.

docs.title: 10.1 Verb ke prakaar — poora ped
docs.text:
Verb ko kai tarah se baanta jaata hai, aur ye baantein ek doosre ke upar chalti hain. Ek hi verb ek saath "main verb", "transitive" aur "irregular" ho sakta hai — jaise write. Isliye ped ko mukaabla na samjho, chaar alag sawaal samjho.

Figure 10.1. Verb ko chaar sawaalon se dekho, ek bantwaare se nahi. Har sawaal alag jaankari deta hai.

docs.title: 10.2 Main verb aur Helping verb
docs.text:
Ek vaakya me asli matlab main verb deta hai. Uske saath aane wale chhote verb — is, am, are, has, have, will, do — tense, sawaal aur negative banane me madad karte hain. Inhe auxiliary ya helping verb kehte hain.

  • She is writing a letter. "writing" asli kaam hai; "is" sirf bata raha hai ki abhi chal raha hai.
  • Do you know him? Sawaal banane ke liye "do" aage aaya; matlab "know" me hi hai.
Helping verb Roop Kaam be is, am, are, was, were, been, being continuous aur passive banana have have, has, had perfect tense banana do do, does, did sawaal, negative, aur zor dena

Teeno khud bhi main verb ban sakte hain

I have a bike. — yahan "have" khud main verb hai. I have finished my work. — yahan "have" helping hai, "finished" main. Dekho ki uske baad doosra verb aa raha hai ya nahi — wahi faisla karta hai.

docs.title: 10.3 Modal verbs — jo kabhi badalte nahi
docs.text:
Modals wo helping verbs hain jo sambhavna, kshamta, anumati ya majboori batate hain. Inke do pakke niyam hain, aur dono yaad rakhna kaafi hai.

Modal ke do pakke niyam

1. Modal ke baad verb hamesha pehle roop me — bina -s, bina -ing, bina to. 2. Modal khud kabhi nahi badalta — na -s lagta hai, na -ed. ✓ She can swim. ✗ She cans swim. ✗ She can swims.

Modal Kya batata hai Example can kshamta, aam anumati I can drive. could pehle ki kshamta, politeness Could you help me? may formal anumati, sambhavna May I come in? might kam sambhavna It might rain today. will bhavishya, vaada I will call you. would politeness, kalpana I would like tea. shall sujhaav (formal) Shall we start? should salaah You should rest. must pakki majboori You must wear a helmet. ought to naitik zimmedari We ought to help them.

can aur could — anumati maangne me farq

Can I borrow your pen? — dosti me theek. Could I borrow your pen? — zyada vinamra, kisi bade ke saath. May I borrow your pen? — sabse formal, office ya interview me.

docs.title: 10.4 Transitive aur Intransitive — object leta hai ya nahi
docs.text:
Verb ke baad poochho "kya?" ya "kisko?". Agar jawaab milta hai, verb transitive hai. Agar jawaab ka koi matlab nahi banta, verb intransitive hai.

Verb Sawaal Jawaab Prakaar She wrote a poem. Kya likha? a poem ✓ Transitive He slept early. Kya soya? koi jawaab nahi ✗ Intransitive They helped us. Kisko? us ✓ Transitive The baby laughed. Kya hansa? jawaab nahi ✗ Intransitive

Kai verb dono hote hain

The bell rang. (intransitive) / She rang the bell. (transitive) The window broke. / He broke the window. Isliye verb ko list me nahi, vaakya me dekho.

Intransitive verb ke baad preposition chahiye hota hai

  • Galat: We will reach at Delhi at 9.
  • Sahi: We will reach Delhi at 9.

  • Kyun: "Reach" transitive hai — seedha object leta hai. Par "arrive" intransitive hai, isliye uske saath preposition zaroori: arrive in Delhi, arrive at the airport.

  • Galat: Let us discuss about the plan.

  • Sahi: Let us discuss the plan.
  • Kyun: "Discuss" transitive hai, isliye object seedha aata hai. Hindi me "ke baare me" hota hai, isliye "about" ghus jaata hai. Isi tarah: enter the room (not enter into), marry her (not marry with her).

docs.title: 10.5 Linking verbs — pul banane wale verb
docs.text:
Linking verb koi kaam nahi batata. Wo subject ko uski pehchaan ya haalat se jod deta hai — jaise ek pul.

Figure 10.2. Linking verb ke dono sirey ek hi cheez hote hain; action verb me kaam subject se nikal kar object par girta hai. Linking verb Example Dhyan be (is, am, are, was, were) He is busy. sabse aam seem, appear She seems tired. lagta hai become, get, turn, grow The sky turned dark. badalna feel, look, smell, sound, taste This tastes sweet. indriyon wale remain, stay He remained calm. bana rehna

Linking verb ke baad adjective, adverb nahi

✓ The food tastes good. ✗ The food tastes well. ✓ She looks beautiful. ✗ She looks beautifully. Kyunki ye verb subject ke baare me bata rahe hain, kaam ke baare me nahi. Subject noun hai → noun ko adjective chahiye.

docs.title: 10.6 Verb ke paanch roop
docs.text:
Har English verb ke paanch roop hote hain. Dictionary me aksar teen likhe jaate hain — V1, V2, V3 — aur yahi teen tense banane me kaam aate hain.

Roop Naam walk (regular) write (irregular) Kahan lagta hai V1 base walk write present, modal ke baad, to ke saath V1-s third person walks writes he / she / it ke saath V2 past simple walked wrote simple past V3 past participle walked written have/has/had ke baad, passive me V-ing present participle walking writing continuous tenses

Regular aur Irregular ka farq

Regular: V2 aur V3 dono me sirf -ed lagta hai — play → played → played. Irregular: shabd andar se badal jaata hai — go → went → gone. English me lagbhag 200 irregular verbs hain, par roz ke kaam ke liye 60-70 kaafi hain.

docs.title: Roz kaam aane wale irregular verbs
docs.text:
V1 V2 V3 V1 V2 V3 go went gone eat ate eaten see saw seen take took taken do did done give gave given come came come run ran run buy bought bought bring brought brought think thought thought teach taught taught speak spoke spoken break broke broken write wrote written drive drove driven begin began begun drink drank drunk put put put cut cut cut

V2 aur V3 ki jagah badal jaana

  • Galat: I have saw that movie.
  • Sahi: I have seen that movie.

  • Kyun: "have / has / had" ke baad hamesha V3 aata hai — seen, gone, done, written. V2 (saw) sirf akela past banane ke liye hai: I saw that movie.

  • Galat: He did not went to school.

  • Sahi: He did not go to school.
  • Kyun: "did" ne pehle se past bata diya — ab main verb pehle roop me hi rahega. Ek vaakya me past do baar nahi batate.

docs.title: 10.7 Finite aur Non-finite verb
docs.text:
Finite verb wo hai jo subject aur tense ke hisaab se badalta hai — yahi vaakya ka asli verb hota hai. Non-finite verb badalta nahi; wo noun ya adjective jaisa kaam karta hai.

Prakaar Roop Example Kaam Finite subject + tense ke saath badalta hai She plays. / They played. asli verb Infinitive to + V1 I want to sleep. noun jaisa Gerund V-ing, noun ki tarah Swimming is good exercise. noun jaisa Participle V-ing ya V3, adjective ki tarah a broken glass / a running train adjective jaisa

Ek vaakya me ek hi finite verb

I want to go home. — "want" finite hai, "to go" non-finite. Isliye tense sirf "want" par lagta hai: I wanted to go home. "to goed" kabhi nahi hota — ab wajah samajh aa gayi?

Preposition ke baad gerund, infinitive nahi

✓ She is good at singing. ✗ good at to sing ✓ I look forward to meeting you. ✗ to meet you Yahan "to" infinitive ka nahi, preposition hai — isliye -ing.

docs.title: 10.8 Stative verbs — jo continuous me nahi jaate
docs.text:
Kuch verb kaam nahi, haalat batate hain. Haalat chalti nahi, hoti hai — isliye inhe -ing me nahi daalte.

Shreni Verbs Soch know, think (maanna), believe, understand, remember, forget, mean Bhaav like, love, hate, want, need, prefer Indriyan see, hear, smell, taste (lagna) Maalikana have (rakhna), own, belong, possess Hona be, seem, appear, cost, weigh, contain

docs.title: 10.9 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Verb ki sabse aam Indian-English galtiyan

  • Galat: I am having a car.
  • Sahi: I have a car.

  • Kyun: Jab "have" ka matlab maalikana ho, wo stative verb hai — continuous me nahi jaata. "I am having" sirf tab theek hai jab kaam ho raha ho: I am having lunch (khana kha raha hoon), I am having a bath.

  • Galat: He don't know the answer.

  • Sahi: He doesn't know the answer.

  • Kyun: He / she / it third person singular hain, aur unka helping verb "does" hota hai. Aur dhyan do — "does" ke baad main verb pehle roop me: doesn't know, na ki doesn't knows.

  • Galat: I am agree with you.

  • Sahi: I agree with you.

  • Kyun: "Agree" khud ek poora verb hai — usse pehle "am" lagane ki zaroorat nahi. Hindi me "main sehmat hoon" me "hoon" aata hai, isliye "am" ghus jaata hai.

  • Galat: She is knowing the answer.

  • Sahi: She knows the answer.

  • Kyun: "Know" stative hai — jaanna ek haalat hai, kaam nahi. Isi liye "I am knowing", "I am understanding", "I am liking" teeno galat hain.

  • Galat: We discussed about the project yesterday.

  • Sahi: We discussed the project yesterday.

  • Kyun: "Discuss" transitive hai — object seedha leta hai, preposition ki zaroorat nahi. Isi list me: enter the hall, attend the meeting, answer the question, reach home.

  • Galat: One of my friend don't like coffee.

  • Sahi: One of my friends doesn't like coffee.

  • Kyun: Do galtiyan ek saath: "one of" ke baad plural noun (friends), par asli subject "one" hai — singular — isliye verb bhi singular: doesn't.

  • Galat: Please revert back to me soon.

  • Sahi: Please reply to me soon.

  • Kyun: "Revert" ka matlab hai purani haalat me laut jaana, jawaab dena nahi. Aur "back" dohraav hai. Office email me "please reply" ya "please get back to me" likho.

  • Galat: He can plays the guitar very well.

  • Sahi: He can play the guitar very well.
  • Kyun: Modal ke baad verb hamesha pehle roop me. Modal ne khud hi kaam sambhaal liya, ab verb ko -s ki zaroorat nahi.

docs.title: 10.10 Yaad rakhne ka chhota naksha
docs.text: Iske baad Verb ka roop Example he / she / it (present) V1 + s She goes. do / does / did V1 She didn't go. modal (can, will, must…) V1 She can go. have / has / had V3 She has gone. is / am / are / was / were V-ing (ya V3 passive me) She is going. to V1 She wants to go. preposition (at, of, in, for…) V-ing She is tired of waiting.

docs.title: 10.11 Practice — Verbs
docs.text:
Exercise 1

She ___ the answer to this question.

  • knows
  • is knowing
  • knowing
  • are knowing

Hint: Ye verb stative hai ya action?

Jawaab

knows

'Know' stative verb hai — jaanna ek haalat hai, chalu kaam nahi. Isliye use continuous me nahi daalte, chahe abhi ki baat ho.

Exercise 2

He ___ live in Mumbai anymore.

  • doesn't
  • don't
  • isn't
  • didn't

Hint: Third person singular ka negative.

Jawaab

doesn't

'He' third person singular hai, isliye helping verb 'does' lagta hai. 'don't' sirf I, you, we, they ke saath aata hai.

Exercise 3

I have ___ that film twice already.

  • seen
  • saw
  • see
  • seeing

Hint: 'have' ke baad kaunsa roop?

Jawaab

seen

have / has / had ke baad hamesha V3 (past participle) aata hai — seen. 'saw' V2 hai, wo akela past banane ke liye hai: I saw that film.

Exercise 4

Kaunsa vaakya sahi hai?

  • She can play the sitar.
  • She can plays the sitar.
  • She cans play the sitar.
  • She can to play the sitar.
Jawaab

She can play the sitar.

Modal ke baad verb pehle roop me aata hai, aur modal khud kabhi nahi badalta. Isliye na 'cans', na 'plays', na 'to play'.

Exercise 5

'The soup tastes ___.' — khaali jagah me kya aayega?

  • delicious
  • deliciously
  • deliciousness
  • tastily

Hint: 'taste' yahan linking verb hai.

Jawaab

delicious

Linking verb ke baad adjective aata hai, kyunki wo subject ke baare me bata raha hai — soup kaisa hai. Adverb tab aata jab kaam ka tareeka batana ho.

Exercise 6

I am looking forward to ___ you next week. (meet)

Hint: 'to' yahan preposition hai, infinitive nahi.

Jawaab

meeting

'look forward to' me 'to' preposition hai, aur preposition ke baad gerund (-ing) aata hai. Isi liye 'to meet' galat lagta hai yahan.

Exercise 7

He did not ___ to the office yesterday. (go)

Hint: 'did' ne past pehle hi bata diya.

Jawaab

go

'did' ke baad verb pehle roop me rehta hai, kyunki past 'did' me hi aa gaya. Ek vaakya me past do baar nahi batate.

Exercise 8

Is vaakya me galat shabd par tap karo.

I am having two brothers and one sister.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: having.

Sahi roop: I have two brothers and one sister.

Jab 'have' ka matlab rishta ya maalikana ho, wo stative hai — continuous me nahi jaata. 'I am having' sirf khane-peene jaise kaam me chalta hai.

Exercise 9

Galat shabd dhoondo.

We discussed about the new policy in the meeting.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: about.

Sahi roop: We discussed the new policy in the meeting.

'Discuss' transitive verb hai — object seedha leta hai. Hindi ke 'ke baare me' se 'about' aa jaata hai, par English me wo extra hai.

Exercise 10

'It rained heavily last night.' — yahan verb kya bata raha hai?

  • occurrence
  • possession
  • state
  • action

Hint: Kisi ne kuch kiya nahi, bas ho gaya.

Jawaab

occurrence

Baarish kisi ka kiya hua kaam nahi, ek ghatna hai — isliye occurrence. 'She writes' action hota, 'He is happy' state, aur 'They have a car' possession.

Exercise 11

Vaakya ko us cheez se jodo jo uska verb bata raha hai.

A B She writes a letter. occurrence He is happy. possession It rained yesterday. action They have a car. state Jawaab

She writes a letter. — action; He is happy. — state; It rained yesterday. — occurrence; They have a car. — possession

Verb chaar cheezein batata hai — kaam (action), haalat (state), ghatna (occurrence), aur kisi ke paas hona (possession).

Exercise 12

We ___ a big house in the village. (possession, present)

Hint: Kisi ke paas kuch hai.

Jawaab

have

Possession ke liye 'have / has' — We have, She has. Possession wala 'have' stative hai, isliye 'We are having a house' nahi bolte.

Exercise 13

Verb ke roop ko uski jagah se jodo.

A B have / has ke baad V-ing — going, writing modal ke baad V1 + s — goes, writes is / am / are ke baad V3 — gone, written he / she ke saath present me V1 — go, write Jawaab

have / has ke baad — V3 — gone, written; modal ke baad — V1 — go, write; is / am / are ke baad — V-ing — going, writing; he / she ke saath present me — V1 + s — goes, writes

Verb ka roop uske aage wale shabd se tay hota hai. Ye chaar jodiyan yaad ho gayin to aadha tense ka kaam ho gaya.

Exercise 14

Sahi kram me vaakya banao — modal ka istemaal hai.

Shabd: wear / must / helmet / riding / while / You / a

Jawaab

You must wear a helmet while riding

Kram hai: subject + modal + V1 + baaki. 'must' ke baad 'wear' pehle roop me rehta hai — 'wears' kabhi nahi.

Exercise 15

Ye line bol ke dekho — 'doesn't' ko ek hi saans me bolna hai.

Jawaab

Bolo: He doesn't know the answer

Bolte waqt hum 'does not' ko alag-alag bolte hain to 'he don't' ki aadat nahi tootti. 'doesn't' ko ek shabd ki tarah bolne se sahi roop automatic aata hai.

Aage kya karein

Roz paanch irregular verbs lo aur unke teeno roop zor se bolo — go went gone, see saw seen. Do hafte me saari list zubaan par aa jaayegi, aur phir tenses ka chapter aadha pehle se pata hoga.

docs.title: Chapter 36: Ek shabd se das shabd
docs.text:
Ek shabd se das shabd — prefix aur suffix ka jaadu

Vocabulary badhaane ka sabse sasta tareeka naye shabd ratna nahi hai — balki jo shabd aap pehle se jaante ho, unke rishtedaar pehchaanna hai. happy jaante ho? To aap unhappy, happiness, happily, unhappiness bhi jaante ho — bas pata nahi tha. Shuru me jude tukde (prefix) matlab badalte hain, aur ant me jude tukde (suffix) shabd ka kaam badalte hain. Is chapter ke baad har naya lamba shabd aapko tukdon me dikhega.

docs.title: 36.1 Ek jad, poora parivaar — word family
docs.text:
Ek shabd ke parivaar ko saath seekhne se do faayde hain: chaar shabd ek ki mehnat me, aur vaakya me sahi roop chunna aasaan. "He spoke happy" ya "Her happy was clear" jaisi galtiyan yahin se rukti hain.

Figure 36.1. Upar jaana (un-) = matlab ulta. Daayein-baayein jaana (-ness, -ly) = wahi matlab, naya kaam. Rang batata hai ki shabd noun hai, adjective hai ya adverb.
  • She looks happy. She smiled happily. Her happiness was clear. Ek hi jad, teen kaam: kaisi dikhti hai (adjective), kaise muskuraayi (adverb), kya dikha (noun).

Do tarah ke tukde

Prefix (shuru me) shabd ka matlab badalta hai: happy → unhappy. Suffix (ant me) shabd ka kaam badalta hai: happy (adj) → happiness (noun) → happily (adverb).

docs.title: 36.2 Prefix — shuru me jodo, matlab badlo
docs.text:
Saat prefix itne aam hain ki roz ki English ke saikdon shabd inhi se bante hain. Inka matlab yaad kar liya, to anjaan shabd ka andaaza bhi lag jaata hai — misread = galat padhna.

Prefix Matlab Examples un- nahi / ulta unhappy · unfair · unlock dis- nahi / ulta dislike · disagree · disconnect im- / in- nahi impossible · incorrect · invisible re- dobara / wapas redo · rewrite · return mis- galat tareeke se misunderstand · misspell · mislead pre- pehle preview · prepaid · preheat over- zaroorat se zyada overeat · overload · overconfident
  • I think you misunderstood me. Let me rephrase that. Aapne mujhe galat samjha. Main dobara, alag shabdon me kehta hoon.
  • Don't overcook the rice, and please preheat the oven. Chawal zyada mat pakaana, aur oven pehle se garam kar lo.

Prefix spelling nahi chheda karta

Prefix bas aage jud jaata hai — jad ki spelling wahi rehti hai. Isliye kabhi-kabhi do akshar saath aa jaate hain: un + necessary = unnecessary, mis + spell = misspell, dis + satisfied = dissatisfied.

docs.title: 36.3 Kaunsa "not" — un, dis, in, im, il, ir
docs.text:
Ulta matlab banane ke chhah prefix hain, aur yahi sabse zyada gadbad karte hain — "unpossible", "unregular". Achhi khabar: aadhe ka pakka niyam hai, aur wo niyam sirf jad ka pehla akshar dekhta hai.

Figure 36.2. Upar ke teen niyam bolne me aasaani ke liye bane hain — in-possible bolke dekho, zubaan khud im-possible kar degi.

Pehle akshar ka niyam

p, m, b → im- (impossible) · l → il- (illegal) · r → ir- (irregular). Baaki un- / dis- / in- ka niyam nahi — inhe shabd ke saath jodi me yaad karo. Shak ho to dictionary — "unpossible" jaisa shabd hota hi nahi.

docs.title: 36.4 Noun banane wale suffix — -tion, -ment, -ness
docs.text:
Formal English, emails aur reports noun se bhari hoti hain — "We decided" ki jagah "We made a decision". Teen suffix se zyaadatar noun ban jaate hain: kaam ka naam (-tion, -ment) aur gun ka naam (-ness).

Shabd → noun Suffix Example inform → information -tion Thanks for the information. educate → education -tion Education changes lives. decide → decision -sion It was a hard decision. develop → development -ment The city needs development. agree → agreement -ment We signed an agreement. pay → payment -ment The payment is due today. kind → kindness -ness Thank you for your kindness. happy → happiness -ness Money can't buy happiness.

Kaam ka naam, gun ka naam

Verb + -tion / -ment = noun (inform → information, agree → agreement). Adjective + -ness = noun (kind → kindness). Ant ka y, -ness se pehle i ban jaata hai: happy → happiness. Aur ant ka chup "e" aksar gir jaata hai: educate → education, decide → decision.

docs.title: 36.5 Adjective aur adverb — -ful, -less, -able, -ly
docs.text:
Ye chaar suffix description ki jaan hain. Ek hi noun se do ulte adjective ban jaate hain (-ful aur -less), aur unpar -ly lagao to wo verb ko describe karne lagte hain.

Figure 36.3. Ek jad, chaar shabd. Upar ka raasta dhyaan se , neeche ka laaparwaahi se . Suffix Matlab Examples -ful se bhara careful · useful · hopeful -less ke bina careless · useless · hopeless -able kiya ja sakta hai readable · washable · comfortable -ly adjective → adverb quickly · carefully · happily

Ek l, do l

-ful me hamesha ek hi l: careful, useful, beautiful — "carefull" nahi. Par uspar -ly lagao to do l aa jaate hain: careful + ly = carefully. Dhyaan do: friendly, lovely, lonely -ly par khatam hote hain par adjective hain — "a friendly person".

docs.title: 36.6 -ize aur kuch purani jadein
docs.text:
-ize noun ya adjective ko kaam (verb) bana deta hai — office English me ye har jagah hai. Aur bahut se lambe shabd purani Latin jadon se bane hain; ek jad pehchaan li, to poora guchha samajh aata hai.

Shabd + -ize = verb Example modern modernize We need to modernize the office. real realize I didn't realize it was so late. summary summarize Can you summarize the report? priority prioritize Let's prioritize the urgent tasks. apology apologize I apologize for the delay.

British spelling -ise (realise, apologise) bhi bilkul sahi hai, aur India me dono chalte hain. Bas ek document me ek hi rakho.

Figure 36.4. Ek jad, chhah shabd. Prefix ne disha di (im = andar, ex = bahar, re = wapas), jad ne kaam (le jaana). Jad Matlab Shabd port le jaana transport · export · portable dict bolna predict · dictionary · contradict spect dekhna, dhyaan se inspect · respect · spectator vis / vid dekh paana visible · vision · video scrib / script likhna describe · script · subscribe

Lamba shabd? Tod ke padho

Prefix + jad + suffix: in-spect-ion = andar dekhne ka kaam (jaanch); pre-dict-able = pehle se bola ja sake. Anjaan shabd ko tukdon me todo — aadha matlab khud nikal aayega.

docs.title: 36.7 Chhah parivaar — ek table me
docs.text:
Ye wo parivaar hain jinke roop sabse zyada galat lagte hain. Har line ko left se right zor se padho — ek baar me chaar shabd pakke ho jaayenge.

Verb Noun Adjective Adverb decide decision decisive decisively succeed success successful successfully create creation creative creatively care care careful carefully differ difference different differently attract attraction attractive attractively
  • She succeeded because she worked carefully. Her success was no accident. Teen parivaar, teen kaam — verb ke saath adverb, akela noun.

Notebook ki aadat

Naya shabd likho to uske saath uska poora parivaar bhi likho — verb, noun, adjective, adverb. Jo khaana khaali rahe (jaise "differ" ka koi aam adverb), wo bhi ek jaankari hai.

docs.title: 36.8 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Ye galtiyan isliye hoti hain ki hum jad sahi chunte hain par roop galat — noun ki jagah verb, adverb ki jagah adjective, ya galat "not" wala prefix.

Word formation ki aam galtiyan

  • Galat: This is unpossible.
  • Sahi: This is impossible.

  • Kyun: "possible" p se shuru hota hai → im-. Isi tarah unregular → irregular, unlegal → illegal.

  • Galat: Her behave in the meeting was rude.

  • Sahi: Her behaviour in the meeting was rude.

  • Kyun: "Her ___ was" ke beech noun chahiye. behave = verb, behaviour (US: behavior) = noun.

  • Galat: He answered very confident.

  • Sahi: He answered very confidently.

  • Kyun: Verb (answered) ko describe karne ke liye adverb: -ly. "He is confident" me adjective theek hai.

  • Galat: I am very boring in this class.

  • Sahi: I am very bored in this class.

  • Kyun: -ed = aapki feeling (bored, tired, interested). -ing = jo feeling deta hai (a boring class). "I am boring" = main bore karta hoon!

  • Galat: Can you repeat it again?

  • Sahi: Can you repeat it? / Can you say it again?
  • Kyun: re- ka matlab hi "dobara" hai — "repeat again" = dobara dobara. Isi tarah "revert back" me "back" faltu hai.

docs.title: 36.9 Practice — Word formation
docs.text:
Exercise 1

'possible' ka ulta kya hai?

  • impossible
  • unpossible
  • dispossible
  • nonpossible
Jawaab

impossible

Jad 'p' se shuru hoti hai, isliye im-. Yaad rakho: p, m, b → im-.

Exercise 2

'regular' ka ulta kya hai?

  • irregular
  • unregular
  • disregular
  • misregular
Jawaab

irregular

Jad 'r' se shuru → ir-. Isi tarah irrelevant, irresponsible.

Exercise 3

In me se adverb kaunsa hai?

  • happily
  • happiness
  • unhappy
  • happy
Jawaab

happily

-ly adjective ko adverb bana deta hai: happy → happily. happiness noun hai, unhappy adjective.

Exercise 4

Please drive ___. The road is wet. (care)

Hint: Verb 'drive' ko describe karna hai — adverb chahiye.

Jawaab

carefully

care → careful (adjective) → carefully (adverb). Do l, kyonki careful + ly.

Exercise 5

We need to make a ___ by Friday. (decide)

Hint: 'a' ke baad noun.

Jawaab

decision

decide → decision. Ant ka 'de' '-sion' ban jaata hai. 'make a decision' pakki jodi hai.

Exercise 6

Thank you for your ___. (kind)

Hint: 'your' ke baad noun — gun ka naam.

Jawaab

kindness

Adjective + -ness = noun: kind → kindness, dark → darkness.

Exercise 7

Is vaakya me ek shabd ka roop galat hai — us par tap karo.

Her behave in the meeting was very rude.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: behave.

Sahi roop: Her behaviour in the meeting was very rude.

'Her ___ was' me noun chahiye — behave verb hai, behaviour noun.

Exercise 8

Galat prefix wala shabd dhoondo.

Finishing this by tonight is unpossible.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: unpossible.

Sahi roop: Finishing this by tonight is impossible.

'possible' p se shuru → im-possible. 'unpossible' shabd hi nahi hai.

Exercise 9

Prefix ko uske matlab se jodo.

A B re- pehle mis- zaroorat se zyada pre- dobara over- galat tareeke se Jawaab

re- — dobara; mis- — galat tareeke se; pre- — pehle; over- — zaroorat se zyada

rewrite = dobara likhna, misread = galat padhna, preview = pehle dekhna, overeat = zyada khaana.

Exercise 10

Jad ko uske matlab se jodo.

A B port dekhna dict likhna spect le jaana scrib bolna Jawaab

port — le jaana; dict — bolna; spect — dekhna; scrib — likhna

transport (le jaana), predict (pehle bolna), inspect (andar dekhna), describe (likh ke batana).

Exercise 11

Sahi kram me lagao.

Shabd: all / confidently / She / questions / the / answered

Jawaab

She answered all the questions confidently

Adverb (confidently) verb ke kaam ko describe karta hai, aur aksar vaakya ke ant me aata hai.

Exercise 12

Ye vaakya bolo — har shabd ka poora suffix saaf sunao.

Jawaab

Bolo: It was a careful and creative decision

'careful' ka -ful halka bolo (kair-fl), aur 'decision' me zor beech par: di-SI-zhn.

Aage kya karein

Aaj ki akhbaar ya kisi bhi article se paanch lambe shabd chuno aur unhe prefix + jad + suffix me todo. Phir har ek ka parivaar likho. Das minute, aur vocabulary chupchaap badh jaayegi.

docs.title: Chapter 50: Email likhna
docs.text:
Email likhna — saaf, chhota, aur kaam ka

Office me aapki pehchaan aksar aapke email se banti hai — bahut se log aapse milne se pehle aapka email padhte hain. Achha email lamba ya bhaari-bharkam nahi hota. Wo padhne wale ka samay bachaata hai: pehli do line me bata deta hai ki aap kaun ho, kyun likh rahe ho, aur unse kya chahiye.

Ek line me

A good email tells the reader, in the first two lines, why you are writing and what you need from them — and by when. Maqsad pehle, kahaani baad me. Padhne wale ko andaaza na lagana pade.

Figure 50.1. Har professional email ke chhe hisse. Is chapter me hum ek-ek karke sabko banayenge.

Email ke chhe hisse

Subject → Greeting → Opening line → Body → Call to action → Sign-off. Har hissa ek kaam karta hai. Koi ek bhi chhoot jaaye to email adhoora ya rukha lagta hai.

docs.title: 50.1 Formal ya informal — pehle reader ko pehchano
docs.text:
Ek hi baat boss ko, client ko aur dost ko alag tarah likhi jaati hai. Galat tone — bahut rukha ya bahut dostana — sahi grammar ke baad bhi galat chhaap chhodti hai.

Figure 50.2. Jitna upar jaoge, utne kam emoji, kam contractions aur zyada poore vaakya.

Ek seedha test

Kya aap is insaan ko unke first name se bulaate ho? Haan → "Hi Priya". Nahi, ya pata nahi → "Dear Mr Sharma". Shak ho to thoda zyada formal rehna safe hai — jawaab me wo "Hi Arjun" likhein, to aap bhi badal lo.

Hissa Formal (boss, client, naya contact) Informal (colleague, dost) Greeting Dear Mr Sharma, Hi Priya, Opener I am writing to… · Thank you for your email. Hope you're well! · Quick one — Shabd I would like to… · Could you please… Can you… · I'd love to… Contractions Kam: I am, do not Theek hain: I'm, don't Emoji, "!!!" Bilkul nahi Kabhi-kabhi, sambhal ke Sign-off Kind regards, · Best regards, Thanks, · Cheers, · Best,

docs.title: 50.2 Subject line — email khulega ya nahi, yahi tay karta hai
docs.text:
Inbox me sau email hon, to log subject padhkar hi tay karte hain ki kaunsa abhi kholna hai. "Regarding" ya "Urgent!!!" jaisi subject line kuch nahi batati — aur aksar baad ke liye chhod di jaati hai.

Figure 50.3. Wahi teen log, wahi teen email — sirf subject line badli.

Subject line ka formula

Topic + action ya date, 4–8 shabd me. Padhne wale ko email khole bina samajh aa jaaye ki ye kis baare me hai aur unhe kya, kab tak karna hai.

Kamzor subject Saaf subject Regarding leave Leave request: 12–14 March (family wedding) URGENT!!! Approval needed by Friday: vendor invoice Hi Notes from Q3 sales review, 4 October Query Question about delivery date for order 4521 Meeting Can we move Monday's review to 3 pm? Fwd: Fwd: Re: Re: update Updated budget — final figures attached

docs.title: 50.3 Shuruaat aur ant — greeting, opener, sign-off
docs.text:
Email ki pehli aur aakhri line tone tay karti hain. "Respected Sir" school ki application jaisa lagta hai, aur bina sign-off ka email rukha. Business email ke apne seedhe niyam hain.

Greeting ka niyam

Business email me "Respected Sir" nahi — "Dear Mr Sharma" ya "Dear Ms Rao". Mr/Ms ke baad surname, first name nahi: "Dear Mr Verma", not "Dear Mr Rahul". First name se bulaate ho to seedha "Hi Rahul".

Greeting Kab Dear Mr Sharma, Formal, naam pata hai Dear Ms Rao, Formal, mahila — Ms; Mrs/Miss tabhi jab wo khud likhti hon Dear Dr Iyer, Doctor ya PhD — Dr + surname Dear Hiring Manager, Naam pata nahi, par role pata hai Dear Sir or Madam, Na naam, na role — aakhri option Hi Priya, · Hello Priya, Colleague, ya jinhe first name se bulaate ho Hi team, · Hi all, Poore group ko
  • I am writing to request a short meeting next week. Sabse saaf opener — pehli hi line me maqsad.
  • Thank you for your quick reply. Jawaab dete waqt — garmjoshi bhi, seedhapan bhi.
  • Following up on our call this morning, here are the next steps. Pichhli baat-cheet se jodne ke liye.
Sign-off Kab Kind regards, · Best regards, Lagbhag har professional email Yours sincerely, Formal letter jo naam se shuru hua (Dear Ms Rao) Yours faithfully, Formal letter jo "Dear Sir or Madam" se shuru hua Thanks, · Many thanks, Jab aapne kuch maanga ho Best, · Cheers, Colleague, informal

docs.title: 50.4 Body aur call to action — kaam ki baat
docs.text:
Body me sirf utna likho jitna padhne wale ko faisla lene ke liye chahiye. Aur email ka ant ek saaf maang par karo — warna jawaab aata hai, "Theek hai, par karna kya hai?"

  • Ek email, ek maqsad Do alag kaam hain (leave aur budget)? Do alag email bhejo — dono ka jawaab jaldi aayega.
  • Chhote paragraph — 2 se 3 line Phone par lamba paragraph deewar jaisa dikhta hai. Teen se zyada cheezein hon to bullet points.
  • Taarikh ke saath din "Tuesday, 13 October" — galti ki gunjaaish hi nahi bachti.

Call to action = kaun + kya + kab tak

"Could you please send the signed copy by Friday, 5 pm?" — padhne wale ko sochna na pade ki ab karna kya hai. Ek email me ek hi mukhya maang rakho.

Dheela ant Saaf call to action Please do the needful. Could you please approve the invoice by Thursday? Waiting for your reply. Please let me know by Friday if 3 pm suits you. Revert ASAP. Could you send the figures by 4 pm? The client call is at 5. Let me know. Which of the two dates works better for you?
  • Could you please send the signed copy by Friday? Vinamra (could you please), saaf (signed copy), aur samay-seema (by Friday).

docs.title: 50.5 Model: ek poora formal email
docs.text:
Ab sab hisse ek saath. Arjun ek interior company me kaam karta hai aur ek client se site visit ki taarikh badalwana chahta hai. Dhyan do ki har line kya kaam kar rahi hai.

Model: formal email — client ko

Subject: Site visit — can we move it to Tuesday, 13 October?

Dear Mr Deshpande,

I am writing to ask if we can move Thursday's site visit to Tuesday, 13 October, at the same time (11 am).

The kitchen cabinets for your flat will now reach us on Monday. If we visit on Tuesday, you can see them installed rather than in boxes, and approve the finish on the spot.

Could you please confirm by Friday whether Tuesday works for you? If it does not, Wednesday morning is also free.

Kind regards, Arjun Nair Project Coordinator, Brightline Interiors

  • Subject — sawaal + nayi taarikh Mr Deshpande inbox me hi samajh jaate hain ki kya poochha gaya hai.
  • Dear Mr Deshpande, Client hai, rishta formal hai — Dear + Mr + surname, aur ant me comma.
  • I am writing to ask… Pehli line me hi maqsad. "Greetings of the day" ya apna parichay nahi.
  • Body — wajah, aur client ka fayda Sirf "hamari majboori" nahi, balki "aapko kya milega" — isse haan jaldi milti hai.
  • Could you please confirm by Friday… Call to action: kya (confirm) + kab tak (Friday) + ek backup option.
  • Kind regards + poora naam + pad Padhne wale ko pata hai ki kaun likh raha hai aur kis company se.

docs.title: 50.6 Model: ek poora informal email
docs.text:
Colleague ko email bhi email hi hai — par tone halki hoti hai. Dekho ki dostana hone ke baad bhi maang utni hi saaf hai.

Model: informal email — colleague ko

Subject: Your slides for Monday + lunch on Friday?

Hi Priya,

Hope your week's going well!

Quick one: could you send me your three slides for Monday's review by Thursday evening? I'll put the full deck together on Friday morning.

Also, a few of us are trying the new dosa place near the office for lunch on Friday. Want to join?

Thanks, Kabir

  • Hi Priya, · Hope your week's going well! First name, contraction (week's), ek exclamation — colleague ke liye bilkul theek.
  • Quick one: could you send… Dostana, par kaam ki baat pehle — aur deadline (Thursday evening) ke saath.
  • Also, … Want to join? Informal email me ek chhoti doosri baat chal jaati hai — par kaam ke baad, pehle nahi.
  • Thanks, Kabir Sirf first name. Pad aur company ki zaroorat nahi — Priya jaanti hai.

docs.title: 50.7 Purane phrases jo ab retire karne hain
docs.text:
Ye phrases Indian offices me dashakon se chal rahe hain, aur galat English bhi nahi hain — bas purane hain. Aaj ke international aur naye Indian offices me ye bhaari, adhoore ya thode rukhe lagte hain.

Purana phrase Dikkat Aaj ka roop Please do the needful. Kya karna hai, ye batata hi nahi Could you please approve the leave by Friday? Kindly revert back. revert = wapas jaana; "back" do baar Please reply. · Please let me know. PFA Short form, rukha lagta hai I have attached the report. Please find attached herewith… "herewith" faltu aur purana Please find the report attached. Thanks and regards (har email me) Thanking you ke saath do baar shukriya Best regards, — ya sirf Thanks, Greetings of the day! Kuch nahi kehta, jagah gherta hai I hope you are well. — ya seedha kaam Respected Sir, School application jaisa Dear Mr Sharma, Thanking you in anticipation. Purana, thoda dabaav wala Thank you for your help.

Purane phrase ki jagah — seedhi maang

In sab ka ek hi ilaaj hai: phrase ki jagah wo likho jo aapko sach me chahiye. "Do the needful" ki jagah wo kaam likho. "Revert" ki jagah "reply". Agar koi senior aaj bhi ye phrases use kare to unhe tokna nahi — bas apne email me naya roop rakho.

docs.title: 50.8 Wo galtiyan jo hum sach me karte hain
docs.text:
Ye galtiyan har roz Indian inboxes me dikhti hain. Inme se zyadatar Hindi se seedhe anuvaad ki wajah se aati hain — aur ek baar pehchaan li, to phir kabhi nahi hongi.

Email ki asli galtiyan

  • Galat: Myself Rahul from the accounts team.
  • Sahi: I am Rahul from the accounts team.

  • Kyun: "Myself" akela subject nahi ban sakta — wo sirf "I did it myself" jaise vaakyon me aata hai.

  • Galat: Dear Mr Rahul,

  • Sahi: Dear Mr Verma, · Hi Rahul,

  • Kyun: Mr/Ms ke saath surname. First name chahiye to Mr hatao aur "Hi" lagao.

  • Galat: I have send the file yesterday.

  • Sahi: I sent the file yesterday.

  • Kyun: "Yesterday" = beeta hua khaas samay → simple past (sent). "have" ke saath V3 aata hai: have sent — par yesterday ke saath nahi.

  • Galat: Waiting for your positive reply.

  • Sahi: I look forward to hearing from you.

  • Kyun: "Positive reply" padhne wale par dabaav daalta hai, aur "waiting" be-sabri jaisa lagta hai.

  • Galat: Hi Sir, please send the details asap!!!

  • Sahi: Dear Mr Kumar, could you please send the details by 3 pm today?
  • Kyun: "Hi Sir" na formal hai na informal. "ASAP" kuch nahi batata, aur "!!!" chillane jaisa padhta hai — samay likho.

docs.title: 50.9 Practice — Emails
docs.text:
Exercise 1

Manager ko leave ke liye email — sabse achhi subject line kaunsi?

  • Leave
  • Leave request: 12–14 March (family wedding)
  • URGENT!!! Please read
  • Regarding leave matter kindly see
Jawaab

Leave request: 12–14 March (family wedding)

Subject me topic + dates + chhoti wajah — manager ko email khole bina pata chal jaata hai ki kya chahiye aur kab.

Exercise 2

Aap client Anil Kapoor se kabhi mile nahi. Pehle email me greeting kya hogi?

  • Dear Mr Kapoor
  • Respected Sir
  • Hey Anil
  • Dear Mr Anil
Jawaab

Dear Mr Kapoor

Naam pata hai, rishta naya hai — to 'Dear' + Mr + surname. 'Mr Anil' galat hai: Mr ke baad surname aata hai, first name nahi.

Exercise 3

Inme se sabse saaf call to action kaunsa hai?

  • Please do the needful.
  • Waiting for your reply.
  • Could you please approve the invoice by Thursday?
  • Revert ASAP.
Jawaab

Could you please approve the invoice by Thursday?

Achha call to action batata hai kya karna hai (approve), kis cheez ko (invoice) aur kab tak (Thursday). Baaki teen me se koi bhi ye nahi batata.

Exercise 4

'Yours faithfully' kab likhte hain?

  • Jab greeting 'Dear Sir or Madam' ho, yaani naam pata na ho
  • Dost ko informal email me
  • Har email ke ant me
  • Jab boss ka naam pata ho
Jawaab

Jab greeting 'Dear Sir or Madam' ho, yaani naam pata na ho

British niyam: naam pata ho (Dear Ms Rao) to Yours sincerely ya Kind regards. Naam pata na ho (Dear Sir or Madam) to Yours faithfully.

Exercise 5

Colleague ko chhote informal email ka sabse natural sign-off?

  • Thanks
  • Yours faithfully
  • Thanking you in anticipation
  • Yours obediently
Jawaab

Thanks

Colleague ke saath 'Thanks,' ya 'Cheers,' + first name kaafi hai. Baaki teen formal letter ke hain — ya bilkul purane.

Exercise 6

Ek shabd bilkul faltu hai — us par tap karo.

Kindly revert back with your comments by Monday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: back.

Sahi roop: Please reply with your comments by Monday.

'Revert' ka matlab hi hai wapas aana — 'back' se baat do baar ho gayi. Aaj ki business English me 'reply' ya 'let me know' zyada saaf hai.

Exercise 7

Galat shabd dhoondo.

I have send the invoice to your team yesterday.

Jawaab

Galat shabd: send.

Sahi roop: I sent the invoice to your team yesterday.

'Yesterday' = beeta hua khaas samay, isliye simple past: sent. 'have send' to kabhi sahi nahi — 'have' ke saath V3 'sent' aata.

Exercise 8

PFA ki jagah poora likho: Please find the report ___.

Jawaab

attached

PFA jaise short forms har koi nahi samajhta. 'Please find the report attached' — ya aur bhi seedha: 'I have attached the report.'

Exercise 9

Naam na pata ho to formal greeting: Dear Sir or ___,

Jawaab

Madam

'Dear Sir or Madam' — kyunki padhne wala koi bhi ho sakta hai. Sirf 'Dear Sir' maan leta hai ki padhne wala aadmi hi hai.

Exercise 10

Purane phrase ko uske aaj ke roop se jodo.

A B Please do the needful I have attached the file Kindly revert back I hope you are well PFA Dear Mr Rao Greetings of the day Could you please approve it by Friday? Respected Sir Please reply Jawaab

Please do the needful — Could you please approve it by Friday?; Kindly revert back — Please reply; PFA — I have attached the file; Greetings of the day — I hope you are well; Respected Sir — Dear Mr Rao

Har naya roop seedha hai: jo chahiye wo saaf bolo, short forms hatao, aur school wali formal bhasha office me mat lao.

Exercise 11

Sahi kram me call to action banao.

Shabd: the / Friday? / copy / please / send / by / you / Could / signed

Jawaab

Could you please send the signed copy by Friday?

Could you please + verb (send) + kya (the signed copy) + kab tak (by Friday) — vinamra bhi, saaf bhi.

Exercise 12

Email ki opening line bolkar dekho.

Jawaab

Bolo: I am writing to request a short meeting next week.

'I am writing to…' sabse saaf opener hai — pehli hi line me email ka maqsad bata deta hai. Phone par bhi yahi kaam aata hai: 'I am calling to…'

Aage kya karein

Agla email bhejne se pehle teen sawaal poochho: kya subject padhkar kaam samajh aata hai? Kya pehli line me maqsad hai? Kya ant me saaf maang aur taarikh hai? Teeno haan — tab Send dabao.
